循环的,慷慨的,旋转的,有叶片的

source: Circles of limestone, porous and oyster-gray with the shells of old things, are arranged in vertical slabs and turned against each other to grind fibrous grains into flours.
translation: 一圈圈石灰岩多孔而呈牡蛎灰，嵌着古物的壳，被排列成竖直石板，彼此相对转动，把纤维谷粒磨成面粉。
厨师,炊事者,谷物,饥饿者

source: Wood paddles black with wet-rot catch the force of the babbling brook and set the wheel to the slow motion of centuries.
translation: 湿腐发黑的木桨接住潺潺溪流的力量，让水轮进入世纪般缓慢的运动。
循环的,慷慨的,水文的,丰盛的,挥霍的,补充者,旋转者
发条装置,工程师,磨坊主

source: A burnished steel jacket hugs a smoldering fire pit. Scorchstrokes of many materials cake its sides.
translation: 抛光钢外壳贴抱着闷燃火坑。许多材料留下的焦痕结在炉壁上。

source: A cased rotor is fed charge through a handcrank and supplemented by solar heat. Its scratched metal surfaces vibrate at ground frequency.
translation: 带壳转子通过手摇曲柄输入电荷，并由太阳热量补充。划痕累累的金属表面以地频振动。
慷慨的,丰盛的,微星的,充足的,强效的,挥霍的,补充者

translation: 电器,能量电池,电网,耗竭者,插接者,渴电者,修补匠

source: Induction coils are rooted under a cork pad, where electric juice is transferred to battery cells.
translation: 感应线圈扎根在软木垫下方，电汁在那里转移进电池芯。
高斯的,感应的,强效的,补充者,恢复者
能量电池,耗竭者,激光脑袋,渴电者,修补匠

source: Magnetized steel drives a diaphragm upward and life water is propelled through chrome pipes to thirsty plants.
translation: 磁化钢驱动隔膜向上，生命之水被推过铬管，送往饥渴的植物。
水性的,慷慨的,丰盛的,滋养的,充足的,带水者
带{{M|Q 女孩}}{{Y|摆锤}}的巴拉瑟姆钟

source: Q Girl replaced the old oscillator on this Barathrum clock with a swing pendulum. Now the several hours per day that Time cheats from its observers are reduced to mere minutes.
translation: Q 女孩把这座巴拉瑟姆钟上的旧振荡器换成了摆锤。如今时间每天从观察者那里偷走的数小时，被缩减成了区区几分钟。

source: During the enterprise of invention, you sometimes require the use of a shapeless gray foam. Or, at the very least, you might require it one day, and so some tinker prudently got ahead of the problem and invented the brass foaminator. Inscribed on the base: 'All the foam, none of the sadness at maybe one day needing foam and not having it'.
translation: 在发明事业中，你有时需要使用一团无定形灰色泡沫。或者至少有一天你可能会需要，于是某个修补匠审慎地抢在问题前面，发明了黄铜发泡器。底座上刻着：“泡沫管够，再也没有某天可能需要泡沫却没有泡沫的悲伤”。

source: Gas is pushed through a hose and ignited into flame. Dew gives texture to the hose barbs.
translation: 气体被推过软管并点燃成火焰。露水让软管倒刺显出质感。

source: Rubber lines the inner topology of a motorized barrel. A kettle of ebon carbide grit sits in the underchamber ready to abrade.
translation: 橡胶衬在电动滚筒的内部拓扑上。下腔里放着一锅黑碳化物砂砾，随时准备磨蚀。

source: Handwheel and spindle turn to sand off matter and gift the world with helices and round things. Metal dust accrues on the ground beneath.
translation: 手轮与主轴转动，磨去物质，把螺旋和圆形之物赠予世界。金属尘积在下方地面上。

source: Photovoltaics are arrayed across two socketed lunes. They spin for optimal range and confer sun energy to a vacuum-cased flywheel.
translation: 光伏件排列在两个带插座的弦月件上。它们旋转以取得最佳范围，并把太阳能传给真空封壳的飞轮。
晒日者,趋光的,光伏的,充足的,补充者
电器,电池,电网,耗竭者,插接者,修补匠

source: Sunrays are captured by photovoltaics across the foundation around a chrome cylinder, and the heat is used to pump water into pipes for dispersal.
translation: 铬柱周围基座上的光伏件捕获日光，热量被用来把水泵入管道以便分散。
淋巴的,流动的,补充者,晒日者,趋光的,光伏的,充足的
液压装置,流动,流体,修补匠

source: Wired metal squares a cabinet of drawers and burners for toasting, pickling, and freeze-drying.
translation: 布线金属围成一只带抽屉和炉头的柜体，用于烘烤、腌渍和冷冻干燥。

source: Shelves, pads, slates, and cradles are worked from metal like a chrome honeycomb. Electrical power gets concentrated into battery-juice and served into its docked cells.
translation: 架板、垫片、薄板和托座都由金属加工而成，像一只铬蜂巢。电力浓缩成电池汁，注入对接的电池芯。
普适的,强效的,补充者,恢复者
能量电池,耗竭者,激光脑袋,渴电者,修补匠

source: Perfect-cut chrome rotors are stacked along a generator shaft, and wide fin blades catch the fluid push and spin electric yarn.
translation: 完美切削的铬转子沿发电机轴堆叠，宽大的鳍叶接住流体推力，纺出电线。
水性的,丰盛的,滋养的,充足的,补充者

source: Down a traverse beam of plate shear metal thrusts a hydraulic piston. Its flat bottom is scratched into grooves by bits of trash.
translation: 一只液压活塞沿板剪金属的横梁向下冲压。平坦底面被垃圾碎片划出沟槽。
压缩者,碾碎者,压平者,砸碎者,挤压者

source: Inside the glass and steel chassis, a sea of force fluid churns in turbulence. It's then pulverized into solid matter by the dynamo and projected into space as a field.
translation: 在玻璃与钢制底盘内，一片力流体之海湍乱翻搅。随后它被发电机粉碎成固态物质，并作为力场投射到空间中。

source: Four flanged couplings form a cross with a wavegraph readout at the center. As liquids and gases pipe through, flux readings appear in neon strings.
translation: 四个带法兰的联轴器组成十字，中央有波形图读数。液体和气体从管中通过时，通量读数以霓虹字符串显现。

source: Two copper bulbs form a spark gap that facilitates current along a path of ionized gas. The thing snaps and sparks at you.
translation: 两个铜泡形成火花间隙，促使电流沿电离气体路径流动。这东西朝你噼啪放出火花。

source: Inside a metal chassis, amber glyphs ride the scanlines painted by a cathode ray. Frustum keys are arranged in quiet rows.
translation: 在金属底盘内，琥珀色字形乘着阴极射线绘出的扫描线。截锥形按键安静地排成一行行。

source: Magnetized innards digest electrical signals and belch out the waveform, while a diaphragm breaths dust onto a brass grill.
translation: 磁化内脏消化电信号，打嗝般吐出波形，而隔膜把尘土呼到黄铜格栅上。

source: Soda ash and limestone flow down a series of hot crucibles and canals toward the batch blanket, where glass is then retrieved and refined.
translation: 纯碱和石灰岩沿一系列炽热坩埚与沟渠流向配合料毯，玻璃随后在那里被取出并精炼。

source: A glinting spindle of steel is spiraled with grooves for stripping wire from raw nuggets and ingots.
translation: 一根闪亮钢轴绕着螺旋沟槽，用于从原矿块和锭块上剥拉出线材。

source: Metal was braided into electromagnetic scaffolding, and through it the modulator molds the clay of the baseband and divulges the shape of the new signal.
translation: 金属被编成电磁脚手架，调制器借它塑造基带的黏土，并泄露新信号的形状。
全支持的,慷慨的,丰盛的,充足的,强效的,挥霍的,射频的,补充者,传输的,无线的
电器,盘绕者,耗竭者,渴电者,接收者,修补匠

source: Bits of tiny matter are smashed together behind the lune of a chrome cylinder, and the heat is used to pump electricity downgrid.
translation: 微小物质碎片在铬柱弦月件后方彼此撞合，产生的热被用来向下游电网泵送电力。
全支持的,火心的,慷慨的,丰盛的,微星的,充足的,强效的,挥霍的,补充者

source: Appliances,Energy Cells,Power Grids,the Depleted,the Jacked,the Power-Hungry,Tinkers
translation: 电器,能量电池,电网,耗竭者,插接者,渴电者,修补匠

source: Bits of tiny matter are smashed together behind the lune of a glass cylinder, and the heat is used to pump water into pipes for dispersal.
translation: 微小物质碎片在玻璃柱弦月件后方彼此撞合，产生的热被用来把水泵入管道以便分散。
淋巴的,流动的,补充者,微星的,聚合者
液压装置,流动,流体,修补匠

source: Cyclopean blades shaped to the airfoil are housed inside a metallic ring nicked with the scars of time. In the distant past, someone directed the course of air at grand scales.
translation: 独眼巨人般的翼型叶片收在一道刻满岁月伤痕的金属环中。遥远过去，有人曾以宏大尺度指挥空气的流向。

source: Behind the pane of a bronzed frame are the programmable instruments of glassmaking: stove and blowpipe for hot work, oiler and wheel for cold.
translation: 青铜框架的窗格后，是可编程的玻璃制造器具：炉子和吹管负责热加工，油壶和轮盘负责冷加工。

source: Tetraxenonoglass walls and convalesscent gel recreate the conditions of the amnion where reptile, bird, and mammal embryos are nurtured to whole life.
translation: 四氙玻璃舱壁与康复凝胶重现羊膜环境，爬行动物、鸟类和哺乳动物的胚胎正是在那里被孕育成完整生命。
治疗性的,医治者,恢复者,奇迹般的

source: It's worked from otherworldly limestone. The stone was quarried from a drift-world spinning about a darkling star whose weak luminescence didn't bleach the voidstuff from the rock's coral. Now it insulates its slumberer from the rays of materiality and conducts them to the psychic aether.
translation: 它由异界石灰岩加工而成。石材采自一颗围绕暗星旋转的漂流世界，那颗暗星微弱的辉光没能把岩石珊瑚中的虚空物质漂白。如今，它把沉眠者与物质性的射线隔离开来，并将其导向心灵以太。

source: Water ribbons climb bone-blanched marble columns in high relief. They mount the archivolt and snake between helical rings before a sharp turn upward on the keystone. Here becomes there.
translation: 水之缎带以高浮雕攀上骨白大理石柱。它们登上拱带，在螺旋环之间蜿蜒，然后在拱顶石上猛然转向上方。此处成为彼处。

source: Water ribbons in high relief crumble off the broken marble. Pieces of the arch that once enclosed the forward motion of travelers now lie on smooth backs somewhere else.
translation: 高浮雕水带从破碎大理石上剥落。曾经圈住旅人前行动作的拱门碎片，如今以光滑背面躺在别处。

source: A rectangle of neutrofoam imprinted with the human form hangs beneath an arch of glass. Across the foam at eye level, glyphs loop on an elliptical screen. Surgical machinery, obscured by blinding light, beetles out from the underside of an enclosing dome.
translation: 一块印有人体形态的中性泡沫矩形板悬在玻璃拱下。泡沫上与眼齐平的位置，一块椭圆屏幕循环着字形。手术机械被刺眼光芒遮掩，从封闭圆顶底部甲虫般探出。

source: Grease drips from an engine of bright chrome and stains the idlers. Pulley wheels are positioned at odd angles to churn flat rubber belts through space.
translation: 油脂从亮铬发动机上滴下，弄脏惰轮。滑轮以奇怪角度布置，搅动扁平橡胶带穿过空间。

source: Putrid dross sticks to the grooves of flat black di-rubber.
translation: 腐臭浮渣黏在扁平黑色双橡胶的沟槽里。

source: Bone-grey ash sticks to the grooves of flat black di-rubber.
translation: 骨灰色灰烬黏在扁平黑色双橡胶的沟槽里。

source: Under a tarnished metal frame hangs a sheet of black rubber cut into pliable curtain strips.
translation: 一张黑色橡胶挂在失去光泽的金属框下，被切成柔韧帘条。

source: Stoneware catches the tiny bit of moisture surrendered by the bone-dry air.
translation: 陶石器接住干到透骨的空气交出的一点点湿气。

source: Stone was carved and shaped into a rough dome with square, even-spaced windows to let air flow. The small difference in temperature inside the dome causes dew to condense from air and accumulate in a catch basin below.
translation: 石头被雕琢成粗糙圆顶，带有方形且间距均匀的窗，以便空气流动。圆顶内微小的温差使露水从空气中凝结，并积入下方集水盆。
水性的,凝结的,带露的,补水者,灌溉者,潮湿的
干枯者,干燥者,含盐者,口渴者

source: Heat from the salt sun evaporates brackish water. When the water condenses again, it's separated into its pure and impure elements: salt gloms on the still, while freshwater collects in the basin.
translation: 盐阳的热量蒸发咸水。水再次凝结时，被分离成纯净和不纯的部分：盐黏附在蒸馏器上，淡水则汇入盆中。
水性的,凝结的,带露的,补水者,灌溉者,潮湿的
干枯者,干燥者,含盐者,口渴者

source: Chrome flanges maximize the surface area for evaporated air to re-settle as distilled dew.
translation: 铬法兰让蒸发空气重新沉降为蒸馏露水的表面积最大化。
水性的,凝结的,带露的,补水者,灌溉者,潮湿的
干枯者,干燥者,含盐者,口渴者

source: Sine waves breaking on the glass lune encode the behavioral primitives of the enclave's mechanical children. The electron field sucks them through the antenna and into the aether.
translation: 破碎在玻璃弦月件上的正弦波，编码着飞地机械孩子们的行为原语。电子场把它们吸过天线，送入以太。

source: A coffin of steel, brass, and cathode tube conceals an array of precision instruments used to suck organ-matter from the dead and deliver it back to kith and kin.
translation: 一口由钢、黄铜和阴极管组成的棺材，藏着一组精密仪器，用来从死者身上吸取器官物质，再送还亲朋同族。
生物循环的,猩红的,立体派的,生态的,血色的
生态城,蛋白质,回收者,可持续性,饥饿者,真实者

source: Metalfoam is packed and plated into a colossal simulacrum of the bio-arm, where the heads of the biceps and triceps brachii gleam. Colossal joints chirr at the effort of rotation.
translation: 金属泡沫被填实并镀覆成生物手臂的巨型拟像，肱二头肌和肱三头肌的肌头闪闪发亮。巨型关节在努力旋转中吱鸣。

source: Metalfoam is packed and plated into a colossal simulacrum of the bio-arm, where the heads of the biceps and triceps brachii gleam. Brass pinchers snap the kinesis out of their target.
translation: 金属泡沫被填实并镀覆成生物手臂的巨型拟像，肱二头肌和肱三头肌的肌头闪闪发亮。黄铜夹钳把目标的运动啪地掐断。

source: A brass hem surrounds a foam shunting pad, and the above-head fretwork is braided into the once-familiar glyphs of exit symbology.
translation: 黄铜边框围着一块泡沫分流垫，头顶镂花编成曾经熟悉的出口符号字形。

source: Out of a gold-plated box, kaleidoscopic tiles and tones harmonize over several dimensions.
translation: 万花筒般的图块与音调从镀金盒中逸出，在数个维度上和鸣。

source: Diamond manifolds pressurize quartz into its Ω form, crystallizing spacetime along the ley lines in the local region. Drops of normality condensate on the flue refract light into an inner dimension.
translation: 钻石流形将石英压成 Ω 形态，沿本地区域的灵脉使时空结晶。烟道上的常态凝结液滴把光折射进内在维度。

source: A fullerite hem surrounds a foam landing pad, and the above-head fretwork is braided into the once-familiar glyphs of recomposition and return symbology.
translation: 富勒体边框围着一块泡沫着陆垫，头顶镂花编成曾经熟悉的重组与返回符号字形。

source: Tracery on the fullerite hem is melted bright white and drips onto the cracked foam pad. Lily sprouts quicken in the cracks and push forth; life creeps outward.
translation: 富勒体边框上的花纹熔成亮白，滴落到开裂的泡沫垫上。百合嫩芽在裂缝中复苏并向外顶出；生命向外爬行。

source: The characteristic glass arch marks the enclosure as a becoming nook gutted and wire-stripped for a new purpose. A claw extends for soldering and shaping, and in the underdrum, a wheel spins wet clay fresh and ready for sunslag fermentation.
translation: 标志性的玻璃拱表明这处封闭空间原本是成形龛，如今被掏空、剥去线缆，改作新用途。一只爪臂伸出，用于焊接和塑形；下鼓室中，一只轮盘旋转着新鲜湿黏土，准备进行日渣发酵。

source: A crude stone hem surrounds a foam landing pad, and the above-head fretwork is braided into the new-fangled glyphs of reshaping and return symbology.
translation: 粗糙石边围着一块泡沫着陆垫，头顶镂花编成新式的重塑与返回符号字形。

source: Wood planks are nailed at orthogonal angles, and dust sleeps on the paper jackets.
translation: 木板以正交角度钉在一起，尘土睡在纸质书衣上。
安歇的,柔软的,块状的,结实的,奢华的,舒适的,床单短的,无弹簧的
斜倚姿态,柔软表面,诱人的平整

source: Fabrics were stuffed with watervine chaff and laid across wooden slats in the style of the hillfolk.
translation: 织物塞满水藤糠，按山民风格铺在木板条上。

source: A goat wool bed fastened with canvas ties.
translation: 一张用帆布系带扎紧的山羊毛睡铺。

source: Wood slats are megaliths to a child. Feather pillows are cold meadows. Here are the boundaries of their dusk-world.
translation: 木板条对孩子而言就是巨石。羽毛枕是寒冷草甸。这里是他们暮色世界的边界。
养育的,安歇的,舒适的,保护者,贴身的

source: Watervine canvas is stretched and folded over wood legs.
translation: 水藤帆布在木腿上绷开又折叠。

source: Brinestraw was braided into a rope lattice saddle for slinging between two old oaks and napping. The fibers on the middle-sag are extra frayed from the center-mass strain of a reclining ass.
translation: 盐草被编成绳格吊兜，可悬在两棵老橡树之间小睡。中间下垂处的纤维因斜躺臀部的中心质量拉扯而格外磨散。

source: Wood was meticulously turned into columns and ornamentally whittled. Quilted downs were bartered from the seamstresses on the banks of the River Svy, layered as a cake and frosted with pillows. Here the moneyed slumberer finds a favored ingress to the dreaming dale.
translation: 木材被细致车成柱子，又雕削出装饰。绗缝鸭绒从斯维河岸的女裁缝那里换来，像蛋糕一样层层叠起，再覆上枕头糖霜。在这里，有钱的沉睡者找到了通往梦之谷的偏爱入口。
安歇的,柔软的,块状的,结实的,奢华的,华丽的,梦幻的

source: Plastic white as salt bleach was contoured for peaceful slumber, convalescence, and realignment of the humours.
translation: 盐漂般白的塑料被塑成适合安宁睡眠、康复和体液重新调和的轮廓。
结实的,照护者,可调节的,撒玛利亚的,消化的,治疗性的,恢复者

source: Wooden slats are laid on right angles in the style of the hillfolk. In place of a chaff cushion, however, lies a plastic mattress pumped with unctuous water, an alternative favored by raft-floaters who pine for the waves of the lake.
translation: 木板条按山民风格以直角铺设。然而取代糠垫的，是一张注满油滑水液的塑料床垫，这是思念湖浪的筏上漂民偏爱的替代品。
液压的,潮湿的,波浪的,涨落的

source: the Weary,the Tired,the Ebb and Flow,Sailors
translation: 疲乏者,困倦者,潮涨潮落者,水手

source: Historians of leisure divide all epochs into the following three ages: the span before ursine creatures evolve or civilizations rise to admire them, the span between ursine prominence and a civilization's capacity to fashion divans in their likeness, and thence the span until the civilization's fall.
translation: 休闲史学家把所有时代分成以下三纪：熊类生物尚未进化、文明尚未兴起并欣赏它们之前的时期；熊类显赫之后、文明获得按其形象制作长榻的能力之前的时期；以及从那以后直到该文明陨落的时期。
柔软的,舒适的,毛茸茸的,温暖的,可爱的

source: Hidden micro-reactors smash together particles, generate heat, and power the biotic machine apparatus that rejuvenates the weary slumberer.
translation: 隐藏的微反应堆撞合粒子，产生热量，并为让疲惫沉睡者返老还童的生物机器装置供能。
治疗性的,医治者,恢复者,奇迹般的
舒适的,短腿的,直背的,结实的,三腿的

source: Planks of wood are nailed together at right angles in the style of the marsh dwellers.
translation: 木板按沼泽居民的风格以直角钉在一起。

source: Stuffed with watervine chaff and glowcrow feathers, this buttoned pillow lets folk repose with crossed legs.
translation: 这只带纽扣的垫子塞满水藤糠和辉鸦羽毛，让人们能盘腿休憩。
舒适的,斜倚的,享乐的,柔软的,丰腴的,美食家的

source: Convivia in the limen, the boundary between sun-baked Moghra'yi and the shade of the Spindle, involves the mulling of cider, holography, and the arrangement of klinai at right angles.
translation: 阈地，也就是烈日烘烤的莫格拉伊与纺锤阴影之间的边界，那里举行的宴饮包括温煮苹果酒、全息术，以及把克林卧榻按直角排布。

source: Planks of wood are nailed together simply to form the austere seat.
translation: 木板被简单钉在一起，形成这张朴素座椅。

source: Nothing is in situ, everything is in motion, and the seated must prepare for the next moment where the memory of leisure is burned in neurotic effigy. The stool abides these truths.
translation: 没有什么在原位，一切都在运动，坐下的人必须为下一刻做好准备，届时闲暇的记忆将在神经质的肖像中燃烧。凳子遵守这些真理。

source: Jointed wood and knit watervine make a movable wharf for the ass.
translation: 有关节的木材和编织水藤，为臀部做成了一座可移动码头。

source: The ornamentation of etched metal and precious stones designate the axis mundi.
translation: 蚀刻金属和宝石的装饰指定了世界轴心。
王室的,帝国的,宏伟的,宽宏的,浮夸的,仪式性的,威严的,庄严的,堂皇的,宏大的,壮丽的,华丽的,崇高的

source: Kneaded under the salt sun by a leatherworker and stuffed with glowcrow feathers for the repose of its owner.
translation: 由皮匠在盐阳下揉制，塞满辉鸦羽毛，供主人休憩。
奢华的,颓靡的,舒适的,斜倚的,慵懒的,享乐的,柔软的,丰腴的,美食家的

source: Plastic white as salt bleach was contoured for ideal digestion and harmony of the humors.
translation: 盐漂般白的塑料被塑成适合完美消化和体液和谐的轮廓。
照护者,可调节的,救命者,撒玛利亚的,矫形的,卫生的,抗菌的,治疗性的

source: It's fitted with a crankshaft that turns a dimpled rubber sheet and kneads kinks out the hindparts of its sitter.
translation: 它装有一根曲轴，带动带凹点的橡胶片，把坐者后部的结块揉开。

source: In a dusty corner of the past, nameless workers glazed striated marble and inlaid it with gold to house the heirlooms and grave goods of a slump-shouldered Eater.
translation: 在过去积尘的一角，无名工匠给条纹大理石上釉，并镶入黄金，用以安放一名垂肩食客的传家物和陪葬品。

source: Cyclopean marble slates enclose an interdiction prism for imperial treasures, including the creatural and sovereign Face. Across their vast surfaces, goldwork plots the geometric sequences of life and its boundaries; water spills down the bodies of world-caryatides and curls back to the welkin.

source: A large storage vase with a decorative slip. The style hints that it was fired in the home-kiln of a canyon dweller.
translation: 一只带装饰化妆土的大储物瓶。风格暗示它是在峡谷居民的家窑里烧成的。

source: A vessel of freeblown glass curves at the lunar arc. The style hints that it originates from the coast of the Fuming God Sea, on the far side of Moghra'yi, and that it was likely exported by the dromads.
translation: 一件自由吹制玻璃容器弯成月弧。风格暗示它来自莫格拉伊远侧的烟神海海岸，并且很可能由德罗马德出口。

source: Glass was blown to a wide bowl and thin stem in the tradition of the grove-carpeted mountain lagynos. Were the style's first artisans working through the thick and ripe air of the musa wood? Did Spindle glitter dust their marvers and pipes?
translation: 玻璃按覆林山地拉吉诺斯瓶的传统，被吹成宽碗与细柄。创造这种风格的最初工匠，是否曾在穆萨林浓稠熟透的空气中劳作？纺锤的闪尘是否落满了他们的滚板和吹管？

source: A trailed vessel was first thrown on the potter's wheel in the soft warmth of morning. A canyoneer shaped the lip with extra care to preserve the precious liquids of life.
translation: 这件带拖尾纹的容器最初在清晨柔暖中由陶轮拉坯成形。一名峡谷人格外小心地塑造壶口，以保存生命的珍贵液体。

source: Bronze was melted and cooled, shaped and etched, to deliver the water of life.
translation: 青铜被熔化又冷却，塑形并蚀刻，用来递送生命之水。

source: Clay was spun on the potter's wheel and shaped into waves, fired, and glazed into a traditional vessel.
translation: 黏土在陶轮上旋转成形，被塑成波纹，烧制并上釉，成为一件传统容器。

source: Clay was spun on the potter's wheel and shaped into waves, fired, and glazed into a ceremonial vessel. Two pictographs are panelled side-by-side: 'life' and 'drink'.
translation: 黏土在陶轮上旋转成形，被塑成波纹，烧制并上釉，成为一件仪式容器。两枚象形图并排分格：“生命”和“饮用”。

source: Glazed and superheated clay lies cracked open. Two pictographs have been rendered illegible.
translation: 上釉并过热的黏土裂开躺着。两枚象形图已经无法辨认。

source: Painted crenulations wrap around the equator of this metal vase.
translation: 绘制的城垛纹环绕这只金属瓶的赤道。

source: The warming phosphor of early earth is neatly latticed by woodbrick, and functions now as a microscopic star.
translation: 早期大地的温暖磷光被木砖整齐围成格架，如今作为一颗微观恒星运作。

source: A burnt out wood core is enveloped in footprinted ash.
translation: 烧尽的木芯被带脚印的灰烬包裹。

source: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the thick clay oven, and with it comes the smell of scrumptious food.
translation: 温暖从厚陶炉中噼啪燃烧的火里辐射出来，随之而来的是美味食物的气味。

source: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the thick clay oven, and with it comes the smell of scrumptious food.

source: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the round mud oven, and with it comes the smell of mulled cider and brined mushrooms.
translation: 温暖从圆泥炉中噼啪燃烧的火里辐射出来，随之而来的是热香料苹果酒和盐渍蘑菇的气味。

source: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the round clay oven, and with it comes the smell of fermented tongue and congealed love.
translation: 温暖从圆陶炉中噼啪燃烧的火里辐射出来，随之而来的是发酵舌头和凝结爱意的气味。

source: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the round bone oven, and with it comes the smell of leavened pastry, sweet bananas, and warm skulk.
translation: 温暖从圆骨炉中噼啪燃烧的火里辐射出来，随之而来的是发酵糕点、甜香蕉和温热潜伏剂的气味。

source: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the bright stone oven, and with it comes the smell of hot spine fruit jam and roasted tail.
translation: 温暖从明亮石炉中噼啪燃烧的火里辐射出来，随之而来的是热刺果酱和烤尾巴的气味。

source: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the thick clay oven, and with it comes the smell of lah broth and steamed matz.
translation: 温暖从厚陶炉中噼啪燃烧的火里散出来，还飘来拉汤和蒸玛兹饼的气味。

source: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the dark electric oven, and with it comes the smell of bitter yuckwheat and boiled plasma.
translation: 温暖从黑暗电炉中噼啪燃烧的火里辐射出来，随之而来的是苦恶心麦和煮沸等离子体的气味。

source: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the round crystalline oven, and with it comes the smell of cooling static. Curiously, there are no prepared meal ingredients here.
translation: 温暖从圆形晶体炉中噼啪燃烧的火里辐射出来，随之而来的是冷却静电的气味。奇怪的是，这里没有准备好的餐食材料。

source: Branches of the living tree were resorbed and reformed into trunk knots. Then, hundreds of years later, the oiled saw of a gorge woodworker disarranged the arbor geometry and flattened it for civil use. That history remains cast in two dimensions, powdered with dust and scratched in pencil.
translation: 活树的枝条被重吸收，重塑成树干节瘤。数百年后，峡谷木匠上过油的锯打乱了树木几何，将其削平以供文明使用。那段历史仍被铸在二维之中，覆着尘粉，带着铅笔划痕。

source: Steel was anointed with liquid chrome, cooled, and beaten into a flat and workable surface.
translation: 钢被液态铬涂抹，冷却后锤打成平整可用的表面。

source: Knotted wood of good moisture content holds the weight of earth at right angles. Scorch marks and salt decorate the grooves.
translation: 含水量良好的节木以直角承托大地的重量。焦痕和盐装饰着沟槽。

source: Wood was salvaged from moist groves, shaved into planks, and carried to the freeholds on the Shale Bridge. There it was received by carpenters who, acclimated to the wetless air, eagerly took the rich wood for their own projects.
translation: 木材从潮湿树林中抢救出来，削成木板，再经页岩桥运往各自由堡。在那里，已经适应无湿空气的木匠接收了它，急切地把这丰美木材用于自己的工程。

source: A sharp rectangle seems to have been balanced on a metal pole over a smaller rectangle, forming a steady working surface. No welding scars are visible.
translation: 一个边角锐利的矩形看起来平衡在金属柱上，下方还有一个更小的矩形，形成稳定工作面。看不见焊接伤痕。

source: It's scratched on top where a pestle splintered the wood.
translation: 顶部有杵把木头击裂留下的划痕。
平坦的,多节的,水平的,L 形的,结实的,三腿的,摇晃的

source: Decorated with painted mandalas and shaped by the geometric hand, the table honors symmetry and numerology.
translation: 这张桌子以彩绘曼荼罗装饰，由几何之手塑形，向对称与数字学致敬。
八重的,平坦的,多节的,水平的,L 形的,结实的,三腿的,摇晃的

source: Wood was precisely cut into drawers and set on brass rails to house clothes.
translation: 木材被精确切成抽屉，装在黄铜轨上，用来安置衣物。
平坦的,多节的,水平的,L 形的,结实的,三腿的,摇晃的

source: Dwellers in the earth-clefts fashion tables in the style of puzzle boxes. Their drawers house the stenographic imagination.
translation: 居住在地裂中的人按机关盒风格制作桌子。抽屉里安放着速记的想象。
平坦的,多节的,水平的,L 形的,结实的,三腿的,摇晃的

source: Etched chromium on the lavish legs tapers to claw-and-ball feet, and on the marble surface, geometric imperfections were rasped off and flung into an iron bucket that may still exist somewhere. Eaters spoke here, and planned.
translation: 奢华桌腿上的蚀刻铬逐渐收成爪球脚；大理石表面上，几何瑕疵曾被锉掉，扔进一只也许仍存在于某处的铁桶。食客曾在这里交谈，谋划。

source: A table scorched with the radial patterns of hot chemistry holds a phial rack and alembic.
translation: 一张被热化学的放射状图案灼焦的桌子，放着小瓶架和蒸馏器。

source: In high relief, folds and knots of sandy hued shapes crown the sapphire surface of the spherical model. The juxtaposition of scales, the proportion of sea to land, and the collective wisdom harnessed to devise such a thing make your head spin.
translation: 在高浮雕中，沙色形状的褶皱和结团覆盖着球形模型的蓝宝石表面。尺度的并置、海陆比例，以及设计它所动用的集体智慧让你头晕目眩。

source: Brass gears, balls, and rings turn in precise mimicry of worlds and stars.
translation: 黄铜齿轮、球体和环圈转动，精确模仿世界与星辰。

source: Barathrum's invention records time to the momentary tick by regulating its advance with a crown wheel. On learning of its utility, the water barons commissioned the assembly of dozens more in order to take precise measurements of their reservoirs at set moments of the day.
translation: 巴拉瑟姆的发明用冠轮调节前进，把时间记录到瞬息滴答。水男爵得知它的用途后，委托组装了几十台，好在每日固定时刻精确测量他们的水库。

source: During the enterprise of invention, you sometimes require the use of a shapeless gray foam. Or, at the very least, you might require it one day, and so some tinker prudently got ahead of the problem and invented the brass foaminator. Inscribed on the base: 'All the foam, none of the sadness at maybe one day needing foam and not having it'.
translation: 在发明事业中，你有时需要使用一团无定形灰色泡沫。或者至少有一天你可能会需要，于是某个修补匠审慎地抢在问题前面，发明了黄铜发泡器。底座上刻着：“泡沫管够，再也没有某天可能需要泡沫却没有泡沫的悲伤”。

source: Glass lunes refract light and paint images in fictive angular size.
translation: 玻璃弦月件折射光线，并以虚构角尺寸绘出图像。

source: The delphic countenance of the Tungsten King is frozen in chrome, cast to perfect specification.
translation: 钨王神谕般的面容凝固在铬中，按完美规格铸成。
穆罕默德一世的铬胸像

source: Hard chrome was cast in the mold of soft cheeks and rounded brow; the patron king of scholarship is canonized.
translation: 硬铬被铸入柔软面颊与圆润额头的模具；学问的庇护王被封圣。

source: Slink-green plant lobes splay out of the ancient cauldron with chromium incision. They live and breathe like their loam-bound cousins, but their bio-data was spliced with the amaranthine seed. They do not die even as the Eaters about them decompose.
translation: 溜绿色植物裂片从带铬刻痕的古老釜中张开。它们像扎根壤土的表亲一样生存呼吸，但生物数据被接入了不凋种子。即使周围食客腐解，它们也不会死亡。

source: Slink-green plant lobes splay out of the ancient cauldron with chromium incision. They live and breathe like their loam-bound cousins, but their bio-data was spliced with the amaranthine seed. They do not die even as the Eaters about them decompose.
translation: 溜绿色植物裂片从带铬刻痕的古老釜中张开。它们像扎根壤土的表亲一样生存呼吸，但生物数据被接入了不凋种子。即使周围食客腐解，它们也不会死亡。

source: Slink-green plant lobes splay out of the ancient cauldron with chromium incision. They live and breathe like their loam-bound cousins, but their bio-data was spliced with the amaranthine seed. They do not die even as the Eaters about them decompose.
translation: 溜绿色植物裂片从带铬刻痕的古老釜中张开。它们像扎根壤土的表亲一样生存呼吸，但生物数据被接入了不凋种子。即使周围食客腐解，它们也不会死亡。

source: Slink-green plant lobes splay out of the ancient cauldron with chromium incision. They live and breathe like their loam-bound cousins, but their bio-data was spliced with the amaranthine seed. They do not die even as the Eaters about them decompose.
translation: 溜绿色植物裂片从带铬刻痕的古老釜中张开。它们像扎根壤土的表亲一样生存呼吸，但生物数据被接入了不凋种子。即使周围食客腐解，它们也不会死亡。

source: Sheared slate stone is powdered with the cloudy remnants of externalized thought and held aloft by the monster.
translation: 剪切过的板岩覆着外化思想的云状残余，被怪物高高托起。
智慧的,诡辩家的,可擦除的,积尘的
诡辩家,修补匠,学者,学生

source: Plastic housed in grainy wood is perforated in a grid of contact points. Capacitors and inductors are fastened in the spring clips and networked with a bouquet of wire.
translation: 包在粗纹木中的塑料被打出一格格接触点。电容器和电感器固定在弹簧夹里，并由一束线缆连成网络。

source: Inside the scratched metal C a needle and a bobbin prepare to punch a pair of threads into a lockstitch. Initials are carved all around its pedestal.
translation: 在划痕金属 C 形结构内，一根针和一个线轴准备把一对线穿成锁式线迹。基座四周刻满姓名首字母。

source: The biped form emerges out of a cocoon of wood and fiberglass.
translation: 双足形体从木材和玻璃纤维的茧中浮现。
成形良好的,美丽的,端正的,静止的,诡异的,栩栩如生的
雕塑家,服饰商,裁衣者,护甲匠

source: The biped form emerges out of a gigantic cocoon of wood and fiberglass.
translation: 双足形体从木材和玻璃纤维的巨茧中浮现。

source: Blue laser light bursts out of the reference beam and reimagines a wavefront sculpted on a light lathe. Air adds a layer of grain.
translation: 蓝色激光从参考光束中迸出，重新想象在光车床上雕出的波前。空气添上一层颗粒。

source: Foam plush is arranged into gyri and sulci to mimic the brain maze.
translation: 泡沫绒料被排列成脑回和脑沟，模仿脑迷宫。

source: The wet paints of earth -- clay, slag, chrome, and dye -- slouch a half-idea with material weight. The transformation is arrested through indecision or neglect.
translation: 大地的湿颜料，即黏土、炉渣、铬和染料，带着物质重量塌成半个念头。转化因犹豫或疏忽而停滞。

source: Marble blossoms on top as a spiraling volute. The column is splattered with paint.
translation: 大理石在顶端绽成螺旋涡卷。柱身溅满颜料。

source: Nacreous oil wets the ecru linen and has dripped onto the easel. From the plane of the canvas, an image is pressed out.
translation: 珠母般的油彩润湿米色亚麻，并滴到画架上。一幅图像从画布平面中压出。

source: Half-moon glass roofs the subterrarium and protects the corpse eaters, who have prospered inside. They are an arcology of gills.
translation: 半月玻璃给地下箱加上屋顶，保护在其中繁盛的食尸者。它们是一座菌褶生态城。

source:
Gnu-gut strings run strata across the soundboard, and rose gold caps the rich wood knee and head.
The frame forms half a heart; the Eaters' favorite remains.
translation:
角马肠弦分层横过共鸣板，玫瑰金覆在丰美木制的弯角和琴头上。
琴框构成半颗心；食客的最爱仍在。

source: Rectangle keys are arranged down the angled ladder to step upwise in pitch. Hanging on frame is a note mallet.
translation: 矩形键沿倾斜阶梯排列，音高逐级上升。框架上挂着一只音槌。

source: Strings of gnu gut are stretched across the trapezoid. The note spoon hangs in a wooden sheath.
translation: 角马肠弦绷过梯形琴身。音匙挂在木鞘里。

source: Rust-caked spines line the interior of an iron sarcophagus. Dissatisfied with the caliber of earthly punishments, its deviser sought to deprave even the restful slumber of eternity.
translation: 铁石棺内部排列着结满锈的尖刺。设计者不满于尘世惩罚的水准，企图连永恒安眠也一并败坏。
施痛者,放血者,屠夫,残酷的,放血至死者,穿刺者,刺入者,拷问者
审判官,施虐者,残酷者,忏悔者,拷问者
高耸身姿,威胁尖刺,令人窒息的封闭

source: Smoking stems bloom from a crystal waterpipe.
translation: 吸烟管柄从一只水晶水烟筒上绽出。

source: The box is wrought from chewed wire and dented iron.
translation: 这只箱笼由被啃咬的铁丝和凹陷铁件锻成。

source: Brinestalk splinters and smokes inside a piped hearth of old stone.
translation: 盐茎在旧石砌成、带管道的炉膛里裂开并冒烟。

source: A hunk of crude granite has been smoothed on top for metalworking and rounded at the side into a shaping horn.
translation: 一块粗花岗岩顶部被磨平，用于金属加工；侧面被磨圆成塑形砧角。

source: This statue worked from *material* intricately depicts *creature.a**creature*:
translation: 这座由*material*加工而成的雕像精细描绘了*creature.a**creature*：

source: Erosion has smoothed its features into abstraction, but once it stood in monument to the coupling of machine and folk.
translation: 侵蚀把它的特征磨平成抽象形态，但它曾作为机器与民众结合的纪念碑矗立。

source: Features erupt from a stone canvas and shatter into a figure from the deep past. Hair, skin, brow, thigh: the details hatch a new emotion inside you, the sense of the strange-familiar. As you move about the petrified likeness, you wonder at how this Eater managed to incise themself into your spacetime braid.
translation: 五官从石质画布中迸出，碎裂成一道来自深远过去的身影。头发、皮肤、眉额、大腿：这些细节在你心中孵出一种新的情绪，一种奇异熟悉感。当你绕着这尊石化肖像移动时，你不禁思索，这名食客究竟如何把自己刻进你的时空辫中。

source: This stone idol of Oboroqoru stands twenty spans tall. Its nameless sculptor chose to depict the ape god sitting cross-legged with each of his three pairs of gargantuan arms grasping each other. The idol is swathed in vines, its caretakers ceding to nature save where the herbage has threatened to obscure Oboroqoru's gentle countenance. Wreaths of flowers of every hue the forest begets -- azure, chartreuse, indigo, carnelian -- litter the base of the shrine, insignificant offerings to what appears to be a callous god.
translation: 这座奥博罗科鲁石像高二十拃。无名雕塑家选择描绘猿神盘腿而坐，三对巨臂各自相握。神像裹满藤蔓，照料者把它让给自然，只在草木将要遮住奥博罗科鲁温和面容处稍加干预。森林孕育的每一种色彩的花环，蔚蓝、黄绿、靛蓝、肉红，散落在神龛基座上，作为献给一位看似冷漠之神的微不足道供品。

source: Abandoned in a tucked-away hut on Bey Lah's outskirts, this enormous statue of hornsfel languishes under a layer of withered vegetation. It depicts a majestic deer with one hoof raised from the ground, its humanlike eyes judging its surroundings and finding them wanting. The metal plaque on the base of the statue hasn't fared well over the centuries, and the only glyphs you can make out are 'K', 'R', 'S', and 'H'.
translation: 这座巨大的角岩雕像被遗弃在贝拉郊外一间隐蔽小屋中，困在一层枯萎植被下。它描绘了一头威严的鹿，一只蹄子抬离地面，人般的眼睛审视周围，并觉得一切都不够格。雕像底座上的金属铭牌几个世纪以来保存得并不好，你只能辨认出“K”、“R”、“S”和“H”几个字形。

source: Nisroch the star mason is depicted here straddling the earth with his mighty legs. He dons his favorite sash, whose folds are exquisitely worked in gold.
translation: 星辰石匠尼斯洛克在此被描绘成以强健双腿跨立大地的形象。他佩戴自己最喜爱的饰带，其褶皱以黄金精细制成。

source: The statue of Bel wears its tremendous weight in polished marble. He wields his epochal aegis, storied for obstructing a swirling gas cloud in the starry dawn.
translation: 贝尔雕像用抛光大理石承载自己惊人的重量。他挥舞着划时代的神盾，据传它曾在星辰黎明中挡住一团旋涡气云。

source: Here Shekhinah has been sculpted into permanence with magnificent cerulean marble. His body is chiseled to blessed perfection. His golden diadem crowns him Father among Fathers.
translation: 在这里，舍基纳以辉煌的蔚蓝大理石被雕成永恒。他的身体凿至受福的完美。他的金冠为他加冕，使他成为父中之父。

source: Dagon the orator domineers the west apse with his brazen pose. His golden coronet shines splendidly in the fire's shine.
translation: 演说家达贡以傲慢姿态统御西侧半圆室。他的金冠在火光中灿烂闪耀。

source: Carthax the athlete is depicted here mid-stride. His glistening silver hair is tied behind his head, in astral tradition, as he vaults through the firmament.
translation: 运动者卡萨克斯在此被描绘成迈步半途的姿态。他闪亮的银发按星界传统束在脑后，正跃过苍穹。

source: Resheph, who's called 'the Above', lifts an enigmatic finger to heal the wounds of the sick.
translation: 被称作“上方者”的雷谢夫举起一根神秘手指，治愈病者的创伤。
吉尔什·阿戈尔戈特神龛

source: A monstrous head slumps in old stone, etched cysts sprouting from the central chine to evoke the spread of disease from its halfgod source. Generations of moss skirt the beast's warted legs.
translation: 一颗怪物头颅在古石中塌垂，蚀刻出的囊肿从中央脊线萌生，唤起疾病从半神源头扩散的景象。数代苔藓围绕着巨兽疣状的腿。

source: Slumping shoulders edge the valley of a cracked stone back, and two pairs of mated arms join at their hundred-knuckles in the stonecarver's depiction of the halfgod's quickening. Generations of moss skirt the beast's varicose legs.
translation: 塌垂肩膀勾出开裂石背的山谷，两对交配般的手臂在百节指关节处相接，这是石匠对半神胎动的描绘。数代苔藓围绕着巨兽静脉曲张的腿。

source: A spiny monstrous fish sits in a pool of stonecarved water. Underneath is the finned tail that poets have beating a foamy brine out the pipes at Maqqom to form the Hinnom lake. Generations of moss skirt its underfin.
translation: 一条多刺怪鱼坐在一池石雕之水中。下方是有鳍的尾巴，诗人说它在马阔姆的管道中拍打出泡沫盐水，形成欣嫩湖。数代苔藓围绕着它的下鳍。
掘地者舒格鲁伊斯神龛

source: Chiseled spines wreathe the sinuous worldeater, who dug the earthly caves that were peopled by late-stage troglodytes. The hundred-nine eyes of legend peer across time, and generations of moss skirt the beast's banded undergirth.
translation: 凿出的棘刺环绕着蜿蜒的吞世者，它挖出尘世洞穴，让晚期穴居人居住其中。传说中的一百零九只眼越过时间凝视，数代苔藓围绕着巨兽带状的下腹。

source: The halfgod kneels on hinds worked wide in old stone. Tiled polygons spill off the statue's base to evoke Qas's rightening of space, time, mountain, and village. Generations of moss skirt the beast's treecutter hooves.
translation: 半神以古石中雕得宽阔的后肢跪下。铺瓦般的多边形从雕像基座溢出，唤起卡斯对空间、时间、山脉与村庄的纠正。数代苔藓围绕着巨兽伐树般的蹄。

source: A godswan sits in stone grace with its gigantic kite train furled to a dizzying gyre. She wears a blank and unreadable expression, to evoke the carver's sense of her as uncertainty's incubus. Generations of moss skirt the beast's down feathers.
translation: 一只神天鹅以石中优雅端坐，巨大的风筝尾曳卷成令人目眩的螺旋。她带着空白而不可读的表情，唤起雕刻者将她视作不确定性梦魇的感受。数代苔藓围绕着巨兽的绒羽。

source: Burnt light erupts on the chromium plate and shatters into a figure from the deep past. Hair, skin, brow, thigh: the features hatch a new emotion inside you, the sense of the strange-familiar. As you move about, the figure moves in parallax; you wonder at how this Eater managed to incise themself into your spacetime braid.
translation: 烧灼的光在铬板上爆发，碎裂成一道来自深远过去的身影。头发、皮肤、眉额、大腿：这些特征在你心中孵出一种新的情绪，一种奇异熟悉感。当你四处移动时，那身影也以视差移动；你不禁思索，这名食客究竟如何把自己刻进你的时空辫中。

source: Glorious Shekhinah, Argent Adonis and First Father, poses in luminous mummery. With the stature of the ageless stars, fixed and permanent, He appraises the temple erected in His honor and cocks His head in approval. Befitting the memory of His union with the Kasaphescence, He clothes His manifestation in cerulean shades, forsaking the viridians and russets of the lowly plants and clay earth.
translation: 荣耀的舍基纳，银白阿多尼斯与第一父，在发光的哑剧中摆出姿态。他以无龄群星的身量，固定而永恒，审视为祂之荣光而建的神殿，并歪头表示认可。为配得上祂与卡萨辉体结合的记忆，祂让自己的显现披上蔚蓝色调，舍弃低等植物与黏土地的翠绿和赤褐。

source: [Shekhinah turns toward you, His arms wide.]
Stone asserts its importance by orienting toward the firmament, whence the oldest wisdom stirs.
translation: 石头朝向苍穹，以此宣告自己的重要性；最古老的智慧在那里搅动。

source: The bellies of vessels are sacred, for they both carry the waters of life and project the fluid past onto the convex present.
translation: 容器的腹部是神圣的，因为它们既承载生命之水，也把流体过去投射到凸起的现在。

source: Etched into this mead hall for small, winged friends are stories they cannot understand.
translation: 这座为有翼小友准备的蜜酒厅上，刻着它们无法理解的故事。

source: A narrative is confined to the etched boundaries of this stone, to the reductive duality of its form.
translation: 一段叙事被限制在这块石头的蚀刻边界内，被限制在其形式的还原性二元之中。

source: Glyphs inscribed into the ancient stone are refracted into the present.
translation: 刻入古石的字形折射进现在。

source: Moss-stuff inserts itself into the story-world evoked into being by the carved rock.
translation: 苔藓物质把自己插入由雕石唤成存在的故事世界。

source: From the hands of a metalworker rods and strips erupted and cooled into shape.
translation: 杆与条从金属工之手喷发出来，冷却成形。

source: Reverence was paid to the orb, smoothed toward ideality and hoisted on brass legs.
translation: 敬意献给这颗球体；它被打磨得趋近理想，并由黄铜腿托起。

source: Flickering interference patterns of light form a moire-cascading tableau.
translation: 闪烁的光干涉图案形成一幅摩尔纹级联的场景。

source: Flickering interference patterns of light form a moire-cascading tableau.
translation: 闪烁的光干涉图案形成一幅摩尔纹级联的场景。

source:
This object is a monument to a scene from the history of {{M|Kyakukya}}.

Under the Beetle Moon, folks settled here to gather goods of passage for Ape Saad Oboroqoru, and so Kyakukya was founded.
translation:
这是一座纪念碑，纪念{{M|克亚库克亚}}历史中的一幕。

在甲虫月下，人们定居于此，为猿神萨阿德·奥博罗科鲁收集通行物资，克亚库克亚由此建立。

source:
This object is a monument to a scene from the history of {{M|Kyakukya}}.

In 979, Nuntu, the legendary albino ape, grew tired of bludgeoning things to death and journeyed to a root-strangled place on the River Svy. There he came upon Kyakukya and its inhabitants. The villagers of Kyakukya asked Nuntu to employ his magisterial skills and lead the village.
translation:
这是一座纪念碑，纪念{{M|克亚库克亚}}历史中的一幕。

979 年，传说中的白化猿努恩图厌倦了把东西殴打至死，前往斯维河上一处根须缠绕之地。在那里，他遇见了克亚库克亚及其居民。克亚库克亚的村民请求努恩图运用他的权威才能，领导村庄。

source:
This object is a monument to a scene from the history of the {{M|Yd Freehold}}.

Centuries after the height of the Gyre, the svardym Goek, Mak, and Geeub met the galgal Many Eyes while languishing inside of a reef sponge. Together they founded the Yd Freehold to live out the rest of their lives.
translation:
这是一座纪念碑，纪念{{M|伊德自由堡}}历史中的一幕。

回旋纪鼎盛后的数个世纪，斯瓦尔丁戈埃克、马克和吉乌布在一块礁海绵里衰弱困顿时，遇见了轮转者多眼。他们共同建立伊德自由堡，以度过余生。

source:
This object is a monument to a scene from the history of the {{M|Yd Freehold}}.

In 901, the villagers of the Yd Freehold and its founders abolished all forms of hierarchy from their settlement. The two pillars of civic life in the Freehold thus became anarchy and authenticity.
translation:
这是一座纪念碑，纪念{{M|伊德自由堡}}历史中的一幕。

901 年，伊德自由堡的村民和创始者从聚落中废除了所有形式的等级制度。于是，自由堡公民生活的两大支柱变成了熵乱与真诚。

source: A terracotta board has been painted with ochre and ground iron.
translation: 一块陶土板涂着赭石和研磨铁粉。
供机器与民众使用的器官

source: Fine Wares from the Consortium of Phyta
ornately engraved marble door with plaque
translation: 带铭牌的华丽雕刻大理石门

source: Geometric shapes of meaning tessellate the ringed rows around the crematory vessel: stars, triquetrae, nonagons, and lunes.
translation: 承载意义的几何形状在火葬容器周围的环形行列中镶嵌：星辰、三角结、九边形与弦月。

source: Black marble was quarried from the vast reaches of the underearth and chiseled into a stone blanket for the dead.
translation: 黑色大理石从辽阔地下深处采出，凿成覆盖死者的石毯。

source: Cirrus clouds of neon stir inside a glass lune and beam light through the prefigured likeness of the sultan. A bleary shape thus hovers supine above the starless and gigantic black rock divan. The artist may have intended this to evoke a lightning storm over a dark plain or a lily on the pitch of a river: something to represent the bright and gaseous mind roaming over the inert body.
translation: 霓虹卷云在玻璃弦月件内搅动，光束穿过预先塑成的苏丹肖像。于是一个朦胧形体仰卧悬浮在无星而巨大的黑岩长榻上方。艺术家或许意在唤起黑暗平原上的雷暴，或河流沥青上的百合：某种象征明亮气态心智游荡于惰性躯体之上的东西。

A bleary shape thus hovers supine above the starless and gigantic black rock divan. The artist may have intended this to evoke a lightning storm over a dark plain or a lily on the pitch of a river: something to represent the bright and gaseous mind roaming over the inert body.

source: Wet clay sticks to a wheel and soldering board. It's flowered with diodes, circuits, vane pumps, and magnets.
translation: 湿黏土黏在轮子和焊接板上。它开满了二极管、电路、叶片泵和磁体。

source: Clay was fired around steel and erected in the rib cage for structural support.
translation: 黏土围着钢材烧制，并竖立在肋笼中作为结构支撑。

source: A pair of retractible chrome panels are fit on oiled tracks.
translation: 一对可伸缩铬板嵌在上油轨道上。

source: Teal foam pads the inside back and the deep seat well, and dials deck the curved armrests. The whole chair swivels atop an ejection motor.
translation: 蓝绿色泡沫垫着内侧靠背和深座槽，弧形扶手上布满刻度盘。整张椅子在弹射马达上旋转。

source: Teal foam pads the inside back and the deep seat well, and a single dial dresses the right armrest. The whole chair swivels atop an ejection motor.
translation: 蓝绿色泡沫垫着内侧靠背和深座槽，右扶手上装着一个刻度盘。整张椅子在弹射马达上旋转。

source: Inside a metal frame damp with soup dew, a glass lune is painted with the data glyphs of navigation and two-body alignment. 3D models of a large and smaller creature rotate on their vertical axes, and a psychoelectric scan shows the status of the meld.
translation: 在沾着汤露的金属框架内，一枚玻璃弦月件上绘着导航与双体对齐的数据字形。一个大型生物和一个较小生物的 3D 模型绕各自竖轴旋转，一项心理电扫描显示融合状态。

source: Teal foam pads the inside back and the deep seat well, and dials deck the curved armrests. The whole chair swivels atop an ejection motor.
translation: 蓝绿色泡沫垫着内侧靠背和深座槽，弧形扶手上布满刻度盘。整张椅子在弹射马达上旋转。

source: Your {{W|Strength}} score determines how effectively you penetrate your opponents' armor with melee attacks, how much damage your melee attacks do, your ability to resist forced movement, and your carry capacity.
translation: 你的 {{W|力量}} 分数决定你用近战攻击穿透对手护甲的效率、你的近战攻击伤害、你抵抗强制移动的能力，以及你的负重能力。

source: Your {{W|Agility}} score determines your accuracy with both melee and ranged weapons and your ability to dodge attacks.
translation: 你的 {{W|敏捷}} 分数决定你使用近战与远程武器的准确度，以及你闪避攻击的能力。

source: Your {{W|Toughness}} score determines your number of hit points, your natural healing rate, and your ability to resist poison and disease.
translation: 你的 {{W|韧性}} 分数决定你的生命值、自然恢复速度，以及你抵抗毒素和疾病的能力。

source: Your {{W|Intelligence}} score determines your number of skill points and your ability to examine artifacts.
translation: 你的 {{W|智力}} 分数决定你的技能点数量，以及你检查神器的能力。

source: Your {{W|Willpower}} score modifies the cooldowns of your activated abilities, determines your ability to resist mental attacks, and modifies your natural healing rate.
translation: 你的 {{W|意志力}} 分数会调整你激活能力的冷却时间，决定你抵抗精神攻击的能力，并调整你的自然恢复速度。

source: Your {{W|Ego}} score determines the potency of your mental mutations, your ability to haggle with merchants, and your ability to dominate the wills of other living creatures.
translation: 你的 {{W|自我}} 分数决定你的精神突变威力、你与商人讨价还价的能力，以及你支配其他活物意志的能力。
