source: Return to Grit Gate and speak to Barathrum.
translation: 返回砂砾门，与巴拉瑟鲁姆交谈。

source: At the behest of a hindren pariah, you traveled to the hidden village of Bey Lah to investigate a mystery.
translation: 受一名欣德伦流亡者所托，你前往隐秘村庄 贝拉赫 调查一桩谜案。

source: Benevolent =name= agreed to meddle in the affairs of the meadow at the behest of a deerfolk pariah. The sultan reigns with kindheartedness!
translation: 仁慈的 =name= 应一名鹿民流亡者所请，同意插手草甸事务。苏丹以善心统治！

source: At =spice:time.partsOfDay.!random= under a =spice:commonPhrases.strange.!random.article= and meadowed sky, the hindren of Bey Lah saw an image on the horizon that looked like a great looking glass. It was =name=, and once =player.subjective= arrived, the hindren built a monument to =player.objective= and thenceforth called =player.objective= the Looking Glass Kendren.
translation: 在 =spice:time.partsOfDay.!random=，于 =spice:commonPhrases.strange.!random.article= 与草甸般的天空下，贝拉赫 的欣德伦看见地平线上有一个像巨大照镜的影像。那就是 =name=；=player.subjective= 抵达后，欣德伦为 =player.objective= 建起纪念碑，并从此称 =player.objective= 为照镜肯德伦。

source: Travel to the hidden village of Bey Lah and investigate the problems there.
translation: 前往隐秘村庄 贝拉赫，调查那里的问题。

source: You found the hindren pariah Eskhind and her sisters inside a hollowed out tree.
translation: 你在一棵空心树中找到了欣德伦流亡者 埃斯欣德 和她的姐妹。

source: Remember! =name= admonished the pariah Eskhind for fleeing her destiny. Thenceforth she was known as Eskhind the Meek.
translation: 铭记！=name= 训诫了逃离命运的流亡者 埃斯欣德。从此她被称为温顺的 埃斯欣德。

source: In the month of =month= of =year=, =name= was challenged by the accused Eskhind to a duel over the location of the hindren heirloom Kindrish. =name= won and admonished Eskhind into returning to Bey Lah.
translation: 在 =year= 年 =month= 月，被指控的 埃斯欣德 因欣德伦传家宝 金德里什 的所在向 =name= 发起决斗。=name= 获胜，并训诫 埃斯欣德 返回 贝拉赫。
找到 埃斯欣德，并取回 金德里什。
与守望者 尼拉欣德 交谈

source: Speak to Warden Neelahind, who was close friends with Eskhind.
translation: 与守望者 尼拉欣德 交谈，她曾是 埃斯欣德 的密友。
传达 埃斯欣德 的消息

source: Speak to Keh with news of Eskhind.
translation: 带着 埃斯欣德 的消息与 凯赫 交谈。

source: You found and returned a discarded love poem.
translation: 你找到并归还了一首被丢弃的情诗。

source: How inspiring is the presence of =name=, who so redeemed Eskhind the Meek that she sought the hand of Bey Lah's greatest champion!
translation: =name= 的存在何等鼓舞人心，=player.subjective= 如此救赎温顺的 埃斯欣德，以至于她寻求 贝拉赫 最伟大勇士的手！

source: In the burnt out core of a tree stump, =name= cemented =player.possessive= friendship with the hindren of Bey Lah by marrying Eskhind and the Warden Neelahind.
translation: 在树桩烧空的核心中，=name= 通过与 埃斯欣德 和守望者 尼拉欣德 成婚，巩固了 =player.possessive= 与 贝拉赫 欣德伦的友谊。

source: Intervene before the fate of the lovers is sealed.
translation: 在这段恋情走到死路前出手干预。

source: Give the crumpled sheet of paper to its author or intended recipient.
translation: 把皱巴巴的纸交给作者或预定收信人。

source: For better or worse to the fate of Bey Lah, you solved the mystery of Kindrish's disappearance and helped Warden Neelahind administer justice.
translation: 无论 贝拉赫 的命运是好是坏，你解开了 金德里什 失踪之谜，并帮助守望者 尼拉欣德 施行正义。

source: Hallowed savior! =name= brought peace and prosperity to the troubled deerfolk of the Bey Lah meadow.
translation: 神圣的救世主！=name= 为 贝拉赫 草甸中困扰的鹿民带来了和平与繁荣。

source: Acting against thieves and the authorities who empower them, =name= led an investigation in the village of Bey Lah. Because of =player.t's= =spice:elements.entity@elements[random].adjectives.!random= wit, the Warden Neelahind was able to properly administer justice.
translation: 为了反抗窃贼和赋予他们权力的当局，=name= 在 贝拉赫 村中主持了一场调查。多亏 =player.t= =spice:elements.entity@elements[random].adjectives.!random= 机智，守望者 尼拉欣德 得以正确施行正义。
向守望者 尼拉欣德 简报

source: Tell Bey Lah's Warden about the disputed nature of Kindrish's theft.
translation: 告诉 贝拉赫 的守望者，金德里什 盗窃案的真相仍有争议。

source: Discover all evidence that might lead to the thief.
translation: 找出所有可能指向窃贼的证据。

source: Speak to Warden Neelahind with evidence of the event and accuse the thief that took Kindrish.
translation: 带着证据与守望者 尼拉欣德 交谈，并指控偷走 金德里什 的窃贼。

source: You visited a coterie of Tomb-dwelling mopango.
translation: 你拜访了一群居于墓中的莫潘戈。

source: Deep in the Tomb of the Eaters at Omonporch, =name= stumbled upon a clan of mopango performing a secret ritual. Ey accepted the sultan into eir fold and taught =player.objective= eir secrets.
translation: 在奥蒙门廊食者之墓深处，=name= 偶遇一族正在举行秘密仪式的莫潘戈。他们接纳苏丹进入族群，并将族中秘密传授给 =player.objective=。

source: Deep in the Tomb of the Eaters at Omonporch, =name= stumbled upon a clan of mopango performing a secret ritual. Ey accepted the =sultanTerm= into eir fold and taught =player.objective= eir secrets.
translation: 在奥蒙门廊食者之墓深处，=name= 偶遇一族正在举行秘密仪式的莫潘戈。他们接纳 =sultanTerm= 进入族群，并将族中秘密传授给 =player.objective=。

translation: 在西北地下墓穴中找到友好的炮塔维维拉，并告诉维维拉是佐索姆派你来的。

source: Ask Lebah about eir encounter with the repulsive device.
translation: 询问利巴遭遇排斥装置的事。

source: Locate k-Goninon in the Folk Catacombs and recover the repulsive device.
translation: 在民众地下墓穴中找到 k-戈尼农，并取回排斥装置。

source: Ask the mopango watchers Dadogom, Doyoba, Gyamyo, and Yona about the repulsive device.
translation: 询问莫潘戈守望者达多戈姆、多约巴、伽米约和约娜关于排斥装置的事。

source: Choose how to best apply the repulsive device.
translation: 决定该怎么使用排斥装置。

source: You returned from the Tomb of the Eaters after successfully disabling the Spindle's magnetic field.
translation: 你成功关闭纺锤的磁场后，从食者之墓返回。

source: Tattoo the mark on your body.
translation: 把印记刺在你的身体上。

source: You helped Chavvah, the Tree of Life, complete the ritual of -elseing and sever one of its entity-chimes forever.
translation: 你帮助生命之树查瓦完成了离枝仪式，让它的一枚子钟永远脱离树体、成为独立的个体。

source: Beauty in subtraction! Pruner =name= cut the Tree of Life to a more aesthetic form.
translation: 减除之美！修枝者 =name= 将生命之树修剪成更美的形态。

source: Acting in accordance with the Tree of Life's many wills, =name= brought a transit rock to the glowing Soft beneath Chavvah's trunk. There =player.subjective= performed a secret ritual and returned to the surface forever altered.
translation: 依照生命之树的众多意志，=name= 将陶的晶钟带到查瓦树干下方发光的柔质中。=player.subjective= 在那里完成了离枝仪式，重返地表时已永远改变。

source: Retrieve Tau's chime from her branch in the keter.
translation: 从陶位于冠层的枝条上取回她的晶钟。

source: Bring 20 drams of primordial soup to Pax Klanq.
translation: 带 20 打兰原初汤给帕克斯·克兰克。

source: Provide a follower level 30 or higher.
translation: 提供一名 30 级或更高级的追随者。

source: Provide 3 drams of a pure liquid.
translation: 提供 3 打兰纯净液体。

source: Provide the limb of a creature.
Provide an entry from your chronology.
translation: 提供你的编年史中的一个条目。

source: Provide an item that weights 5 lbs. or less.
translation: 提供一件重量不超过 5 磅的物品。

source: Provide 3 drams of neutron flux or find another power source.
translation: 提供 3 打兰中子通量，或找到另一种动力源。
让巴拉瑟鲁姆进入魔像。

source: Engage the ascension mechanisms of the Spindle.
Leaving the battlefield may give the Templar time to regroup and result in more Barathrumite casualties. Proceed?
translation: 离开战场可能会让圣殿骑士有时间重整旗鼓，并导致更多巴拉瑟鲁姆派伤亡。要继续吗？

source: Remove the threat of the Templar warleader from the perimeter of Omonporch.
translation: 清除奥蒙门廊周边的圣殿骑士战帅威胁。

translation: 清除奥蒙门廊周边的圣殿骑士战帅威胁。

source: You gain a +5 bonus to your DV when flinching away from missile attacks.
translation: 你闪避投射物攻击时，闪避 获得 +5 加值。

source: You gain a +2 bonus to your DV.
translation: 你的 闪避 获得 +2 加值。

source: You jump into an unoccupied square within range 2. You cannot jump over a square occupied by a creature, unless you have an ability (such as flight) that augments your jump.
translation: 你跳入距离 2 内一个未被占据的格子。你不能跳过被生物占据的格子，除非你拥有强化跳跃的能力（例如飞行）。

source: You gain a +1 bonus to your DV. Additionally, Juke's cooldown is reduced to 20.
translation: 你的 闪避 获得 +1 加值。此外，闪身的冷却时间降至 20。

source: You get +2 to hit with axes.

Whenever you hit an opponent with an axe, there's a 75% chance you cleave their armor, giving them a -1 penalty to their AV. This penalty can stack a number of times up to half your Str modifier, rounded up, +1 on a critical hit.
translation: 每当你用斧命中对手时，有 75% 几率劈开对方护甲，让对方 护甲 受到 -1 惩罚。该惩罚可叠加，次数最高为你的 力量 修正值一半（向上取整），重击时额外 +1 次。

source: When you charge with an axe and hit, if you cleave their armor, they get an additional -1 penalty to their AV. If you have Dismember, your chance to dismember when charging with an axe is doubled. When you charge with a cudgel and hit, you automatically daze your opponent.
translation: 你持斧冲锋并命中时，如果劈开对方护甲，对方 护甲 额外受到 -1 惩罚。如果你拥有肢解，持斧冲锋时肢解几率翻倍。你持棍棒冲锋并命中时，会自动使对手晕眩。

source: Activated; cooldown 30. Axe attack. If you hit and penetrate, you dismember one of their limbs at random and they start bleeding (1-2 damage per turn. toughness save; difficulty 35). Additionally, your axe attacks that penetrate have a percentage chance to dismember: 3% for one-handed axes and 6% for two-handed axes.
translation: 主动；冷却 30。斧攻击。如果你命中并穿透，随机肢解对方一条肢体，并让对方开始流血（每回合 1-2 伤害。坚韧豁免；难度 35）。此外，你的斧攻击如果穿透，有一定几率造成肢解：单手斧 3%，双手斧 6%。

source: Activated; cooldown 50. You grab an opponent's limb with the heel of your axe. If successful, you pull your opponent with you as you move and make a free attack with your axe. Your opponent gets a chance to resist the move (strength save; difficulty 20 + your Str modifier) and a chance to break free at the start of their turn (same save). Lasts for 9 rounds or until you dismember the opponent.
translation: 主动；冷却 50。你用斧跟钩住对手的肢体。如果成功，你移动时会拖着对手，并用斧进行一次免费攻击。对手有机会抵抗移动（力量豁免；难度 20 + 你的 力量 修正值），也有机会在自己的回合开始时挣脱（同一豁免）。持续 9 轮，或直到你肢解这个对手。

source: Heads are added to the list of possible limbs you can dismember. Chopping off the only head of a creature kills them instantly. If the creature has multiple heads, they start bleeding profusely (2-3 damage per turn. toughness save; difficulty 35).
translation: 头部会加入你可肢解的肢体列表。砍掉生物唯一的头会让它立即死亡。如果这个生物有多个头，它会开始大量流血（每回合 2-3 伤害。坚韧豁免；难度 35）。

source:
Activated; cooldown 100.
You enter a blood frenzy, and for 5 rounds your chance to dismember with axe attacks is 100%. To use Berserk, Dismember must be off cooldown, and using Berserk puts Dismember on cooldown.
translation:
主动；冷却 100。
你进入血腥狂乱，在 5 轮内，你的斧攻击肢解几率为 100%。要使用狂暴，肢解必须不在冷却中；使用狂暴会让肢解进入冷却。

source: You are skilled with bows and rifles.
For the purpose of determining your accuracy with bows and rifles, your agility is treated as if it were 4 points higher.
translation: 在决定你使用弓和步枪的精准度时，你的敏捷视为提高 4 点。

source: You spend a turn to draw a bead on a target and mark it. Whenever you fire at a marked target with a bow or rifle, your agility is treated as if it were 2 points higher for the purpose of determining your accuracy. You may only mark one target at a time. Targets get unmarked if you lose vision of them.
translation: 你花费一回合瞄准目标并将其标记。每当你用弓或步枪射击被标记目标时，计算精准度时你的敏捷视为提高 2 点。你一次只能标记一个目标。如果你失去对目标的视野，标记会消失。

source: You fire at a marked target. If your shot penetrates, your target is suppressed and can't move for 3-5 rounds. Then your target is unmarked.
translation: 你向被标记目标开火。如果射击穿透，目标会被压制，3-5 轮内不能移动。随后目标的标记被移除。

source: As long as your target is surrounded by 6 or more solid obstacles, Suppressive Fire is upgraded to Flattening Fire. Flattening Fire also knocks your target prone and disarms them.
translation: 只要目标周围有 6 个或更多坚固障碍物，压制射击升级为压倒射击。压倒射击还会击倒目标并解除其武装。

source: You fire at a marked target. For each penetration on each shot that hits, your target bleeds 1 point of damage per round (save: 20 + max damage of the weapon). Then your target is unmarked.
translation: 你向被标记目标开火。每次命中的射击每造成一次穿透，目标每轮流血 1 点伤害（豁免：20 + 武器最大伤害）。随后目标的标记被移除。

source: As long as your target can't see or hear any faction allies, Wounding Fire is upgraded to Disorienting Fire. Disorienting Fire also reduces your target's DV and MA by 4.
translation: 只要目标看不见也听不见任何同阵营盟友，创伤射击升级为迷向射击。迷向射击还会使目标的 闪避 和 精神护甲 降低 4。

source: You fire at a marked target with no accuracy penalty (the accuracy of your weapon still matters). Then your target is unmarked.
translation: 你向被标记目标开火，不受精准度惩罚（武器本身的精准度仍然重要）。随后目标的标记被移除。

source: As long as your target is flaming, luminous, or phosphorescent, Sure Fire is upgraded to Beacon Fire. Beacon Fire shots are also treated as critical hits.
translation: 只要目标正燃烧、发光或呈磷光，必中射击升级为信标射击。信标射击还会被视为重击。

source: Cooldown 100. You fire at a marked target. Your shot combines the effects of all the other Fire powers you have.
translation: 冷却 100。你向被标记目标开火。你的射击结合你拥有的所有其他射击能力效果。

source: You are skilled at cooking and gathering meal ingredients.
translation: 你擅长烹饪和采集餐食材料。

source:
While at a campfire, you can cook from recipes, choose up to two ingredients to cook with, and preserve fresh foods.
Meals cooked from recipes bestow special status effects. Meals cooked with selected ingredients bestow dynamically-generated status effects.
Preserved foods are used as meal ingredients.
translation:
在营火旁，你可以按食谱烹饪、选择最多两种食材入锅，并保存新鲜食物。
按食谱烹饪的餐食会提供特殊状态效果。用自选食材烹饪的餐食会提供动态生成的状态效果。
保存食物可用作餐食材料。

source: You can harvest fresh ingredients and other usable parts from plants.
translation: 你可以从植物上收获新鲜食材和其他可用部件。

source: You can butcher fresh ingredients and other usable parts from animal corpses.
translation: 你可以从动物尸体上屠宰出新鲜食材和其他可用部件。

source: When you choose ingredients to cook with, you can choose up to three instead of two. Meals cooked with three ingredients bestow more powerful status effects.
translation: 当你选择烹饪食材时，可以选择最多三种，而不是两种。用三种食材烹饪的餐食会提供更强大的状态效果。

source: Whenever you gain a level, and 5% of the time you explore a new map, you become inspired for two days. While inspired, the next time you cook a meal by choosing ingredients, you get a choice of three dynamically-generated effects to apply. You create a recipe for the chosen effect.
translation: 每当你升级，以及你探索新地图时有 5% 几率，你会获得两天灵感。受灵感启发时，下次你用自选食材烹饪餐食，会从三个动态生成的效果中选择一个应用。你会为所选效果创建一份食谱。

source: You are skilled with crushing and bludgeoning weapons.
translation: 你擅长使用碾压和钝击武器。

source: You get +2 to hit with cudgels.

Whenever you hit with a cudgel, there's a 50% chance to daze your opponent (-4 int, -4 agi, -10 movespeed) for 3-4 rounds. If you daze a dazed opponent, they're stunned for 1 round instead (cannot take actions and 0 DV).
translation: 每当你用棍棒命中时，有 50% 几率让对手晕眩（-4 智力、-4 敏捷、-10 移动速度）3-4 轮。如果你让已晕眩的对手再次晕眩，则改为让对方震慑 1 轮（不能行动且 闪避 为 0）。

source: When you charge with a cudgel and hit, you automatically daze your opponent. When you charge with an axe and hit, if you cleave their armor, they get an additional -1 penalty to their AV. If you have Dismember, your chance to dismember when charging with an axe is doubled.
translation: 你持棍棒冲锋并命中时，会自动使对手晕眩。你持斧冲锋并命中时，如果劈开对方护甲，对方 护甲 额外受到 -1 惩罚。如果你拥有肢解，持斧冲锋时肢解几率翻倍。

source:
Activated; cooldown 10.
You make an attack with a cudgel at an adjacent opponent. If you hit, you automatically daze them for 3-4 rounds. Dazing a dazed opponent stuns them. Conking a stunned opponent instead knocks them unconscious for 30-40 rounds (unconscious opponents wake up dazed when they take damage).
translation:
主动；冷却 10。
你用棍棒攻击相邻对手。如果命中，你会自动让对手晕眩 3-4 轮。让已晕眩的对手再次晕眩会改为震慑。敲昏已震慑的对手则会让对方昏迷 30-40 轮（昏迷的对手受伤时会晕眩醒来）。

source: Whenever you make a cudgel attack with your primary hand, there's a 25% chance you make an additional free attack with the same hand.
translation: 每当你用主手进行棍棒攻击时，有 25% 几率用同一只手进行一次额外免费攻击。

source: Activated; cooldown 50. You make an attack with a cudgel at an adjacent opponent with +1 to your penetration roll. If you hit, you slam your opponent backwards up to 3 spaces, pushing other creatures and breaking through walls if their AVs are less than 5 times your Strength modifier. Opponents who get pushed are stunned for 1 round plus an additional round for each space pushed. Opponents who are pushed through or against walls take extra weapon damage for each wall. Gigantic opponents don't get pushed but are still stunned for 1 round. Destroys a wall or door if its AV is under 5 times your Strength modifier.
translation: 主动；冷却 50。你用棍棒攻击相邻对手，穿透掷骰 +1。如果命中，你将对手向后猛击最多 3 格；如果其他生物和墙壁的 护甲 小于你力量修正值的 5 倍，则会推动它们并破墙而过。被推动的对手震慑 1 轮，每被推动 1 格额外 +1 轮。被推穿墙壁或撞到墙壁的对手，每面墙都会受到额外武器伤害。巨型对手不会被推动，但仍会震慑 1 轮。如果墙或门的 护甲 低于你力量修正值的 5 倍，则会被摧毁。

source:
Activated; cooldown 100.
For the next 5 rounds, your chance to daze with cudgel attacks is 100% and Slam has no cooldown. To use Demolish, Slam must be off cooldown, and using Demolish puts Slam on cooldown.
translation:
主动；冷却 100。
接下来的 5 轮内，你的棍棒攻击造成晕眩的几率为 100%，且猛撞没有冷却。要使用拆毁，猛撞必须不在冷却中；使用拆毁会使猛撞进入冷却。

source: You are familiar with the customs and folklore of Qud.
translation: 你熟悉 库德 的风俗与民俗。

source: Whenever you begin the water ritual with a new creature, you gain 25 bonus reputation. If you purchase this power after you treat with a creature, you gain 25 bonus reputation the next time you treat with them.
translation: 每当你与一种新生物开始饮水仪式时，获得 25 点额外声望。如果你在与某生物交涉后购买此能力，下次与其交涉时获得 25 点额外声望。

source: Whenever you rifle through trash, there's a 5% chance you piece together clues and learn a random secret.
translation: 每当你翻找垃圾时，有 5% 几率拼凑出线索并获知一个随机秘密。

source: You may choose not to make offhand attacks in exchange for mastery with a single weapon.
translation: 你可以选择不进行副手攻击，以换取对单件武器的精通。

source: Whenever you score a critical hit with a melee weapon while single-weapon fighting, the cooldowns of up to two random weapon or shield skills are immediately refreshed.
translation: 单武器战斗时，每当你用近战武器造成重击，最多两个随机武器或盾牌技能的冷却会立即刷新。

source: Whenever you make a melee attack while single-weapon fighting, there's a 50% chance you immediately make a second attack for free.
translation: 单武器战斗时，每当你进行近战攻击，有 50% 几率立即免费进行第二次攻击。

source: While single-weapon fighting, your melee attacks always penetrate one extra time.
translation: 单武器战斗时，你的近战攻击总会额外穿透一次。

source: Whenever you make a melee attack while single-weapon fighting, immediately make a second attack for free.
translation: 单武器战斗时，每当你进行近战攻击，立即免费进行第二次攻击。

source: You are skilled at multiweapon fighting. Your chance to attack with offhand weapons is increased.
translation: 你擅长多武器战斗。你用副手武器攻击的几率提高。

source: Activated; cooldown 60. You make an attack with every weapon-wielding limb, including extra limbs granted by mutation or technology.
translation: 主动；冷却 60。你用每条持有武器的肢体进行一次攻击，包括由突变或科技获得的额外肢体。

source: Your chance to strike with each of your offhand weapons is increased by 20%.
translation: 你每件副手武器的攻击几率提高 20%。

source: Your chance to strike with each of your offhand weapons is increased by 35%.
translation: 你每件副手武器的攻击几率提高 35%。

source: Your chance to strike with each of your offhand weapons is increased by 50%.
translation: 你每件副手武器的攻击几率提高 50%。

source: You are skilled at enduring harsh conditions and situations.
translation: 你擅长忍受严酷环境和处境。

source: Each round you are dazed or stunned, you have a (Toughness-10)% chance to shake off the effect. You also take 25% less damage from poison.
translation: 每轮你处于晕眩或震慑状态时，有 (坚韧-10)% 几率摆脱该效果。你受到的毒素伤害也减少 25%。

source: Reduces the movement speed penalty when swimming (normally 50 points) by 25 points.
translation: 游泳时的移动速度惩罚（通常为 50 点）减少 25 点。

source: You take 25% less damage from poison.
translation: 你受到的毒素伤害减少 25%。

source: You take 15% less damage from heating and cooling effects. Additionally, the severities of effects that change your temperature are reduced by 15%.
translation: 你受到的加热和冷却效果伤害减少 15%。此外，改变你温度的效果严重程度降低 15%。

source: You may ingest one additional tonic without it reacting adversely to the tonic you have already ingested.
translation: 你可以额外摄入一剂药剂，而不会与已摄入的药剂发生不良反应。
你的天然 护甲 提升至 1。

source: You may sprint for an additional 10 turns.
translation: 你可以额外疾跑 10 回合。

source: Bandages you apply are much more effective at stopping bleeding.
translation: 你使用的绷带在止血方面有效得多。

source: You can treat bleeding, poison, illness, and disease onset for you and your companions at a campfire.
translation: 你可以在营火旁为自己和同伴治疗流血、中毒、患病以及疾病发作。

source: You can voluntarily amputate your own limbs and the limbs of infected companions.
translation: 你可以自愿截断自己的肢体，以及受感染同伴的肢体。

source: Healing tonics you apply last an extra round.
translation: 你施用的治疗药剂额外持续一轮。

source: You are skilled with heavy weapons.
You shoulder your weapons more effectively. Heavy weapons count for half their weight toward your encumbrance.
translation: 你更有效地扛负武器。重武器只按一半重量计入你的负重。

source: You suffer no movement penalty while wielding a heavy weapon.
translation: 你持用重武器时不受移动惩罚。

source: You fire 5 shots with your heavy weapon, sweeping over a 90 degree cone. Your heavy weapon is reloaded before each shot.
translation: 你用重武器开火 5 次，扫过 90 度锥形区域。每次射击前你的重武器都会重新装填。

source: sweeping a gun back and forth
You are skilled with long thrusting and slashing blades.
translation: 你擅长使用长刺击刃和长劈砍刃。

source:
You gain access to two stances.
Aggressive stance: With a long blade in your primary hand, your long blade and short blade attacks gain +1 to your penetration roll but -2 to hit.
Defensive stance: While wielding a long blade in your primary hand, you gain +2 DV.
translation:
你获得两种架势。
进攻架势：主手持长刃时，你的长刃和短刃攻击穿透掷骰 +1，但命中 -2。
防御架势：主手持长刃时，你获得 +2 闪避。

source:
Activated; cooldown 15.
Aggressive stance: Lunge through an empty space at an opponent and attack with +2 to your penetration roll. You must move through the empty space.
Defensive stance: Attack an opponent then lunge backward 2 spaces.
Dueling stance: Attack an opponent with +1 to your penetration roll. The attack is guaranteed to hit and penetrate at least once.
translation:
主动；冷却 15。
进攻架势：穿过一个空格向对手突进并攻击，穿透掷骰 +2。你必须穿过该空格。
防御架势：攻击一名对手，然后向后突退 2 格。
决斗架势：攻击一名对手，穿透掷骰 +1。该攻击必定命中并至少穿透一次。

source:
Activated; cooldown 15.
Aggressive stance: Make an attack against all adjacent opponents.
Defensive stance: Push all adjacent creatures back 1 space and attempt to trip opponents (strength/agility save; difficulty 30).
Dueling stance: Attack an opponent and attempt to disarm them (strength save; difficulty 25 + your Agi modifier). The attack is guaranteed to hit and penetrate at least once.
translation:
主动；冷却 15。
进攻架势：攻击所有相邻对手。
防御架势：将所有相邻生物推后 1 格，并尝试绊倒对手（力量/敏捷豁免；难度 30）。
决斗架势：攻击一名对手并尝试解除其武装（力量豁免；难度 25 + 你的 敏捷 修正值）。该攻击必定命中并至少穿透一次。

source: You gain access to dueling stance. While wielding a long blade in your primary hand, you get +2 to hit with long blades and short blades.
translation: 你获得决斗架势。主手持长刃时，你用长刃和短刃攻击命中 +2。

source: Your penetration bonus in aggressive stance is increased to +2, but your to-hit penalty is increased to -3.
translation: 你在进攻架势下的穿透加值提高至 +2，但命中惩罚提高至 -3。

source: Your DV bonus in defensive stance is increased to +3.
translation: 你在防御架势下的 闪避 加值提高至 +3。

source: Your to-hit bonus in dueling stance is increased to +3.
translation: 你在决斗架势下的命中加值提高至 +3。

source: Activated; cooldown 100. For the next 10 rounds, Lunge and Swipe have no cooldown.
translation: 主动；冷却 100。接下来的 10 轮内，突刺和横扫没有冷却。

source: You are skilled at convincing others.
You stare down a nearby opponent and send them fleeing in terror.
translation: 你瞪退附近一名对手，让对手因恐惧而逃跑。

source: Cooldown 50. You try to terrify adjacent, hostile creatures (1d8 + [Ego modifier] penetration roll vs. MA). On success, a frightened creature flees from you for 6d4 rounds.
translation: 冷却 50。你试图吓坏相邻的敌对生物（1d8 + [自我 修正值] 穿透掷骰对抗 精神护甲）。成功时，受惊生物会逃离你 6d4 轮。

source: Cooldown 50. You shame a nearby creature for 6d6 rounds, giving it a -4 penalty to DV, to-hit, Ego, Willpower and a -10% penalty to quickness.
translation: 冷却 50。你羞辱附近一个生物 6d6 轮，让对方 闪避、命中、自我、意志力 受到 -4 惩罚，并受到 -10% 迅捷惩罚。

source: For purposes of bartering, your ego is treated as though it were 4 points higher.
translation: 在以物易物时，你的 自我 视为提高 4 点。

source: You persuade an intelligent creature to join you.
translation: 你说服一个智能生物加入你。

source: You are skilled with pistols of various kinds.
For purposes of determining your accuracy with pistols, your agility is treated as if it were 4 points higher.
translation: 计算你使用手枪的精准度时，你的敏捷视为提高 4 点。

source: Whenever you make a ranged attack while wielding multiple guns, you fire a shot with each of them.
translation: 每当你持有多把枪进行远程攻击时，你会用每把枪各射击一次。

source: You are 5% more likely to score critical hits with pistols (standard chance is 5%).
translation: 你用手枪造成重击的几率提高 5%（标准几率为 5%）。

source: You receive no accuracy penalties for firing pistols while running.
translation: 你奔跑时发射手枪不受精准度惩罚。

source: You have an agility-based chance to disarm your opponent when you score a hit with a pistol.
translation: 你用手枪命中时，有一个基于敏捷的几率解除对手武装。

source: Critical hits you score with pistols are more deadly.
translation: 你用手枪造成的重击更加致命。

source: Cooldown 200. For 20 rounds, firing a pistol only takes half a round instead of a full round.
translation: 冷却 200。接下来的 20 轮内，发射手枪只需半轮，而不是完整一轮。

source: The action cost of firing pistols is reduced by 25%.
translation: 发射手枪的行动花费降低 25%。

source: You are skilled at maintaining self-discipline.

While meditating, you regenerate three times as fast, and negative status effects wear out three times as fast. The only action you can take while meditating is Wait. You stop meditating if you take damage in a single round exceeding (Willpower*3)-60. If you rest for 10 or more turns, you automatically begin meditating.
translation: 冥想时，你的再生速度提高到三倍，负面状态效果消退速度也提高到三倍。冥想时你唯一能执行的行动是等待。如果你在单轮内受到超过 (意志力*3)-60 的伤害，你会停止冥想。如果你休息 10 回合或更久，会自动开始冥想。

source:
You hunger and thirst at one-half the normal rate.
Metabolic effects from meals last twice as long.
translation:
你的饥饿和口渴速度为正常的一半。
餐食带来的代谢效果持续时间翻倍。

source: Each round you are confused, you have a (Willpower-10)% chance to shake off the effect.
translation: 每轮你处于混乱状态时，有 (意志力-10)% 几率摆脱该效果。

source: Each round you are terrified, you have a (Willpower-10)% chance to shake off the effect.
translation: 每轮你处于恐惧状态时，有 (意志力-10)% 几率摆脱该效果。

source: You may sprint for an additional 10 turns.
translation: 你可以额外疾跑 10 回合。

source:
You hunger and thirst at one-sixth rate.
Metabolic effects from meals last six times as long.
You suffer no penalty for becoming famished.
translation:
你的饥饿和口渴速度为正常的六分之一。
餐食带来的代谢效果持续时间为六倍。
你处于饥馑状态时不受惩罚。

source: putting the mind over the body
You are skilled at wielding shields.

As long as you wield a shield, there is a 50% chance you block one melee attack per round. When you block an attack, you add the shield's AV bonus to your AV for that attack. If you equip multiple shields, the one block per round limit is per shield, and you only can attempt to block a given attack once, using your best usable shield.
translation: 只要你持有盾牌，每轮有 50% 几率格挡一次近战攻击。当你格挡攻击时，在该次攻击中将盾牌的 护甲 加值加入你的 护甲。如果你装备多个盾牌，每轮一次格挡限制按每面盾牌分别计算，且你只能尝试格挡某次攻击一次，使用你可用的最佳盾牌。

source: Activated; cooldown 40. You attempt to knock an opponent down and deal (Str modifier)d2 + your shield's AV bonus in damage. Your opponent gets a chance to resist (strength save; difficulty 20 + your Str modifier). Whenever you charge an opponent with a shield equipped, you get a free Shield Slam attack against them.
translation: 主动；冷却 40。你尝试击倒一名对手，并造成 (力量 修正值)d2 + 你的盾牌 护甲 加值的伤害。对手有机会抵抗（力量豁免；难度 20 + 你的 力量 修正值）。每当你装备盾牌向对手冲锋时，你会获得一次针对该对手的免费盾击攻击。

source: Your chance to block with a shield improves to 75%.
translation: 你用盾牌格挡的几率提高至 75%。

source: You may block an additional attack per round per shield.
translation: 每面盾牌每轮可额外格挡一次攻击。

source: Whenever you block an opponent's attack, there is a (Strength*2)-35% chance that your opponent is stunned for 1d2 rounds.
translation: 每当你格挡对手的攻击时，有 (力量*2)-35% 几率使对手震慑 1d2 轮。

source: For the next three rounds, you automatically block all incoming melee attacks (may not be used with bucklers).
translation: 接下来的三轮内，你自动格挡所有来袭近战攻击（不可与小圆盾一起使用）。

source: forming a wall with your shield
You are skilled with small one-handed knives and blades.
translation: 你擅长使用小型单手刀具和刀刃。

source: You get +1 to hit with short blades. Also, the action costs of attacking with a short blade in your primary hand is reduced by 25%.
translation: 你用短刃攻击时命中 +1。此外，用主手短刃攻击的行动花费降低 25%。

source: Your short blade attacks that penetrate have a 75% chance to cause your opponent to bleed (0-1 damage per turn. toughness save; difficulty 20 + your Agi modifier). The opponent saves to stop bleeding each round, and the save difficulty decreases by 1 each round. This effect can stack a number of times equal to 1 plus your Agi modifier.
translation: 你的短刃攻击如果穿透，有 75% 几率让对手流血（每回合 0-1 伤害。坚韧豁免；难度 20 + 你的 敏捷 修正值）。对手每轮进行豁免以停止流血，豁免难度每轮降低 1。这个效果可叠加，次数等于 1 + 你的 敏捷 修正值。

source: Whenever you make an offhand attack with a short blade, you immediately make another attack with that same weapon. Flurry attacks do not trigger this.
translation: 每当你用短刃进行副手攻击时，立即用同一把武器再次攻击。乱舞攻击不会触发此效果。

source: You make an attack with a short blade in your primary hand, looking for a weak spot in your opponent's armor. If you hit, you penetrate exactly once and hobble them (-50% movespeed for 16-20 rounds).
translation: 你用主手短刃发动一次攻击，寻找对手护甲的弱点。如果命中，你恰好穿透一次并让对手跛行（移动速度 -50%，持续 16-20 轮）。

source: Whenever you juke an opponent while wielding a short blade in your primary hand, you make a free attack. If you have Bloodletter, the attack's chance to cause bleeding is 100%.
translation: 每当你主手持短刃闪身绕开对手时，发动一次免费攻击。如果你拥有放血者，该攻击造成流血的几率为 100%。

source: Once per turn, when an opponent misses you with a melee attack, there's a 40% chance you make a free attack with a short blade you're wielding.
translation: 每回合一次，当对手用近战攻击未命中你时，有 40% 几率用你持有的一把短刃发动一次免费攻击。

source: Activated; cooldown 10 (primary) or 20 (offhand). You make a melee attack with a short blade in your primary hand (preferred) or offhand. If you hit, the attack gets +2 to penetration rolls for each negative status effect your opponent suffers from.
translation: 主动；冷却 10（主手）或 20（副手）。你用主手（优先）或副手短刃发动一次近战攻击。如果命中，对手每承受一种负面状态效果，该攻击的穿透掷骰 +2。

source: You are aware of basic combat tactics.
You receive no penalty to your DV while sprinting and can jump without interrupting your sprint.
translation: 疾跑时你的 闪避 不受惩罚，并且可以跳跃而不中断疾跑。

source: Your throw range is increased by 3 and your throw variance is halved when throwing at a target inside your throw range.
translation: 你的投掷范围增加 3；向投掷范围内的目标投掷时，投掷偏差减半。

source: You charge forward two or three squares and perform a melee attack with +1 to your penetration roll.
translation: 你向前冲锋两或三格，并发动一次近战攻击，穿透掷骰 +1。

source: Whenever you fire a missile weapon at a target in melee range, you attempt to kick the target backwards.
translation: 每当你在近战范围内向目标发射投射武器时，你会尝试将目标向后踢。

source: Activated; cooldown 40. You move one square at no action cost. You may swap squares with a hostile opponent.
translation: 主动；冷却 40。你不花费行动移动一格。你可以与一名敌对对手交换格子。

source: You are skilled at examining, building, repairing and modding artifacts.
translation: 你擅长检查、制造、修理和改造神器。

source: You are much more successful at examining artifacts, and you can deploy wiring.
translation: 你检查神器的成功率大幅提高，并且可以部署布线。

source: You can disassemble scrap and artifacts for bits. You get the most significant bit from the item schematic plus a 50% chance to receive each remaining bit.
translation: 你可以将废料和神器拆解为零件。你获得物品图纸中最重要的零件，并有 50% 几率获得每个剩余零件。

source: Whenever you disassemble an item, you have a 25% chance to learn how to build the item. If the item was modded, you also have a 15% chance per mod to learn the mod.
translation: 每当你拆解一件物品时，有 25% 几率学会如何制造这个物品。如果这个物品经过改造，你还会对每个改造项各有 15% 几率学会这个改造。

source: Whenever you step over garbage, you astutely rifle through it and occasionally discover scrap. Additionally, you harvest extra scrap from robots you destroy.
translation: 每当你踩过垃圾时，你会机敏地翻找其中，偶尔发现废料。此外，你会从摧毁的机器人身上收获额外废料。

source: You may repair broken items with Bits.
translation: 你可以用 零件 修理破损物品。

source: You may deploy missile weapons as static turrets.
translation: 你可以将投射武器部署为固定炮塔。

source: You may lay down grenades as mines or set them as bombs.
translation: 你可以将手雷布设为地雷，或设置为炸弹。

source: You may build items from low-tier schematics and you get 1 free schematic. You can also recharge energy cells and capacitors.
translation: 你可以根据低阶图纸制造物品，并获得 1 张免费图纸。你还可以为能量电池和电容器充能。

source: You may build items from medium-tier schematics and you get 1 free schematic.
translation: 你可以根据中阶图纸制造物品，并获得 1 张免费图纸。

source: You may build items from high-tier schematics and you get 1 free schematic.
translation: 你可以根据高阶图纸制造物品，并获得 1 张免费图纸。

source: You are skilled at wilderness survival.
Start a campfire for cooking meals and preserving foods.
translation: 生起营火，用于烹饪餐食和保存食物。

source:
Doubles the chance of regaining your bearings when you are lost.
Reduces chance of getting lost by about 15%.
You travel on the world map twice as quickly.
translation:
迷路时重新辨明方向的几率翻倍。
迷路几率降低约 15%。
你在世界地图上的旅行速度翻倍。

source:
Doubles the chance of interesting encounters while traveling through the flower fields on the world map.
Reduces the chance of getting lost in the flower fields from base 12% to 1%.
On the world map, you travel through the flower fields twice as quickly.
translation:
在世界地图上穿越花田时，有趣遭遇的几率翻倍。
在花田中迷路的几率从基础 12% 降至 1%。
在世界地图上，你穿越花田的速度翻倍。

source:
Doubles the chance of interesting encounters while traveling through the salt marshes and watervine fields on the world map.
Reduces the chance of getting lost in the salt marshes and watervine fields from base 12% to 1%.
On the world map, you travel through the salt marshes and watervine fields twice as quickly.
translation:
在世界地图上穿越盐沼和水藤田时，有趣遭遇的几率翻倍。
在盐沼和水藤田中迷路的几率从基础 12% 降至 1%。
在世界地图上，你穿越盐沼和水藤田的速度翻倍。

source:
Doubles the chance of interesting encounters while traveling through the hills and mountains on the world map.
Reduces the chance of getting lost in the hills and mountains from base 12% to 1%.
On the world map, you travel through the hills and mountains twice as quickly.
translation:
在世界地图上穿越丘陵和山脉时，有趣遭遇的几率翻倍。
在丘陵和山脉中迷路的几率从基础 12% 降至 1%。
在世界地图上，你穿越丘陵和山脉的速度翻倍。

source:
Doubles the chance of interesting encounters while traveling through the desert canyons on the world map.
Reduces the chance of getting lost in the desert canyons from base 12% to 1%.
On the world map, you travel through the desert canyons twice as quickly.
translation:
在世界地图上穿越沙漠峡谷时，有趣遭遇的几率翻倍。
在沙漠峡谷中迷路的几率从基础 12% 降至 1%。
在世界地图上，你穿越沙漠峡谷的速度翻倍。

source:
Doubles the chance of interesting encounters while traveling through the salt dunes on the world map.
Reduces the chance of getting lost in the salt dunes from base 10% to 1%.
On the world map, you travel through the salt dunes twice as quickly.
translation:
在世界地图上穿越盐丘时，有趣遭遇的几率翻倍。
在盐丘中迷路的几率从基础 10% 降至 1%。
在世界地图上，你穿越盐丘的速度翻倍。

source:
Doubles the chance of interesting encounters while traveling through the jungles on the world map.
Reduces the chance of getting lost in the jungles from base 12% to 1%.
On the world map, you travel through the jungles twice as quickly.
translation:
在世界地图上穿越丛林时，有趣遭遇的几率翻倍。
在丛林中迷路的几率从基础 12% 降至 1%。
在世界地图上，你穿越丛林的速度翻倍。

source:
Doubles the chance of interesting encounters while traveling across rivers and lakes on the world map.
Reduces the chance of getting lost in rivers and lakes from base 12% to 1%.
On the world map, you travel across rivers and lakes twice as quickly.
translation:
在世界地图上穿越河流和湖泊时，有趣遭遇的几率翻倍。
在河流和湖泊中迷路的几率从基础 12% 降至 1%。
在世界地图上，你穿越河流和湖泊的速度翻倍。

source:
Doubles the chance of interesting encounters while traveling through chrome ruins on the world map.
Reduces the chance of getting lost in ruins from base 12% to 1%.
On the world map, you travel through ruins twice as quickly.
translation:
在世界地图上穿越铬钢废墟时，有趣遭遇的几率翻倍。
在废墟中迷路的几率从基础 12% 降至 1%。
在世界地图上，你穿越废墟的速度翻倍。

source: Your precognitive visions last twice as long.
translation: 你的预知幻象持续时间翻倍。

source: Your {{W|Strength}} determines how much melee damage you do (by improving your armor penetration), your ability to resist forced movement, and your carry capacity.
translation: 你的 {{W|力量}} 决定你的近战伤害（通过提高护甲穿透）、抵抗强制移动的能力，以及负重能力。

source: Your {{W|Agility}} determines your accuracy with both melee and ranged weapons and your chance to dodge attacks.
translation: 你的 {{W|敏捷}} 决定你使用近战和远程武器的精准度，以及你闪避攻击的几率。

source: Your {{W|Toughness}} determines your number of hit points, your hit point regeneration rate, and your ability to resist poison and disease.
translation: 你的 {{W|坚韧}} 决定你的生命值数量、生命值再生速度，以及抵抗毒素和疾病的能力。

source: Your {{W|Intelligence}} determines your number of skill points and your ability to examine artifacts.
translation: 你的 {{W|智力}} 决定你的技能点数量，以及检查神器的能力。

source: Your {{W|Willpower}} modifies the cooldowns of your activated abilities, determines your ability to resist mental attacks, and modifies your hit point regeneration rate.
translation: 你的 {{W|意志力}} 会修正主动能力的冷却时间，决定你抵抗心灵攻击的能力，并修正你的生命值再生速度。

source: Your {{W|Ego}} determines the potency of your mental mutations, your ability to haggle with merchants, and your ability to dominate the wills of other living creatures.
translation: 你的 {{W|自我}} 决定你的心灵突变威力、与商人讨价还价的能力，以及支配其他活物意志的能力。

source: Your {{W|Armor Value (AV)}} measures how well protected you are against physical attacks that hit you. The higher your score, the fewer times an opponent's attack will penetrate your armor and do damage to you.
translation: 你的 {{W|护甲值 (护甲)}} 衡量你对命中你的物理攻击有多强防护。分数越高，对手攻击穿透你护甲并对你造成伤害的次数就越少。

source: Your {{W|Dodge Value (DV)}} measures how likely you are to be hit by physical attacks. The higher your score, the less likely an opponent's attack will hit you. Your DV is modified by your Agility modifier.
translation: 你的 {{W|闪避值 (闪避)}} 衡量你被物理攻击命中的可能性。分数越高，对手攻击命中你的可能性就越低。你的 闪避 受敏捷修正值影响。

source: Your {{W|Mental Armor (MA)}} measures how well protected you are against mental attacks. The higher your score, the less likely an opponent's mental attack will penetrate your defenses and harm you. Your MA is modified by your Willpower modifier.
translation: 你的 {{W|心灵护甲 (精神护甲)}} 衡量你对心灵攻击有多强防护。分数越高，对手心灵攻击穿透你的防御并伤害你的可能性就越低。你的 精神护甲 受意志力修正值影响。

source: Your {{W|Quickness}} measures the speed you perform every action you take.
translation: 你的 {{W|迅捷}} 衡量你执行每个行动的速度。

source: Your {{W|Move Speed}} measures how fast you walk or fly.
translation: 你的 {{W|移动速度}} 衡量你行走或飞行的速度。

source: Your {{W|Temperature}} measures how hot or cold you are. Being too cold can reduce your Quickness and prevent you from taking physical actions. Being too hot can set you aflame and cause damage every round.
translation: 你的 {{W|温度}} 衡量你的冷热程度。过冷会降低你的迅捷，并阻止你执行物理行动。过热会点燃你，并每轮造成伤害。

source: Your {{W|Acid Resist}} determines how much acid damage you ablate. At 100, you are immune to acid damage.
translation: 你的 {{W|酸液抗性}} 决定你削减多少酸液伤害。达到 100 时，你免疫酸液伤害。

source: Your {{W|Cold Resist}} determines how much cold damage you ablate and how insulated you are from effects that reduce your temperature. At 100, you are immune to cold damage and your temperature cannot be reduced.
translation: 你的 {{W|寒冷抗性}} 决定你削减多少寒冷伤害，以及你抵抗降温效果的能力。达到 100 时，你免疫寒冷伤害，且你的温度不能被降低。

source: Your {{W|Electrical Resist}} determines how much electrical damage you ablate and how resistive you are to electric current. At 100, you are immune to electrical damage and you do not conduct electricity.
translation: 你的 {{W|电击抗性}} 决定你削减多少电击伤害，以及你抵抗电流的能力。达到 100 时，你免疫电击伤害，并且不导电。

source: Your {{W|Heat Resist}} determines how much heat damage you ablate and how insulated you are from effects that increase your temperature. At 100, you are immune to heat damage and your temperature cannot be increased.
translation: 你的 {{W|热能抗性}} 决定你削减多少热能伤害，以及你抵抗升温效果的能力。达到 100 时，你免疫热能伤害，且你的温度不能被升高。
{{emote|*巴拉瑟姆含混地低语，听不清楚。*}}

path: ((('string', (('ID', "{{emote|*Barathrum's countenance suddenly gravens.*}}\n\nO.. I know it to be arduous for you, meyvn, to see me like this. The imago unstrung..."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-Ascended.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Barathrum's countenance suddenly gravens.*}}

O.. I know it to be arduous for you, meyvn, to see me like this. The imago unstrung...
translation:
{{emote|*巴拉瑟姆的神情突然沉重起来。*}}

哦……我知道，明识者，让你看见我这副模样很艰难。意象散线了……

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I am sorry, =name=. I am so proud of you! I wish... I wish it were I did not peel, like your model.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-Ascended2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I am sorry, =name=. I am so proud of you! I wish... I wish it were I did not peel, like your model.
translation: 对不起，=name=。我真为你骄傲！我希望……我希望我没有像你的模型那样剥落。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Farewell, now, meyvn. =name=. Live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-Ascended3.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Farewell, now, meyvn. =name=. Live and drink.
translation: 现在，告别了，明识者。=name=。生而饮水。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "{{emote|*Barathrum's countenance suddenly gravens.*}}\n\nChild. There is much more I would have liked to share. But... I am a puppet of my shame."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-Ascended-No-Reveal.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Barathrum's countenance suddenly gravens.*}}

Child. There is much more I would have liked to share. But... I am a puppet of my shame.
translation:
{{emote|*巴拉瑟姆的神情突然沉重起来。*}}

孩子。我本还想分享更多。但……我是自己羞耻的傀儡。
{{emote|*巴拉瑟姆含混地低语，听不清楚。*}}

我们已经-

我们做到了，=name=。我-

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Only in the Shallows' dawnstirs did I let myself think it possible. And now..."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Dawnstirs.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Only in the Shallows' dawnstirs did I let myself think it possible. And now...
translation: 只有在浅滩的晨动中，我才允许自己想象这是可能的。而现在……

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*Barathrum exhales with effort.*}}\n\nLet us sort our faculties before we reach the rim of our ascent. There is the edge of our journey still to lathe.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.SortFaculties.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Barathrum exhales with effort.*}}

Let us sort our faculties before we reach the rim of our ascent. There is the edge of our journey still to lathe.
translation:
{{emote|*巴拉瑟姆吃力地呼出一口气。*}}

在我们到达攀升边缘前，先整理一下思绪吧。旅程还有最后一道边要打磨。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Barathrum, let us again talk about the past.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.SortFaculties.BarathrumCuspChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Barathrum, let us again talk about the past.
translation: 巴拉瑟姆，让我们再谈谈过去。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'The Templar are defeated, but will they return in force?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.SortFaculties.TemplarDefeatedChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: The Templar are defeated, but will they return in force?
translation: 圣殿骑士被击败了，但他们会大举归来吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Barathrum, you look pained. Are you well?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.SortFaculties.WellChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Barathrum, you look pained. Are you well?
translation: 巴拉瑟姆，你看起来很痛苦。你还好吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'By your guess, what awaits us where the Spindle breaks?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.SortFaculties.AwaitsChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: By your guess, what awaits us where the Spindle breaks?
translation: 你觉得尖塔断裂的地方会有什么等着我们？

source: I would like a moment, Barathrum.
translation: 我想独处片刻，巴拉瑟姆。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I cannot say, =name=. But I know it's facile to believe a living heritage can be evanesced in one stroke. We are always downstream of a past violence."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.TemplarDefeated.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I cannot say, =name=. But I know it's facile to believe a living heritage can be evanesced in one stroke. We are always downstream of a past violence.
translation: 我说不准，=name=。但我知道，以为一种仍活着的遗产能一击抹掉，是太轻率了。过去的暴力总会流到我们这里。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*Barathrum shifts his weight, pauses, and flexes an arthritic paw.*}}\n\nI am sorry. Tis the acceleration, =name=. I am whirling and empty of breath. Steel yourself, and so shall I.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Well.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Barathrum shifts his weight, pauses, and flexes an arthritic paw.*}}

I am sorry. Tis the acceleration, =name=. I am whirling and empty of breath. Steel yourself, and so shall I.
translation:
{{emote|*巴拉瑟姆挪了挪重心，停顿片刻，屈伸着一只关节炎的爪子。*}}

对不起。是加速度，=name=。我在旋转，喘不上气。你要坚强，我也会如此。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}\n\nO, =name=, our cursors draw together on Fate's phenomenic slide rule! You burn with speculation, and I- I molder in the coolness of knowing. I enter my dwarf phase."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Awaits.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}

O, =name=, our cursors draw together on Fate's phenomenic slide rule! You burn with speculation, and I- I molder in the coolness of knowing. I enter my dwarf phase.
translation:
{{emote|*巴拉瑟姆停顿。*}}

哦，=name=，我们的游标在命运的现象滑尺上相互靠近！你因揣测而燃烧，而我- 我在知晓的冷意中腐朽。我进入了我的矮星相。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*Barathrum takes in a long breath.*}}'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Awaits2.Text')), 1),), '#text')

((('string', (('ID', 'O, deceit! The grueling gate I crossed on every tilt of glittering dusk. I slept in my crimeclothes and wept, did you hear?

Or could you hear only the damnable static, like me, and speak naught to the machine that belches it out. Heal none of the wounds of its grievous heart, or mine own...

O, oh... So much to bear.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Awaits3.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
O, deceit! The grueling gate I crossed on every tilt of glittering dusk. I slept in my crimeclothes and wept, did you hear?

Or could you hear only the damnable static, like me, and speak naught to the machine that belches it out. Heal none of the wounds of its grievous heart, or mine own...

O, oh... So much to bear.
translation:
哦，欺瞒！每逢闪光暮色倾斜，我都穿过那道折磨人的门。我穿着罪衣睡去，哭泣，你听见了吗？

还是你只能像我一样听见那该死的静噪，什么也不对那台喷吐它的机器说。不去治愈它悲痛之心的任何伤口，也不治愈我自己的……

哦，哦……要承受的太多。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I found a torn sheet of graph paper with a note about deceit. Was it yours?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Awaits3.NoMaskChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I found a torn sheet of graph paper with a note about deceit. Was it yours?
translation: 我找到一张撕裂的方格纸，上面写着关于欺瞒的笔记。那是你的吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Your crimeclothes? There was a codex about crimes and punishments near the bedroll in your study. What was it?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Awaits3.NoMaskChoice2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Your crimeclothes? There was a codex about crimes and punishments near the bedroll in your study. What was it?
translation: 你的罪衣？你书房铺盖旁有一本关于罪与罚的典籍。那是什么？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'The svardym Mak said he was born to a cacophony of static ringing his ears raw. Could it have been the signal?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Awaits3.NoMaskChoice3.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: The svardym Mak said he was born to a cacophony of static ringing his ears raw. Could it have been the signal?
translation: 斯瓦尔丁人麦克说，他出生时耳边充满刺痛耳膜的静噪杂响。那会不会就是信号？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'The Svardym Geeub mentioned a machine speaker and her ursine apprentice. Was that you?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Awaits3.NoMaskChoice4.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: The Svardym Geeub mentioned a machine speaker and her ursine apprentice. Was that you?
translation: 斯瓦尔丁人吉乌布提到一名机器言说者和她的熊形学徒。那是你吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Rebekah was a healer. But the daughters of Exile, her acolytes, are tinkers. Why?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Awaits3.NoMaskChoice5.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Rebekah was a healer. But the daughters of Exile, her acolytes, are tinkers. Why?
translation: 丽贝卡是一名医者。但流亡之女，她的侍从们，却是修补匠。为什么？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Yes, that paper, twas mine. This racket of a Signal is mine, too, of sorts.\n\nIt is my tolling bell.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Graph2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Yes, that paper, twas mine. This racket of a Signal is mine, too, of sorts.

It is my tolling bell.
translation:
是的，那张纸是我的。这个喧闹的信号，在某种意义上也是我的。

它是为我敲响的丧钟。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'That codex? A comfort, a guidebook, a ledger. My crimes have no signatories, but the heart is its own document.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.CrimePunishment.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: That codex? A comfort, a guidebook, a ledger. My crimes have no signatories, but the heart is its own document.
translation: 那本典籍？一种安慰，一本指南，一册账簿。我的罪行没有签署者，但心本身就是文书。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Svardym Mak's static? Yes, twas the Signal. My signal. My tolling bell."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.MakStatic.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Svardym Mak's static? Yes, twas the Signal. My signal. My tolling bell.
translation: 斯瓦尔丁人麦克听到的静噪？是的，那就是信号。我的信号。我的丧钟。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Apprentice. So long since I've worn that title, but it feels right still.\n\nYes, twas me at the machine speaker's side."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.GeeubSpeaker.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Apprentice. So long since I've worn that title, but it feels right still.

Yes, twas me at the machine speaker's side.
translation:
学徒。我已太久不曾戴上这个头衔，但它仍然贴切。

是的，当年在机器言说者身旁的正是我。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'She was a healer, yes. The wire cutter can perform the work of a scalpel; and the soldering iron, a suture.\n\nTo take apart a history, and stitch something new...'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.DaughtersTinkers.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
She was a healer, yes. The wire cutter can perform the work of a scalpel; and the soldering iron, a suture.

To take apart a history, and stitch something new...
translation:
她确实是一名医者。剪线钳可以完成手术刀的工作；烙铁也可以成为缝线。

拆开一段历史，再缝合出新的东西……

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}\n\nForgive me, =name=. The ascent strains the mind as well as the body. My flight of fancy is done; I am regrounded.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.BarathrumRecovers.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}

Forgive me, =name=. The ascent strains the mind as well as the body. My flight of fancy is done; I am regrounded.
translation:
{{emote|*巴拉瑟姆停顿片刻。*}}

原谅我，=name=。攀升不只折磨身体，也折磨心智。我已经不再胡思乱想，重新稳住了。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*Barathrum pauses and frowns.*}}\n\nDo you know, =name=, the engine types that ask us to loose every pin and unhinge every cam to know them? Such an engine of culture we are encased in now, and I cannot speak to the workings of one gearset without disassembling them all. I meant not to tease, and soon, I promise, you will spy the next arc of our journey.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.BarathrumCusp.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Barathrum pauses and frowns.*}}

Do you know, =name=, the engine types that ask us to loose every pin and unhinge every cam to know them? Such an engine of culture we are encased in now, and I cannot speak to the workings of one gearset without disassembling them all. I meant not to tease, and soon, I promise, you will spy the next arc of our journey.
translation:
{{emote|*巴拉瑟姆停顿片刻，皱起眉头。*}}

你知道吗，=name=，有些引擎必须松开每一枚销钉、拆下每一只凸轮，才能真正理解。我们现在就被包在这样一台文化引擎里；不把它全部拆开，我就说不清其中一组齿轮怎样运作。我不是有意吊你胃口。我保证，很快你就会看到我们旅程的下一段方向。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Barathrum, if the past has some relevance to this moment, I would ask you to share what you know.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.BarathrumCusp.Z-Reveal0Choice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Barathrum, if the past has some relevance to this moment, I would ask you to share what you know.
translation: 巴拉瑟姆，如果过去和现在有关，请把你知道的告诉我。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'It is done, then. Have the explication you are owed.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-Reveal1.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: It is done, then. Have the explication you are owed.
translation: 那好。你该听到这个解释。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'You see, =name=, when I, a young bruin, crossed the Homs Delta with my flood-fleeing clan and into the western reach of Qud, the plagues of the Gyre were already ascendant. We took root at our new hearth, in the chrome grottos where we urshiib find natural peace, and by the providence of my elders, I was able to study the tinkering craft.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-Reveal1a.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You see, =name=, when I, a young bruin, crossed the Homs Delta with my flood-fleeing clan and into the western reach of Qud, the plagues of the Gyre were already ascendant. We took root at our new hearth, in the chrome grottos where we urshiib find natural peace, and by the providence of my elders, I was able to study the tinkering craft.
translation: 你看，=name=，当年我还是一头年轻的熊，随躲洪水的氏族穿过霍姆斯三角洲，进入库德西境时，轮回诸疫已经兴起。我们在新的炉火旁扎根，在铬钢岩窟中安顿。那地方让我们乌尔希布天生感到平静；也多亏长辈许可，我得以学习修补技艺。

path:
((('string', (('ID', "Through my work I caught the attention of a master machinist, unconventional of method, who took me under her wing and, in time, availed me of the orphic truth.

She explained, as I've shared with you and the rest of the acolytes, that the world we know once belonged to a grand Coven of beings who spanned the stars. And that, acting on some inscrutable logic, they disappeared. That an injunction was placed on our world.

This, you know. It is the truth I told, if only half. But Rebekah taught me more."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-Reveal2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Through my work I caught the attention of a master machinist, unconventional of method, who took me under her wing and, in time, availed me of the orphic truth.

She explained, as I've shared with you and the rest of the acolytes, that the world we know once belonged to a grand Coven of beings who spanned the stars. And that, acting on some inscrutable logic, they disappeared. That an injunction was placed on our world.

This, you know. It is the truth I told, if only half. But Rebekah taught me more.
translation:
我的工作引起了一位机械大师的注意。她做事不按常规，却收我为徒，后来又让我接触到奥秘真理。

她解释说，正如我曾告诉你和其他侍僧的那样，我们所知的世界曾属于一个宏大的星际盟会。随后，出于某种不可测的逻辑，他们消失了。我们的世界也被加上了一道禁令。

这些你都知道。这是我讲述过的真相，虽只是一半。但丽贝卡还教给我更多。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Atop the implausible rise of the Spindle roosted a Seraph, one of the great machinic archons of the Eaters, and this being Rebekah served.\n\nIn the short years before I arrived in Qud, the Seraph became convinced that something had changed in the cosmic order. That along the ecliptic of the Folk Clock, some uncounted peg had slid to a priming position, and that the Coven was set to imminently return.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-Reveal3.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Atop the implausible rise of the Spindle roosted a Seraph, one of the great machinic archons of the Eaters, and this being Rebekah served.

In the short years before I arrived in Qud, the Seraph became convinced that something had changed in the cosmic order. That along the ecliptic of the Folk Clock, some uncounted peg had slid to a priming position, and that the Coven was set to imminently return.
translation:
在纺锤那不可思议的高升之巅，栖居着一位炽天使，食客伟大机械执政者之一；丽贝卡侍奉的正是此存在。

在我抵达库德前不久，炽天使确信宇宙秩序中有什么发生了变化。民钟的黄道上，某枚未计数的销栓已滑入预备位置，盟会即将归来。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'The Seraph spoke of a Great Machine that spanned galaxies, the motion of whose sails and gear trains directed the fluidic shifting of stars and cultures. But they spoke little of it, and little I know.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.FolkClock.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: The Seraph spoke of a Great Machine that spanned galaxies, the motion of whose sails and gear trains directed the fluidic shifting of stars and cultures. But they spoke little of it, and little I know.
translation: 炽天使曾说起一台横跨星系的伟大机器；它的帆翼与齿轮组运转，导引着星辰与文化如流体般迁移。但他们谈得很少，我所知也少。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "{{emote|*Barathrum coughs and swallows.*}}\n\nTo ready our world for the Coven's return, the Seraph, who would be called Resheph, became convinced that all higher life on the planet must... be purged. That it was our life and way of living that moved the Coven to set the injunction. The only way through was for a new life to obtain."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-Reveal4.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Barathrum coughs and swallows.*}}

To ready our world for the Coven's return, the Seraph, who would be called Resheph, became convinced that all higher life on the planet must... be purged. That it was our life and way of living that moved the Coven to set the injunction. The only way through was for a new life to obtain.
translation:
{{emote|*巴拉瑟姆咳嗽，吞咽了一下。*}}

为了让我们的世界为盟会归来做好准备，那位后来被称作瑞谢夫的炽天使确信，星球上一切高等生命都必须……被清除。他们认定，正是我们的生命和生活方式促使盟会降下禁令。唯一的出路，是让新的生命取得位置。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "And so, Resheph seeded the plagues and whorled them via waveform to a breathing gyre. Blights engineered to attack life whilst preserving the planet's artifacts of glass and chrome.\n\nRebekah, dear tutor, betrayed Resheph's confidences and apprised me of the plan, so that I might help her dash it apart and save the peoples of our world."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-Reveal5.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
And so, Resheph seeded the plagues and whorled them via waveform to a breathing gyre. Blights engineered to attack life whilst preserving the planet's artifacts of glass and chrome.

Rebekah, dear tutor, betrayed Resheph's confidences and apprised me of the plan, so that I might help her dash it apart and save the peoples of our world.
translation:
于是，瑞谢夫播下瘟疫，以波形将它们旋成一场呼吸的轮回。那些灾疫经工程设计，专攻生命，却保全星球上的玻璃与铬钢造物。

丽贝卡，我亲爱的导师，背弃了瑞谢夫托付的秘密，将计划告知于我，好让我协助她粉碎它，拯救我们世界的诸民。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I asked for time. Give me time. To reform Qud, extinguish the hatefulness and needless warmaking, to lift our world across the eschaton and prepare it for the Coven's return..."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-Reveal7.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I asked for time. Give me time. To reform Qud, extinguish the hatefulness and needless warmaking, to lift our world across the eschaton and prepare it for the Coven's return...
translation: 我请求时间。给我时间。让我重塑库德，熄灭仇恨与无谓的征战，把我们的世界托举越过末世，为盟会归来做好准备……

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'After a storm of shrapnel words, the Seraph acceded to ten centuries.

Ten centuries! An eyeblink on the scales of the Folk Clock but an eternity for us. So I believed.

The rousing Signal would cease, the plagues of the Gyre would be reversed, to the extent they could; for even the potent archon had not full governance over what they had worked into being.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-Reveal8.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
After a storm of shrapnel words, the Seraph acceded to ten centuries.

Ten centuries! An eyeblink on the scales of the Folk Clock but an eternity for us. So I believed.

The rousing Signal would cease, the plagues of the Gyre would be reversed, to the extent they could; for even the potent archon had not full governance over what they had worked into being.
translation:
在一场弹片般飞溅的言语风暴之后，炽天使允给了十个世纪。

十个世纪！在民钟的刻度上不过一眨眼，对我们却是一段永恒。我当时这样相信。

唤醒信号会停下，轮回诸疫也会尽量被逆转；因为就连那位强大的执政者，也不能完全控制他们亲手造出的东西。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'What would there be for the Coven to return to, if life on our world was purged?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-Reveal8.Z-PurgeChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: What would there be for the Coven to return to, if life on our world was purged?
translation: 如果我们世界上的生命都被清除，盟会回来后还能回到哪里？
瑞谢夫为什么成了苏丹？

source: Resheph is remembered as a healer.
translation: 瑞谢夫被后世铭记为一名医者。

source: How did the agreement play out?

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Then you did not succeed, by Resheph's measure?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-Reveal8.Z-FailedChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Then you did not succeed, by Resheph's measure?
translation: 那么按瑞谢夫的标准，你并没有成功？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I asked Resheph that very question. But the seraphim transit an ethical manifold much different than our own.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-Purge.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I asked Resheph that very question. But the seraphim transit an ethical manifold much different than our own.
translation: 我也曾向瑞谢夫问过这个问题。但炽天使看待伦理的方式，和我们很不一样。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Once the Seraph had become convinced of the Coven's return, they reified their authority and assumed a more material role in onworld matters. The decaying sultanate was a convenient tool."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-Sultan.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Once the Seraph had become convinced of the Coven's return, they reified their authority and assumed a more material role in onworld matters. The decaying sultanate was a convenient tool.
translation: 一旦炽天使确信盟会将归，他们便使自身的权威具现，并在世间事务中承担起更为实体性的角色。日渐朽败的苏丹国，恰是一件称手的工具。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "And he was, of a sort. The cure for a plague is often too its cause. With one's paws on the dials and drum of power, history is a cloth to be loomspun."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-Healer.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: And he was, of a sort. The cure for a plague is often too its cause. With one's paws on the dials and drum of power, history is a cloth to be loomspun.
translation: 某种意义上，他确实是。瘟疫的解药往往也正是它的病因。只要双爪按在权力的旋钮和鼓面上，历史就像布，可以按自己的意思织出来。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'We allied on the notion that the sultanate must be abolished for the future to flower. I was to execute the earthly plan, while Resheph continued preparations at the astronomical tier. To achieve a sort of bicameralism of action, Resheph insisted on reformatting their personality as a triumvirate, seeded from thin scans of the original archon, Rebekah, and myself.\n\nThe art of mythmaking was employed to enshrine the Resheph persona. Thus- the healer, the Coiled Lamb, and perhaps unexpectedly, the Above.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-Agreement.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
We allied on the notion that the sultanate must be abolished for the future to flower. I was to execute the earthly plan, while Resheph continued preparations at the astronomical tier. To achieve a sort of bicameralism of action, Resheph insisted on reformatting their personality as a triumvirate, seeded from thin scans of the original archon, Rebekah, and myself.

The art of mythmaking was employed to enshrine the Resheph persona. Thus- the healer, the Coiled Lamb, and perhaps unexpectedly, the Above.
translation:
我们结盟，是基于同一个信念：苏丹国必须废除，未来才能开花。我负责执行尘世层面的计划，而瑞谢夫则继续在天文层级上筹备。为了达成某种行动上的两院制，瑞谢夫坚持将自己的人格重格式化为三头执政，由原初执政者、丽贝卡与我的浅层扫描播种而成。

神话营造之术被用来圣化瑞谢夫这个人格。于是便有了医者，盘曲羔羊，以及或许出人意料的，上方者。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*Barathrum inhales and stutters.*}} She-\n\nResheph would not forgive her trespass. She contracted the rotting tongue while abetting the lepers of =RebekahRegion=. When her time came, she-'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-Rebekah.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Barathrum inhales and stutters.*}} She-

Resheph would not forgive her trespass. She contracted the rotting tongue while abetting the lepers of =RebekahRegion=. When her time came, she-
translation:
{{emote|*巴拉瑟姆吸了一口气，结巴起来。*}} 她——

瑞谢夫不愿宽恕她的越界。她在援助=RebekahRegion=的麻风病人时染上了腐舌病。等她的时候到了，她——

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Resheph would not let her return home. O..\n\n{{emote|*Barathrum expels a hushed whimper.*}}'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-Rebekah2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Resheph would not let her return home. O..

{{emote|*Barathrum expels a hushed whimper.*}}
translation:
瑞谢夫不让她回家。噢……

{{emote|*巴拉瑟姆发出一声压低的呜咽。*}}

{{emote|*巴拉瑟姆呜咽。*}}

——什么？谁在那里？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'If the signal sounds and the Gyre widens again, then you did not reach whatever watermark Resheph set?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-Failed.Z-Failed2Choice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: If the signal sounds and the Gyre widens again, then you did not reach whatever watermark Resheph set?
translation: 如果信号响起，轮回再次扩张，就说明你没达到瑞谢夫设下的某个水位线？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'No... Qud is fractious, and no lasting peace has obtained. I tried... for decades on decades I tried our paws on the tiller, to shim together what blossomed in the wild...\n\nThe restoration of machines, the federation of free sovranties, the nourishing rituals of salt and star, the sacred, the profane...'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-Failed2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
No... Qud is fractious, and no lasting peace has obtained. I tried... for decades on decades I tried our paws on the tiller, to shim together what blossomed in the wild...

The restoration of machines, the federation of free sovranties, the nourishing rituals of salt and star, the sacred, the profane...
translation:
没有……库德四分五裂，从未取得长久和平。我试过……一连数十年，我试着让我们的爪子握住舵柄，把荒野中绽放的一切垫合在一起……

机器的复兴，自由主权体的联邦，盐与星的滋养仪式，神圣的，亵渎的……

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'In the late years I saw the writing on the wall. I turned us inward, retreated to my candle-dim study to angle at the project alone. A new plan... {{emote|*eeehw*}} was-\n\n{{emote|*Barathrum starts panting.*}}'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-Failed3.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
In the late years I saw the writing on the wall. I turned us inward, retreated to my candle-dim study to angle at the project alone. A new plan... {{emote|*eeehw*}} was-

{{emote|*Barathrum starts panting.*}}
translation:
到了晚年，我已看见墙上的不祥字迹。我让我们转向内里，退回烛光昏暗的书房，独自斜着身子钻研这个计划。一个新计划……{{emote|*呃呜*}}本来是——

{{emote|*巴拉瑟姆开始喘气。*}}

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*Barathrum heaves a great sigh upon the moist air of the control pit.*}}\n{{emote|*Barathrum stumbles to the floor with paws to his face.*}}'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-Failed4.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Barathrum heaves a great sigh upon the moist air of the control pit.*}}
{{emote|*Barathrum stumbles to the floor with paws to his face.*}}
translation:
{{emote|*巴拉瑟姆在控制坑潮湿的空气中长长叹息。*}}
{{emote|*巴拉瑟姆踉跄倒在地上，双爪捂住脸。*}}

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I failed it! I have failed! A thousand years too short, and- MORE TIME\n\n{{emote|*Barathrum weeps.*}}'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-Failed5.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I failed it! I have failed! A thousand years too short, and- MORE TIME

{{emote|*Barathrum weeps.*}}
translation:
我搞砸了！我失败了！一千年太短，而且——更多时间

{{emote|*巴拉瑟姆哭泣。*}}

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I am debased on the plank across the light of God! d- do I have a rightful claim to pity? Blindness! This darkling room abjures the light. Is this the House of Judgement, Hortensa? Or mere penumbra, the child's playcave, and law and language (not yet invented) cast their forcing functions back through time to puppet the unblossomed mind to civilized shape..."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-Failed6.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I am debased on the plank across the light of God! d- do I have a rightful claim to pity? Blindness! This darkling room abjures the light. Is this the House of Judgement, Hortensa? Or mere penumbra, the child's playcave, and law and language (not yet invented) cast their forcing functions back through time to puppet the unblossomed mind to civilized shape...
translation: 我被压在横跨神之光的木板上！我——我真的有资格请求怜悯吗？盲目！这间昏暗的屋子拒绝光明。这里是审判之屋吗，霍滕萨？还是只是一片半影，一个孩子玩耍的洞穴，而律法与语言（那时还没有被发明）把自己的强制函数投回时间里，牵着还没开花的心智，把它捏成文明的形状……

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Each of us is a sick animal in a darkling thicket. Each cursed with machinery to compress the clamber of echoes into bees, mothers, mountains, country. How many millions of snowsick years to sew a feeling substance into an agent of the world! A felt and machine animal, and in so doing, to stuff the whole of the world inside the agent (an inarguable document of its falsity), for agency is in its very definition the world in containment acting on itself...'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-Failed7.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Each of us is a sick animal in a darkling thicket. Each cursed with machinery to compress the clamber of echoes into bees, mothers, mountains, country. How many millions of snowsick years to sew a feeling substance into an agent of the world! A felt and machine animal, and in so doing, to stuff the whole of the world inside the agent (an inarguable document of its falsity), for agency is in its very definition the world in containment acting on itself...
translation: 我们每一个都是幽暗灌丛里的病兽。每一个都受机器诅咒，把乱爬的回声压成蜜蜂、母亲、山脉、国土。究竟要多少百万个雪病缠身的年月，才能把有感觉的物质缝成世界的行动者！一个有感觉的机械动物；这样一来，整个世界又被塞进行动者体内（这正是它虚假的铁证），因为所谓行动性，本来就是被装进容器里的世界在对自己行动……

path:
((('string', (('ID', "Then? Perhaps.. Perhaps the greater bodies whose agency I share the smaller cut from might share too the greater portion of my meal in blame.

Winding Svy? Thou art devious in symbol shape like serpent Ba'al!
Hinnom? For blooming alga thou crossed thy perch's back!
Shiftless moon?
Sun! Proud and idle, Sun! Silver father of the protoplanets! Claim mine selfhood and be done with it.

{{emote|*Barathrum weeps.*}}"), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-Failed8.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Then? Perhaps.. Perhaps the greater bodies whose agency I share the smaller cut from might share too the greater portion of my meal in blame.

Winding Svy? Thou art devious in symbol shape like serpent Ba'al!
Hinnom? For blooming alga thou crossed thy perch's back!
Shiftless moon?
Sun! Proud and idle, Sun! Silver father of the protoplanets! Claim mine selfhood and be done with it.

{{emote|*Barathrum weeps.*}}
translation:
然后呢？也许……也许那些更大的躯体，我只从它们的行动性里分得一小份；它们也该替我的罪责分走更大一份。

蜿蜒的斯维？你的符形狡猾得像蛇神巴力！
欣嫩？为了盛开的藻，你越过了栖枝的脊背！
飘忽的月亮？
太阳！骄傲又闲散的太阳！原行星的白银之父！拿走我的自我，把一切了结吧。

{{emote|*巴拉瑟姆哭泣。*}}

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Why ascend the Spindle then? For what purpose?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-DotDotDot.Z-WhyAscendChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Why ascend the Spindle then? For what purpose?
translation: 那为什么还要攀上纺锤？为了什么目的？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "{{emote|*Barathrum's countenance suddenly burns bright.*}}\n\nDid you know, =name=, I harbor a memory older than even the flooding of my hearth cave. A gleaming ancient tale, told by my elders to the nippy cub I once was..."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-WhyAscend.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Barathrum's countenance suddenly burns bright.*}}

Did you know, =name=, I harbor a memory older than even the flooding of my hearth cave. A gleaming ancient tale, told by my elders to the nippy cub I once was...
translation:
{{emote|*巴拉瑟姆的神情忽然明亮起来。*}}

你知道吗，=name=，我心中藏着一段记忆，比我炉洞被洪水淹没还要古老。那是一个闪光的古老传说，是长辈们讲给当年那个怕冷幼崽的……

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'In the age of the covenate, a coterie of our urshiib ancestors took to the stars to ply their burning cores! Can you envision it??

Ho, ho! I know a secret! Heh, heh! I know... there is a functioning starship atop the Spindle. We can take it, =name=! We launch ourselves into the deepness of the dusted cosmos and find the starshiib! You and I, ho ho!

Starshiib!'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-WhyAscend2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
In the age of the covenate, a coterie of our urshiib ancestors took to the stars to ply their burning cores! Can you envision it??

Ho, ho! I know a secret! Heh, heh! I know... there is a functioning starship atop the Spindle. We can take it, =name=! We launch ourselves into the deepness of the dusted cosmos and find the starshiib! You and I, ho ho!

Starshiib!
translation:
在盟会时代，我们乌尔希布先祖中有一群同道奔赴群星，驱使他们燃烧的核心！你能想象吗？？

呵，呵！我知道一个秘密！嘿，嘿！我知道……纺锤顶上有一艘还能运作的星舰。我们可以乘上它，=name=！我们把自己发射进积尘宇宙的深处，去寻找星希布！你和我，呵呵！

星希布！

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Barathrum, we're to rest the fate of Qud on a mere cub's tale?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Z-WhyAscend2.Z-Starshiib1Choice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Barathrum, we're to rest the fate of Qud on a mere cub's tale?
translation: 巴拉瑟姆，我们要把库德的命运寄托在一个幼崽传说上？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Is that you, nestling =name=? Are you returned from gate and Tomb? Come closer, I say.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Recame.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Is that you, nestling =name=? Are you returned from gate and Tomb? Come closer, I say.
translation: 是你吗，雏儿 =name=？你从门与陵墓归来了？靠近些，我说。
是我，巴拉瑟姆。我回来了。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'You appear... refreshed. My old eyes spy the swim lines of the waking world and to you they cede precedence. A newness obtains.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.RecameMe.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You appear... refreshed. My old eyes spy the swim lines of the waking world and to you they cede precedence. A newness obtains.
translation: 你看起来……焕然一新。我这双老眼窥见醒世的游线，而它们在你面前退居其次。一种新生已然成形。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Outside of time I found myself in a place of light. I chose to return and was made new.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.RecameMe.Brightsheol1Choice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Outside of time I found myself in a place of light. I chose to return and was made new.
translation: 在时间之外，我发现自己来到一处光明之地。我选择回来，于是被重塑一新。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I found Brightsheol, where it lies beyond the Tomb. I spoke to the Shomer there and arranged for the disablement of the Spindle's magnets."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.RecameMe.Brightsheol2Choice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I found Brightsheol, where it lies beyond the Tomb. I spoke to the Shomer there and arranged for the disablement of the Spindle's magnets.
translation: 我找到了陵墓之外的明灼阴府。我在那里与守望者交谈，并安排让纺锤的磁体关闭。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Over there, by your workbench. Is that... Pax Klanq?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.RecameMe.PreKlanqChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Over there, by your workbench. Is that... Pax Klanq?
translation: 那边，在你的工作台旁。那是……帕克斯·克兰克吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}\n\nIt is. For reasons I will explain shortly, for reasons beyond any of our remits, Klanq has returned to Grit Gate.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.PreKlanq.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}

It is. For reasons I will explain shortly, for reasons beyond any of our remits, Klanq has returned to Grit Gate.
translation:
{{emote|*巴拉瑟姆停顿片刻。*}}

是。出于我稍后会解释的原因，也出于超出我们任何人权限的原因，克兰克回到了砂砾门。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}\n\nUnusual circumstances have put my study in disarray. Lamentable, this is, but necessary.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.PreJunk.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}

Unusual circumstances have put my study in disarray. Lamentable, this is, but necessary.
translation:
{{emote|*巴拉瑟姆停顿片刻。*}}

异常局势让我的书房乱成一团。这令人惋惜，却也必要。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}\n\nI am confident there is a richness of wisdom in the poetry of that statement. One day, I will be eager to discover it. For now, what of the Spindle?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Brightsheol1.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}

I am confident there is a richness of wisdom in the poetry of that statement. One day, I will be eager to discover it. For now, what of the Spindle?
translation:
{{emote|*巴拉瑟姆停顿片刻。*}}

我确信那句话的诗意中蕴含着丰沛的智慧。总有一天，我会热切地去发现它。现在，纺锤如何了？

We must take Klanq at their word, here..."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Golem.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: High on the mount above Omonporch, the Putus Templar watch us through their war lenses and prepare an attack. translation: 在奥蒙廊上方的山上，普图斯圣殿骑士正透过战争镜片监视我们，并准备发动进攻。拿非利也在月阶的摇篮中躁动，带着地狱般的意图蹒跚而来。简言之，由于准备时间不足，武装也不够充分，帕克斯·克兰克不再相信 Q 女孩的攀升器设计可行。这件事上，我们必须相信克兰克的判断……

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'This disheartens us, but there is another hope. Klanq has offered up a new design, something unconventional at all angles. And, despite our early misgivings, Q Girl and I now work in assistance to the project...'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Golem2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: This disheartens us, but there is another hope. Klanq has offered up a new design, something unconventional at all angles. And, despite our early misgivings, Q Girl and I now work in assistance to the project...
translation: 这令我们沮丧，但另有一线希望。克兰克提出了一项新设计，从各个角度看都不合常规。而且，尽管我们起初有所疑虑，Q 女孩和我现在都在协助这个项目……

source: A new creature struggles to be born, =name=, and you will help birth it. Then, it will carry us, you and I, to the top of the Spindle.
translation: 一个新生物正在挣扎着诞生，=name=，而你将帮助它出生。之后，它会载着你我登上纺锤之巅。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Pax Klanq will mold the creature from raw bioelectrical materials. You must gather these entrails: the body as a model, the catalyst to charge the sanguine fluid, the atzmus as deistic direction, the armament for protection, and the hamsa for personality. You will bond with the creature, too, and act as its pilot. So you must speak an incantation to inscribe the connection.\n\nYou'll also need to procure the sanguine fluid itself. And, too, a power source shielded from electromagnetic attacks."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Golem4.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Pax Klanq will mold the creature from raw bioelectrical materials. You must gather these entrails: the body as a model, the catalyst to charge the sanguine fluid, the atzmus as deistic direction, the armament for protection, and the hamsa for personality. You will bond with the creature, too, and act as its pilot. So you must speak an incantation to inscribe the connection.

You'll also need to procure the sanguine fluid itself. And, too, a power source shielded from electromagnetic attacks.
translation:
帕克斯·克兰克会用原始的生物电材料塑造这个生物。你得收集这些内材：作为模板的身体、给血质流体充能的催化剂、负责神性指向的阿兹穆斯、用于防护的武装，以及赋予人格的汉萨。你还要和这个生物结合，成为它的驾驶者。所以你必须念出咒文，把这道连接刻进去。

你还需要取得血质流体本身。另外，还需要一个能屏蔽电磁攻击的动力源。

没错。这个生物会被塑造成足够宽，可以容下两个人，但只有你会和它结合。也只有你会驾驶它。
