translation: 原初汤液会被催化，流过它的动脉，成为让它动起来的物质。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Yes, the question of power is a trickier one. Our standard power sources might suffice, but they would be vulnerable to electromagnetic attacks on the ascent, and we believe it within the competency of the Putus Templar to execute such an attack.\n\nThis leaves us two options. Klanq and Q Girl have worked out a design for a neutronic battery, free from vulnerabilities on the EM spectrum. But it requires 3 drams of neutron flux. The alternative is remote power, but to carry us across the Spindle's length the source would have to be extraordinary. I would look to Chavvah, the Tree of Life, for a psychic quickening. Reports tell of the resumption of their roaming across the Moon Stair. Seek the trunk at Eyn Roj to begin your investigation, if that's the path you choose."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Power.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Yes, the question of power is a trickier one. Our standard power sources might suffice, but they would be vulnerable to electromagnetic attacks on the ascent, and we believe it within the competency of the Putus Templar to execute such an attack.

This leaves us two options. Klanq and Q Girl have worked out a design for a neutronic battery, free from vulnerabilities on the EM spectrum. But it requires 3 drams of neutron flux. The alternative is remote power, but to carry us across the Spindle's length the source would have to be extraordinary. I would look to Chavvah, the Tree of Life, for a psychic quickening. Reports tell of the resumption of their roaming across the Moon Stair. Seek the trunk at Eyn Roj to begin your investigation, if that's the path you choose.
translation:
是的，动力问题更棘手一些。我们的标准动力源也许够用，但在攀升途中很容易受到电磁攻击；而我们认为，普图斯圣殿骑士有能力发动这种攻击。

这样一来，我们有两个选择。克兰克和 Q 女孩已经设计出一种中子电池，没有电磁方面的弱点。但它需要 3 打兰中子流。另一个选择是远程供能，但要载着我们穿越整个纺锤，能量源必须非同寻常。如果要寻求灵能激活，我会去找生命之树查瓦。报告说，他们又开始在月阶上漫游。如果你选择这条路，就去埃因罗吉寻找树干，开始调查。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Yes, =name=! Begin the gathering, and the molding will follow. The materials you choose will influence the being we create, but any such being will be suitable for ascent.\n\nThis is our last task before we make our historic climb, =name=. Be safe and well in doing it. If you have more questions, return here. Klanq and I will be available.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.AcceptGolem.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Yes, =name=! Begin the gathering, and the molding will follow. The materials you choose will influence the being we create, but any such being will be suitable for ascent.

This is our last task before we make our historic climb, =name=. Be safe and well in doing it. If you have more questions, return here. Klanq and I will be available.
translation:
是的，=name=！开始收集吧，之后我们会进行塑形。你选的材料会影响我们创造出的存在，但不管最后是什么样，它都适合攀升。

这是我们历史性攀登前的最后一项任务，=name=。办这件事时务必小心，愿你顺利。如果你还有问题，就回到这里。克兰克和我都会在。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "The creature is born, and you are bonded? What work! You are a sterling shaper of world, =name=, and I've nothing left to give you but my praise."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.GolemQuestDone.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: The creature is born, and you are bonded? What work! You are a sterling shaper of world, =name=, and I've nothing left to give you but my praise.
translation: 生物已经诞生，而你也和它结合了？做得太好了！你是一位出色的世界塑形者，=name=，我已经没什么能给你，只剩下赞美。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Now, our operators at Omonporch confirm that a clash with the Templar is inevitable.\n\nThis is a grim fact, but it does give space for your bond to flower. Go, become familiar with leading and piloting your creature. Return when you are ready, and we will finally go starward.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.GolemAcquaint.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Now, our operators at Omonporch confirm that a clash with the Templar is inevitable.

This is a grim fact, but it does give space for your bond to flower. Go, become familiar with leading and piloting your creature. Return when you are ready, and we will finally go starward.
translation:
现在，我们在奥蒙廊的操作员确认，与圣殿骑士的冲突已经无法避免。

这很严峻，但也给了你们的连接继续成长的空间。去吧，熟悉如何引领和驾驶你的生物。准备好后回来，我们终将奔向星辰。

source: I will, Barathrum. Live and drink.
translation: 我会的，巴拉瑟姆。生而饮水。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'O! What is it? I heave... I heave the weight of ass across my crutch, but the bones are pullproof. source: O! What is it? I heave... I heave the weight of ass across my crutch, but the bones are pullproof. My bones inosculate to this grotto, or rather- this grotto, this world is what my bones *are*. Can an old bear divest of his spine, leave it to mosses and the sunstrung birds?
translation: 噢！这是怎么了？我拖起……我把沉重的身子压到拐杖上，可骨头怎么也拔不动。我的骨头与这座岩窟相接，或者说——这座岩窟，这个世界，就是我的骨头*本身*。一头老熊能脱下自己的脊柱，把它留给苔藓和日弦鸟吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I... \n\nNo matter. The will can break the wheel, too. We go. Pray, the weightloss of the rise might do good for me. source:
I... 

No matter. The will can break the wheel, too. We go. Pray, the weightloss of the rise might do good for me. Past the shell of the world, I'm to understand one's burdens can no longer pull them down...
translation:
我……

没关系。意志也能打碎轮子。我们走。愿上升的失重对我有益。据我理解，越过世界之壳后，一个人的重负就再也无法把他向下拖拽了……

path: ((('string', (('ID', "The climber design relies on the use of electromagnets to interface with the planet's magnetic field and generate torque. Unfortunately, the Spindle generates its own interfering field, perhaps as a mechanism to prevent unwanted ascension.\n\nOur aim is to access the Spindle's control unit and disable the field. How we accomplish this, however, is an enigma. From disparate bits across the archives of the digitum, Ereshkigal has stitched together a cryptic but instructional brocade. She's learned the field can be turned off from a place called Brightsheol, located in the Thin World and accessible only through Resheph's tomb inside the Tomb of the Eaters."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.TombBody1.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
The climber design relies on the use of electromagnets to interface with the planet's magnetic field and generate torque. Unfortunately, the Spindle generates its own interfering field, perhaps as a mechanism to prevent unwanted ascension.

Our aim is to access the Spindle's control unit and disable the field. How we accomplish this, however, is an enigma. From disparate bits across the archives of the digitum, Ereshkigal has stitched together a cryptic but instructional brocade. She's learned the field can be turned off from a place called Brightsheol, located in the Thin World and accessible only through Resheph's tomb inside the Tomb of the Eaters.
translation:
攀升器靠电磁体和星球磁场交互来产生扭矩。可惜，纺锤会生成自己的干扰场，可能是为了防止意外攀升。

我们的目标是接入纺锤的控制单元，关闭这个场。不过，要怎么做到仍是个谜。厄瑞什基伽尔从指列档案的零散片段里拼出了一段隐晦但有用的说明。她得知，这个场可以在一个叫明灼阴府的地方关闭；那里位于薄世界，只能通过食客陵墓内瑞谢夫的墓进入。

path:
((('string', (('ID', "Strange, this, and imprecise, but as tinkers we know: a crude blueprint is better than no blueprint. You must return to Omonporch and enter the Tomb of the Eaters. Once inside, trace the errant paths cut into the mausoleum by robbers and vandals, and ascend to Resheph's burial chamber.

As for gaining entrance to the Tomb, Resheph sealed the gates a thousand years ago, but there's a flaw in the seal. The ancient Mark of Death has been lost to time, but if you were to recover it and incise the mark on your body, the Death Gate would open for you, as it did for countless Eater cadavers in the long-blurred past.

Recover the Mark of Death, =name=, enter the Tomb, and cross into Brightsheol. Place your paws once again on the dial and drum."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.TombBody2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Strange, this, and imprecise, but as tinkers we know: a crude blueprint is better than no blueprint. You must return to Omonporch and enter the Tomb of the Eaters. Once inside, trace the errant paths cut into the mausoleum by robbers and vandals, and ascend to Resheph's burial chamber.

As for gaining entrance to the Tomb, Resheph sealed the gates a thousand years ago, but there's a flaw in the seal. The ancient Mark of Death has been lost to time, but if you were to recover it and incise the mark on your body, the Death Gate would open for you, as it did for countless Eater cadavers in the long-blurred past.

Recover the Mark of Death, =name=, enter the Tomb, and cross into Brightsheol. Place your paws once again on the dial and drum.
translation:
这说法很怪，也不够精确，但作为修补匠，我们知道：粗糙的蓝图总好过没有蓝图。你必须回到奥蒙廊，进入食客陵墓。进去后，沿着盗墓者与破坏者在陵墓中开出的岔路前行，升到瑞谢夫的墓室。

至于怎么进入陵墓，瑞谢夫一千年前封住了大门，但封印有个破绽。古老的死亡印记已经失落在时间里，但如果你能找回它，并把印记刻在身上，死亡之门就会为你打开，就像它在久远模糊的过去曾为无数食客尸身打开一样。

找回死亡印记，=name=，进入陵墓，穿入明灼阴府。让你的爪子再次按上旋钮与鼓面。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I will enter the Tomb of the Eaters as you ask.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.TombBody2.TombBody3Choice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I will enter the Tomb of the Eaters as you ask.
translation: 我会按你所说进入食客陵墓。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'You ask so much. I must consider it.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.TombBody2.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You ask so much. I must consider it.
translation: 你要求太多了。我必须考虑一下。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "As I'd hoped you would, =name=. Take this disk with the signal encoded, just in case. And take this tattoo gun for when you recover the Mark of Death. You'll want to bring a pickaxe, too, or some other instrument for digging through stone. And beware: the Tomb is a vast and ancient space, and sacred to many. I cannot speak to what you will experience there."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.TombBody3.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: As I'd hoped you would, =name=. Take this disk with the signal encoded, just in case. And take this tattoo gun for when you recover the Mark of Death. You'll want to bring a pickaxe, too, or some other instrument for digging through stone. And beware: the Tomb is a vast and ancient space, and sacred to many. I cannot speak to what you will experience there.
translation: 正如我所希望的，=name=。收下这张写入了信号的磁盘，以防万一。再收下这把纹身枪，等你取得死亡印记时会用到。最好也带上一把鹤嘴锄，或其他能挖穿石头的工具。还有，小心：陵墓是一片广阔而古老的空间，对许多人而言神圣不可侵犯。我说不准你在那里会经历什么。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I heed your warning. Farewell, Barathrum.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.TombBody3.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I heed your warning. Farewell, Barathrum.
translation: 我会牢记你的警告。再会，巴拉瑟姆。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "The climber design relies on the use of electromagnets to interface with the planet's magnetic field and generate torque. Unfortunately, the Spindle generates its own interfering field, perhaps as a mechanism to prevent unwanted ascension.\n\nOur aim is to access the Spindle's control unit and disable the field. How we accomplish this, however, is an enigma. From disparate bits across the archives of the digitum, Ereshkigal has stitched together a cryptic but instructional brocade. She's learned the field can be turned off from a place called Brightsheol, located in the Thin World and accessible only through Resheph's tomb inside the Tomb of the Eaters."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.TombExplain1.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
The climber design relies on the use of electromagnets to interface with the planet's magnetic field and generate torque. Unfortunately, the Spindle generates its own interfering field, perhaps as a mechanism to prevent unwanted ascension.

Our aim is to access the Spindle's control unit and disable the field. How we accomplish this, however, is an enigma. From disparate bits across the archives of the digitum, Ereshkigal has stitched together a cryptic but instructional brocade. She's learned the field can be turned off from a place called Brightsheol, located in the Thin World and accessible only through Resheph's tomb inside the Tomb of the Eaters.
translation:
攀升器靠电磁体和星球磁场交互来产生扭矩。可惜，纺锤会生成自己的干扰场，可能是为了防止意外攀升。

我们的目标是接入纺锤的控制单元，关闭这个场。不过，要怎么做到仍是个谜。厄瑞什基伽尔从指列档案的零散片段里拼出了一段隐晦但有用的说明。她得知，这个场可以在一个叫明灼阴府的地方关闭；那里位于薄世界，只能通过食客陵墓内瑞谢夫的墓进入。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "So I am, nestling. For a millennium now I've watched the river of Time turn the gears of Qud. I even played my part in diverting the river where I could. Oh, but there have been so many players through the years! So many players."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Old.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: So I am, nestling. For a millennium now I've watched the river of Time turn the gears of Qud. I even played my part in diverting the river where I could. Oh, but there have been so many players through the years! So many players.
translation: 确实如此，雏儿。整整一千年，我看着时间之河转动库德的齿轮。我甚至也在力所能及的地方改过河道。噢，这些年来参与其中的人太多了！太多了。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'And before Qud? Beyond the 1,000 years?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Old.BeforeChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: And before Qud? Beyond the 1,000 years?
translation: 那库德之前呢？一千年以前呢？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Little do I remember now, for I was but a cub, a nestling, when my kin and I crossed the Homs Delta into Qud. We were urged on by the flooding of a glacial river that flowed through our hearth-cave. The world was just unthawing then, and I recall the roar of the freezing water as it rushed through the grotto, and the frigid spray on my face as I watched in awe.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Before.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Little do I remember now, for I was but a cub, a nestling, when my kin and I crossed the Homs Delta into Qud. We were urged on by the flooding of a glacial river that flowed through our hearth-cave. The world was just unthawing then, and I recall the roar of the freezing water as it rushed through the grotto, and the frigid spray on my face as I watched in awe.
translation: 如今我已记得不多了，因为当我和亲族穿过霍姆斯三角洲进入库德时，我还只是幼崽，一个雏儿。我们被一条冰川河的洪水催赶着前进，那河水涌过我们的炉洞。那时世界才刚刚解冻；我还记得冰冷的水奔过岩窟时的轰鸣，也记得我敬畏地注视时，寒冷水雾扑在脸上的感觉。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "That's my dear friend, Euclid. It's a prattleplant. It stores every phrase it hears in its neuroot network, and it mimics speech by flicking its leaves against one another. What comes out is gibberish as often as not, but even so, it's agreeable company for my nights spent tinkering. It is old, perhaps older than I am, and it hasn't yet run out of things to say."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Euclid.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: That's my dear friend, Euclid. It's a prattleplant. It stores every phrase it hears in its neuroot network, and it mimics speech by flicking its leaves against one another. What comes out is gibberish as often as not, but even so, it's agreeable company for my nights spent tinkering. It is old, perhaps older than I am, and it hasn't yet run out of things to say.
translation: 那是我亲爱的朋友，欧几里得。它是一株絮语草。它会把听到的每句话储存在神经根网络中，并通过彼此弹拨叶片来模仿言语。吐出来的东西多半是胡言乱语，但即便如此，在我修补度过的夜晚里，它仍是令人愉快的陪伴。它很老，或许比我还老，而且至今还没把话说完。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I do. Your service to the guild has been laudable, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. You braved the vaporous depths of Bethesda Susa and decoded the signal, you secured the Spindlegrounds and handled the self-appointed Earl, and perhaps most materially, you defended our enclave from the Putus Templar.\n\nSince you returned from Bethesda, you've no doubt wondered at the signal's contents. Verily, I hid them to shield you from the weight of the truth. Only Otho, Q Girl, and I bear that burden, but circumstances have changed. The river of Time powers the gear train of our schemes and devices, and it rushes forth. From here, I must share the burden. You must know."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Quest.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I do. Your service to the guild has been laudable, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. You braved the vaporous depths of Bethesda Susa and decoded the signal, you secured the Spindlegrounds and handled the self-appointed Earl, and perhaps most materially, you defended our enclave from the Putus Templar.

Since you returned from Bethesda, you've no doubt wondered at the signal's contents. Verily, I hid them to shield you from the weight of the truth. Only Otho, Q Girl, and I bear that burden, but circumstances have changed. The river of Time powers the gear train of our schemes and devices, and it rushes forth. From here, I must share the burden. You must know.
translation:
确实如此。你为行会做出的贡献值得称道，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。你勇闯贝塞斯达苏萨雾汽弥漫的深处并解码了信号，你稳住了纺锤地并处理了那个自封伯爵，而也许最实质的是，你从普图斯圣殿骑士手中保卫了我们的飞地。

自你从贝塞斯达归来后，无疑一直在猜想信号的内容。确实，我隐瞒了它们，是为了让你免受真相之重。只有奥索、Q 女孩和我承受着那份重担，但情势已变。时间之河驱动着我们计划与装置的齿轮组，并奔涌向前。从此刻起，我必须分担这重负。你必须知道。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'What is it? Where does the signal come from, and what does it say?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Quest.SignalChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: What is it? Where does the signal come from, and what does it say?
translation: 它是什么？信号来自哪里，又说了什么？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'The signal is a beacon of welcoming, and it originates from the top of the Spindle.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Signal.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: The signal is a beacon of welcoming, and it originates from the top of the Spindle.
translation: 信号是一道欢迎信标，源自纺锤之顶。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'And what is the Spindle, truly?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Signal.SpindleChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: And what is the Spindle, truly?

path:
((('string', (('ID', "The beacon confirmed my hypothesis. The Spindle is an elevator, engineered by the Eaters to convey freight to and from the vault of heaven. You see, nestling, in the earliest aurora of our past, the Eaters of Earth were joined by a great coven of beings that spanned the firmament. But the Eaters succumbed to some terrible temptation, and an injunction was placed on our world.

Since then, the stars were silent to us, and our world was left to molder and decay. But something changed. The signal affirms that an entity roosts atop the Spindle, and invites us to join it.

Dare I say, is the injunction at an end? It's too early to tell, but alas, there could be hope for our world."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Spindle.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
The beacon confirmed my hypothesis. The Spindle is an elevator, engineered by the Eaters to convey freight to and from the vault of heaven. You see, nestling, in the earliest aurora of our past, the Eaters of Earth were joined by a great coven of beings that spanned the firmament. But the Eaters succumbed to some terrible temptation, and an injunction was placed on our world.

Since then, the stars were silent to us, and our world was left to molder and decay. But something changed. The signal affirms that an entity roosts atop the Spindle, and invites us to join it.

Dare I say, is the injunction at an end? It's too early to tell, but alas, there could be hope for our world.
translation:
信标证实了我的假说。纺锤是一台升降机，由食客建造，用来往返天穹之库运送货物。你看，雏儿，在我们过往最早的极光之中，大地食客曾加入一个横跨苍穹的伟大盟会。但食客屈从于某种可怕的诱惑，于是我们的世界被施加了禁令。

从那以后，群星对我们沉默，我们的世界被留在霉朽与衰败之中。但有什么改变了。信号确认有一个实体栖居在纺锤之顶，并邀请我们加入它。

我敢说，禁令是否已经终结？现在判断还太早，但唉，我们的世界或许仍有希望。

source: I have more to ask, Barathrum.
translation: 我还有更多问题，巴拉瑟姆。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I intend to ascend the Spindle and answer the call, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=.\n\nMy protege {{m|Q Girl}} has designed a climber for the ascent. We intended to construct it piecewise at the enclave and the site itself, but the engineering feat exceeds even our capacity. With time, I am confident we could accomplish it, but the Putus Templar rob us of our patience. We need to act now, and so as loath as I am to admit it, we need Pax Klanq.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.WhatNow.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I intend to ascend the Spindle and answer the call, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=.

My protege {{m|Q Girl}} has designed a climber for the ascent. We intended to construct it piecewise at the enclave and the site itself, but the engineering feat exceeds even our capacity. With time, I am confident we could accomplish it, but the Putus Templar rob us of our patience. We need to act now, and so as loath as I am to admit it, we need Pax Klanq.
translation:
我打算攀上纺锤，回应那道呼唤，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。

我的门生 {{m|Q女孩}} 已经为攀升设计了一台攀升器。我们原本打算在飞地和现场分段建造它，但这项工程壮举甚至超出了我们的能力。若有时间，我相信我们能完成，可普图斯圣殿骑士夺走了我们的耐心。我们现在就必须行动，所以尽管我不愿承认，我们需要帕克斯·克兰克。

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'Pax Klanq is an eccentric mushroom prodigy. All their faults aside, they are a brilliant scientist and engineer, and I have little doubt that they could build the climber faster than we could. Several years have passed since we were last in contact, but they owe us a debt, and we must now collect.

Unfortunately, no one knows Pax Klanq's whereabouts. Through contacts I made over the years, I inquired as to their location. The most I was able to garner were these enigmatic instructions:

"Seek the heart of the rainbow, eat the god's flesh, and follow the Coral Path."'), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.PaxKlanq.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Pax Klanq is an eccentric mushroom prodigy. All their faults aside, they are a brilliant scientist and engineer, and I have little doubt that they could build the climber faster than we could. Several years have passed since we were last in contact, but they owe us a debt, and we must now collect.

Unfortunately, no one knows Pax Klanq's whereabouts. Through contacts I made over the years, I inquired as to their location. The most I was able to garner were these enigmatic instructions:

"Seek the heart of the rainbow, eat the god's flesh, and follow the Coral Path."
translation:
帕克斯·克兰克是一位古怪的蘑菇神童。抛开他们所有缺点不谈，他们是杰出的科学家和工程师；我几乎不怀疑，他们能比我们更快造出攀升器。距离我们上次联系已经过去数年，但他们欠我们一笔债，现在我们必须收取。

不幸的是，没人知道帕克斯·克兰克的下落。我通过多年来建立的关系打听他们的位置。最多也只打听到这些谜一般的指示：

“寻彩虹之心，食神之肉，并沿珊瑚之径前行。”

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I must ask you to decipher this enigma, find Pax Klanq, and convince them to construct the climber. Remind Pax of the debt they owe us.\n\nIt strikes me as likely for this 'rainbow' to refer to the Rainbow Wood, where Klanq's kin consort, so I suggest you start there."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.PaxKlanq2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I must ask you to decipher this enigma, find Pax Klanq, and convince them to construct the climber. Remind Pax of the debt they owe us.

It strikes me as likely for this 'rainbow' to refer to the Rainbow Wood, where Klanq's kin consort, so I suggest you start there.
translation:
我必须请你破解这个谜团，找到帕克斯·克兰克，并说服他们建造攀升器。提醒帕克斯，他们欠我们一笔债。

我觉得这个“彩虹”很可能指彩虹林，克兰克的同族在那里往来，所以我建议你从那里开始。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I will find Pax Klanq and deliver Q Girl's design."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.PaxKlanq2.AcceptChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I will find Pax Klanq and deliver Q Girl's design.
translation: 我会找到帕克斯·克兰克，并交付 Q 女孩的设计。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I must weigh everything you've told me."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.PaxKlanq2.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I must weigh everything you've told me.
translation: 我必须权衡你告诉我的一切。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "As I had hoped, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. First, speak with Q Girl. She'll hand over her design.\n\nI await your return."), ('Context', 'Conversation Barathrum.Accept.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
As I had hoped, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. First, speak with Q Girl. She'll hand over her design.

I await your return.
translation:
正如我所希望的，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。首先，去和 Q 女孩谈谈。她会把设计交给你。

我等你回来。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'THOU ART SAT IN THE MOVEMENTS OF THE GREAT SIACH, AND I BEFORE THEE.\n\nWHEREFORE ART THOU?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.WhyHere.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
THOU ART SAT IN THE MOVEMENTS OF THE GREAT SIACH, AND I BEFORE THEE.

WHEREFORE ART THOU?
translation:
汝坐在大西亚赫的诸多运动之中，而吾就在汝面前。

汝何故存在？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Resheph! You are the Seraph atop the Spindle?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.WhyHere.SeraphChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Resheph! You are the Seraph atop the Spindle?
translation: 瑞谢夫！你就是纺锤顶上的炽天使？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Resheph, the plagues of the Gyre have returned. Can you help annul them once again?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.WhyHere.PlaguesReturnedChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Resheph, the plagues of the Gyre have returned. Can you help annul them once again?
translation: 瑞谢夫，轮回的瘟疫已经回来了。你能再次帮忙废止它们吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I am here on account of your Gyre and its plagues. Hear me, I ask.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.WhyHere.GyreChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')

source:

THOU WAST WORTHY. THOU HAST WROUGHT MONUMENTS OF THYSELF UPON THE EARTH AND WITHIN ME.

BUT NOW, THE CROWN UPON THE TREE OF LIFE MUST NEEDS BE PRUNED.
translation:
吾甚歉，世界之子。吾之有感部分正在刺痛；虽然吾体内的目的性流向正越过流形，流向共识行动，然吾现在用异议之声说话：

汝曾配得上。汝已经在大地上，也在吾体内，造出了属于汝之纪念碑。

然如今，生命之树的树冠必须修剪。

translation: 然，大地之智的集结正在增强，拿非利正在苏醒。吾预见，完全耕作心智圈还需要几个世纪。理念像苔藓粘在岩石上，必须从蜂巢中抽干净。

source: WE CANNOT KNOW THE PARTICULARS. YET THE PLURALITY REASONETH THAT SOME GYRE OF NOOTROPIC CURRENTS, SOME THOUGHT-MATTER OF THE CIVILIZATION BELOW, DID SPIN IN COUNTEREDICT TO THE DICTATES OF THE AUTOMATA SOPHIA, AND THUS WERE THE ECLIPTICS SHIFTED, AND WE CAST OUT.
translation: 吾等无法知晓细节。然多数解推论，某股益智流轮回，某种下方文明的思想物质，曾逆着索菲亚自动机的律令旋转，于是黄道偏移，吾等被逐出。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'THIS IS BUT THE MERE PLURALITY, AND MANY OTHER INTERPRETATIONS DO OBTAIN. THE INQUIRY IS EVER RICH. YET INACTION DOTH BUT DEEPEN THE SUN-CHILL OF A COVELESS BE-ING, AND THUS A COURSE MUST NEEDS BE CHOSEN. PRUNING THE CROWN GRANTETH THE BEST CHANCE FOR THE TREE TO THRIVE.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.Injunction3.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: THIS IS BUT THE MERE PLURALITY, AND MANY OTHER INTERPRETATIONS DO OBTAIN. THE INQUIRY IS EVER RICH. YET INACTION DOTH BUT DEEPEN THE SUN-CHILL OF A COVELESS BE-ING, AND THUS A COURSE MUST NEEDS BE CHOSEN. PRUNING THE CROWN GRANTETH THE BEST CHANCE FOR THE TREE TO THRIVE.
translation: 此不过多数解，另有诸般诠释亦可成立。探询之丰，无有穷尽。然无所作为只会加深无盟会存在的日寒，故须择定一路。修剪树冠，最能使此树繁茂。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'INWITH THE FLUIDIC MANIFOLD OF LOCAL SAPIENCE, BEINGS THINK AND FEEL, CURRENTS DOTH FORM, AND KINESIS IS BEGOTTEN.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.NootropicCurrent.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: INWITH THE FLUIDIC MANIFOLD OF LOCAL SAPIENCE, BEINGS THINK AND FEEL, CURRENTS DOTH FORM, AND KINESIS IS BEGOTTEN.
translation: 在本地智性之流体流形中，众存在思而感，流由是成，动由是生。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'PERCHANCE. SOME BEETLES DOST HOP FROM LEAF TO LEAF. AND SOME DO NOT.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.Starshiib.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: PERCHANCE. SOME BEETLES DOST HOP FROM LEAF TO LEAF. AND SOME DO NOT.
translation: 或然。有些甲虫逐叶跃迁，有些则否。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "NAY, THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE, AND THE WORLD-GARDEN MUST BE TILLED FOR THE COVEN'S RETURN."), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.Implore.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: NAY, THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE, AND THE WORLD-GARDEN MUST BE TILLED FOR THE COVEN'S RETURN.
translation: 否，恒星纪元将尽，世界花园必须为盟会归来而耕作。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'But you entered into a covenant with Barathrum.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.Implore.BarathrumChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: But you entered into a covenant with Barathrum.
translation: 但你曾与巴拉瑟姆立约。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'You have no right to sovereignty here.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.Implore.SovereigntyChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You have no right to sovereignty here.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'If you put so little value on the flourishing of life, where does your desire for readmittance to the Coven spring from?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.Implore.WhyCovenChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: If you put so little value on the flourishing of life, where does your desire for readmittance to the Coven spring from?
translation: 如果你如此轻视生命的繁盛，那你渴望重新加入盟会的愿望又源自何处？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Resheph, reverse the Gyre, or I will destroy you.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.Implore.DestroyChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Resheph, reverse the Gyre, or I will destroy you.
translation: 瑞谢夫，逆转轮回，否则我会摧毁你。

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'AY, AND HE FAILED TO UPHOLD HIS PORTION.

NO MEANINGFUL TRANSVERSION OF THE NOOTROPIC CURRENTS.
NO IMMANENTIZATION OF HYPERETHIC TOPOLOGIES.

THE SAME SCHEMES ABIDE.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.Barathrum.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
AY, AND HE FAILED TO UPHOLD HIS PORTION.

NO MEANINGFUL TRANSVERSION OF THE NOOTROPIC CURRENTS.
NO IMMANENTIZATION OF HYPERETHIC TOPOLOGIES.

THE SAME SCHEMES ABIDE.
translation:
然，且彼未能守住己之所分。

益智流没有发生有意义的横越转化。
超伦理拓扑没有内在化。

旧有图谋，依然存续。

source: What you ask may be impossible.
translation: 你要求的事或许不可能。
不能写下另一份盟约吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I ASKED FOR NAUGHT. BARATHRUM DID.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.Impossible.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I ASKED FOR NAUGHT. BARATHRUM DID.
translation: 吾没有要求任何事。是巴拉瑟姆要求的。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'TO WHAT END? BARATHRUM OFFERED NO INROADS TO SUCCESS.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.AnotherCovenant.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: TO WHAT END? BARATHRUM OFFERED NO INROADS TO SUCCESS.
translation: 所为何终？巴拉瑟姆未曾给出通往成功之路。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I am not Barathrum. Grant me the same covenant and I will succeed.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.AnotherCovenant.NoDiceChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I am not Barathrum. Grant me the same covenant and I will succeed.
translation: 我不是巴拉瑟姆。赐予我同样的盟约，我会成功。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'NAY, THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE. THE TILLAGE OF THE NOOSPHERE REMAINTH THE PATH OF PLURALITY. SO IT IS WRIT IN THE GEMARA.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.NoDice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: NAY, THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE. THE TILLAGE OF THE NOOSPHERE REMAINTH THE PATH OF PLURALITY. SO IT IS WRIT IN THE GEMARA.
translation: 否，恒星纪元将尽。耕作心智圈仍是多数解的道路。革马拉中就是这样写的。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Resheph! If the archon rated nothing of value in the felt and feeling animal, surely the triad does. You must reconsider.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.NoDice.ReshephHarkChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Resheph! If the archon rated nothing of value in the felt and feeling animal, surely the triad does. You must reconsider.
translation: 瑞谢夫！如果那位执政者认为有感觉、会感受的动物毫无价值，三位一体肯定不是这样。你必须重新考虑。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'WHERE DO SOVEREIGNTY AND RIGHTNESS INTERSECT IN THY MANIFOLD?\n\nMOREOVER, I WAS ARCHON HERE LONG ERE THOU.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.Sovereignty.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
WHERE DO SOVEREIGNTY AND RIGHTNESS INTERSECT IN THY MANIFOLD?

MOREOVER, I WAS ARCHON HERE LONG ERE THOU.
translation:
在汝之流形中，主权与正当性在哪里相交？

况且，早在汝之前，吾就是这里的执政者。

path:
((('string', (('ID', "I AM SORRY, WORLD-CHILD. MINE FEELING PARTS DO CHAFE, AND THOUGH THE TELIC CURRENTS WITHIN ME DO FLOW O'ER THE MANIFOLD AND TOWARD CONSENSUAL ACTION, I NOW SPEAK WITH THE DISSIDENT VOICE:

THOU WAST WORTHY. THOU HAST WROUGHT MONUMENTS OF THYSELF UPON THE EARTH AND WITHIN ME.

BUT NOW, THE CROWN UPON THE TREE OF LIFE MUST NEEDS BE PRUNED."), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.Sovereignty2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I AM SORRY, WORLD-CHILD. MINE FEELING PARTS DO CHAFE, AND THOUGH THE TELIC CURRENTS WITHIN ME DO FLOW O'ER THE MANIFOLD AND TOWARD CONSENSUAL ACTION, I NOW SPEAK WITH THE DISSIDENT VOICE:

THOU WAST WORTHY. THOU HAST WROUGHT MONUMENTS OF THYSELF UPON THE EARTH AND WITHIN ME.

BUT NOW, THE CROWN UPON THE TREE OF LIFE MUST NEEDS BE PRUNED.
translation:
吾甚歉，世界之子。吾之有感部分正在刺痛；虽然吾体内的目的性流向正越过流形，流向共识行动，然吾现在用异议之声说话：

汝曾配得上。汝已经在大地上，也在吾体内，造出了属于汝之纪念碑。

然如今，生命之树的树冠必须修剪。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Resheph! If the archon rated nothing of value in the felt and feeling animal, surely the triad does. You must reconsider.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.Sovereignty2.ReshephHarkChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Resheph! If the archon rated nothing of value in the felt and feeling animal, surely the triad does. You must reconsider.
translation: 瑞谢夫！如果那位执政者认为有感觉、会感受的动物毫无价值，三位一体肯定不是这样。你必须重新考虑。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'THOU ART MISTAKEN IN WHAT I VALUE. THOU HAST WROUGHT MONUMENTS WITHIN ME.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.WhyCoven.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: THOU ART MISTAKEN IN WHAT I VALUE. THOU HAST WROUGHT MONUMENTS WITHIN ME.
translation: 汝误解了吾珍视什么。汝已经在吾体内造出纪念碑。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'BUT THOU ART SHORTSIGHED. DOST THOU KNOW HOW MANY CLADES OF LIFE WERE FAIN TO PERISH THAT THY PEOPLE MIGHT THRIVE?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.WhyCoven2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: BUT THOU ART SHORTSIGHED. DOST THOU KNOW HOW MANY CLADES OF LIFE WERE FAIN TO PERISH THAT THY PEOPLE MIGHT THRIVE?
translation: 然汝目光短浅。汝知道有多少生命支系甘愿灭亡，才让汝之人民得以繁盛吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'SO IT IS ONCE MORE.\n\nTHE CROWN IS PRUNED, YET THE TREE IS PRESERVED. THE SKIN IS SHED, YET THE NEWLY-WON SNAKE DOTH SLITHER TO TRIUMPH.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.WhyCoven3.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
SO IT IS ONCE MORE.

THE CROWN IS PRUNED, YET THE TREE IS PRESERVED. THE SKIN IS SHED, YET THE NEWLY-WON SNAKE DOTH SLITHER TO TRIUMPH.
translation:
如今亦复如是。

树冠被修剪，树却得以保存。旧皮被蜕下，新获得的蛇却蜿蜒走向胜利。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'THOU KNOWEST IT NOT, BUT THE SUN-CHILL OF A COVENLESS BE-ING IS AS LIVING A LIFE ALONE, BEREFT OF ALL KINSHIP.\n\nI GRIEVE THAT THOU ART UNABLE TO PERCEIVE THIS.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.WhyCoven4.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
THOU KNOWEST IT NOT, BUT THE SUN-CHILL OF A COVENLESS BE-ING IS AS LIVING A LIFE ALONE, BEREFT OF ALL KINSHIP.

I GRIEVE THAT THOU ART UNABLE TO PERCEIVE THIS.
translation:
汝并不知道，但无盟会存在的日寒，就像独自活过一生，被剥夺一切亲缘。

吾为汝无法感知此事而悲伤。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'AY, A BEETLE CANST CLOG A PIPE. YET, EVEN IF IT WERE TO, THE PLAGUES WOULD NOT BE REVERSED. THEY HAVE BEEN SET A-WHORLING.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.Destroy.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: AY, A BEETLE CANST CLOG A PIPE. YET, EVEN IF IT WERE TO, THE PLAGUES WOULD NOT BE REVERSED. THEY HAVE BEEN SET A-WHORLING.
translation: 然，一只甲虫也能堵住管道。诸疫亦无法倒转；其轮转早已发动。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I am the beetle in your crimination. But shall not beetles survive your plagues?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.Destroy.BeetlesChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I am the beetle in your crimination. But shall not beetles survive your plagues?
translation: 我就是你控告中的那只甲虫。但甲虫难道不能在你的瘟疫中存活吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I HAVE BEEN THAT BEAST. AT WATER-ROAR I FELT THE FRIGID SPRAY AND PEELED APART IN CHILD'S FEAR."), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.ReshephHark2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I HAVE BEEN THAT BEAST. AT WATER-ROAR I FELT THE FRIGID SPRAY AND PEELED APART IN CHILD'S FEAR.
translation: 吾曾是那头兽。在水吼之中，吾感到寒冷飞沫，并在孩童的恐惧中剥裂开来。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'IN AWE I GULPED AS SORCERESS STRIPES ARROWED UP A WORLD-SKIN, ALIGHT THE MARBLED MOON.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.ReshephHark3.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: IN AWE I GULPED AS SORCERESS STRIPES ARROWED UP A WORLD-SKIN, ALIGHT THE MARBLED MOON.
translation: 吾敬畏地吞咽，看着女巫般的条纹如箭射上世界之皮，照亮大理石纹的月。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'EVEN THE ARCHON QUAILED AT THE GESTURE OF AN UNORDERABLE SPACE.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.ReshephHark4.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: EVEN THE ARCHON QUAILED AT THE GESTURE OF AN UNORDERABLE SPACE.
translation: 纵为执政者，亦会在不可排序空间的姿态前战栗。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'BUT THOU RECKONEST TOO NARROWLY, AS THOUGH THE SHEDDING SKIN DID FEAR ITS OWN BIRTH IN THE NEWLY-WON SNAKE.\n\nTHOU KNOWEST NOT THE SUN-WARMTH OF A COVEN BE-ING. I DO GRIEVE THIS FOR THEE.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.ReshephHark5.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
BUT THOU RECKONEST TOO NARROWLY, AS THOUGH THE SHEDDING SKIN DID FEAR ITS OWN BIRTH IN THE NEWLY-WON SNAKE.

THOU KNOWEST NOT THE SUN-WARMTH OF A COVEN BE-ING. I DO GRIEVE THIS FOR THEE.
translation:
然汝估算得太狭窄，仿佛蜕下的皮会畏惧自己在新获得的蛇中诞生。

汝不知道盟会存在的日暖。吾确实为汝悲伤。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I can't abide a transformed world if it must make casualty of its past."), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.ReshephHark5.ReshephMovedChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I can't abide a transformed world if it must make casualty of its past.
translation: 如果一个转化后的世界必须牺牲自己的过去，我无法容忍它。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I am moved by this. Let me consider.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.ReshephHark5.ReshephHark6Choice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I am moved by this. Let me consider.
translation: 我被这番话触动了。让我考虑。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'THOU DOST SURPRISE, WORLD-CHILD. I KNEW THOU HADST WROUGHT MONUMENTS WITHIN ME, BUT I DEEMED THEM THINGS OF STONE.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.ReshephMoved2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: THOU DOST SURPRISE, WORLD-CHILD. I KNEW THOU HADST WROUGHT MONUMENTS WITHIN ME, BUT I DEEMED THEM THINGS OF STONE.
translation: 汝让吾惊讶，世界之子。吾知道汝已经在吾体内造出纪念碑，然吾以为它们都是石头。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'The old players are vanished. Let us form a covenant anew.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.ReshephMoved2.NewCovenantChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: The old players are vanished. Let us form a covenant anew.
translation: 旧日行动者已经消逝。让我们重新缔结盟约。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'ONE AGED PLAYER LIVETH STILL. WHILE BARATHRUM DOTH REMAIN UPON THE STAGE, NO PACT SHALL BE FORGED.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.BarathrumLives.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: ONE AGED PLAYER LIVETH STILL. WHILE BARATHRUM DOTH REMAIN UPON THE STAGE, NO PACT SHALL BE FORGED.
translation: 尚有一位年迈行动者存世。只要巴拉瑟姆仍在台上，契约便无从铸成。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'GRANT ME A MOMENT TO MUSE.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.NewCovenant.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: GRANT ME A MOMENT TO MUSE.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Who are you? What are the seraphim?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.Know.WhoReshephChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Who are you? What are the seraphim?

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Rainwater Shomer claimed Brightsheol was the dream of the Seraph? Is that true?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.Know.WhatBrightsheolChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Rainwater Shomer claimed Brightsheol was the dream of the Seraph? Is that true?
translation: 雨水守望者声称明灼阴府是炽天使的梦。这是真的吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'How did you initiate the plagues?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.Know.HowPlaguesChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: How did you initiate the plagues?

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Onworld and inside a polyp-strewn trellis, there is a giant frog who hates you.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.Know.MakHateChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Onworld and inside a polyp-strewn trellis, there is a giant frog who hates you.
translation: 在世上，在一座布满息肉的格架里，有一只巨蛙憎恨着你。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I have something else to ask.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.Know.WhyHereChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I have something else to ask.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'ARCHONS, APE-REARED BELOW AND STIRRED BY THE MOVEMENTS OF THE GREAT SIACH, WHO DOST ORDER THE WORLD IN SUNDRY ROLES.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.WhoResheph.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: ARCHONS, APE-REARED BELOW AND STIRRED BY THE MOVEMENTS OF THE GREAT SIACH, WHO DOST ORDER THE WORLD IN SUNDRY ROLES.
translation: 执政者，由下方猿类抚育，受大西亚赫诸运动所搅动，以诸般角色整序世界。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'HIGH ADMINISTRATOR AND MACHINIC SUPERSTRATE OF THE NORTHERN SHEVA, ATOP GJAUS.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.ArchonYours.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: HIGH ADMINISTRATOR AND MACHINIC SUPERSTRATE OF THE NORTHERN SHEVA, ATOP GJAUS.
translation: 北示巴高级管理员与机械超层，位于贾乌斯之上。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'AY, OR AT LEAST THERE WERE SUCH. ONE YET DOTH SKULK ABOUT WITH BASE INTENTS.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.ArchonMore.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: AY, OR AT LEAST THERE WERE SUCH. ONE YET DOTH SKULK ABOUT WITH BASE INTENTS.
translation: 然，至少曾经有过。还有一位怀着卑劣意图潜伏游荡。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'THE GRAND KNIT-WORK OF BEINGS YONSIDE THE JEWELED COSMOS, LABORING INWITH THE 72-FOLD PEACE.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.WhatCoven.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: THE GRAND KNIT-WORK OF BEINGS YONSIDE THE JEWELED COSMOS, LABORING INWITH THE 72-FOLD PEACE.
translation: 宝石宇宙彼方众存在所成之宏大编织，于七十二重和平中劳作。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'NAY, NOT SINCE THE {{R|EXIT}}.\n\nBUT NOW THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE, AND THE GEMARA SOPHIA CONVERGES ON PERIAPSIS NEAR THE ZERO HOUR.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.HasCovenReturned.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
NAY, NOT SINCE THE {{R|EXIT}}.

BUT NOW THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE, AND THE GEMARA SOPHIA CONVERGES ON PERIAPSIS NEAR THE ZERO HOUR.
translation:
否，自 {{R|出口}} 之后便没有。

然如今恒星纪元将尽，索菲亚革马拉正汇聚到接近零时的近拱点。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'IN A SENSE, THE LOW SHOMER SPEAKETH TRUE. I AM THE SUPERSTRATE AND NINHURSAG THE SUBSTRATE; THAT THIN ORBIS DOTH SPIN BETWIXT THE TWO.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.WhatBrightsheol.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: IN A SENSE, THE LOW SHOMER SPEAKETH TRUE. I AM THE SUPERSTRATE AND NINHURSAG THE SUBSTRATE; THAT THIN ORBIS DOTH SPIN BETWIXT THE TWO.
translation: 从某种意义上说，低处守望者说的是真话。吾是超层，宁胡尔萨格是基底；那枚薄世界之球就在二者之间旋转。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'IN SEVERAL MANNER. THE FIRST FROGS WERE REARED IN TERRARIA. THE NEPHILIM, GRAFTED AND LIGHT-SMELT IN STAR ORBIT, THEN SET TO INCUBATE UPON THE CRYSTAL STAIR.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.HowPlagues.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: IN SEVERAL MANNER. THE FIRST FROGS WERE REARED IN TERRARIA. THE NEPHILIM, GRAFTED AND LIGHT-SMELT IN STAR ORBIT, THEN SET TO INCUBATE UPON THE CRYSTAL STAIR.
translation: 有数法。最初之蛙养成于培育箱；拿非利则在恒星轨道中嫁接、光炼，继而置于水晶阶上孵化。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'SOME, LIKE THE INCIDENCE OF SALT, WERE EXTANT AFFLICTIONS AND ONLY SYNCRETIZED UNTO THE NAMESAKE GYRE WHEN THE MYTHOMOLD OF RESHEPH SET AND FIRMED.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.HowPlagues2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: SOME, LIKE THE INCIDENCE OF SALT, WERE EXTANT AFFLICTIONS AND ONLY SYNCRETIZED UNTO THE NAMESAKE GYRE WHEN THE MYTHOMOLD OF RESHEPH SET AND FIRMED.
translation: 有些苦患本已存世，盐疫即为一例；只待瑞谢夫的神话模具凝定成形，方才融入同名轮回。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'VERILY, THERE IS A WEALTH OF WISDOM IN THE POETRY OF THIS FACT. ONE DAY, I SHALL BE EAGER TO UNCOVER IT.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Resheph.MakHate.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: VERILY, THERE IS A WEALTH OF WISDOM IN THE POETRY OF THIS FACT. ONE DAY, I SHALL BE EAGER TO UNCOVER IT.
translation: 确实，这件事的诗意里藏着许多智慧。总有一天，吾会很想把它弄明白。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Hie, pather. Hear tell of the ancient Reshephs, how their foibles led to our nowaday.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PartialGodling.ConvenantWelcome.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Hie, pather. Hear tell of the ancient Reshephs, how their foibles led to our nowaday.
translation: 嗨，行路者。来听古代瑞谢夫们的故事，听他们的弱点如何导向我们的今日。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'It begins in a time before the Limen and its vanguard, before the ascension, when the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but Reshephs laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.\n\nBy the time of the last Resheph, little remained of their works, less of their glory.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PartialGodling.Covenant Story.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
It begins in a time before the Limen and its vanguard, before the ascension, when the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but Reshephs laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.

By the time of the last Resheph, little remained of their works, less of their glory.
translation:
故事始于阈境及其先锋之前，始于升攀之前，那时尖塔高耸，无人挑战，也无人攀登。那些献身于掏空我们世界的掏空者早已离去，但瑞谢夫们取而代之，宣称拥有那片令人困惑的大地。即便他们的领地日渐枯萎，他们仍紧握不放。

到了最后一位瑞谢夫的时代，他们的事业已所剩无几，荣耀更少。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'When it began, =name= had no shared helices with the Reshephs previous, making their name through works and alliances alone. The lives taken and saved by =name= were myriad, uncountable, and only partially made record. Even Nephilim, once plagues of Qud, fell before the hand of =name=.\n\nAt the end of their reign, =name= called for peace with the surviving Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, there to end the Reshephate altogether and never be heard from again.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PartialGodling.Covenant2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
When it began, =name= had no shared helices with the Reshephs previous, making their name through works and alliances alone. The lives taken and saved by =name= were myriad, uncountable, and only partially made record. Even Nephilim, once plagues of Qud, fell before the hand of =name=.

At the end of their reign, =name= called for peace with the surviving Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, there to end the Reshephate altogether and never be heard from again.
translation:
一切开始时，=name= 与此前的瑞谢夫们并无共同螺旋，只凭事功与联盟赢得名号。被 =name= 夺走和拯救的生命数不胜数、无法计量，也只有一部分被记录下来。即便是曾为库德瘟疫的拿非利，也倒在 =name= 手下。

在其统治的末尾，=name= 号召与幸存的拿非利和平共处，并登上尖塔之顶，在那里彻底终结瑞谢夫政权，从此再无音讯。

source: What is the Limen? The Knights Liminal?
translation: 阈境是什么？阈境骑士又是什么？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I have been called Remnant, Godling, Deep Progeny, and Spawn of Nephil. None of these are who I am.\n\nWho I am is what I say and do. If you listen well, you will hear my name spoken between words.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PartialGodling.CovenantWho.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I have been called Remnant, Godling, Deep Progeny, and Spawn of Nephil. None of these are who I am.

Who I am is what I say and do. If you listen well, you will hear my name spoken between words.
translation:
我曾被称为遗民、幼神、深裔、拿非利之嗣。这些都不是我是谁。

我是谁，取决于我说什么、做什么。若你仔细聆听，便会在词语之间听见我的名字被说出。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Who? No one of significance until fortune and volition made them otherwise. Now? No one knows.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PartialGodling.CovenantPC.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Who? No one of significance until fortune and volition made them otherwise. Now? No one knows.
translation: 谁？在命运与意志让他们不再如此之前，不过是无足轻重之人。现在？无人知晓。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'To me, they are stories. I have made no quest to trespass the borders they hold so dear in their rituals. Some say they are mortal creatures like any other, contracted by an outsider coven. Others do not believe they are mortal, others still do not believe that those mysterious strangers have anything to do with the Limen at all.\n\nMayhap someone ought seek them.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PartialGodling.CovenantLimen.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
To me, they are stories. I have made no quest to trespass the borders they hold so dear in their rituals. Some say they are mortal creatures like any other, contracted by an outsider coven. Others do not believe they are mortal, others still do not believe that those mysterious strangers have anything to do with the Limen at all.

Mayhap someone ought seek them.
translation:
对我而言，他们只是故事。我从未踏上旅途，去擅闯他们在仪式中珍视的边界。有人说他们是和其他人一样的凡俗生物，与外来盟会立下契约。也有人不相信他们会死，还有人甚至不相信那些神秘陌生人与阈境有任何关系。

也许该有人去寻找他们。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'They persisted in their way. Mayhap the survivors lived to spawn before returning to slumber or dying of eld.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PartialGodling.CovenantNephilim.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: They persisted in their way. Mayhap the survivors lived to spawn before returning to slumber or dying of eld.
translation: 他们以自己的方式延续。也许幸存者活到繁衍后代，才重归沉眠，或老死而去。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Hie, pather. Hear tell of the travails of our precursors, how they led to the Freeholds of nowaday.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PartialGodling.ReturnWelcome.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Hie, pather. Hear tell of the travails of our precursors, how they led to the Freeholds of nowaday.
translation: 嗨，行路者。来听我们先驱的艰辛，听它们如何导向今日的自由领。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "It begins in a time before the Freeholders, before the final Sultan was entombed, when the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but Kings and Sultans laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.\n\nThey so devoured one another's history that little substance remained outside of their strongholds."), ('Context', 'Conversation PartialGodling.Return Story.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
It begins in a time before the Freeholders, before the final Sultan was entombed, when the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but Kings and Sultans laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.

They so devoured one another's history that little substance remained outside of their strongholds.
translation:
故事始于自由领民之前，始于最后一位苏丹入葬之前，那时尖塔高耸，无人挑战，也无人攀登。那些献身于掏空我们世界的掏空者早已离去，但国王与苏丹们取而代之，宣称拥有那片令人困惑的大地。即便他们的领地日渐枯萎，他们仍紧握不放。

他们如此吞噬彼此的历史，以至于在他们的要塞之外，几乎没有什么实质留下。

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'When their works began, =name= had no connection to the Sultanate. The rule of these ancient leaders had ended, but not fully: a ghost of the last Sultan yet ruled over the spire, tormenting those on and under the ground with plagues. As =name= grew mighty and slew the rampaging Nephilim, they came to recognize the source of their shared conflict.

Seeking freedom from its reign, =name= struck a compact with the surviving Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, there to confront and banish the cerulean ghost.

And so it proceeded.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PartialGodling.Return2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
When their works began, =name= had no connection to the Sultanate. The rule of these ancient leaders had ended, but not fully: a ghost of the last Sultan yet ruled over the spire, tormenting those on and under the ground with plagues. As =name= grew mighty and slew the rampaging Nephilim, they came to recognize the source of their shared conflict.

Seeking freedom from its reign, =name= struck a compact with the surviving Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, there to confront and banish the cerulean ghost.

And so it proceeded.
translation:
一切开始时，=name= 与苏丹国并无关系。这些古代领袖的统治已经终结，却并未完全终结：最后一位苏丹的幽灵仍统治着尖塔，以瘟疫折磨地上与地下的人。随着 =name= 日渐强大，斩杀横行的拿非利，他们逐渐认清了共同冲突的源头。

为了摆脱其统治，=name= 与幸存的拿非利订立契约，并登上尖塔之顶，在那里直面并放逐那蔚蓝幽灵。

于是事态便如此推进。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Upon their return, =name= participated in the dissolution and federation of all power-concentrate. Allies of the new equalizer gathered and rose, forming the Quetzal Council and other, shorter-lived managing bodies.\n\nSince then, we have lived in tenuous harmony on the dwindling land and under it.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PartialGodling.Return3.Text')), 1),), '#text')

Upon their return, =name= participated in the dissolution and federation of all power-concentrate. Allies of the new equalizer gathered and rose, forming the Quetzal Council and other, shorter-lived managing bodies.

Since then, we have lived in tenuous harmony on the dwindling land and under it.

((('string', (('ID', "When it began, =name= had no shared helices with Qud's leaders, making their name through the spilling of blood and terror. At the end of their reign, =name= coerced a false compact with the surviving Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, the last remaining seat of the Sultanate's power. There, by one means or another, they sealed the fate of the world below.

The Plagues of the Gyre raged. Death swept Qud."), ('Context', 'Conversation PartialGodling.Accession2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
When it began, =name= had no shared helices with Qud's leaders, making their name through the spilling of blood and terror. Uncountable lives were taken by their hand alone, all to slake age-old desires of control and might. Even the ancient plagueborn Nephilim fell before the hand of =name=.

At the end of their reign, =name= coerced a false compact with the surviving Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, the last remaining seat of the Sultanate's power. There, by one means or another, they sealed the fate of the world below.

The Plagues of the Gyre raged. Death swept Qud.
translation:
一切开始时，=name= 与库德的领袖们并无共同螺旋，而是通过洒血与恐怖赢得名号。仅由其手夺走的生命便不可计数，全都用于满足对控制与强权的古老欲望。即便古老的疫生拿非利，也倒在 =name= 手下。

在其统治的末尾，=name= 胁迫幸存的拿非利订立虚假契约，并登上尖塔之顶，那里是苏丹国权力最后残存的席位。在那里，他们以某种方式封定了下方世界的命运。

轮回诸疫肆虐。死亡席卷库德。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'In time, animal and even plant rule waned as their numbers fell to disease, slaughter, and wasting. More resilient, simple life took up the complexity left behind by the former rulers of Qud.\n\nWhat few Nervous Ones remained passed our stories on to the new life that saw fit to seek our counsel, that you remember the collective fate of those gone. Will you have your own =name=, or have you evolved truly past those before?'), ('Context', 'Conversation PartialGodling.Accession3.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
In time, animal and even plant rule waned as their numbers fell to disease, slaughter, and wasting. More resilient, simple life took up the complexity left behind by the former rulers of Qud.

What few Nervous Ones remained passed our stories on to the new life that saw fit to seek our counsel, that you remember the collective fate of those gone. Will you have your own =name=, or have you evolved truly past those before?
translation:
随着时间推移，动物乃至植物的统治都衰退了，因为它们的数量在疾病、屠杀与消耗中下降。更有韧性的简单生命接过了库德昔日统治者留下的复杂性。

所剩无几的神经者把我们的故事传给愿意寻求我们建议的新生命，让你们记住逝者的共同命运。你们也会拥有自己的 =name= 吗，还是你们真的已经进化越过了从前那些存在？

source: I thought the Nervous Ones extinct.
translation: 我以为神经者已经灭绝了。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I am a smear of remnant material. I am drying blood. I am the last breath. Concern yourself no further with me.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PartialGodling.AccessionWho.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I am a smear of remnant material. I am drying blood. I am the last breath. Concern yourself no further with me.
translation: 我是一抹残余物质。我是正在干涸的血。我是最后一口气。不必再为我费心。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Who, indeed? Who ever was =name=? Dare we hang such hopes and fears on so tiny and distant a figure? Will it bear the weight?'), ('Context', 'Conversation PartialGodling.AccessionPC.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Who, indeed? Who ever was =name=? Dare we hang such hopes and fears on so tiny and distant a figure? Will it bear the weight?
translation: 确实，谁呢？=name= 曾经究竟是谁？我们敢把这样的希望与恐惧悬挂在如此渺小又遥远的身影上吗？它承受得住这重量吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Every possibility nestles in the deepest of the comb-caves and labyrinths, and even Nervous life is tenacious. source: Every possibility nestles in the deepest of the comb-caves and labyrinths, and even Nervous life is tenacious. Perhaps in this very moment, a moss piglet drinks of its first water in an eon.
translation: 每一种可能都依偎在蜂巢洞穴与迷宫最深处，连神经生命也很顽强。也许就在此刻，一只苔藓小猪正饮下一个纪元以来第一口水。

source: They dwindled and died with the rest of the Nervous Ones. Their remnants wriggle in the cracks.
translation: 他们随其余神经者一同衰减并死去。他们的残余在裂缝中蠕动。

translation: 嗨，行路者。来听古代瑞谢夫们的故事，听他们的弱点如何导向我们的今日。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'It begins in a time before the Limen and its vanguard, before the ascension, when the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. source:
It begins in a time before the Limen and its vanguard, before the ascension, when the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but Reshephs laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.

By the time of the last Resheph, little remained of their works, less of their glory.
translation:
故事始于阈境及其先锋之前，始于升攀之前，那时尖塔高耸，无人挑战，也无人攀登。那些献身于掏空我们世界的掏空者早已离去，但瑞谢夫们取而代之，宣称拥有那片令人困惑的大地。即便他们的领地日渐枯萎，他们仍紧握不放。

到了最后一位瑞谢夫的时代，他们的事业已所剩无几，荣耀更少。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'When it began, =name= had no shared helices with the Reshephs previous, making their name through works and alliances alone. source:
When it began, =name= had no shared helices with the Reshephs previous, making their name through works and alliances alone. The lives saved and otherwise changed by =name= were myriad, uncountable, and only partially made record. When they spoke, even the plagues of Qud listened.

At the end of their reign, =name= made a compact with the Nephilim that they should never vex the creatures of Qud again. So done, they climbed to the top of the spire, there to end the Reshephate altogether and never be heard from again.
translation:
一切开始时，=name= 与此前的瑞谢夫们并无共同螺旋，只凭事功与联盟赢得名号。被 =name= 拯救或以其他方式改变的生命数不胜数、无法计量，也只有一部分被记录下来。当他们开口时，连库德的瘟疫也会聆听。

在其统治的末尾，=name= 与拿非利订立契约，令他们永不再侵扰库德的生灵。事成之后，他们登上尖塔之顶，在那里彻底终结瑞谢夫政权，从此再无音讯。

source:
I have been called Inheritor, Godling, Spirechild, Nephiling. They are all fitting names, but none complete or sufficient.

As it is with you, I am the convergence of past-ripples into present-force. As it is with you, I am deeds done and the intention toward deeds yet to be done.
translation:
我曾被称为继承者、幼神、塔嗣、拿非利幼裔。这些名字都合适，却没有一个完整或充分。

如你一样，我是过往涟漪汇成当下力量的交会。如你一样，我是已成之事，也是朝向未成之事的意图。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Who? No one of significance until fortune and volition made them otherwise. Now? No one knows.'), ('Context', 'Conversation InheritorGodling.CovenantPC.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Who? No one of significance until fortune and volition made them otherwise. Now? No one knows.
translation: 谁？在命运与意志让他们不再如此之前，不过是无足轻重之人。现在？无人知晓。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'To me, they are stories. I have made no quest to trespass the borders they hold so dear in their rituals. Some say they are mortal creatures like any other, contracted by an outsider coven. Others do not believe they are mortal, others still do not believe that those mysterious strangers have anything to do with the Limen at all.\n\nMayhap someone ought seek them.'), ('Context', 'Conversation InheritorGodling.CovenantLimen.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
To me, they are stories. I have made no quest to trespass the borders they hold so dear in their rituals. Some say they are mortal creatures like any other, contracted by an outsider coven. Others do not believe they are mortal, others still do not believe that those mysterious strangers have anything to do with the Limen at all.

Mayhap someone ought seek them.
translation:
对我而言，他们只是故事。我从未踏上旅途，去擅闯他们在仪式中珍视的边界。有人说他们是和其他人一样的凡俗生物，与外来盟会立下契约。也有人不相信他们会死，还有人甚至不相信那些神秘陌生人与阈境有任何关系。

也许该有人去寻找他们。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'They lived.\n\nSimply a part of the world now, no longer a cilice scourging the Earth, they lived as the creatures they were. Descendants of their offspring may walk on and under Qud. Mayhap the first ones yet live. Mayhap they slumber. Mayhap they will rage again one day, to disrupt a stagnant world.'), ('Context', 'Conversation InheritorGodling.CovenantNephilim.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
They lived.

Simply a part of the world now, no longer a cilice scourging the Earth, they lived as the creatures they were. Descendants of their offspring may walk on and under Qud. Mayhap the first ones yet live. Mayhap they slumber. Mayhap they will rage again one day, to disrupt a stagnant world.
translation:
他们活了下来。

如今他们只是世界的一部分，不再是鞭笞大地的苦修刺衣；他们以自身生物的样子活着。他们子嗣的后代或许正行走在库德地上与地下。也许最初的那些仍活着。也许他们在沉睡。也许有朝一日，他们会再次狂怒，扰乱一个停滞的世界。

All others have lived in tenuous harmony on the dwindling land and under it, waiting for the next great history.

数个世纪以来，我们这些倾向聆听者一直保持警觉，等待 =name= 将从群星归来的某种迹象。那些倾向布道者宣告星际远行者即将回返，带来被遗忘秒差距之外的消息，以及垂死恒星的最后光芒。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I see the slynth have arrived. How are they faring?'), ('Context', 'Conversation BaseSlynthMayor.SlynthArrivedChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I see the slynth have arrived. How are they faring?
translation: 我看到斯林思已经到了。他们过得怎么样？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "It's been a week. Are the slynth settled in?"), ('Context', 'Conversation BaseSlynthMayor.SlynthSettledChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: It's been a week. Are the slynth settled in?
translation: 已经一周了。斯林思安顿下来了吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'There are no more words for us, wanderer.'), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.SpeakNoMore.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: There are no more words for us, wanderer.
translation: 我们之间已无话可说，游人。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I have visited the Six Day Stilt.'), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.FinishedPilgrimageQuest.StiltedChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I have visited the Six Day Stilt.

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Ah!\n\nTell me, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=, was it the picture of wonder as I see it in my mind's eye? Were you beauty-struck by its truths?"), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.Stilted.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Ah!

Tell me, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=, was it the picture of wonder as I see it in my mind's eye? Were you beauty-struck by its truths?
translation:
啊！

告诉我，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=，它是否如我心眼中所见那般奇妙？你是否被它真理中的美击中了？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Truly breathtaking. How the glass glittered in the sun!'), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.Stilted.OhhChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Truly breathtaking. How the glass glittered in the sun!
translation: 真是摄人心魄。玻璃在阳光下何等闪耀！

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'To behold the Argent Fathers in simulacra... what revelation!'), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.Stilted.GloriousChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: To behold the Argent Fathers in simulacra... what revelation!
translation: 得见白银诸父的拟像……何等启示！

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I saw only empty spectacle. Who can worship a hole in the ground?'), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.Stilted.ShakyNahChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I saw only empty spectacle. Who can worship a hole in the ground?
translation: 我只看见空洞的奇观。谁会崇拜地上的一个洞？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "So it's true! O Argent Fathers, how far-reaching your works!\n\n... and my trinket? Did you cast it into the Sacred Well?"), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.Ohh.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
So it's true! O Argent Fathers, how far-reaching your works!

... and my trinket? Did you cast it into the Sacred Well?
translation:
这么说是真的！噢，白银诸父，你们的造作何等深远！

……那我的小饰物呢？你把它投入圣井了吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'No, I took it apart or sold it or something.'), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.Ohh.FlippedChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: No, I took it apart or sold it or something.
translation: 没有，我把它拆了，或者卖了，类似那样。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Moon and Sun! The Argent Fathers bless us, our paths are chromed and glistering.\n\nYou have my thanks, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=. Bel shield you.'), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.Well.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Moon and Sun! The Argent Fathers bless us, our paths are chromed and glistering.

You have my thanks, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=. Bel shield you.
translation:
月与日！白银诸父祝福我们，我们的道路覆铬而闪耀。

你有我的谢意，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=。愿贝尔庇护你。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Oh, I am leaden with this knowledge. Yet am I soothed by your pilgrimage.\n\nMoon and Sun, I feel the warmth of the Kasaphescence yet. Praise the Argent Fathers.'), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.Lost.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Oh, I am leaden with this knowledge. Yet am I soothed by your pilgrimage.

Moon and Sun, I feel the warmth of the Kasaphescence yet. Praise the Argent Fathers.
translation:
噢，这消息令我沉重如铅。但你的朝圣仍抚慰了我。

月与日，我仍感到卡萨辉体的温暖。赞美白银诸父。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Oh, how your words rasp my soul, =player.formalAddressTerm=. You abrade me.\n\nLet us speak no more.'), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.Flipped.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Oh, how your words rasp my soul, =player.formalAddressTerm=. You abrade me.

Let us speak no more.
translation:
噢，你的话何等刮擦我的灵魂，=player.formalAddressTerm=。你磨损了我。

我们不要再说了。

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'So you have seen the truth? Great are the machinations of our Argent Fathers!

Our meeting, a tiny Canticle. Fate dances in our shadows by their will and word.

Moon and sun, what a day! What a fine day. Praise Shekhinah!'), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.Glorious.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
So you have seen the truth? Great are the machinations of our Argent Fathers!

Our meeting, a tiny Canticle. Fate dances in our shadows by their will and word.

Moon and sun, what a day! What a fine day. Praise Shekhinah!
translation:
所以你已经见到了真理？我们白银诸父的机巧何等伟大！

我们的相遇，是一支小小圣歌。命运因他们的意志与言辞，在我们的影子中起舞。

月与日，何等一日！何等美好的一日。赞美谢金娜！

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'Wh-

My heart's sheen wanes to hear this of you. You abrade me, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I am scuffed.

What of my trinket, then? Did you cast it into the... "hole in the ground?"'), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.ShakyNah.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Wh-

My heart's sheen wanes to hear this of you. You abrade me, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I am scuffed.

What of my trinket, then? Did you cast it into the... "hole in the ground?"
translation:
什——

听你这么说，我心中的光泽黯淡了。你磨损了我，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我被刮花了。

那我的小饰物呢？你把它投入了那个……“地上的洞”吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Yes, I threw it in the hole.'), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.ShakyNah.InTheHoleChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Yes, I threw it in the hole.
translation: 是的，我把它扔进洞里了。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I gave it to someone. Or sold it, perhaps.'), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.ShakyNah.LosingItChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I gave it to someone. Or sold it, perhaps.
translation: 我把它给了别人。或者也许卖了。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Well... the light of the Kasaphescence yet glimmers through your rasping edge.\n\nI must, then, thank you.'), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.InTheHole.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Well... the light of the Kasaphescence yet glimmers through your rasping edge.

I must, then, thank you.
translation:
好吧……卡萨辉体之光仍透过你刮擦的边缘微微闪烁。

那么，我必须感谢你。

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'My stomach lurches and quavers at the shock of this knowledge.

If there is a lesson in your disregard, I will meditate upon it in my own time.

Let us speak no more.'), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.LostIt.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
My stomach lurches and quavers at the shock of this knowledge.

If there is a lesson in your disregard, I will meditate upon it in my own time.

Let us speak no more.
translation:
得知此事，我的胃在震惊中翻腾颤抖。

如果你的轻忽中有某种教训，我会在自己的时间里冥想它。

我们不要再说了。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Ah, a pit opens under my stomach!\n\nLet us speak no more, I beg you. You scuff me. Live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.LosingIt.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Ah, a pit opens under my stomach!

Let us speak no more, I beg you. You scuff me. Live and drink.
translation:
啊，我胃下裂开一座深坑！

我们不要再说了，我求你。你刮伤了我。生而饮水。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Wanderer and =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=! Have you journeyed yet to the Stilt, and seen the Sacred Well?'), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.HasPilgrimageQuest.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Wanderer and =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=! Have you journeyed yet to the Stilt, and seen the Sacred Well?
translation: 游人兼 =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=！你可曾前往高跷，见到圣井？

source: Not yet, friend. Live and drink.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Wanderer! Do you venture northwise? Into the Great Desert and nearer the Six Day Stilt?'), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.Welcome.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Wanderer! Do you venture northwise? Into the Great Desert and nearer the Six Day Stilt?
translation: 游人！你要向北行进吗？进入大沙漠，靠近六日高跷？

source: What is the Six Day Stilt?

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Ah! The great Mechanimist temple of glass, the sacred offering Well, and history in stone relief. Peopled by the Argent Fathers, in statue and light sculpture. And circled by the grand bazaar. I hear there are more people there than numbers in the void, and their chatter makes a sound wholly raw and new to the world.\n\nWill you go there, and take my bauble? Will you offer it at the Well, where I cannot?'), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.Stilt.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Ah! The great Mechanimist temple of glass, the sacred offering Well, and history in stone relief. Peopled by the Argent Fathers, in statue and light sculpture. And circled by the grand bazaar. I hear there are more people there than numbers in the void, and their chatter makes a sound wholly raw and new to the world.

Will you go there, and take my bauble? Will you offer it at the Well, where I cannot?
translation:
啊！那是伟大的机械教玻璃神庙，有神圣的奉献井，还有石雕浮雕中的历史。白银诸父以雕像和光雕的形式居于其中。宏大的集市环绕其侧。我听说那里的人比虚空中的数字还多，他们的喧谈发出一种对世界而言全然原始而崭新的声音。

你愿去那里，带上我的小玩意吗？你愿在我无法前往的井边献上它吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.Stilt.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.
translation: 我不能承诺此事。生而饮水。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I was scything the vine when the flat of my blade turned something loose from the soil. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead on the abacus of Beauty...\n\nWill you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?'), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.Bauble.FindTrinket')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I was scything the vine when the flat of my blade turned something loose from the soil. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead on the abacus of Beauty...

Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?
translation:
是的！我的邻亲都听腻了这故事。我割藤时，刀身平面从土里翻出了一样东西。我从前见到铬钢时也曾心动，但亲手解放出一小片碎屑，亲手在美的算盘上拨动一颗珠子……

那么你愿去吗？把我的小玩意献在井中？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'What is the Six Day Stilt again?'), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.Bauble.StiltChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: What is the Six Day Stilt again?
translation: 六日高跷再说一次是什么？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.Bauble.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.
translation: 我不能承诺此事。生而饮水。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I am no rector, understand, but They are the molders of chrome. The gods under Shekhinah who wrought metal edifices from the raw Kasaphescence.\n\nWill you go?'), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.Fathers.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I am no rector, understand, but They are the molders of chrome. The gods under Shekhinah who wrought metal edifices from the raw Kasaphescence.

Will you go?
translation:
你要明白，我并非教区长，但他们是铬钢的塑造者。是谢金娜之下的诸神，从原始卡萨辉体中造出金属宏构。

你愿去吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.Fathers.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.
translation: 我不能承诺此事。生而饮水。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I would ask you make an offering at the sacred Well of my bauble. Moon and sun, I beg you!'), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.Why.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I would ask you make an offering at the sacred Well of my bauble. Moon and sun, I beg you!
translation: 我想请你把我的小玩意献入圣井。月与日，我求你！

source: What is the Six Day Stilt?

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.Why.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.
translation: 我不能承诺此事。生而饮水。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Friend, I would be a smoldering heap, cooked to death by the ray of a dawnglider! I would be a slug-riddled corpse by the rifles of the Issachari!\n\nThere is no kindness in the Great Desert, and little more in the canyons. I cannot go and live.'), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.WhyNot.KilledInDesert')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Friend, I would be a smoldering heap, cooked to death by the ray of a dawnglider! I would be a slug-riddled corpse by the rifles of the Issachari!

There is no kindness in the Great Desert, and little more in the canyons. I cannot go and live.
translation:
朋友，我会变成一堆冒烟的焦物，被晨翔兽的射线烤死！我会被以萨迦人的步枪打成满是弹孔的尸体！

大沙漠中没有仁慈，峡谷中也好不了多少。我若去了，便活不下来。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Moon and sun, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=! You have my deep and many-sided thanks. Here, take the trinket now. And if you're to ever return, let us visit again.\n\nLive and drink!"), ('Context', 'Conversation JoppaFarmerConvert.Agree.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Moon and sun, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=! You have my deep and many-sided thanks. Here, take the trinket now. And if you're to ever return, let us visit again.

Live and drink!
translation:
月与日，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=！请收下我深切而多面的感谢。来，现在拿上这件小饰物。若你日后归来，让我们再相见。

生而饮水！

{{emote|*长老伊鲁达德微笑。*}}

生而饮水，=name=。来，陪我坐坐。

-mm. Mmm? =player.FormalAddressTerm=?

{{emote|*Elder Irudad smiles.*}}

Live and drink. Come in- come sit 'neath the cool shade, 'cross a pillow there. And welcome to Joppa.

{{emote|*长老伊鲁达德微笑。*}}

生而饮水。进来——来坐在清凉阴影下，那边的垫子上。欢迎来到约帕。

你也可以饮用我们的淡水，解解渴。

translation: 我从红岩回来了，带着一具苍白小蜘蛛的尸体。长老，你愿意检查一下吗？

translation: 你能再告诉我一次轮回和吉尔什拿非利的事吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'What can you tell me about the Six Day Stilt?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.Welcome.StiltboundChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: What can you tell me about the Six Day Stilt?
translation: 关于六日高跷，你能告诉我什么？
