source: Argyve wants me to meet the Barathrumites.
translation: 阿吉夫想让我去见巴拉瑟姆派。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "-this? The oasis-hamlet. 'Neath the shelf of the world. A million breaths of salt the wind heaves over the Great Salt Desert Moghra'yi. And to the east, the rotting jungles of Qud.\n\nHere in the crack between the two, watervine can grow, and we grow it. mmm, =player.formalAddressTerm=."), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.Joppa.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
-this? The oasis-hamlet. 'Neath the shelf of the world. A million breaths of salt the wind heaves over the Great Salt Desert Moghra'yi. And to the east, the rotting jungles of Qud.

Here in the crack between the two, watervine can grow, and we grow it. mmm, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
translation:
——这里？绿洲小村。在世界架层之下。风把百万口盐息吹过莫格拉伊大盐漠。而东方，是库德腐烂的丛林。

就在两者之间的裂隙里，水藤能够生长，而我们种植它。嗯，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Can you tell me about Qud?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.Joppa.QudChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Can you tell me about Qud?

path:
((('string', (('ID', '-mm, there? Land slopes up and is toothed in chrome steeples, ageless things. Looming over the old-earth tunnels, pillowed in rotting jungle and fungus groves. And broken against the mounts of the north, they are, in the shadow of the Spindle...

There are people, friends, communities. And friends-to-noone, too. History is thick as the high salt sun, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and where the past is ground up like matz meal, a mix of life sets in.

-mm, adventurous ones set off for their own splinter of artifact. To both Fates, life and death...'), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.Qud.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
-mm, there? Land slopes up and is toothed in chrome steeples, ageless things. Looming over the old-earth tunnels, pillowed in rotting jungle and fungus groves. And broken against the mounts of the north, they are, in the shadow of the Spindle...

There are people, friends, communities. And friends-to-noone, too. History is thick as the high salt sun, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and where the past is ground up like matz meal, a mix of life sets in.

-mm, adventurous ones set off for their own splinter of artifact. To both Fates, life and death...
translation:
——嗯，那里？土地向上倾斜，长着铬钢尖塔般的齿，那些无龄之物。它们耸立在旧土隧道之上，枕在腐烂丛林与真菌林中。又在北方山脉前碎裂，处在纺锤的阴影里……

那里有人，有朋友，有社群。也有谁都不友善的存在。历史像高悬的盐日一样厚重，=player.formalAddressTerm=，而在过去被碾成无酵饼粉的地方，各种生命混杂扎根。

——嗯，爱冒险的人会出发，去寻找属于自己的神器碎片。敬两种命运，生命与死亡……

path: ((('string', (('ID', "-here? Speak to my daughter through the east door, for herbs. And sitting Tam in the southeast has all manner of trinket, against his chests o' drawers."), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.Wares.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: -here? Speak to my daughter through the east door, for herbs. And sitting Tam in the southeast has all manner of trinket, against his chests o' drawers.
translation: ——这里？要草药，就去东门那边找我女儿。东南边坐着的塔姆有各式小玩意，靠着他的抽屉柜。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "-mm, work? The farmers are plagued by cave vermin. You might speak to Mehmet o' there, by the southern watervine patch.\n\nAnd Argyve, too, =player.formalAddressTerm=. The tinker. Always looking for trinkets to wire between, heh. Go through his hut of sheet metal, to the southwest."), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.Work.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
-mm, work? The farmers are plagued by cave vermin. You might speak to Mehmet o' there, by the southern watervine patch.

And Argyve, too, =player.formalAddressTerm=. The tinker. Always looking for trinkets to wire between, heh. Go through his hut of sheet metal, to the southwest.
translation:
——嗯，活干？农民正受洞穴害兽困扰。你可以去和那边的穆罕默德谈谈，就在南边水藤田旁。

还有阿吉夫，=player.formalAddressTerm=。那个修补匠。总在找小玩意接线，呵。往西南去，穿过他的铁皮小屋。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '-mm, work? Try Argyve, =player.formalAddressTerm=. The tinker. Always looking for trinkets to wire between, heh. Go through his hut of sheet metal, to the southwest.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.WorkAfter.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: -mm, work? Try Argyve, =player.formalAddressTerm=. The tinker. Always looking for trinkets to wire between, heh. Go through his hut of sheet metal, to the southwest.
translation: ——嗯，活干？去找阿吉夫试试，=player.formalAddressTerm=。那个修补匠。总在找小玩意接线，呵。往西南去，穿过他的铁皮小屋。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "-ahh, mm, such spectacle. The statues within, a revelation to the eyes. Chandlers enough to drain your skins dry 'twixt Shallows and Beetle Moon."), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.Stiltbound.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: -ahh, mm, such spectacle. The statues within, a revelation to the eyes. Chandlers enough to drain your skins dry 'twixt Shallows and Beetle Moon.
translation: ——啊，嗯，何等奇观。里面的雕像，对眼睛而言是一场启示。香烛商多得足以在浅滩月到甲虫月之间把你的水囊榨干。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "-mm, Barathrumites. Strange draft o'those bearfolk. They, mm, hah. They care not overly for outsiders. I hope Argyve sold you not a better welcome than you'll have."), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.Barathrumites.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: -mm, Barathrumites. Strange draft o'those bearfolk. They, mm, hah. They care not overly for outsiders. I hope Argyve sold you not a better welcome than you'll have.
translation: ——嗯，巴拉瑟姆派。那些熊民中奇怪的一支。他们，嗯，哈。他们不怎么喜欢外人。我希望阿吉夫没把你会得到的欢迎说得太好。

path:
((('string', (('ID', '-this? Oh? Oh...

{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses for several minutes.*}}

Warted leg? mm. Foul smell of sour gum? mmm. Moon and sun....

A girshling? This is a girshling.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.FinishedRedrock.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
-this? Oh? Oh...

{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses for several minutes.*}}

Warted leg? mm. Foul smell of sour gum? mmm. Moon and sun....

A girshling? This is a girshling.
translation:
——这个？噢？噢……

{{emote|*长老伊鲁达德停顿了好几分钟。*}}

长疣的腿？嗯。酸胶的恶臭？嗯。月与日……

一只吉尔什幼体？这是吉尔什幼体。

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'Creature of plague, =player.formalAddressTerm=. mmm. This one...

{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}

This one covered in slick and muscled out the bilge hose of sleeping Agolgot, in the cave under the Cloaca...

-mm, but here? Girshling this far west? There must be hundreds for one to reach... mm, does the Gyre widen again??'), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.Girshling.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Creature of plague, =player.formalAddressTerm=. mmm. This one...

{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}

This one covered in slick and muscled out the bilge hose of sleeping Agolgot, in the cave under the Cloaca...

-mm, but here? Girshling this far west? There must be hundreds for one to reach... mm, does the Gyre widen again??
translation:
瘟疫之物，=player.formalAddressTerm=。嗯。这个……

{{emote|*长老伊鲁达德停顿。*}}

这东西浑身滑腻，从泄殖腔下方洞穴里沉睡阿戈尔戈特的舱底排水管中强行挤出……

——嗯，可是在这里？吉尔什幼体到了这么西边？必定有成百上千只，才会有一只抵达……嗯，轮回又在扩张了吗？？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I talked to a strange figure next to the girshling.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.Girshling.GyreWightChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I talked to a strange figure next to the girshling.
translation: 我和吉尔什幼体旁边的一个怪人说过话。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'There was a strange figure shadowing the creature...'), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.Girshling.GyreWightChoice2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: There was a strange figure shadowing the creature...
translation: 有个怪人尾随着那生物……

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I noticed the creature has had its fangs removed.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.Girshling.DefangedChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I noticed the creature has had its fangs removed.
translation: 我注意到那生物的尖牙被拔掉了。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}\n\n-mm, plagues. Of our great grandsires many-times-over. Salt, darkness, svardym-frog... Girshling.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.Gyre.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}

-mm, plagues. Of our great grandsires many-times-over. Salt, darkness, svardym-frog... Girshling.
translation:
{{emote|*长老伊鲁达德停顿。*}}

——嗯，瘟疫。我们许多代以前祖祖辈辈的瘟疫。盐，黑暗，斯瓦尔丁蛙……吉尔什幼体。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}\n\n-mm, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Do not like to sour the air with a harsh word! But this tiding bites my liver like acid. mm, must ask Nima for an elixir of yuckwheat...'), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.Agolgot2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}

-mm, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Do not like to sour the air with a harsh word! But this tiding bites my liver like acid. mm, must ask Nima for an elixir of yuckwheat...
translation:
{{emote|*长老伊鲁达德停顿。*}}

——嗯，=player.formalAddressTerm=。我不喜欢用刺耳话语酸败空气！但这消息像酸一样咬我的肝。嗯，必须去找妮玛要一剂恶心麦药水……

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I talked to a strange figure next to the girshling.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.Agolgot2.GyreWightChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I talked to a strange figure next to the girshling.
translation: 我和吉尔什幼体旁边的一个怪人说过话。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'There was a strange figure shadowing the creature...'), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.Agolgot2.GyreWightChoice2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: There was a strange figure shadowing the creature...
translation: 有个怪人尾随着那生物……

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I noticed the creature has had its fangs removed.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.Agolgot2.DefangedChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I noticed the creature has had its fangs removed.
translation: 我注意到那生物的尖牙被拔掉了。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I am sorry to cause pain, Elder.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.Agolgot2.ApologyChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I am sorry to cause pain, Elder.

path: ((('string', (('ID', '-mm, oh? In dyed robes, flashing gestures of hand? And ranting about pipe milk? A gyre wight, must be. They about worship the Girsh nephilim as gods.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.GyreWight.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: -mm, oh? In dyed robes, flashing gestures of hand? And ranting about pipe milk? A gyre wight, must be. They about worship the Girsh nephilim as gods.
translation: ——嗯，噢？穿染色长袍，手势闪动？还嚷嚷着管乳？一定是轮回尸鬼。他们近乎把吉尔什拿非利当作神来崇拜。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}\n\n-mm, nephilim. Seventh plague. Girsh titans born on the Moon Stair, and quickened to life to eat our young. Sultan Resheph drove them back a chiliad ago, away to slumber. mm, do they rouse?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.Nephilim.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}

-mm, nephilim. Seventh plague. Girsh titans born on the Moon Stair, and quickened to life to eat our young. Sultan Resheph drove them back a chiliad ago, away to slumber. mm, do they rouse?
translation:
{{emote|*长老伊鲁达德停顿。*}}

——嗯，拿非利。第七瘟疫。诞生于月阶的吉尔什巨人，被激活成生命来吞食我们的幼子。一千年前，苏丹瑞谢夫把他们赶回去沉睡。嗯，他们要醒来了吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', '-mm, oh? A gyre wight, must be. They bind the teeth right up to their own gums, to make a show for the Girsh nephilim.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.Defanged.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: -mm, oh? A gyre wight, must be. They bind the teeth right up to their own gums, to make a show for the Girsh nephilim.
translation: ——嗯，噢？一定是轮回尸鬼。他们把牙直接绑到自己的牙龈上，向吉尔什拿非利作秀。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '-mm? No, =player.formalAddressTerm=! Your finding is rich in value to us. We are poor farmers, and sharpen our vinereapers is all we can do. But others? Perhaps more.\n\nTake these prickly-boons as thanks. mm, I will not soon forget this, =name=. Leave me now to muse, kindly...'), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.Apology.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
-mm? No, =player.formalAddressTerm=! Your finding is rich in value to us. We are poor farmers, and sharpen our vinereapers is all we can do. But others? Perhaps more.

Take these prickly-boons as thanks. mm, I will not soon forget this, =name=. Leave me now to muse, kindly...
translation:
——嗯？不，=player.formalAddressTerm=！你的发现对我们极有价值。我们只是贫苦农民，能做的只有磨快藤镰。但其他人呢？或许能做更多。

收下这些刺恩果作为谢礼。嗯，我不会很快忘记这事，=name=。现在请让我独自沉思吧……

path: ((('string', (('ID', '-mm, yes? Plagues, a chiliad old. Seven such: girshlings, darkness. mm, svardym-frog...\n\nAh, nephilim, too, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Girsh titans who eat the young of kith and kin. Sultan Resheph drove them under the earth, but do they stir??'), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.GyreReminder.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
-mm, yes? Plagues, a chiliad old. Seven such: girshlings, darkness. mm, svardym-frog...

Ah, nephilim, too, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Girsh titans who eat the young of kith and kin. Sultan Resheph drove them under the earth, but do they stir??
translation:
——嗯，是吗？瘟疫，一千年前的瘟疫。共有七种：吉尔什幼体，黑暗。嗯，斯瓦尔丁蛙……

啊，还有拿非利，=player.formalAddressTerm=。吞食亲族幼子的吉尔什巨人。苏丹瑞谢夫把他们驱入地下，但他们在躁动吗？？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "-mm, oh? You're wondering if they might come to Joppa, then?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.SlynthRequest.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: -mm, oh? You're wondering if they might come to Joppa, then?
translation: ——嗯，噢？那么你是在想，他们能否来到约帕？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "mm, I am for you, =name=. Any friend of yours is too a friend of Joppa, and if those friends desire shelter I wouldn't dare turn them away. I only hope these lilypad-folk have the patience for a farmer's life. -mm, not as exciting here as it was in the Palladium Reef."), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.SlynthRequestAccept.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: mm, I am for you, =name=. Any friend of yours is too a friend of Joppa, and if those friends desire shelter I wouldn't dare turn them away. I only hope these lilypad-folk have the patience for a farmer's life. -mm, not as exciting here as it was in the Palladium Reef.
translation: 嗯，我支持你，=name=。你的任何朋友也都是约帕的朋友；若这些朋友想要庇护，我不敢拒绝他们。我只希望这些睡莲叶之民有耐心过农夫的生活。——嗯，这里可不像钯礁那么刺激。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '-mm, blessings upon your generous heart, =name=. I mean no slight to these slynth, but it is too great a favor you ask of the people of Joppa.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.SlynthRequestReject.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: -mm, blessings upon your generous heart, =name=. I mean no slight to these slynth, but it is too great a favor you ask of the people of Joppa.
translation: ——嗯，愿祝福落在你慷慨的心上，=name=。我无意轻慢这些斯林思，但你向约帕人民请求的恩惠太大了。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Have you spoken to the slynth, =name=? I am curious to hear what destination they choose.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.SlynthAbout.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Have you spoken to the slynth, =name=? I am curious to hear what destination they choose.
translation: 你和斯林思谈过了吗，=name=？我很好奇他们会选择什么目的地。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '-mm, your luminous friends are settling in quite well.\n\nThere is yet a pall of ennui among some, but such is the case for any party of brave migrants. Ah, they will find their ground or their path, all in time. Some farmers show some small discomfort but that will pass in time.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.SlynthArrived.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
-mm, your luminous friends are settling in quite well.

There is yet a pall of ennui among some, but such is the case for any party of brave migrants. Ah, they will find their ground or their path, all in time. Some farmers show some small discomfort but that will pass in time.
translation:
——嗯，你那些发光的朋友安顿得相当不错。

有些人身上仍笼着一层倦怠，但任何勇敢迁徙者的队伍都是如此。啊，他们终会找到自己的土地或道路。一些农民表现出些许不适，但那也会随时间过去。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '-mm, ah, =name=. Come see how the slynth have become a part of Joppa!\n\nSome cared not for the slow pace of our lives and struck out on their own, and with their thews and wits I have no doubt they will live to find purpose. mm, others are welcome to grow and flourish here in our marshes.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Irudad.SlynthSettled.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
-mm, ah, =name=. Come see how the slynth have become a part of Joppa!

Some cared not for the slow pace of our lives and struck out on their own, and with their thews and wits I have no doubt they will live to find purpose. mm, others are welcome to grow and flourish here in our marshes.
translation:
——嗯，啊，=name=。来看看斯林思如何成为约帕的一部分！

有些人不喜欢我们生活的缓慢步调，便独自出发；凭他们的筋力和智慧，我毫不怀疑他们会活着找到目标。嗯，其他人则欢迎在我们的沼泽中生长繁盛。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Live and drink, =name=. Any news from Red Rock?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Mehmet.RedrockNews.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Live and drink, =name=. Any news from Red Rock?
translation: 生而饮水，=name=。红岩有什么消息吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Yes. I found the vermin and bits of gnawed watervine. I carry one's corpse with me."), ('Context', 'Conversation Mehmet.RedrockNews.BackFromRedrockChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Yes. I found the vermin and bits of gnawed watervine. I carry one's corpse with me.
translation: 有。我找到了害兽和被啃过的水藤碎片。我带着其中一只的尸体。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Taste what on the wind today, =name=?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Mehmet.Welcome..Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: Taste what on the wind today, =name=?

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I can taste lime, =name=. And mayhaps gallium?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Mehmet.Welcome..Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: I can taste lime, =name=. And mayhaps gallium?
translation: 我能尝到石灰，=name=。也许还有镓？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Aye, the pest-vanquisher! Live and drink, =name=.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Mehmet.Welcome..Text5')), 1),), '#text')
source: Aye, the pest-vanquisher! Live and drink, =name=.
translation: 是啊，害虫征服者！生而饮水，=name=。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'A waterhand? Aye. Live and drink, traveller.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Mehmet.Welcome.2')), 1),), '#text')
source: A waterhand? Aye. Live and drink, traveller.
translation: 水佣？是啊。生而饮水，旅人。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Can you tell me about your village, Joppa?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Mehmet.Welcome.VillageChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Can you tell me about your village, Joppa?
translation: 你能讲讲你的村子约帕吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I am in search of work.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Mehmet.Welcome.WorkChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I am in search of work.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Mehmet, the tongue says. Live and drink, =name=.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Mehmet.Name')), 1),), '#text')
source: Mehmet, the tongue says. Live and drink, =name=.
translation: 舌头说，是穆罕默德。生而饮水，=name=。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Watervine farm in the lap of the marsh. You've sucked the moisture out a vinewafer, yea? We tend the plant here."), ('Context', 'Conversation Mehmet.Village.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Watervine farm in the lap of the marsh. You've sucked the moisture out a vinewafer, yea? We tend the plant here.
translation: 沼泽怀抱里的水藤农场。你吸过藤饼里的水分吧？我们在这里照料那种植物。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Wind off the Great Desert cools a touch and gives up moisture. Just enough. A tongue can taste a hundred kinds of wind, y'know?\n\nAnywhile, that's where my wandering mind goes. More's about Joppa I say speak to our Elderfriend. Irudad. Up northwise the path."), ('Context', 'Conversation Mehmet.VillageMore.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Wind off the Great Desert cools a touch and gives up moisture. Just enough. A tongue can taste a hundred kinds of wind, y'know?

Anywhile, that's where my wandering mind goes. More's about Joppa I say speak to our Elderfriend. Irudad. Up northwise the path.
translation:
从大沙漠吹来的风稍微凉下来，交出一点水分。刚刚够。舌头能尝出一百种风，你知道吗？

总之，我飘来飘去的心就会想到那里。想知道更多约帕的事，我说去找我们的长老朋友。伊鲁达德。沿路往北。

path:
((('string', (('ID', "Aye? I have it, then.

Somethin' is eating our watervine, 'round Beetle Moon. Q-ruun says he saw a creature, spider-like, slinking in the brine. But no cave spider would dare get so near Warden's stomps.

I tasted a bit of red fleck in the pool. Shale, like we find in the soil by Red Rock..."), ('Context', 'Conversation Mehmet.Work.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Aye? I have it, then.

Somethin' is eating our watervine, 'round Beetle Moon. Q-ruun says he saw a creature, spider-like, slinking in the brine. But no cave spider would dare get so near Warden's stomps.

I tasted a bit of red fleck in the pool. Shale, like we find in the soil by Red Rock...
translation:
是吗？那我有活。

甲虫月前后，有东西在吃我们的水藤。库伦说他看见一种像蜘蛛的生物，在盐水里潜行。但没有洞穴蜘蛛敢靠守望者的脚步那么近。

我在水池里尝到一点红色碎屑。页岩，就像我们在红岩那边土里找到的……

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Hike there, will you? To Red Rock. Just about two parasangs north of Joppa.\n\nKill the vermin and bring one's corpse back, for seein' what it is. Elder will take care to pay you after, waterhand."), ('Context', 'Conversation Mehmet.WorkMore.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Hike there, will you? To Red Rock. Just about two parasangs north of Joppa.

Kill the vermin and bring one's corpse back, for seein' what it is. Elder will take care to pay you after, waterhand.
translation:
你愿意走一趟吗？去红岩。就在约帕以北大约两帕拉桑。

杀掉害兽，带一具尸体回来，好看看它到底是什么。之后长老会负责付你报酬，水佣。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I will do as you ask.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Mehmet.WorkMore.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I will do as you ask.

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Oh? Oh. {{emote|*Mehmet pauses.*}}\n\nDon't like the look o' that thing. Best bring it to Elder. Hut's northwise up the path."), ('Context', 'Conversation Mehmet.BackFromRedrock.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Oh? Oh. {{emote|*Mehmet pauses.*}}

Don't like the look o' that thing. Best bring it to Elder. Hut's northwise up the path.
translation:
噢？噢。{{emote|*穆罕默德停顿。*}}

我不喜欢那东西的样子。最好把它带给长老。小屋沿路往北。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '=player.apparentSpecies=? We are greeted! What do you desire?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Tam.Welcome.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: =player.apparentSpecies=? We are greeted! What do you desire?

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'What kind of creature are you?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Tam.Welcome.AboutTheDromadChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: What kind of creature are you?

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I desire nothing. Live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Tam.Welcome.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I desire nothing. Live and drink.
translation: 我什么也不想要。生而饮水。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'It is a pleasure to know this, =player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm= =name=! I am Tam.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Tam.WhoIsTam.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: It is a pleasure to know this, =player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm= =name=! I am Tam.
translation: 很高兴知道这一点，=player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm= =name=！我是塔姆。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Joppa is my home, yes.\n\nI walked Moghra'yi in the caravans of my brethren and the saltback, but upon meeting Elder Irudad, knew at once to settle down here. You will understand, =player.formalAddressTerm= =player.apparentSpecies=, if you speak to him."), ('Context', 'Conversation Tam.Joppa.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Joppa is my home, yes.

I walked Moghra'yi in the caravans of my brethren and the saltback, but upon meeting Elder Irudad, knew at once to settle down here. You will understand, =player.formalAddressTerm= =player.apparentSpecies=, if you speak to him.
translation:
约帕是我的家，是的。

我曾随我的同胞与盐背的商队行走莫格拉伊，但一见到长老伊鲁达德，便立刻知道该在此定居。你若和他说话，就会明白的，=player.formalAddressTerm= =player.apparentSpecies=。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I am dromad, =player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm=. Some say saltstrider. Do you know this?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Tam.AboutTheDromad.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I am dromad, =player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm=. Some say saltstrider. Do you know this?
translation: 我是卓马德，=player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm=。有人说盐行者。你知道吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'My people have walked the salt for thousands of years, meeting every creature that lives and thinks. From Pale Sea to the marsh of Joppa, and under the Hanging Hills, our chests are drawn.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Tam.AboutTheDromad2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: My people have walked the salt for thousands of years, meeting every creature that lives and thinks. From Pale Sea to the marsh of Joppa, and under the Hanging Hills, our chests are drawn.
translation: 我的族人在盐中行走了数千年，遇见每一种活着并思考的生物。从苍白海到约帕沼泽，再到悬丘之下，我们的箱柜都被牵引而行。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '=player.apparentSpecies=? We are greeted! What do you desire?'), ('Context', 'Conversation DromadTrader.Start.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: =player.apparentSpecies=? We are greeted! What do you desire?
What kind of creature are you?

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I desire nothing. Live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation DromadTrader.Start.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I desire nothing. Live and drink.
translation: 我什么也不想要。生而饮水。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I am dromad, =player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm=. Some say saltstrider. Do you know this?'), ('Context', 'Conversation DromadTrader.AboutTheDromad.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I am dromad, =player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm=. Some say saltstrider. Do you know this?

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Psst!\n\nHey, can I interest you in some Consortium wares?'), ('Context', 'Conversation ConsortiumGlowpad.Start.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Psst!

Hey, can I interest you in some Consortium wares?
translation:
嘘！

嘿，有没有兴趣看看财团货物？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Welcome a-Joppa, friend. Stay peacelike, and we stay friends, hyeh? You make trouble, it's my work a-split you open like a croc."), ('Context', 'Conversation WardenYrame.Start.Text.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Welcome a-Joppa, friend. Stay peacelike, and we stay friends, hyeh? You make trouble, it's my work a-split you open like a croc.
translation: 欢迎来约帕，朋友。和平点，我们就还是朋友，嘿？你要惹麻烦，我的活儿就是把你像鳄鱼一样剖开。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Elder's over my right shoulder, chemist a-left. I ask you pick one or turn around. I en't here for chat."), ('Context', 'Conversation WardenYrame.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: Elder's over my right shoulder, chemist a-left. I ask you pick one or turn around. I en't here for chat.
translation: 长老在我右肩那边，药剂师在左边。我请你挑一个，或者转身走。我不是来聊天的。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Well. They en't ended you yet."), ('Context', 'Conversation WardenYrame.Start.Text.Text8')), 1),), '#text')
source: Well. They en't ended you yet.
translation: 好吧。他们还没把你了结。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Mehmet has bade me travel to Red Rock.'), ('Context', 'Conversation WardenYrame.Start.Red RockChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Mehmet has bade me travel to Red Rock.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I depart for Grit Gate soon.'), ('Context', 'Conversation WardenYrame.Start.Grit GateChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I depart for Grit Gate soon.
translation: 我很快要动身去砂砾门。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I journey North, to the Six Day Stilt.'), ('Context', 'Conversation WardenYrame.Start.StiltChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I journey North, to the Six Day Stilt.

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Called Yrame, Warden a-Joppa. I kill trouble. Don't be trouble."), ('Context', 'Conversation WardenYrame.Who.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Called Yrame, Warden a-Joppa. I kill trouble. Don't be trouble.
translation: 叫伊拉姆，约帕守望者。我杀麻烦。别当麻烦。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Nigh every settlement a-Qud keeps a Warden. We snuff threats to the peace.'), ('Context', 'Conversation WardenYrame.Warden.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Nigh every settlement a-Qud keeps a Warden. We snuff threats to the peace.
translation: 库德几乎每个聚居点都有守望者。我们掐灭威胁和平的东西。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Out East? Uegh. Wouldn't go, I. Git ta Qudzu. Like as rust the pauldrons right off a-shoulders."), ('Context', 'Conversation WardenYrame.Rustwells.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Out East? Uegh. Wouldn't go, I. Git ta Qudzu. Like as rust the pauldrons right off a-shoulders.
translation: 往东？呃。我可不去。会碰上库德葛。说不定把肩上的肩甲都锈掉。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Up North? En't far. See them baboons, you put one's light out for me."), ('Context', 'Conversation WardenYrame.Red Rock.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Up North? En't far. See them baboons, you put one's light out for me.
translation: 往北？不远。见到那些狒狒，替我弄死一只。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Don't say? Well. Fates favor your feet, hyeh."), ('Context', 'Conversation WardenYrame.Grit Gate.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Don't say? Well. Fates favor your feet, hyeh.
translation: 真的？好吧。愿命运眷顾你的脚，嘿。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "If you don't get dry-roasted by the fire snakes, ought be a time of times. Better hit all the food stalls for samples, hyeh?"), ('Context', 'Conversation WardenYrame.Stilt.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: If you don't get dry-roasted by the fire snakes, ought be a time of times. Better hit all the food stalls for samples, hyeh?
translation: 如果你没被火蛇烤干，那该会是一段好时候。最好去每个食摊都尝点样品，嘿？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Ahh, there is a new face. I am Nima Ruda, town apothecary. If your feet point to Qud, you'll need some of my wares before you go."), ('Context', 'Conversation Nima Ruda.Start.Text.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Ahh, there is a new face. I am Nima Ruda, town apothecary. If your feet point to Qud, you'll need some of my wares before you go.
translation: 啊，有张新面孔。我是妮玛·鲁达，镇上的药剂师。如果你的脚指向库德，出发前你会需要我的一些货物。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Time and rest are the surest way to dress a wound, but my wares can help if you're in a hurry."), ('Context', 'Conversation Nima Ruda.Start.Text.Text3')), 1),), '#text')
source: Time and rest are the surest way to dress a wound, but my wares can help if you're in a hurry.
translation: 时间与休息是包扎伤口最稳妥的方法，但如果你赶时间，我的货物能帮上忙。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Don't let your nostrums run dry on the road. I have what you need."), ('Context', 'Conversation Nima Ruda.Start.Text.Text5')), 1),), '#text')
source: Don't let your nostrums run dry on the road. I have what you need.
translation: 别让你的药剂在路上耗尽。我有你需要的东西。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'What wares do you offer?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Nima Ruda.Start.WaresChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')

((('string', (('ID', 'Witchwood for pain, bandages for bleeding, yuckwheat and honey for when your guts act up. Coldcaps when I can find them. Why not take a look?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Nima Ruda.Wares.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Witchwood for pain, bandages for bleeding, yuckwheat and honey for when your guts act up. Coldcaps when I can find them. Why not take a look?
translation: 止痛用的巫木，止血用的绷带，肠胃闹腾时用的恶心麦和蜂蜜。找得到时也有冷帽菇。何不看看？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I grew up right here in Joppa, daughter of the Elder and all. Spent some years delving, but gave it up after a few near escapes and nearly deadly wounds. I'm better suited to herbalism anyway, and my father worries less."), ('Context', 'Conversation Nima Ruda.Story.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I grew up right here in Joppa, daughter of the Elder and all. Spent some years delving, but gave it up after a few near escapes and nearly deadly wounds. I'm better suited to herbalism anyway, and my father worries less.
translation: 我就在约帕长大，毕竟是长老的女儿。曾经探洞好几年，但几次险些逃不出来、几处差点要命的伤之后就放弃了。反正我更适合草药学，我父亲也少担心些。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Will you inherit leadership of Joppa from your father?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Nima Ruda.Story.LeadershipChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Will you inherit leadership of Joppa from your father?
translation: 你会从你父亲那里继承约帕的领导权吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Fates forfend. I would hardly like to lead a village and run a shop at the same time.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Nima Ruda.Leadership.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Fates forfend. I would hardly like to lead a village and run a shop at the same time.
translation: 命运可别如此。我可不想一边领导村子，一边经营店铺。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Fair enough. Live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Nima Ruda.Leadership.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
((('string', (('ID', 'Live and drink, traveler. Moist starapples for the road?'), ('Context', 'Conversation StarappleFarmer.Start.Text.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Live and drink, traveler. Moist starapples for the road?
translation: 生而饮水，旅人。路上要些多汁星苹果吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Mind the trees, =player.formalAddressTerm=. They ain't yours."), ('Context', 'Conversation StarappleFarmer.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: Mind the trees, =player.formalAddressTerm=. They ain't yours.
translation: 注意那些树，=player.formalAddressTerm=。它们不是你的。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Now you keep your eyes off my young, =player.formalAddressTerm=.'), ('Context', 'Conversation StarappleFarmer.Start.Text.Text3')), 1),), '#text')
source: Now you keep your eyes off my young, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
translation: 你可别盯着我的小崽看，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Can't go wrong with starapples, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Good for what ails ya."), ('Context', 'Conversation StarappleFarmer.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: Can't go wrong with starapples, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Good for what ails ya.
translation: 星苹果不会错，=player.formalAddressTerm=。有啥毛病都管点用。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'You know how to make starapple jam? If not, you can buy it from me.'), ('Context', 'Conversation StarappleFarmer.Start.Text.Text5')), 1),), '#text')
source: You know how to make starapple jam? If not, you can buy it from me.
translation: 你知道怎么做星苹果酱吗？不知道的话，可以从我这儿买。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Spread starapple on yer matz! It's proof against thirst and harm alike."), ('Context', 'Conversation StarappleFarmer.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: Spread starapple on yer matz! It's proof against thirst and harm alike.
translation: 把星苹果抹在你的无酵饼上！既防渴，也防伤。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "See my whiskers? Starapples. They'll boost your virility threefold."), ('Context', 'Conversation StarappleFarmer.Start.Text.Text7')), 1),), '#text')
source: See my whiskers? Starapples. They'll boost your virility threefold.
translation: 看见我的胡须了吗？星苹果。它们能让你的精力强上三倍。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Live and drink, traveler. Are you hungry?'), ('Context', 'Conversation PigFarmer.Start.Text.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Live and drink, traveler. Are you hungry?

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Now don't you go breaking my fence."), ('Context', 'Conversation PigFarmer.Start.Text.Text5')), 1),), '#text')
source: Now don't you go breaking my fence.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'You best not hurt my critters.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PigFarmer.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: You best not hurt my critters.
translation: 你最好别伤我的小家伙。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I en't filthy. I'm muddy. Big difference."), ('Context', 'Conversation PigFarmer.Start.Text.Text7')), 1),), '#text')
source: I en't filthy. I'm muddy. Big difference.
translation: 我不脏。我只是沾泥。差得远呢。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "It's get meat here or risk a slugsnout ball in the gut. Your choice, =player.formalAddressTerm=."), ('Context', 'Conversation PigFarmer.Start.Text.Text8')), 1),), '#text')
source: It's get meat here or risk a slugsnout ball in the gut. Your choice, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
translation: 要么在这儿买肉，要么冒着肚子里挨一发蛞蝓嘴弹丸的风险。你选吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Good clean meat! Well. Clean as it gets.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PigFarmer.Start.Text.Text9')), 1),), '#text')
source: Good clean meat! Well. Clean as it gets.
translation: 好干净的肉！呃。能干净到这份上。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Now don't you fret. My crabs are docile as dogs."), ('Context', 'Conversation CrabFarmer.Start.Text.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Now don't you fret. My crabs are docile as dogs.
translation: 别担心。我的蟹温顺得像狗。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Get close if you like, they don't pinch."), ('Context', 'Conversation CrabFarmer.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: Get close if you like, they don't pinch.
translation: 你愿意就靠近点，它们不夹人。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'You ever run into one of these in the wild? The lengths some folks will go for a crab leg!'), ('Context', 'Conversation CrabFarmer.Start.Text.Text3')), 1),), '#text')
source: You ever run into one of these in the wild? The lengths some folks will go for a crab leg!
translation: 你在野外碰见过这种东西吗？有些人为了蟹腿真是什么都肯干！

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I hand-reared each one of these critters. They've had a life of luxury."), ('Context', 'Conversation CrabFarmer.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: I hand-reared each one of these critters. They've had a life of luxury.
translation: 这些小家伙每一只都是我亲手养大的。它们过的是奢华日子。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Stressed crab means tough crab meat. Buy domesticated meat.'), ('Context', 'Conversation CrabFarmer.Start.Text.Text5')), 1),), '#text')
source: Stressed crab means tough crab meat. Buy domesticated meat.
translation: 有压力的蟹，肉就硬。买驯养肉吧。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Ain't they precious? Cute little buggers."), ('Context', 'Conversation CrabFarmer.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: Ain't they precious? Cute little buggers.
translation: 它们不宝贝吗？可爱的小东西。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'My crabs are as gentle as can be. Delicious, too.'), ('Context', 'Conversation CrabFarmer.Start.Text.Text7')), 1),), '#text')
source: My crabs are as gentle as can be. Delicious, too.
translation: 我的蟹温柔得不能再温柔。也很好吃。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "They say we'll all be crabs, eventually."), ('Context', 'Conversation CrabFarmer.Start.Text.Text8')), 1),), '#text')
source: They say we'll all be crabs, eventually.
translation: 他们说，我们最终都会变成蟹。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'No lie, I love my job.'), ('Context', 'Conversation LeechFarmer.Start.Text.Text5')), 1),), '#text')
source: No lie, I love my job.
translation: 说真的，我喜欢我的工作。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Leeches. Blood. If that's what you want, I got what you want."), ('Context', 'Conversation LeechFarmer.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: Leeches. Blood. If that's what you want, I got what you want.
translation: 水蛭。血。如果你想要这个，我有你想要的。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I feed these critters what blood the ranchers have to spare.'), ('Context', 'Conversation LeechFarmer.Start.Text.Text7')), 1),), '#text')
source: I feed these critters what blood the ranchers have to spare.
translation: 牧场主们有多余的血，我就拿来喂这些小家伙。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Sorry. Lost focus a bit. What do you need?'), ('Context', 'Conversation LeechFarmer.Start.Text.Text8')), 1),), '#text')
source: Sorry. Lost focus a bit. What do you need?
translation: 抱歉。有点走神。你需要什么？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Blood tastes all right, but I can't fathom living on it."), ('Context', 'Conversation LeechFarmer.Start.Text.Text9')), 1),), '#text')
source: Blood tastes all right, but I can't fathom living on it.
translation: 血味道还行，但我想象不了靠它过活。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "By the Eaters, I'm exhausted. May I help you?"), ('Context', 'Conversation CatHerder.Start.Text.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: By the Eaters, I'm exhausted. May I help you?
translation: 食客在上，我累坏了。需要帮忙吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I beg you. Do not release the cats.'), ('Context', 'Conversation CatHerder.Start.Text.Text3')), 1),), '#text')
source: I beg you. Do not release the cats.

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I'll buy your shiniest things, if you'll sell them."), ('Context', 'Conversation CatHerder.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: I'll buy your shiniest things, if you'll sell them.
translation: 如果你肯卖，我会买下你最闪亮的东西。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I'm a cat herder. My parents were cat herders. Their parents were cat herders, and their parents. I don't understand why we do what we do but it is all I know."), ('Context', 'Conversation CatHerder.Start.Text.Text5')), 1),), '#text')
source: I'm a cat herder. My parents were cat herders. Their parents were cat herders, and their parents. I don't understand why we do what we do but it is all I know.
translation: 我是牧猫人。我父母是牧猫人。他们的父母是牧猫人，再往上也是。我不明白我们为什么要做这些，但我只懂这个。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I've a glimmer of light for sale if you need one, wanderer."), ('Context', 'Conversation CatHerder.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: I've a glimmer of light for sale if you need one, wanderer.
translation: 如果你需要，我有一缕光可卖，游人。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'The cats are not for sale.'), ('Context', 'Conversation CatHerder.Start.Text.Text7')), 1),), '#text')
source: The cats are not for sale.

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I'm like to faint from this heat."), ('Context', 'Conversation CatHerder.Start.Text.Text8')), 1),), '#text')
source: I'm like to faint from this heat.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Mind your footing! Ha ha ha!'), ('Context', 'Conversation AmoebaFarmer.Start.Text.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Mind your footing! Ha ha ha!

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Takes a simple person to tend a simple creature. I don't mind it."), ('Context', 'Conversation AmoebaFarmer.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: Takes a simple person to tend a simple creature. I don't mind it.
translation: 照料简单生物需要简单的人。我不介意。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Bless this mess and bless you, =player.formalAddressTerm=.'), ('Context', 'Conversation AmoebaFarmer.Start.Text.Text3')), 1),), '#text')
source: Bless this mess and bless you, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
translation: 祝福这一团乱，也祝福你，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'What can I do for you? Need slime?'), ('Context', 'Conversation AmoebaFarmer.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: What can I do for you? Need slime?
translation: 我能为你做什么？需要黏液吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Have you ever taken a swig of slime? It's not half bad!"), ('Context', 'Conversation AmoebaFarmer.Start.Text.Text5')), 1),), '#text')
source: Have you ever taken a swig of slime? It's not half bad!
translation: 你喝过一大口黏液吗？还不算坏！

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I keep my amoebas happy! Or, you know, whatever they got in place of happy.'), ('Context', 'Conversation AmoebaFarmer.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: I keep my amoebas happy! Or, you know, whatever they got in place of happy.
translation: 我让我的变形虫保持快乐！或者，你懂的，它们用来替代快乐的那种状态。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'See how their skin glisters in the salt sun? Lovely.'), ('Context', 'Conversation AmoebaFarmer.Start.Text.Text7')), 1),), '#text')
source: See how their skin glisters in the salt sun? Lovely.
translation: 看它们的皮肤在盐日下多闪亮？真可爱。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Now don't you dare pop my amoeba."), ('Context', 'Conversation AmoebaFarmer.Start.Text.Text8')), 1),), '#text')
source: Now don't you dare pop my amoeba.
translation: 你可别敢弄爆我的变形虫。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I think I got all the puddles, but watch for slime all the same.'), ('Context', 'Conversation AmoebaFarmer.Start.Text.Text9')), 1),), '#text')
source: I think I got all the puddles, but watch for slime all the same.
translation: 我想我已经清掉所有水洼了，但还是小心黏液。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Step in. Take shelter from the salt.'), ('Context', 'Conversation SnailFarmer.Start.Text.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Step in. Take shelter from the salt.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'What mazes and mandalas could be crafted by human hands that hope to surpass what nature wrought eons before our creation?'), ('Context', 'Conversation SnailFarmer.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: What mazes and mandalas could be crafted by human hands that hope to surpass what nature wrought eons before our creation?
translation: 人手能造出什么迷宫与曼荼罗，竟希望超越自然在我们诞生前亿万年便已造就之物？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'How sublime, the striations of the snail shell. And such a lovely word, striation.'), ('Context', 'Conversation SnailFarmer.Start.Text.Text3')), 1),), '#text')
source: How sublime, the striations of the snail shell. And such a lovely word, striation.
translation: 蜗牛壳的条纹何等崇高。而“条纹”也是个多可爱的词。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I think often upon the gyre, from Resheph's gospels. Why do you imagine it is so named?"), ('Context', 'Conversation SnailFarmer.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: I think often upon the gyre, from Resheph's gospels. Why do you imagine it is so named?
translation: 我常常思索瑞谢夫福音中的轮回。你觉得它为什么会如此命名？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Even in the imperfections of a spiral shell we see the perfection of nature.'), ('Context', 'Conversation SnailFarmer.Start.Text.Text5')), 1),), '#text')
source: Even in the imperfections of a spiral shell we see the perfection of nature.
translation: 即便在螺旋壳的不完美中，我们也能看见自然的完美。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "My snails aren't so suited to this climate. Some days I spend more water keeping them properly slimy than I make in sales."), ('Context', 'Conversation SnailFarmer.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: My snails aren't so suited to this climate. Some days I spend more water keeping them properly slimy than I make in sales.
translation: 我的蜗牛不太适应这种气候。有些日子，我为了让它们保持足够黏滑，花掉的水比卖货赚来的还多。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Snails find the spiral of another shell familiar and comforting. Should you wear one, they will look upon you favorably.'), ('Context', 'Conversation SnailFarmer.Start.Text.Text7')), 1),), '#text')
source: Snails find the spiral of another shell familiar and comforting. Should you wear one, they will look upon you favorably.
translation: 蜗牛会觉得另一只壳的螺旋熟悉而安心。如果你戴上一只，它们会友善地看待你。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'There is kinship from mollusk to mollusk. What secrets do they know that we do not?'), ('Context', 'Conversation SnailFarmer.Start.Text.Text8')), 1),), '#text')
source: There is kinship from mollusk to mollusk. What secrets do they know that we do not?
translation: 软体动物与软体动物之间自有亲缘。它们知道哪些我们不知道的秘密？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Goat meat keeps good. Buy some afore you head back to the salt.'), ('Context', 'Conversation GoatHerder.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: Goat meat keeps good. Buy some afore you head back to the salt.
translation: 山羊肉耐放。回盐地之前买点吧。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'What, you need a menu? I got goat meat and goat jerky.'), ('Context', 'Conversation GoatHerder.Start.Text.Text3')), 1),), '#text')
source: What, you need a menu? I got goat meat and goat jerky.
translation: 怎么，你还要菜单？我有山羊肉和山羊肉干。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I hate my goats and they hate me, but we both hate every other body more.'), ('Context', 'Conversation GoatHerder.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: I hate my goats and they hate me, but we both hate every other body more.
translation: 我恨我的山羊，它们也恨我，但我们都更恨其他所有人。
这天气糟透了。你想要啥？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Goats ain't fun to travel with, but they're good protection."), ('Context', 'Conversation GoatHerder.Start.Text.Text7')), 1),), '#text')
source: Goats ain't fun to travel with, but they're good protection.
translation: 带山羊旅行不好玩，但它们很能护身。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I didn't ask for this life, but here we are. Wanna buy something?"), ('Context', 'Conversation GoatHerder.Start.Text.Text8')), 1),), '#text')
source: I didn't ask for this life, but here we are. Wanna buy something?
translation: 我没主动要这种生活，但事已至此。想买点什么吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Some say beetle jerky is too sour. I say, learn to cook!'), ('Context', 'Conversation BeetleFarmer.Start.Text.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Some say beetle jerky is too sour. I say, learn to cook!
translation: 有人说甲虫肉干太酸。我要说，学学做饭吧！

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Look at their chitin! See the sheen? Means they're healthy."), ('Context', 'Conversation BeetleFarmer.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: Look at their chitin! See the sheen? Means they're healthy.
translation: 看看它们的几丁质！看见光泽了吗？说明它们很健康。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Beetles are fine companions, but don't leave your backpack and your pet beetlebum in the same room."), ('Context', 'Conversation BeetleFarmer.Start.Text.Text3')), 1),), '#text')
source: Beetles are fine companions, but don't leave your backpack and your pet beetlebum in the same room.
translation: 甲虫是好伙伴，但别把你的背包和宠物甲虫屁股留在同一个房间里。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Nothing wrong with beetle meat. Come, try it.'), ('Context', 'Conversation BeetleFarmer.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: Nothing wrong with beetle meat. Come, try it.
translation: 甲虫肉没什么不好。来，试试。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Beetle jerky holds its own. You learn to appreciate the aftertaste.'), ('Context', 'Conversation BeetleFarmer.Start.Text.Text5')), 1),), '#text')
source: Beetle jerky holds its own. You learn to appreciate the aftertaste.
translation: 甲虫肉干自有本事。你会学会欣赏它的回味。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Meat, fresh and preserved alike, all at reasonable prices.'), ('Context', 'Conversation BeetleFarmer.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: Meat, fresh and preserved alike, all at reasonable prices.
translation: 肉，新鲜的和腌存的都有，价格都公道。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Come to see my beasts? All hale and well-fed, I assure you.'), ('Context', 'Conversation BeetleFarmer.Start.Text.Text7')), 1),), '#text')
source: Come to see my beasts? All hale and well-fed, I assure you.
translation: 来看我的牲口？我保证，它们都健康，吃得也好。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Oh, look. It is a not-bear. Greetings, not-bear.'), ('Context', 'Conversation SapientBear.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: Oh, look. It is a not-bear. Greetings, not-bear.
translation: 噢，看啊。是一只非熊。你好，非熊。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Oh my, what a cute not-bear. Greetings, cute not-bear.'), ('Context', 'Conversation SapientBear.Start.Text.Text10')), 1),), '#text')
source: Oh my, what a cute not-bear. Greetings, cute not-bear.
translation: 哎呀，多可爱的非熊。你好，可爱的非熊。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I cannot decide which I like best: berries, meat, or honey? I simply cannot decide.'), ('Context', 'Conversation SapientBear.Start.Text.Text17')), 1),), '#text')
source: I cannot decide which I like best: berries, meat, or honey? I simply cannot decide.
translation: 我决定不了自己最喜欢哪一种：浆果、肉，还是蜂蜜？我就是决定不了。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Glowfish are not the tastiest food, but they are the prettiest.'), ('Context', 'Conversation SapientBear.Start.Text.Text18')), 1),), '#text')
source: Glowfish are not the tastiest food, but they are the prettiest.
translation: 辉光鱼不是最美味的食物，但它们最漂亮。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I once traveled over a mountain, believing I would see something that I had not seen before once past the summit. I was disappointed to find that the other side of the mountain bore a striking resemblance to the one I'd just left. What is the purpose of mountains?"), ('Context', 'Conversation SapientBear.Start.Text.Text19')), 1),), '#text')
source: I once traveled over a mountain, believing I would see something that I had not seen before once past the summit. I was disappointed to find that the other side of the mountain bore a striking resemblance to the one I'd just left. What is the purpose of mountains?
translation: 我曾经翻过一座山，相信越过山顶后就会看见未曾见过的东西。结果我失望地发现，山的另一侧与我刚离开的那一侧惊人相似。山的目的是什么？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Live and eat honey, bear friend.'), ('Context', 'Conversation SapientBear.Start.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Live and eat honey, bear friend.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I might be willing to trade.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Arconaut.Start.Text.Text10')), 1),), '#text')
source: I might be willing to trade.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Lot of good stuff down here. Lots of bad stuff too.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Arconaut.Start.Text.Text17')), 1),), '#text')
source: Lot of good stuff down here. Lots of bad stuff too.
translation: 下面有很多好东西。坏东西也很多。
诶嘿。诶嘿嘿。诶嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿！
诶嘿。嘿。什么。诶嘿嘿。什么！
生饮水生饮水生饮水，诶嘿嘿嘿。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'libm drin. ehehehe. lipum dronk! ahahahahah!'), ('Context', 'Conversation Snapjaw.Start.Text.Text16')), 1),), '#text')
source: libm drin. ehehehe. lipum dronk! ahahahahah!
translation: 生嗯饮。诶嘿嘿。哩噗咚！啊哈哈哈哈！
诶嘿嘿！诶嘿嘿嘿！啊哈哈哈！

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'ehh, what for you talk me?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Snapjaw.Start.Text.Text27')), 1),), '#text')
source: ehh, what for you talk me?

translation: 啊哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Pick a direction and walk in it.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Issachari.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: Pick a direction and walk in it.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Got nothing to say to a lack-salt.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Issachari.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: Got nothing to say to a lack-salt.
translation: 我跟缺盐人没什么好说的。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Hey lack-salt. How much water you got? No, don't ever answer that question."), ('Context', 'Conversation Issachari.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: Hey lack-salt. How much water you got? No, don't ever answer that question.
translation: 嘿，缺盐人。你有多少水？不，永远别回答这种问题。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Be respectful of the red-and-white and we will get along.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Issachari.Start.Text.Text7')), 1),), '#text')
source: Be respectful of the red-and-white and we will get along.
translation: 尊重红白，我们就能相安无事。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Keep your mouth covered, or the brine air will cure your lungs to jerky.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Issachari.Start.Text.Text8')), 1),), '#text')
source: Keep your mouth covered, or the brine air will cure your lungs to jerky.
translation: 把嘴遮好，不然盐水气会把你的肺腌成肉干。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Humble before my Fathers, I walk.'), ('Context', 'Conversation MechanimistPilgrim.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: Humble before my Fathers, I walk.
translation: 我谦卑于诸父之前而行。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Live and drink, traveler. Show mercy to a weary pilgrim.'), ('Context', 'Conversation MechanimistPilgrim.Start.Text.Text3')), 1),), '#text')
source: Live and drink, traveler. Show mercy to a weary pilgrim.
translation: 生而饮水，旅人。怜悯一位疲惫的朝圣者吧。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Praise be upon Nisroch, who shelters us stiltseekers.'), ('Context', 'Conversation MechanimistPilgrim.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: Praise be upon Nisroch, who shelters us stiltseekers.
translation: 愿赞美归于尼兹洛克，祂庇护我们这些寻高跷者。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I see my wares catch your eye, =player.formalAddressTerm=. They can be yours.'), ('Context', 'Conversation GenericMerchant.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: I see my wares catch your eye, =player.formalAddressTerm=. They can be yours.
translation: 我看我的货入了你的眼，=player.formalAddressTerm=。它们可以归你。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Ah, =player.formalAddressTerm=, thank the Eaters that you have found Qud's only honest shopkeep."), ('Context', 'Conversation GenericMerchant.Start.Text.Text7')), 1),), '#text')
source: Ah, =player.formalAddressTerm=, thank the Eaters that you have found Qud's only honest shopkeep.
translation: 啊，=player.formalAddressTerm=，感谢吞噬者，你找到了库德唯一诚实的店主。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'On my honor, =player.formalAddressTerm=, my goods are of only the highest quality and I offer a fair trade.'), ('Context', 'Conversation GenericMerchant.Start.Text.Text8')), 1),), '#text')
source: On my honor, =player.formalAddressTerm=, my goods are of only the highest quality and I offer a fair trade.
translation: 以我的荣誉起誓，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我的货只有最高品质，我也只做公平买卖。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Welcome, =player.formalAddressTerm=. How may I serve you today?'), ('Context', 'Conversation GenericMerchant.Start.Text.Text10')), 1),), '#text')
source: Welcome, =player.formalAddressTerm=. How may I serve you today?
translation: 欢迎，=player.formalAddressTerm=。今天我能为你效劳什么？
你的水囊是不是沉起来了，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'May you find shade and vittle, =player.formalAddressTerm=.'), ('Context', 'Conversation GenericMerchant.Start.Text.Text14')), 1),), '#text')
source: May you find shade and vittle, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'By the Eaters, have you ever seen so much treasure?'), ('Context', 'Conversation GenericMerchant.Start.Text.Text16')), 1),), '#text')
source: By the Eaters, have you ever seen so much treasure?
translation: 以吞噬者之名，你见过这么多宝贝吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Live and drink, traveler. Welcome to the Stilt.'), ('Context', 'Conversation WardenEsthers.Welcome.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Live and drink, traveler. Welcome to the Stilt.
translation: 生而饮水，旅人。欢迎来到高跷。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Praise be to Shekhinah! O, sovereign Fathers... at last, I am here!'), ('Context', 'Conversation WardenEsthers.Welcome.PraiseChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Praise be to Shekhinah! O, sovereign Fathers... at last, I am here!
translation: 赞美谢金娜！噢，至高诸父……我终于到了！

path: ((('string', (('ID', "This is the Six Day Stilt, huh. It's... colossal, beautiful. I see why the chrome stewards gather here."), ('Context', 'Conversation WardenEsthers.Welcome.HuhChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: This is the Six Day Stilt, huh. It's... colossal, beautiful. I see why the chrome stewards gather here.
translation: 这就是六日高跷啊。它……庞大，美丽。我明白铬钢司事为什么聚集在这里了。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Is it true what they say? That it's a petrified kraken?"), ('Context', 'Conversation WardenEsthers.Welcome.TrueChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Is it true what they say? That it's a petrified kraken?
translation: 他们说的是真的吗？这里是一头石化海怪？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "What a grand bazaar! What's in each of these tents?"), ('Context', 'Conversation WardenEsthers.Welcome.BazaarChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: What a grand bazaar! What's in each of these tents?
translation: 好宏伟的集市！这些帐篷里都有什么？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'You are among friends here, pilgrim. Stay peaceful.'), ('Context', 'Conversation WardenEsthers.Praise.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You are among friends here, pilgrim. Stay peaceful.
translation: 你在朋友之中，朝圣者。保持和平。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Then you're not of the faith =player.reflexive=, huh? Me neither. Do go inside, though. She's a beauty. Got dyed glass high in her rafters, she does. And two marvelous carvings on the wings. Plus a light-sculpture of a god. Hear the sermon, too, as you like. The high priest is persuasive, but not half as persuasive as the cathedral herself. In beauty there is power, you know.\n\nEither way, while you're in the cathedral or on the Stiltgrounds, stay peaceful."), ('Context', 'Conversation WardenEsthers.Huh.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Then you're not of the faith =player.reflexive=, huh? Me neither. Do go inside, though. She's a beauty. Got dyed glass high in her rafters, she does. And two marvelous carvings on the wings. Plus a light-sculpture of a god. Hear the sermon, too, as you like. The high priest is persuasive, but not half as persuasive as the cathedral herself. In beauty there is power, you know.

Either way, while you're in the cathedral or on the Stiltgrounds, stay peaceful.
translation:
那么你自己也不是信徒，是吧？我也不是。不过还是进去看看吧。她很美。她的高椽上有染色玻璃，两翼还有两座精妙雕刻。还有一座神祇的光雕。你愿意的话，也可以听听布道。大祭司很有说服力，但还不到大教堂本身的一半。美之中有力量，你知道的。

不管怎样，在大教堂里或高跷地上，都要保持和平。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Aye, aye. The clamor of it all can overwhelm.\n\nThe glowcrows say 'twas a bird-god who taught folks to gather like this, in large flocks. So blame birds."), ('Context', 'Conversation WardenEsthers.Folks.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Aye, aye. The clamor of it all can overwhelm.

The glowcrows say 'twas a bird-god who taught folks to gather like this, in large flocks. So blame birds.
translation:
是啊，是啊。这一切喧嚣能把人压垮。

辉鸦说，是一位鸟神教会了人们像这样大群聚集。所以怪鸟吧。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Who knows? I've wondered it myself. Sometimes she'll catch my eye, when the moon's silver-bright, and she's there bearing down on the flats.\n\nWhatever she is, she's gigantic. And old. Real old. Way older than the cathedral the Mechanimists built inside her."), ('Context', 'Conversation WardenEsthers.True.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Who knows? I've wondered it myself. Sometimes she'll catch my eye, when the moon's silver-bright, and she's there bearing down on the flats.

Whatever she is, she's gigantic. And old. Real old. Way older than the cathedral the Mechanimists built inside her.
translation:
谁知道呢？我自己也想过。有时月光银亮，她压在盐滩上，我就会忽然注意到她。

不管她是什么，她都巨大无比。而且古老。非常古老。比机械信徒建在她体内的大教堂古老得多。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Are you mad? You think I keep a tally of every shopkeeper that steps foot on the Stiltgrounds? They come and go as they please. You've got merchants of all types here. Winesellers, honey hawkers, bookbinders, cobblers.\n\nHave a look around for =player.reflexive=. Following the road around the Stilt. There's tents the whole way round."), ('Context', 'Conversation WardenEsthers.Bazaar.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Are you mad? You think I keep a tally of every shopkeeper that steps foot on the Stiltgrounds? They come and go as they please. You've got merchants of all types here. Winesellers, honey hawkers, bookbinders, cobblers.

Have a look around for =player.reflexive=. Following the road around the Stilt. There's tents the whole way round.
translation:
你疯了吗？你以为我会给每个踏上高跷地的店主记账？他们想来就来，想走就走。这里什么样的商人都有。卖酒的，叫卖蜂蜜的，装订书的，做鞋的。

自己四处看看吧。沿着路绕高跷走一圈。一路上都是帐篷。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Live and learn, wanderer. Have you come across any books or scrolls in your travels? Do you care to donate one to the cathedral library? Whenever you return, you may speak to me and read anything you've donated."), ('Context', 'Conversation MechanimistLibrarian.Start.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Live and learn, wanderer. Have you come across any books or scrolls in your travels? Do you care to donate one to the cathedral library? Whenever you return, you may speak to me and read anything you've donated.
translation: 流浪者，长生，求知。你在旅途中遇到过什么书或卷轴吗？愿意捐一本给大教堂图书馆吗？你以后回来时，可以找我阅读自己捐赠过的任何东西。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "What use is a library in this salt den? Or in the marshes, strangled by wild plants and poisoned by the glow? Wouldn't a stash of vinereapers serve us better?"), ('Context', 'Conversation MechanimistLibrarian.Start.WhatChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: What use is a library in this salt den? Or in the marshes, strangled by wild plants and poisoned by the glow? Wouldn't a stash of vinereapers serve us better?
translation: 图书馆在这盐窝里有什么用？或者在那些被野草扼住、被辉光毒害的沼泽里有什么用？一堆藤割镰不是更有用吗？

source: Not today. Live and drink, chronicler.
translation: 今天不了。生而饮水，编年者。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'You imagine they will thrive here at the Stiltgrounds, among the faithful?'), ('Context', 'Conversation MechanimistLibrarian.SlynthRequest.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You imagine they will thrive here at the Stiltgrounds, among the faithful?
translation: 你认为他们能在高跷地这里、在信众之间兴盛起来？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "This wouldn't be the first time the Stiltgrounds have hosted refugees, =name=, and make no mistake: it is a burden upon the church, Catechists and Protectors in particular. But your words echo loud in our hearts as our hallways. Some in our number will see the slynth as the chosen of chosen, and if I speak to them first, everyone else will take it as Shekhinah's will. Which, arguably, it would be. Tell the slynth that the Mechanimists will have them."), ('Context', 'Conversation MechanimistLibrarian.SlynthRequestAccept.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: This wouldn't be the first time the Stiltgrounds have hosted refugees, =name=, and make no mistake: it is a burden upon the church, Catechists and Protectors in particular. But your words echo loud in our hearts as our hallways. Some in our number will see the slynth as the chosen of chosen, and if I speak to them first, everyone else will take it as Shekhinah's will. Which, arguably, it would be. Tell the slynth that the Mechanimists will have them.
translation: 这不会是高跷地第一次接纳难民，=name=，而且别弄错：这对教会是个负担，尤其对教理师和护持者更是如此。但你的话在我们心中回响，正如在我们的廊道中回响一样响亮。我们之中有些人会把斯林斯视作被选者中的被选者；如果我先与他们谈，其他人都会把这视为谢金娜的旨意。可以说，那也确实会是。告诉斯林斯，机械信徒会接纳他们。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I mean no slight to these slynth folk, =name=, but the Stiltgrounds have hosted refugees before and it is a substantial burden upon our stewards. Our resources and space are scant, and I must request that you find another home for them. May the Kasaphescence shine upon them, and you, in this endeavor.'), ('Context', 'Conversation MechanimistLibrarian.SlynthRequestReject.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I mean no slight to these slynth folk, =name=, but the Stiltgrounds have hosted refugees before and it is a substantial burden upon our stewards. Our resources and space are scant, and I must request that you find another home for them. May the Kasaphescence shine upon them, and you, in this endeavor.
translation: 我无意轻慢这些斯林斯人，=name=，但高跷地过去接纳过难民，这对我们的司事是沉重负担。我们的资源和空间都很有限，我必须请求你为他们另寻家园。愿卡萨辉体在这份事业中照耀他们，也照耀你。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '=name=, bless you. Have you brought tidings of the slynth?'), ('Context', 'Conversation MechanimistLibrarian.SlynthAbout.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: =name=, bless you. Have you brought tidings of the slynth?
translation: =name=，愿你受福。你带来了斯林斯的消息吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Praise be to Shekhinah, =name=, your slynth friends are hard workers and quick learners!\n\nI can't help but feel a bit concerned at their ethic, and who in the church might take advantage of it. I hope to foster an interest in reading in them if I can, before they are taught incuriosity. Perhaps a book club?"), ('Context', 'Conversation MechanimistLibrarian.SlynthArrived.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Praise be to Shekhinah, =name=, your slynth friends are hard workers and quick learners!

I can't help but feel a bit concerned at their ethic, and who in the church might take advantage of it. I hope to foster an interest in reading in them if I can, before they are taught incuriosity. Perhaps a book club?
translation:
赞美谢金娜，=name=，你的斯林斯朋友们勤劳肯干，学得也快！

他们这种品性让我忍不住有些担心，担心教会里会有人利用这一点。我希望能在他们被教会冷漠之前，尽力培养他们对阅读的兴趣。也许办个读书会？

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'Live and learn, =name=.

The slynth are settling in as folk do. I see some flank the Priests and Catechists with empty eye, but some have proven hungry for knowledge. I have established a weekly Canticle study group, and its numbers grow each meeting.

Praise be to Shekhinah for this meeting, =name=.'), ('Context', 'Conversation MechanimistLibrarian.SlynthSettled.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Live and learn, =name=.

The slynth are settling in as folk do. I see some flank the Priests and Catechists with empty eye, but some have proven hungry for knowledge. I have established a weekly Canticle study group, and its numbers grow each meeting.

Praise be to Shekhinah for this meeting, =name=.
translation:
=name=，长生，求知。

斯林斯正在像普通人那样安顿下来。我看到有些人目光空洞地侍立在祭司和教理师两侧，但也有些人展现出了对知识的渴求。我开办了每周一次的圣歌研习小组，每次聚会人数都在增加。

为这次相遇赞美谢金娜，=name=。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Oh, we're in but the first phase of its foundation. The church has amassed a splendid collection of scripts through the years. Glorious Shekhinah, praise be upon Him, gifted us with several caches. The eremites work day and night reproducing them in the scriptorium, and I have taken it upon myself to beseech travelers, for the rarest finds often come from the least likely places."), ('Context', 'Conversation MechanimistLibrarian.Where.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Oh, we're in but the first phase of its foundation. The church has amassed a splendid collection of scripts through the years. Glorious Shekhinah, praise be upon Him, gifted us with several caches. The eremites work day and night reproducing them in the scriptorium, and I have taken it upon myself to beseech travelers, for the rarest finds often come from the least likely places.
translation: 哦，我们还只是在奠基的第一阶段。多年来，教会积攒了一批极好的经文。荣耀的谢金娜，愿赞美归于祂，赐给了我们数个藏匣。隐修士们日夜在抄经室里复制它们，而我则主动承担起恳请旅行者的职责，因为最稀有的发现往往来自最意想不到的地方。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "What use is a library in this salt den? Or in the marshes, strangled by wild plants and poisoned by the glow? Wouldn't a stash of vinereapers serve us better?"), ('Context', 'Conversation MechanimistLibrarian.Where.WhatChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: What use is a library in this salt den? Or in the marshes, strangled by wild plants and poisoned by the glow? Wouldn't a stash of vinereapers serve us better?
translation: 图书馆在这盐窝里有什么用？或者在那些被野草扼住、被辉光毒害的沼泽里有什么用？一堆藤割镰不是更有用吗？

path:
((('string', (('ID', "You share the pessimism of my kin, and several of the priests as well. My heart hears you, but listen to my words, and maybe you will come to feel as I do.

To devalue wisdom is to devalue the Kasaphescence. She shines in the void, refracting light, illuminating those around her. So does the written wisdom of our elders.

The machinery of chromium is complex in its divinity. Don't we do a disservice to our Fathers when we remain ignorant of it, of our past, of our future? Don't we deserve the joy of knowing? Bless Eschelstadt II, first Child, for he believes as I do."), ('Context', 'Conversation MechanimistLibrarian.What.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
You share the pessimism of my kin, and several of the priests as well. My heart hears you, but listen to my words, and maybe you will come to feel as I do.

To devalue wisdom is to devalue the Kasaphescence. She shines in the void, refracting light, illuminating those around her. So does the written wisdom of our elders.

The machinery of chromium is complex in its divinity. Don't we do a disservice to our Fathers when we remain ignorant of it, of our past, of our future? Don't we deserve the joy of knowing? Bless Eschelstadt II, first Child, for he believes as I do.
translation:
你和我的族人，还有几位祭司一样悲观。我的心听见了你的话，但也请听听我的话，也许你会开始感受到我所感受的。

贬低智慧，就是贬低卡萨辉体。她在虚空中闪耀，折射光芒，照亮周遭之物。我们长者书写下来的智慧亦是如此。

铬钢机械的神性复杂而深奥。若我们对它、对我们的过去、对我们的未来一无所知，岂不是辜负了诸父？难道我们不配享有知晓的喜悦？愿首位子嗣埃舍尔施塔特二世受福，因为他与我所信相同。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Peace and health in the light of the Star, pilgrim. Brood with me on the life of Resheph, if you are willing.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Tszappur.Start.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Peace and health in the light of the Star, pilgrim. Brood with me on the life of Resheph, if you are willing.
translation: 愿你在星辰之光中得享和平与健康，朝圣者。若你愿意，就与我一同沉思瑞舍夫的一生。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'A spiritual patron of kith and kin, who did so much for us, and who leads me and others like me to the path of healing. For, above all, he was a healer. He dressed the wounds of the sick and rid the land of the plagues of the Gyre.\n\nHe was also a sultan, but he was the last sultan. He unbricked the walls of monocracy so we could pick berries in the orchards they hid.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Tszappur.Resheph.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
A spiritual patron of kith and kin, who did so much for us, and who leads me and others like me to the path of healing. For, above all, he was a healer. He dressed the wounds of the sick and rid the land of the plagues of the Gyre.

He was also a sultan, but he was the last sultan. He unbricked the walls of monocracy so we could pick berries in the orchards they hid.
translation:
他是亲友族类的精神庇护者，为我们做了许多，也引领我和我这样的人走上疗愈之路。因为归根结底，他是一位医者。他包扎病患的伤口，把轮回之灾的瘟疫从大地上清除。

他也曾是苏丹，但他是最后一位苏丹。他拆开了独治王权的砖墙，让我们得以在墙后隐藏的果园里采摘浆果。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "A quiet shrine to the Coiled Lamb, centuries old. Tucked away here, outside the marble parapets and cloaked in the dust of time, it's lost to those who'd sneer at the veneration of Resheph over other fathers.\n\nStep inside and voice a prayer, if you are willing."), ('Context', 'Conversation Tszappur.Inside.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
A quiet shrine to the Coiled Lamb, centuries old. Tucked away here, outside the marble parapets and cloaked in the dust of time, it's lost to those who'd sneer at the veneration of Resheph over other fathers.

Step inside and voice a prayer, if you are willing.
translation:
一座献给盘绕羔羊的静谧圣龛，已有数百年历史。它藏在这里，位于大理石胸墙之外，披覆着时间的尘埃，对那些会嘲笑人们敬奉瑞舍夫甚于其他诸父的人来说，它已经失落无踪。

若你愿意，就走进去，念出一声祈祷吧。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Don't breathe in too deep, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I've set some glue to dry."), ('Context', 'Conversation bookbinder.Start.Text.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Don't breathe in too deep, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I've set some glue to dry.
translation: 别吸得太深，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我放了些胶水等它干。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Live and drink, but please do it elsewhere. I fear spills.'), ('Context', 'Conversation bookbinder.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: Live and drink, but please do it elsewhere. I fear spills.
translation: 生而饮水，但请到别处去饮。我怕泼洒。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Feel free to examine my books closely.'), ('Context', 'Conversation bookbinder.Start.Text.Text3')), 1),), '#text')
source: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Feel free to examine my books closely.
translation: 你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=。尽管仔细查看我的书。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Please inspect only the quality of the letters. I am not a librarian.'), ('Context', 'Conversation bookbinder.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: Please inspect only the quality of the letters. I am not a librarian.
translation: 请只检视字母的质量。我不是图书管理员。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'These books can weather the salt and jungle alike.'), ('Context', 'Conversation bookbinder.Start.Text.Text5')), 1),), '#text')
source: These books can weather the salt and jungle alike.
translation: 这些书经得起盐地，也经得起丛林。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I assure you, the smell fades once the glue is dry.'), ('Context', 'Conversation bookbinder.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: I assure you, the smell fades once the glue is dry.
translation: 我向你保证，胶水干了之后味道就会散。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I've books for trade, if you're interested."), ('Context', 'Conversation bookbinder.Start.Text.Text7')), 1),), '#text')
source: I've books for trade, if you're interested.
translation: 我有书可供交易，如果你有兴趣的话。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Everything I sell is the product of many hours of toil.'), ('Context', 'Conversation scribe.Start.Text.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Everything I sell is the product of many hours of toil.
translation: 我卖的每一样东西，都是许多小时辛劳的成果。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Come closer, so I can see your face.'), ('Context', 'Conversation scribe.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: Come closer, so I can see your face.
translation: 靠近些，让我看看你的脸。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Ink runs in my very veins, =player.formalAddressTerm=.'), ('Context', 'Conversation scribe.Start.Text.Text3')), 1),), '#text')
source: Ink runs in my very veins, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
translation: 墨水就在我的血管里流淌，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "If you're looking to read, I have what you need."), ('Context', 'Conversation scribe.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: If you're looking to read, I have what you need.
translation: 如果你想读点什么，我有你需要的。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Please be gentle with the parchment.'), ('Context', 'Conversation scribe.Start.Text.Text5')), 1),), '#text')
source: Please be gentle with the parchment.

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Do be quick, =player.formalAddressTerm=, as I've much work to do."), ('Context', 'Conversation scribe.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: Do be quick, =player.formalAddressTerm=, as I've much work to do.
translation: 请快些，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我还有许多工作要做。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Come here. No, closer. Don't mind the bees, they rarely sting."), ('Context', 'Conversation beekeeper.Start.Text.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Come here. No, closer. Don't mind the bees, they rarely sting.
translation: 过来。不，再近点。别在意蜜蜂，它们很少蜇人。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Don't be afraid to approach. The bees rarely sting."), ('Context', 'Conversation beekeeper.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: Don't be afraid to approach. The bees rarely sting.
translation: 别怕靠近。蜜蜂很少蜇人。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Drink a dram of honey every morning, Slog itself couldn't make you sick."), ('Context', 'Conversation beekeeper.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: Drink a dram of honey every morning, Slog itself couldn't make you sick.
translation: 每天早晨喝一打兰蜂蜜，就算斯洛格亲自来也别想让你生病。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'You know, bees communicate by dancing. Got a whole language.'), ('Context', 'Conversation beekeeper.Start.Text.Text5')), 1),), '#text')
source: You know, bees communicate by dancing. Got a whole language.
translation: 你知道吗，蜜蜂靠跳舞交流。那是一整套语言。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Without bees, all life in Qud would eventually die.'), ('Context', 'Conversation beekeeper.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: Without bees, all life in Qud would eventually die.
translation: 没有蜜蜂，库德的一切生命终将死去。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Bees are smarter than you think. They got that hive mind, see.'), ('Context', 'Conversation beekeeper.Start.Text.Text7')), 1),), '#text')
source: Bees are smarter than you think. They got that hive mind, see.
translation: 蜜蜂比你想的聪明。它们有蜂巢心智，懂吧。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I eat honey matz every morning and I ain't been sick in decades."), ('Context', 'Conversation beekeeper.Start.Text.Text8')), 1),), '#text')
source: I eat honey matz every morning and I ain't been sick in decades.
translation: 我每天早晨都吃蜂蜜薄饼，几十年没病过。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "We'd all be dead without bees, you know."), ('Context', 'Conversation beekeeper.Start.Text.Text9')), 1),), '#text')
source: We'd all be dead without bees, you know.
translation: 没有蜜蜂，我们全都得死，你知道吧。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Use your gadgets hard, don't you? I can fix them."), ('Context', 'Conversation tinker.Start.Text.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Use your gadgets hard, don't you? I can fix them.
translation: 你用小玩意用得挺狠，是吧？我能修。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I can repair, recharge, and identify whatever you have! Within reason.'), ('Context', 'Conversation tinker.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: I can repair, recharge, and identify whatever you have! Within reason.
translation: 你有什么东西，我都能修、充能、鉴定！在合理范围内。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "If you've got anything you can't make heads or tails of it, give it here."), ('Context', 'Conversation tinker.Start.Text.Text3')), 1),), '#text')
source: If you've got anything you can't make heads or tails of it, give it here.
translation: 如果你有东西怎么看都看不明白，拿来给我。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "You've got to respect a machine. Machines bite harder than any croc."), ('Context', 'Conversation tinker.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: You've got to respect a machine. Machines bite harder than any croc.
translation: 你得尊重机器。机器咬人比任何鳄鱼都狠。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Take out what you've busted and I'll jury-rig it for a fair price."), ('Context', 'Conversation tinker.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: Take out what you've busted and I'll jury-rig it for a fair price.
translation: 把你弄坏的东西拿出来，我收个公道价给你临时修好。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'You get used to the nicks and burns, after years working with spark and solder.'), ('Context', 'Conversation tinker.Start.Text.Text8')), 1),), '#text')
source: You get used to the nicks and burns, after years working with spark and solder.
translation: 和火花、焊料打了多年交道，划伤和烫伤也就习惯了。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'They say some folks can talk to machines. I say we all can, if we listen right.'), ('Context', 'Conversation tinker.Start.Text.Text9')), 1),), '#text')
source: They say some folks can talk to machines. I say we all can, if we listen right.
translation: 他们说有些人能和机器说话。依我看，只要听得对，我们都能。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'My fees for battery charging depend how empty the battery is when you bring it to me.'), ('Context', 'Conversation tinker.Start.Text.Text10')), 1),), '#text')
source: My fees for battery charging depend how empty the battery is when you bring it to me.
translation: 我给电池充能的收费，取决于你拿来时电池有多空。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Absolutely no refunds or returns on scrap.'), ('Context', 'Conversation tinker.Start.Text.Text11')), 1),), '#text')
source: Absolutely no refunds or returns on scrap.
translation: 废料一经售出，概不退款，概不退货。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I would prefer not to interrupt this task long.'), ('Context', 'Conversation schematics drafter.Start.Text.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I would prefer not to interrupt this task long.
translation: 我不想让这项工作被打断太久。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'How my joints ache! Buy something to justify my pain.'), ('Context', 'Conversation schematics drafter.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: How my joints ache! Buy something to justify my pain.
translation: 我的关节疼得厉害！买点东西，让我的痛苦有点意义。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Unfinished schematics are obviously not for sale. Everything else is.'), ('Context', 'Conversation schematics drafter.Start.Text.Text3')), 1),), '#text')
source: Unfinished schematics are obviously not for sale. Everything else is.
translation: 没完成的设计图显然不卖。其他都卖。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Disturb the trash if you must, but do not touch any of my papers.'), ('Context', 'Conversation schematics drafter.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: Disturb the trash if you must, but do not touch any of my papers.
translation: 你非要翻垃圾就翻吧，但别碰我的任何纸张。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Are you a tinker? Surely I have something you wish to build.'), ('Context', 'Conversation schematics drafter.Start.Text.Text5')), 1),), '#text')
