source: Are you a tinker? Surely I have something you wish to build.
translation: 你是修补匠吗？我这里肯定有你想造的东西。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "If you've the wits to build, I've got something you want."), ('Context', 'Conversation schematics drafter.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: If you've the wits to build, I've got something you want.
translation: 如果你有本事制造，我就有你想要的东西。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I have lost much to my dedication. Help me gain anew, =player.formalAddressTerm=.'), ('Context', 'Conversation schematics drafter.Start.Text.Text7')), 1),), '#text')
source: I have lost much to my dedication. Help me gain anew, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
translation: 我为自己的奉献失去了许多。帮我重新得到些东西吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'So help me, Argent Fathers, if someone has changed the order of my papers...'), ('Context', 'Conversation schematics drafter.Start.Text.Text8')), 1),), '#text')
source: So help me, Argent Fathers, if someone has changed the order of my papers...
translation: 白银诸父在上，要是有人改了我纸张的顺序……

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Please, =player.formalAddressTerm=, buy a schematic. I'm sure it will be of use to you."), ('Context', 'Conversation schematics drafter.Start.Text.Text9')), 1),), '#text')
source: Please, =player.formalAddressTerm=, buy a schematic. I'm sure it will be of use to you.
translation: 拜托，=player.formalAddressTerm=，买张设计图吧。我相信它会对你有用。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Even if you can't make a thing now, you could gain the insight later."), ('Context', 'Conversation schematics drafter.Start.Text.Text10')), 1),), '#text')
source: Even if you can't make a thing now, you could gain the insight later.
translation: 即使你现在造不出来，日后也可能得到灵感。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I've the cure for what ails you."), ('Context', 'Conversation apothecary.Start.Text.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I've the cure for what ails you.

path: ((('string', (('ID', "You don't look so good. You need more yuckwheat and honey in your diet."), ('Context', 'Conversation apothecary.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: You don't look so good. You need more yuckwheat and honey in your diet.
translation: 你看起来不太好。你的饮食里需要更多恶心麦和蜂蜜。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'In the market for a tonic, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Spend water now or blood later, your choice.'), ('Context', 'Conversation apothecary.Start.Text.Text3')), 1),), '#text')
source: In the market for a tonic, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Spend water now or blood later, your choice.
translation: 想买补剂吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？现在花水，还是以后流血，你自己选。
刺恩果和恶心麦可交易。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Cook your meals with yuckwheat if you feel sick. Catch a disease early enough and you can kill it.'), ('Context', 'Conversation apothecary.Start.Text.Text5')), 1),), '#text')
source: Cook your meals with yuckwheat if you feel sick. Catch a disease early enough and you can kill it.
translation: 如果觉得不舒服，就用恶心麦做饭。疾病发现得够早，就能把它扼杀。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'If you came for the humble pie, you had best not have led any mind-hunters here.'), ('Context', 'Conversation apothecary.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: If you came for the humble pie, you had best not have led any mind-hunters here.
translation: 如果你是为了谦卑派来的，最好没把任何猎心者引到这里。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '"Ease the pain, addle the brain." Be careful when you chew witchwood bark.'), ('Context', 'Conversation apothecary.Start.Text.Text7')), 1),), '#text')
source: "Ease the pain, addle the brain." Be careful when you chew witchwood bark.
translation: “缓痛，乱脑。”咀嚼巫木树皮时小心些。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Don't eat the hoarshrooms too fast, now."), ('Context', 'Conversation apothecary.Start.Text.Text8')), 1),), '#text')
source: Don't eat the hoarshrooms too fast, now.
translation: 别把白霜菇吃得太快，听见没。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Got a fungal infection? You'll want one of my spray bottles to apply the cure."), ('Context', 'Conversation apothecary.Start.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Got a fungal infection? You'll want one of my spray bottles to apply the cure.
translation: 得了真菌感染？你会需要一个我的喷雾瓶来涂抹治疗药剂。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Get your hands on the Corpus Choliys for disease and fungus cures.'), ('Context', 'Conversation apothecary.Start.Text.2')), 1),), '#text')
source: Get your hands on the Corpus Choliys for disease and fungus cures.
translation: 去弄到 科普斯·乔利斯(病典 乔利斯)，用来治疗疾病和真菌。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I've the cure for what ails you."), ('Context', 'Conversation herbalist.Start.Text.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I've the cure for what ails you.

path: ((('string', (('ID', "You don't look so good. You need more yuckwheat and honey in your diet."), ('Context', 'Conversation herbalist.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: You don't look so good. You need more yuckwheat and honey in your diet.
translation: 你看起来不太好。你的饮食里需要更多恶心麦和蜂蜜。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Cook your meals with yuckwheat if you feel sick. Catch a disease early enough and you can kill it.'), ('Context', 'Conversation herbalist.Start.Text.Text3')), 1),), '#text')
source: Cook your meals with yuckwheat if you feel sick. Catch a disease early enough and you can kill it.
translation: 如果觉得不舒服，就用恶心麦做饭。疾病发现得够早，就能把它扼杀。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '"Ease the pain, addle the brain." Be careful when you chew witchwood bark.'), ('Context', 'Conversation herbalist.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: "Ease the pain, addle the brain." Be careful when you chew witchwood bark.
translation: “缓痛，乱脑。”咀嚼巫木树皮时小心些。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Best not leave town without some bark and bandages, wayfarer.'), ('Context', 'Conversation herbalist.Start.Text.Text5')), 1),), '#text')
source: Best not leave town without some bark and bandages, wayfarer.
translation: 最好别不带树皮和绷带就离镇，旅人。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Live and drink. Keeping well, I hope?'), ('Context', 'Conversation herbalist.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: Live and drink. Keeping well, I hope?
translation: 生而饮水。希望你身体还好？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I tell you, =player.formalAddressTerm=, my recipes come from years of experience. There's none the like."), ('Context', 'Conversation chef.Start.Text.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I tell you, =player.formalAddressTerm=, my recipes come from years of experience. There's none the like.
translation: 我告诉你，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我的食谱来自多年经验。别处没有这样的。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Finest food for parasangs! Finest food in Qud! Recipes and samples!'), ('Context', 'Conversation chef.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: Finest food for parasangs! Finest food in Qud! Recipes and samples!
translation: 数帕拉桑之内最好的食物！库德最好的食物！食谱和样品！

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I will share my food-secrets with you, =player.formalAddressTerm=, if you're willing to make it worth my while."), ('Context', 'Conversation chef.Start.Text.Text3')), 1),), '#text')
source: I will share my food-secrets with you, =player.formalAddressTerm=, if you're willing to make it worth my while.
translation: 我愿意与你分享我的食物秘方，=player.formalAddressTerm=，只要你愿意让我觉得值得。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Do you cook, =player.formalAddressTerm=? So long as you aren't the type to throw whatever local debris you find in the pot, I have wares for you."), ('Context', 'Conversation chef.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: Do you cook, =player.formalAddressTerm=? So long as you aren't the type to throw whatever local debris you find in the pot, I have wares for you.
translation: 你做饭吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？只要你不是那种把本地捡到的什么破烂都往锅里扔的人，我这里就有适合你的货。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Not a word of lie, I studied under a chef who studied under Agate Severance Star herself. That's why my recipes are the best."), ('Context', 'Conversation chef.Start.Text.Text5')), 1),), '#text')
source: Not a word of lie, I studied under a chef who studied under Agate Severance Star herself. That's why my recipes are the best.
translation: 一句假话没有，我师从一位曾向玛瑙·断离星本人学艺的厨师。这就是为什么我的食谱最好。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Try my recipe. You'll believe =player.reflexive= to be judging the Carbide Chefs in the Kitchen Heptagon itself."), ('Context', 'Conversation chef.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: Try my recipe. You'll believe =player.reflexive= to be judging the Carbide Chefs in the Kitchen Heptagon itself.
translation: 试试我的食谱。你会觉得自己正在厨房七角厅里评判碳化物厨师。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Cookbooks are best named from the heart. Those who ridicule the name of a cookbook have lost their sense of wonder.'), ('Context', 'Conversation chef.Start.Text.Text7')), 1),), '#text')
source: Cookbooks are best named from the heart. Those who ridicule the name of a cookbook have lost their sense of wonder.
translation: 食谱书最好凭真心命名。嘲笑食谱书名字的人，已经失去了惊奇之心。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Smell a bit strong? That's how you know it's good."), ('Context', 'Conversation kipper.Start.Text.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Smell a bit strong? That's how you know it's good.
translation: 气味有点重？这正说明它好。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'You can preserve almost anything. Al... most.'), ('Context', 'Conversation kipper.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: You can preserve almost anything. Al... most.
translation: 几乎什么东西都能腌存。几……乎。
腌存过的食材烹调起来更好，也更安全。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Everything I sell is safe to eat as it is.'), ('Context', 'Conversation kipper.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: Everything I sell is safe to eat as it is.
translation: 我卖的每样东西都可以直接安全食用。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Crave a bit of salt, =player.formalAddressTerm=, or a load of salt?'), ('Context', 'Conversation kipper.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: Crave a bit of salt, =player.formalAddressTerm=, or a load of salt?
translation: 想来点盐吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=，还是想来一大堆盐？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Nothing sadder than a cookfire and nothing to cook over it.'), ('Context', 'Conversation kipper.Start.Text.Text7')), 1),), '#text')
source: Nothing sadder than a cookfire and nothing to cook over it.
translation: 没有什么比有炊火却没东西可烹更悲伤了。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Are you a chef, =player.formalAddressTerm=? My vittles are of the highest quality.'), ('Context', 'Conversation kipper.Start.Text.Text8')), 1),), '#text')
source: Are you a chef, =player.formalAddressTerm=? My vittles are of the highest quality.
translation: 你是厨师吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？我的口粮品质最高。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'My wares are sweet and strong, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Care to try them?'), ('Context', 'Conversation vintner.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: My wares are sweet and strong, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Care to try them?
translation: 我的货又甜又烈，=player.formalAddressTerm=。想尝尝吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Tell me, =player.formalAddressTerm=, is there any sight more sad than a hookah tent without wine?'), ('Context', 'Conversation vintner.Start.Text.Text5')), 1),), '#text')
source: Tell me, =player.formalAddressTerm=, is there any sight more sad than a hookah tent without wine?
translation: 告诉我，=player.formalAddressTerm=，还有什么景象比没有酒的水烟帐篷更悲伤？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Wine, cheese, bread. =player.FormalAddressTerm=, tell me, is there anything else you truly need?'), ('Context', 'Conversation vintner.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: Wine, cheese, bread. =player.FormalAddressTerm=, tell me, is there anything else you truly need?
translation: 酒、奶酪、面包。=player.FormalAddressTerm=，告诉我，你真正需要的还有别的吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'The kipper and I both know that the finest ingredient is time.'), ('Context', 'Conversation vintner.Start.Text.Text7')), 1),), '#text')
source: The kipper and I both know that the finest ingredient is time.
translation: 腌货商和我都知道，最好的配料是时间。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Try some rose wine? One rose is fair, but as you may know from hanging around the Stiltgrounds, five is death.'), ('Context', 'Conversation vintner.Start.Text.Text8')), 1),), '#text')
source: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Try some rose wine? One rose is fair, but as you may know from hanging around the Stiltgrounds, five is death.
translation: 你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=。要尝点玫瑰酒吗？一朵玫瑰尚好，但你在高跷地待久了也许知道，五朵便是死亡。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Aren't they beautiful, =player.formalAddressTerm=? The bottles, the phials, the light shining through them."), ('Context', 'Conversation ichormerchant.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: Aren't they beautiful, =player.formalAddressTerm=? The bottles, the phials, the light shining through them.
translation: 它们美得很，不是吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？瓶子，小瓶，穿透它们的光。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Live and drink, but not everything. Some things you don't drink."), ('Context', 'Conversation ichormerchant.Start.Text.Text3')), 1),), '#text')
source: Live and drink, but not everything. Some things you don't drink.
translation: 生而饮水，但不是什么都能喝。有些东西不能喝。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Is there any state of form so fine as a liquid?'), ('Context', 'Conversation ichormerchant.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: Is there any state of form so fine as a liquid?
translation: 还有哪一种形态能像液体这样精妙？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Pouring, decanting, collecting, mixing. I adore my calling.'), ('Context', 'Conversation ichormerchant.Start.Text.Text5')), 1),), '#text')
source: Pouring, decanting, collecting, mixing. I adore my calling.
translation: 倾倒、滗析、收集、混合。我热爱我的天职。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'If it flows, I desire it. You should too, =player.formalAddressTerm=.'), ('Context', 'Conversation ichormerchant.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: If it flows, I desire it. You should too, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
translation: 只要它会流动，我就渴望它。你也该如此，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Do you ever stop and think about fluids? Are they not divine?'), ('Context', 'Conversation ichormerchant.Start.Text.Text7')), 1),), '#text')
source: Do you ever stop and think about fluids? Are they not divine?
translation: 你有没有停下来想过流体？它们难道不神圣吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Someday I will plumb the depths of Bethesda Susa, that I may meet the Alchemist.'), ('Context', 'Conversation ichormerchant.Start.Text.Text8')), 1),), '#text')
source: Someday I will plumb the depths of Bethesda Susa, that I may meet the Alchemist.
translation: 总有一天，我会探入贝塞斯达苏萨的深处，去见那位炼金术士。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Live and drink, and collect, and combine...'), ('Context', 'Conversation ichormerchant.Start.Text.Text9')), 1),), '#text')
source: Live and drink, and collect, and combine...

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Hold, aristocrat! I have wares to claim your interest.'), ('Context', 'Conversation gutsmonger.Start.Text.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Hold, aristocrat! I have wares to claim your interest.
translation: 慢着，贵胄！我有些货能引起你的兴趣。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'My implants are acquired peaceably, I assure you.'), ('Context', 'Conversation gutsmonger.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: My implants are acquired peaceably, I assure you.
translation: 我向你保证，我的植入体都是和平取得的。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'How becoming you look, Aristocrat! But you could be more becoming.'), ('Context', 'Conversation gutsmonger.Start.Text.Text3')), 1),), '#text')
source: How becoming you look, Aristocrat! But you could be more becoming.
translation: 你看起来多么成形啊，贵胄！但你还可以更加成形。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Tire of your legs? Arms? Hands? See what I have that fits you.'), ('Context', 'Conversation gutsmonger.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: Tire of your legs? Arms? Hands? See what I have that fits you.
translation: 厌倦你的腿了？手臂？双手？看看我这里有什么适合你。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Luxury internal adornments for the discerning Aristocrat.'), ('Context', 'Conversation gutsmonger.Start.Text.Text5')), 1),), '#text')
source: Luxury internal adornments for the discerning Aristocrat.
translation: 为有眼光的贵胄准备的奢华内在饰物。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'No additional sterilisation required, of course.'), ('Context', 'Conversation gutsmonger.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: No additional sterilisation required, of course.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Quality implants for sale at reasonable prices!'), ('Context', 'Conversation gutsmonger.Start.Text.Text7')), 1),), '#text')
source: Quality implants for sale at reasonable prices!

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'You strike me as an Aristocrat who knows the value of artisanal organs.'), ('Context', 'Conversation gutsmonger.Start.Text.Text8')), 1),), '#text')
source: You strike me as an Aristocrat who knows the value of artisanal organs.
translation: 你看起来像是懂得手工器官价值的贵胄。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I recommend everything I carry. Not all at once, of course.'), ('Context', 'Conversation gutsmonger.Start.Text.Text9')), 1),), '#text')
source: I recommend everything I carry. Not all at once, of course.
translation: 我推荐我带的每一样东西。当然，不是一次全装。
希望你还会“成形”回来，哈哈。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'You look dangerous. Ever go hunting for parts?'), ('Context', 'Conversation gutsmonger.Start2.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: You look dangerous. Ever go hunting for parts?
translation: 你看起来挺危险。去猎过零件吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Can you imagine sticking one of these things inside you? Disgusting.'), ('Context', 'Conversation gutsmonger.Start2.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: Can you imagine sticking one of these things inside you? Disgusting.
translation: 你能想象把这些东西塞进自己体内吗？恶心。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I've plenty water if you've got implants to sell."), ('Context', 'Conversation gutsmonger.Start2.Text.Text5')), 1),), '#text')
source: I've plenty water if you've got implants to sell.
translation: 如果你有植入体要卖，我有的是水。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Always check becoming nook shelves for parts.'), ('Context', 'Conversation gutsmonger.Start2.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: Always check becoming nook shelves for parts.
translation: 找零件时一定要看看成形龛的架子。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Y'ain't peeled open any Sons or Daughters, have you?"), ('Context', 'Conversation gutsmonger.Start2.Text.Text7')), 1),), '#text')
source: Y'ain't peeled open any Sons or Daughters, have you?
translation: 你没剥开过什么儿子或女儿吧？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Less I know about where my stock comes from, the better.'), ('Context', 'Conversation gutsmonger.Start2.Text.Text8')), 1),), '#text')
source: Less I know about where my stock comes from, the better.
translation: 我越少知道存货从哪来，就越好。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I'll still take parts you ain't washed off, it's fine."), ('Context', 'Conversation gutsmonger.Start2.Text.Text9')), 1),), '#text')
source: I'll still take parts you ain't washed off, it's fine.
translation: 没洗过的零件我也收，没事。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "If you can butcher a boar, you can do the same to a man. Just ain't meat you're looking for."), ('Context', 'Conversation gutsmonger.Start2.Text.Text10')), 1),), '#text')
source: If you can butcher a boar, you can do the same to a man. Just ain't meat you're looking for.
translation: 你能宰一头野猪，就能对人做同样的事。只是你找的不是肉。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "My best customers don't ask questions. My best stock asked too many."), ('Context', 'Conversation gutsmonger.Start2.Text.Text11')), 1),), '#text')
source: My best customers don't ask questions. My best stock asked too many.
translation: 我最好的顾客不问问题。我最好的存货问了太多问题。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Need something to complete your ensemble, =player.formalAddressTerm=?'), ('Context', 'Conversation hatter.Start.Text.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Need something to complete your ensemble, =player.formalAddressTerm=?
translation: 需要点什么来补完整身行头吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "With a good hat, =player.formalAddressTerm=, you'll last longer in the salt sun."), ('Context', 'Conversation hatter.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: With a good hat, =player.formalAddressTerm=, you'll last longer in the salt sun.
translation: 有顶好帽子，=player.formalAddressTerm=，你就能在盐阳下撑得更久。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Peruse my wares, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Adorn your head or heads.'), ('Context', 'Conversation hatter.Start.Text.Text3')), 1),), '#text')
source: Peruse my wares, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Adorn your head or heads.
translation: 细看我的货吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。装点你的头，或者你的那些头。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Care for a new topper?'), ('Context', 'Conversation hatter.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Care for a new topper?

path: ((('string', (('ID', "You need a new hat, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Or a helmet, if that's the life you lead."), ('Context', 'Conversation hatter.Start.Text.Text5')), 1),), '#text')
source: You need a new hat, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Or a helmet, if that's the life you lead.
translation: 你需要一顶新帽子，=player.formalAddressTerm=。或者一顶头盔，如果你过的是那种日子。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "If you're passing through baboon country, you'll want to protect your head, =player.formalAddressTerm=."), ('Context', 'Conversation hatter.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: If you're passing through baboon country, you'll want to protect your head, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
translation: 如果你要穿过狒狒地盘，就会想保护好自己的头，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Hello, hello, =player.formalAddressTerm=, let's get your weary feet covered."), ('Context', 'Conversation shoemaker.Start.Text.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Hello, hello, =player.formalAddressTerm=, let's get your weary feet covered.
translation: 你好，你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=，来给你疲惫的双脚找点遮护吧。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Come in, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and let me 'shoe' you around, ha ha!"), ('Context', 'Conversation shoemaker.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: Come in, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and let me 'shoe' you around, ha ha!
translation: 进来吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=，让我给你“鞋”着逛逛，哈哈！

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Boots! Shoes! Slippers! Sabatons! How would you prefer to cover your feet, =player.formalAddressTerm=?'), ('Context', 'Conversation shoemaker.Start.Text.Text3')), 1),), '#text')
source: Boots! Shoes! Slippers! Sabatons! How would you prefer to cover your feet, =player.formalAddressTerm=?
translation: 靴子！鞋！拖鞋！铁靴！你想怎样覆盖双脚，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Even as high-quality as my products are, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I don't suggest you go walking in the fracti to test them out."), ('Context', 'Conversation shoemaker.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: Even as high-quality as my products are, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I don't suggest you go walking in the fracti to test them out.
translation: 我的产品再怎么高品质，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我也不建议你去分形林里走路测试它们。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Anything you need to ask 'a boot', =player.FormalAddressTerm=? Just a little cobbler's joke, there."), ('Context', 'Conversation shoemaker.Start.Text.Text5')), 1),), '#text')
source: Anything you need to ask 'a boot', =player.FormalAddressTerm=? Just a little cobbler's joke, there.
translation: 有什么关于“靴”要问的吗，=player.FormalAddressTerm=？只是个鞋匠小笑话。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Hot sands out there, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Is your footwear protecting you?'), ('Context', 'Conversation shoemaker.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: Hot sands out there, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Is your footwear protecting you?
translation: 外头沙子很烫，=player.formalAddressTerm=。你的鞋履能保护你吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Walk a few parasangs in my shoes, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and you'll wonder how you ever did otherwise."), ('Context', 'Conversation shoemaker.Start.Text.Text8')), 1),), '#text')
source: Walk a few parasangs in my shoes, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and you'll wonder how you ever did otherwise.
translation: 穿着我的鞋走上几帕拉桑，=player.formalAddressTerm=，你会奇怪自己以前怎么能不这样走。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Please, =player.formalAddressTerm=, do come in. Take your time browsing my wares.'), ('Context', 'Conversation haberdasher.Start.Text.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Please, =player.formalAddressTerm=, do come in. Take your time browsing my wares.
translation: 请吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=，一定要进来。慢慢看我的货。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Welcome, =player.formalAddressTerm=, to the sole bastion of class in this wretched place.'), ('Context', 'Conversation haberdasher.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: Welcome, =player.formalAddressTerm=, to the sole bastion of class in this wretched place.
translation: 欢迎你，=player.formalAddressTerm=，来到这可怜地方唯一的品味堡垒。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Please knock the sand from your feet, =player.formalAddressTerm=. It gets everywhere.'), ('Context', 'Conversation haberdasher.Start.Text.Text3')), 1),), '#text')
source: Please knock the sand from your feet, =player.formalAddressTerm=. It gets everywhere.
translation: 请把脚上的沙子磕掉，=player.formalAddressTerm=。它会钻得到处都是。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Ah, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I can certainly help you.'), ('Context', 'Conversation haberdasher.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: Ah, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I can certainly help you.

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Now, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I know you must have an eye for fashion, if you're here."), ('Context', 'Conversation haberdasher.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: Now, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I know you must have an eye for fashion, if you're here.
translation: 好了，=player.formalAddressTerm=，既然你来了，我知道你一定有时尚眼光。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Oh dear. Who dressed you, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Let me help you, please.'), ('Context', 'Conversation haberdasher.Start.Text.Text7')), 1),), '#text')
source: Oh dear. Who dressed you, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Let me help you, please.
translation: 噢天哪。是谁给你穿成这样的，=player.formalAddressTerm=？请让我帮帮你。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I've got my eye on you."), ('Context', 'Conversation armorer.Start.Text.Text7')), 1),), '#text')
source: I've got my eye on you.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Leather, ring, and plate, to keep you alive.'), ('Context', 'Conversation armorer.Start.Text.Text8')), 1),), '#text')
source: Leather, ring, and plate, to keep you alive.
translation: 皮甲、环甲和板甲，保你活命。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Hand-coats for sale! Spare your digits the indignity of early removal!'), ('Context', 'Conversation glover.Start.Text.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Hand-coats for sale! Spare your digits the indignity of early removal!
translation: 出售手衣！让你的指头免遭过早移除的屈辱！

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Best protect your hands, =player.formalAddressTerm=. You don't know how much you need them until a madpole takes one."), ('Context', 'Conversation glover.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: Best protect your hands, =player.formalAddressTerm=. You don't know how much you need them until a madpole takes one.
translation: 最好保护好你的手，=player.formalAddressTerm=。直到疯蝌蚪咬走一只，你才知道自己多需要它们。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Light gloves, heavy gloves, gauntlets. Don't let your hands go bare, =player.formalAddressTerm=."), ('Context', 'Conversation glover.Start.Text.Text3')), 1),), '#text')
source: Light gloves, heavy gloves, gauntlets. Don't let your hands go bare, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
translation: 轻手套、重手套、护手甲。别让你的手裸着，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'One size fits all, =player.formalAddressTerm=. If I sell it to you, it fits.'), ('Context', 'Conversation glover.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: One size fits all, =player.formalAddressTerm=. If I sell it to you, it fits.
translation: 均码通用，=player.formalAddressTerm=。只要我卖给你，它就合适。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "How do I get my gloves so supple? I'll never tell."), ('Context', 'Conversation glover.Start.Text.Text5')), 1),), '#text')
source: How do I get my gloves so supple? I'll never tell.
translation: 我是怎么把手套做得这么柔软的？我永远不说。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Moving on soon, =player.formalAddressTerm=? My gloves and gauntlets need no maintenance, so finely are they crafted.'), ('Context', 'Conversation glover.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: Moving on soon, =player.formalAddressTerm=? My gloves and gauntlets need no maintenance, so finely are they crafted.
translation: 很快要上路吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？我的手套和护手甲工艺精良，不需要保养。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "You can't go wrong with my slugspitters, =player.formalAddressTerm=."), ('Context', 'Conversation gunsmith.Start.Text.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You can't go wrong with my slugspitters, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Guns, guns, guns! Don't they just make you smile?"), ('Context', 'Conversation gunsmith.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: Guns, guns, guns! Don't they just make you smile?
translation: 枪，枪，枪！它们难道不会让你微笑吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', '=player.FormalAddressTerm=, I tell you: there is no defense like a good, and distant, offense.'), ('Context', 'Conversation gunsmith.Start.Text.Text3')), 1),), '#text')
source: =player.FormalAddressTerm=, I tell you: there is no defense like a good, and distant, offense.
translation: =player.FormalAddressTerm=，我告诉你：最好的防御就是一次漂亮而遥远的进攻。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Ahh, I love the smell of cordite. You know, that sulfury smell? Accelerants make a fine perfume, if you ask me.'), ('Context', 'Conversation gunsmith.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: Ahh, I love the smell of cordite. You know, that sulfury smell? Accelerants make a fine perfume, if you ask me.
translation: 啊，我喜欢无烟火药的味道。你知道，那股硫磺味？要我说，助燃剂就是很好的香水。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'You know, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I once had an traveler from Yawningmoon tell me my shop smelled of home. Now I want to visit! Hah!'), ('Context', 'Conversation gunsmith.Start.Text.Text5')), 1),), '#text')
source: You know, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I once had an traveler from Yawningmoon tell me my shop smelled of home. Now I want to visit! Hah!
translation: 你知道吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=，曾有个来自呵欠月的旅行者告诉我，我的店闻起来像家。现在我倒想去看看了！哈！

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'May you find adequate cover and more loot than you can carry, =player.formalAddressTerm=.'), ('Context', 'Conversation gunsmith.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: May you find adequate cover and more loot than you can carry, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
translation: 愿你找到足够的掩体，以及多到带不动的战利品，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I used to be a wayfarer like you, =player.formalAddressTerm=, but old wounds slow you down. Cherish the time while you have it.'), ('Context', 'Conversation gunsmith.Start.Text.Text7')), 1),), '#text')
source: I used to be a wayfarer like you, =player.formalAddressTerm=, but old wounds slow you down. Cherish the time while you have it.
translation: 我以前也和你一样是个旅人，=player.formalAddressTerm=，但旧伤会拖慢脚步。趁还有时间，好好珍惜吧。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I wish I could allow you to test my wares in the shop, =player.formalAddressTerm=, but walk a parasang in any direction and you'll find a target."), ('Context', 'Conversation gunsmith.Start.Text.Text8')), 1),), '#text')
source: I wish I could allow you to test my wares in the shop, =player.formalAddressTerm=, but walk a parasang in any direction and you'll find a target.
translation: 我也希望能让你在店里试试我的货，=player.formalAddressTerm=，但你朝任意方向走上一帕拉桑，就能找到靶子。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Might not want to touch anything on the workbenches, =player.formalAddressTerm=.'), ('Context', 'Conversation gunsmith.Start.Text.Text9')), 1),), '#text')
source: Might not want to touch anything on the workbenches, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
translation: 工作台上的东西最好别碰，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Live, drink, and shoot, =player.formalAddressTerm=, in whichever order you like.'), ('Context', 'Conversation gunsmith.Start.Text.Text10')), 1),), '#text')
source: Live, drink, and shoot, =player.formalAddressTerm=, in whichever order you like.
translation: 生存、饮水、射击，=player.formalAddressTerm=，顺序随你喜欢。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Grenades do no good sitting in a pack. Don't forget to use them."), ('Context', 'Conversation grenadier.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: Grenades do no good sitting in a pack. Don't forget to use them.
translation: 手榴弹放在包里没用。别忘了用。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "=player.FormalAddressTerm=, there is little you can't solve with a well-thrown grenade... as long as you don't stand too close."), ('Context', 'Conversation grenadier.Start.Text.Text3')), 1),), '#text')
source: =player.FormalAddressTerm=, there is little you can't solve with a well-thrown grenade... as long as you don't stand too close.
translation: =player.FormalAddressTerm=，只要手榴弹扔得好，几乎没什么解决不了……只要你别站得太近。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Defoliant and fungicide are perfectly safe, but you may wish to avoid breathing too deeply all the same.'), ('Context', 'Conversation grenadier.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: Defoliant and fungicide are perfectly safe, but you may wish to avoid breathing too deeply all the same.
translation: 落叶剂和杀菌剂完全安全，不过你可能还是别吸得太深。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Can I serve you something explosive, =player.formalAddressTerm=?'), ('Context', 'Conversation grenadier.Start.Text.Text5')), 1),), '#text')
source: Can I serve you something explosive, =player.formalAddressTerm=?
translation: 要我给你来点会爆炸的东西吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "You'll be back, =player.formalAddressTerm=, provided you don't blow =player.reflexive= up."), ('Context', 'Conversation grenadier.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: You'll be back, =player.formalAddressTerm=, provided you don't blow =player.reflexive= up.
translation: 你会回来的，=player.formalAddressTerm=，前提是别把自己炸飞。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Be careful with my wares as you peruse them.'), ('Context', 'Conversation grenadier.Start.Text.Text7')), 1),), '#text')
source: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Be careful with my wares as you peruse them.
translation: 你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=。查看我的货时请小心些。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'How is your throwing arm, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Barring that, do you feel lucky?'), ('Context', 'Conversation grenadier.Start.Text.Text8')), 1),), '#text')
source: How is your throwing arm, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Barring that, do you feel lucky?
translation: 你的投掷手感如何，=player.formalAddressTerm=？不行的话，你觉得自己够走运吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "It's a dangerous job, =player.formalAddressTerm=, but well worth it."), ('Context', 'Conversation grenadier.Start.Text.Text9')), 1),), '#text')
source: It's a dangerous job, =player.formalAddressTerm=, but well worth it.
translation: 这是份危险工作，=player.formalAddressTerm=，但很值得。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "The vintners say that 'one rose is fair, but five is death'. I can sell you blossoms that mean death no matter the number."), ('Context', 'Conversation grenadier.Start.Text.Text10')), 1),), '#text')
source: The vintners say that 'one rose is fair, but five is death'. I can sell you blossoms that mean death no matter the number.
translation: 酒商说“一朵玫瑰尚好，五朵便是死亡”。我能卖给你不论几朵都意味着死亡的花。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "There's a shape in every stone waiting to be brought out."), ('Context', 'Conversation gemcutter.Start.Text.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: There's a shape in every stone waiting to be brought out.
translation: 每块石头里都有一个形状，等着被释放出来。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'If you bend the light just so, it frays into brilliance.'), ('Context', 'Conversation gemcutter.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: If you bend the light just so, it frays into brilliance.
translation: 只要把光折得恰到好处，它就会散成辉煌。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I can wait years for the inspiration to craft another figurine. I have before.'), ('Context', 'Conversation gemcutter.Start.Text.Text3')), 1),), '#text')
source: I can wait years for the inspiration to craft another figurine. I have before.
translation: 为了等来雕出下一尊小像的灵感，我可以等上几年。我以前就等过。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'What manner of jewel are our eyes, to skew light into thought?'), ('Context', 'Conversation gemcutter.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: What manner of jewel are our eyes, to skew light into thought?
translation: 我们的眼睛是什么样的宝石，竟能把光偏折成思想？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Enter, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and behold my jewels and figurines.'), ('Context', 'Conversation gemcutter.Start.Text.Text5')), 1),), '#text')
source: Enter, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and behold my jewels and figurines.
translation: 进来吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=，看看我的珠宝和小像。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Uncrafted jewels and metals buy and sell for the same cost, but my art's price tag is up to me."), ('Context', 'Conversation gemcutter.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: Uncrafted jewels and metals buy and sell for the same cost, but my art's price tag is up to me.
translation: 未经雕琢的珠宝和金属买卖价格相同，但我的艺术要标什么价，由我决定。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Every statuette is a tribute, of a kind, but not every tribute is received well.'), ('Context', 'Conversation gemcutter.Start.Text.Text7')), 1),), '#text')
source: Every statuette is a tribute, of a kind, but not every tribute is received well.
translation: 每尊小雕像都算是一种献礼，但不是每份献礼都能被好好接受。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Wouldn't these make a fine conversation piece for a water ritual?"), ('Context', 'Conversation gemcutter.Start.Text.Text8')), 1),), '#text')
source: Wouldn't these make a fine conversation piece for a water ritual?
translation: 这些难道不是水仪式上很好的谈资吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Beautiful baubles and gleaming gemstones over here!'), ('Context', 'Conversation gemcutter.Start.Text.Text9')), 1),), '#text')
source: Beautiful baubles and gleaming gemstones over here!
translation: 漂亮饰物和闪亮宝石，都在这里！

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'A well-polished and well-picked gem, no matter how rough, is as beautiful a work of art as any figurine.'), ('Context', 'Conversation jeweler.Start.Text.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: A well-polished and well-picked gem, no matter how rough, is as beautiful a work of art as any figurine.
translation: 一颗选得好、抛得亮的宝石，不管原本多粗糙，都和任何小像一样是一件美丽艺术品。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Lean in close to see the detail. No, don't touch."), ('Context', 'Conversation jeweler.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: Lean in close to see the detail. No, don't touch.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Within my gemstones there burns a brighter fire than in some hearts.'), ('Context', 'Conversation jeweler.Start.Text.Text3')), 1),), '#text')
source: Within my gemstones there burns a brighter fire than in some hearts.
translation: 我的宝石里燃着比某些心中更明亮的火。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Water-wealth means nothing if you cannot carry it. Need jewels?'), ('Context', 'Conversation jeweler.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: Water-wealth means nothing if you cannot carry it. Need jewels?
translation: 如果带不走，水财富就毫无意义。需要珠宝吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Friend, I have precious metals and jewels to adorn or trade.'), ('Context', 'Conversation jeweler.Start.Text.Text5')), 1),), '#text')
source: Friend, I have precious metals and jewels to adorn or trade.
translation: 朋友，我有贵金属和珠宝，可作装饰，也可交易。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Raw metals and gems buy and sell for a fixed water-cost.'), ('Context', 'Conversation jeweler.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: Raw metals and gems buy and sell for a fixed water-cost.
translation: 原料金属和宝石按固定水价买卖。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Come, wanderer, change some of that heavy water for a pocketful of riches.'), ('Context', 'Conversation jeweler.Start.Text.Text7')), 1),), '#text')
source: Come, wanderer, change some of that heavy water for a pocketful of riches.
translation: 来吧，流浪者，把那些沉重的水换成一口袋财富。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Water Barons don't adorn themselves with water, after all."), ('Context', 'Conversation jeweler.Start.Text.Text8')), 1),), '#text')
source: Water Barons don't adorn themselves with water, after all.
translation: 毕竟，水男爵也不会用水来装饰自己。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*mumbling*}} ...exceeding mass thresholds, perhaps a ganglionic teleprojector fitted with suspensors...'), ('Context', 'Conversation Argyve.MumblingWelcome.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: {{emote|*mumbling*}} ...exceeding mass thresholds, perhaps a ganglionic teleprojector fitted with suspensors...
translation: {{emote|*咕哝*}} ……超过质量阈值，也许要给神经节远程投射器装上悬浮器……

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Oh, I didn't notice you there. That's because I was ignoring you."), ('Context', 'Conversation Argyve.MumblingWelcome2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Oh, I didn't notice you there. That's because I was ignoring you.
translation: 哦，我没注意到你在那儿。因为我正在无视你。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*mumbling*}} ...waste heat from the thermo cask? Or centrifugal extraction to the p-density of sunslag...'), ('Context', 'Conversation Argyve.MumblingWelcome3.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: {{emote|*mumbling*}} ...waste heat from the thermo cask? Or centrifugal extraction to the p-density of sunslag...
translation: {{emote|*咕哝*}} ……来自热能桶的废热？还是用离心萃取达到日渣的 p 密度……

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Where can I find a cave?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Argyve.Knickknack.CaveChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Where can I find a cave?

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'There are caves everywhere, you dolt! Scoop the surface of the marsh, or head on east to the rust wells, or wander into the Desert for all I care...'), ('Context', 'Conversation Argyve.Cave.Text')), 1),), '#text')

translation: 到处都是洞穴，你这笨蛋！去沼泽表面刨刨，或者往东去锈井，或者随便你游荡进沙漠……

translation: 你挡住我的光了！你想要什么？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "{{emote|*Argyve whistles.*}}\n\nImpressive, you! Maybe you're fit to poke around my workshop and swap scrap with me. I have been wanting another apprentice. So unfortunate about Skref, what with the disembowelment and all. Take a seat, there."), ('Context', 'Conversation Argyve.Impressive.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Argyve whistles.*}}

Impressive, you! Maybe you're fit to poke around my workshop and swap scrap with me. I have been wanting another apprentice. So unfortunate about Skref, what with the disembowelment and all. Take a seat, there.
translation:
{{emote|*阿吉夫吹了声口哨。*}}

令人刮目相看，是你！也许你适合在我的工坊里翻翻东西，和我交换废料。我一直想再收个学徒。斯克雷夫实在不幸，毕竟都开膛破肚什么的。坐那儿吧。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "{{emote|*Argyve raises both eyebrows.*}}\n\nNow, to screw the nut on the bolt with an explanation! I'm on the cusp, you see. A grand discovery. The Weirdwire Conduit is near assembled, and once it is, we'll be able to chat with anyone... in instant time! from here to the Yd Freehold. But before I can finish, I need wire. As much as you can find... at least two hundred feet. You should be able to scavenge it from the rust wells."), ('Context', 'Conversation Argyve.Weirdwire.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Argyve raises both eyebrows.*}}

Now, to screw the nut on the bolt with an explanation! I'm on the cusp, you see. A grand discovery. The Weirdwire Conduit is near assembled, and once it is, we'll be able to chat with anyone... in instant time! from here to the Yd Freehold. But before I can finish, I need wire. As much as you can find... at least two hundred feet. You should be able to scavenge it from the rust wells.
translation:
{{emote|*阿吉夫扬起双眉。*}}

现在，该把说明这颗螺母拧到螺栓上了！你看，我正处在临界点。一项伟大发现。怪线导管快组装好了；一旦完成，我们就能和任何人交谈……即时交谈！从这里一直到伊德自由堡都行。但在我完成之前，我需要电线。你能找到多少就要多少……至少两百英尺。你应该能从锈井里搜刮到。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'The wire! Give it to me!'), ('Context', 'Conversation Argyve.TheWire.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: The wire! Give it to me!

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*Argyve hoots*}}\n\nYes, yes! Beautiful wire! -oh, before I forget, I repaired an old recoiler for you. Use it whenever you wish to hop back to Joppa quickly. Now, give me a few moments to attach the wire...'), ('Context', 'Conversation Argyve.GiveWire.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Argyve hoots*}}

Yes, yes! Beautiful wire! -oh, before I forget, I repaired an old recoiler for you. Use it whenever you wish to hop back to Joppa quickly. Now, give me a few moments to attach the wire...
translation:
{{emote|*阿吉夫欢叫起来*}}

对，对！漂亮的电线！——哦，在我忘记之前，我给你修好了一个旧回弹器。你想快速跳回约帕时就用它。现在，给我一点时间把电线接上……

path: ((('string', (('ID', "It's working! Genius! Genius! Noise in the static- I hear it! I hear!... what's this? What *is* that? Wait..."), ('Context', 'Conversation Argyve.ConduitWorking.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: It's working! Genius! Genius! Noise in the static- I hear it! I hear!... what's this? What *is* that? Wait...
translation: 它工作了！天才！天才！静电噪声里有声音——我听见了！我听见了！……这是什么？那*是什么*？等等……

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*Argyve mumbles to himself for several minutes.*}}'), ('Context', 'Conversation Argyve.Signal2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: {{emote|*Argyve mumbles to himself for several minutes.*}}
translation: {{emote|*阿吉夫自言自语地咕哝了好几分钟。*}}

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Apprentice! Come, here! Something strange is occurring. The Conduit is picking up a signal, some sort of repeating transmission. I cannot decipher it, however. I lack cryptogull eggs and, well, never you mind! I have a great task for you, my apprentice. Do you accept it?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Argyve.Signal3.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Apprentice! Come, here! Something strange is occurring. The Conduit is picking up a signal, some sort of repeating transmission. I cannot decipher it, however. I lack cryptogull eggs and, well, never you mind! I have a great task for you, my apprentice. Do you accept it?
translation: 学徒！过来，到这儿来！有怪事发生。导管接收到一个信号，某种重复传输。不过我无法破译它。我缺少隐鸥蛋，还有，呃，你别管！我有一项重大任务给你，我的学徒。你接受吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Can I know what it is?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Argyve.Signal3.Canticle1Choice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Can I know what it is?
translation: 我能知道是什么任务吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', '-yes. You must seek out Barathrum the Old, the eldest and wisest tinker alive. He lives with his followers the Barathrumites under the arch of Grit Gate to the northeast, in the jungle-strangled ruins of Qud. He will know what to make of the signal.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Argyve.Canticle1.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: -yes. You must seek out Barathrum the Old, the eldest and wisest tinker alive. He lives with his followers the Barathrumites under the arch of Grit Gate to the northeast, in the jungle-strangled ruins of Qud. He will know what to make of the signal.
translation: ——可以。你必须去寻找老巴拉瑟姆，现世最年长、最睿智的修补匠。他和追随者巴拉瑟姆派住在东北方砂砾门的拱门下，那里是库德被丛林扼住的遗迹。他会知道该如何看待这个信号。
这些巴拉瑟姆派是什么人？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I require no further information. I will go.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Argyve.Canticle1.CanticleAccept1Choice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I require no further information. I will go.
translation: 我不需要更多信息。我这就去。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Disciples of Barathrum. Mostly urshiib, like their mentor- quilled albino bears who prefer their candle-dim caves to the sun-salted surface of the jungle. A thousand years ago Barathrum and his kin crossed the Homs Delta into the rusting heart of Qud. He has spent centuries peeling the chrome shells off time's artifacts in his workshop. If he cannot decipher the signal, no one can."), ('Context', 'Conversation Argyve.WhoBarathrumites.BarathrumiteDescription')), 1),), '#text')
source: Disciples of Barathrum. Mostly urshiib, like their mentor- quilled albino bears who prefer their candle-dim caves to the sun-salted surface of the jungle. A thousand years ago Barathrum and his kin crossed the Homs Delta into the rusting heart of Qud. He has spent centuries peeling the chrome shells off time's artifacts in his workshop. If he cannot decipher the signal, no one can.
translation: 巴拉瑟姆的门徒。大多是乌尔希布，和他们的导师一样——带刺的白化熊，宁愿待在烛光昏暗的洞穴里，也不愿去丛林那被太阳晒盐的地表。一千年前，巴拉瑟姆和他的族人越过霍姆斯三角洲，进入库德锈蚀的心脏。数百年来，他一直在工坊里剥开时间遗物的铬钢外壳。如果他无法破译信号，那就没人能。
我接受这项任务，阿吉夫。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Splendid! Perfect! Let me record the signal to disk, which you'll need to guard with your life, I'm afraid.\n\nI'll rig up a droid scrambler for you, too. You see, the Barathrumites have programmed a troupe of waydroids to guard the approach to Grit Gate. With the scrambler, you'll needn't worry about them. Wait there."), ('Context', 'Conversation Argyve.CanticleAccept1.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Splendid! Perfect! Let me record the signal to disk, which you'll need to guard with your life, I'm afraid.

I'll rig up a droid scrambler for you, too. You see, the Barathrumites have programmed a troupe of waydroids to guard the approach to Grit Gate. With the scrambler, you'll needn't worry about them. Wait there.
translation:
好极了！完美！让我把信号记录到磁盘上，恐怕你得用性命保护它。

我还会给你装一个机器人扰频器。你看，巴拉瑟姆派编程了一队路行机器人，守卫通往砂砾门的道路。有了扰频器，你就不用担心它们了。在那儿等着。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*Argyve mumbles to himself for several minutes.*}}'), ('Context', 'Conversation Argyve.CanticleAccept2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: {{emote|*Argyve mumbles to himself for several minutes.*}}
translation: {{emote|*阿吉夫自言自语地咕哝了好几分钟。*}}

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Here you are. Now, go! Off with you! May you live long enough to do my bidding. Away, away!'), ('Context', 'Conversation Argyve.CanticleAccept3.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Here you are. Now, go! Off with you! May you live long enough to do my bidding. Away, away!
translation: 给你。现在，去！快走！愿你活得够久，好替我办事。走吧，走吧！

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'The Barathrumites say I must plumb a cave called Golgotha before joining them.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Argyve.StartFinishedCanticle.GolgothaChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: The Barathrumites say I must plumb a cave called Golgotha before joining them.
translation: 巴拉瑟姆派说，我必须先探入一个叫各各他的洞穴，才能加入他们。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Argyve, I am no apprentice. The Barathrumites call me =factionaddress:Barathrumites= now.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Argyve.StartFinishedCanticle.RankUpChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Argyve, I am no apprentice. The Barathrumites call me =factionaddress:Barathrumites= now.
translation: 阿吉夫，我不是学徒了。巴拉瑟姆派现在称我为 =factionaddress:Barathrumites=。
巴拉瑟姆派又是什么人来着？

path:
((('string', (('ID', "Did they, now? Well you're not MY =factionaddress:Barathrumites=!

Grit Gate is not Joppa, you pridesome solder-nail, and in this house you are apprentice still.

Now, what did you want? Be quick!"), ('Context', 'Conversation Argyve.RankUp.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Did they, now? Well you're not MY =factionaddress:Barathrumites=!

Grit Gate is not Joppa, you pridesome solder-nail, and in this house you are apprentice still.

Now, what did you want? Be quick!
translation:
他们这么叫了，是吗？可你不是我的 =factionaddress:Barathrumites=！

砂砾门不是约帕，你这自负的焊钉；在这屋子里，你仍然是学徒。

现在，你想要什么？快点！

path: ((('string', (('ID', "-what?\n\nNo, no, I'm far too engrossed to see to your curiosity. I'm sure the Barathrumites have something for you to do."), ('Context', 'Conversation Argyve.AskAfter.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
-what?

No, no, I'm far too engrossed to see to your curiosity. I'm sure the Barathrumites have something for you to do.
translation:
——什么？

不，不，我太专注了，没空照料你的好奇心。我相信巴拉瑟姆派会有事情给你做。

path:
((('string', (('ID', "Welcome to Grit Gate. I am Otho, Barathrum's steward. I apologize for the manner of our introduction, but we must take precautions. Qud is a very unforgiving place.

You demonstrate tremendous promise to have returned from Golgotha with such inexperience. Take this firearm as your reward. It bears the mark of our finest gunsmith, Sparafucile. Take this bracelet, as well.

Return when you are ready to discuss the signal."), ('Context', 'Conversation Otho.Start.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Welcome to Grit Gate. I am Otho, Barathrum's steward. I apologize for the manner of our introduction, but we must take precautions. Qud is a very unforgiving place.

You demonstrate tremendous promise to have returned from Golgotha with such inexperience. Take this firearm as your reward. It bears the mark of our finest gunsmith, Sparafucile. Take this bracelet, as well.

Return when you are ready to discuss the signal.
translation:
欢迎来到砂砾门。我是奥托，巴拉瑟姆的管事。请原谅我们以这种方式相识，但我们必须采取防范。库德是个非常无情的地方。

你经验如此不足，却能从各各他返回，显示出巨大的潜力。收下这把火器作为奖赏。它带有我们最优秀枪匠斯帕拉富奇莱的标记。也收下这只手镯。

等你准备好讨论信号时再回来。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'It takes more than a willing spirit to be trusted here, wayfarer.\n\nProve your worth and bring us a waydroid, and we will have more to speak of.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Otho.Start4.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
It takes more than a willing spirit to be trusted here, wayfarer.

Prove your worth and bring us a waydroid, and we will have more to speak of.
translation:
要在这里获得信任，光有愿意效劳的精神还不够，旅人。

证明你的价值，给我们带来一台路行机器人，那时我们就有更多可谈。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Are you ready to discuss the signal?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Otho.Start5.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Are you ready to discuss the signal?
translation: 你准备好讨论信号了吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "The signal is a repeat transmission being broadcast from an unknown source. =V0tinkeraddendum= One of our tinkers, {{m|Q Girl}}, discovered it while rigging a long wave detector. Unfortunately, it's encrypted, and we do not have the means here to decrypt it. You may be of some help in this matter, however.\n\nWe've long known the location of a fully functioning {{W|baetyl}} within the bowels of the great hall {{C|Bethesda Susa}}. The Mechanimists have consecrated the site around it and built a temple there. Q Girl claims to have developed a means to decrypt the signal, but she needs the computing power of the baetyl. If you can infiltrate the Mechanimist compound, you may be able to engage the baetyl and decode the signal."), ('Context', 'Conversation Otho.Signal.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
The signal is a repeat transmission being broadcast from an unknown source. =V0tinkeraddendum= One of our tinkers, {{m|Q Girl}}, discovered it while rigging a long wave detector. Unfortunately, it's encrypted, and we do not have the means here to decrypt it. You may be of some help in this matter, however.

We've long known the location of a fully functioning {{W|baetyl}} within the bowels of the great hall {{C|Bethesda Susa}}. The Mechanimists have consecrated the site around it and built a temple there. Q Girl claims to have developed a means to decrypt the signal, but she needs the computing power of the baetyl. If you can infiltrate the Mechanimist compound, you may be able to engage the baetyl and decode the signal.
translation:
这个信号是来自未知源头的重复广播。=V0tinkeraddendum= 我们的一位工匠，{{m|Q 女孩}}，在装配长波探测器时发现了它。可惜信号经过加密，我们这里没有解密手段。不过，你或许能帮上忙。

我们早已知道，{{C|贝塞斯达苏萨}}大厅深处有一座功能完好的{{W|圣像}}。机械教徒将周围奉为圣地，并在那里修建了一座神殿。Q 女孩声称已经想出解密信号的办法，但需要借助圣像的计算能力。如果你能潜入机械教徒的据点，或许就能与圣像交互，解开信号。

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'They are antique stones located in certain places deep within the caverns of Qud. We believe they are some sort of hyper-advanced machines built by the Eaters. Often one claims to possess a sentience of its own. However, most of them have gone haywire in the eons since their creation; it is rare indeed to discover one whose circuitry is wholly uncorroded.

The Mechanimists worship this one as an idol, and they will protect it at all costs. You will need to find a way through their host to the baetyl itself.

Do you believe you can accomplish this task?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Otho.Baetyl?.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
They are antique stones located in certain places deep within the caverns of Qud. We believe they are some sort of hyper-advanced machines built by the Eaters. Often one claims to possess a sentience of its own. However, most of them have gone haywire in the eons since their creation; it is rare indeed to discover one whose circuitry is wholly uncorroded.

The Mechanimists worship this one as an idol, and they will protect it at all costs. You will need to find a way through their host to the baetyl itself.

Do you believe you can accomplish this task?
translation:
它们是古老的石头，位于库德洞穴深处的某些地点。我们认为它们是吞噬者建造的某种超先进机器。它们常常声称自己拥有独立感知。然而，自被创造以来经过无数宙纪，大多数都已经失控；能发现一块电路完全未被腐蚀的，实在罕见。

机械信徒把这一块当作偶像崇拜，并会不惜一切保护它。你需要想办法穿过他们的队伍，抵达贝特尔本身。

你认为自己能完成这项任务吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I must think on this task.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Otho.Baetyl?.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I must think on this task.
translation: 我必须考虑一下这项任务。

path:
((('string', (('ID', "Good, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Speak to {{m|Q Girl}} in the workshop. She'll encode her instructions for the baetyl onto a copy of the disk.

There's one more thing. The baetyl is located beneath the ancient cryobarrios of the Eaters. Time has worked to erode the mechanisms that contain their cryogenic mist. That freezing vapor billows out of the chambers freely now, cooling the entire cavern. You will want to procure warm clothing to protect =player.reflexive=.

The spoils of the Mechanimists are yours to keep. Remember, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=, Barathrum will look kindly upon your service."), ('Context', 'Conversation Otho.Bethesda1.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Good, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Speak to {{m|Q Girl}} in the workshop. She'll encode her instructions for the baetyl onto a copy of the disk.

There's one more thing. The baetyl is located beneath the ancient cryobarrios of the Eaters. Time has worked to erode the mechanisms that contain their cryogenic mist. That freezing vapor billows out of the chambers freely now, cooling the entire cavern. You will want to procure warm clothing to protect =player.reflexive=.

The spoils of the Mechanimists are yours to keep. Remember, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=, Barathrum will look kindly upon your service.
translation:
很好，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。去工坊找 {{m|Q 女孩}}。她会把自己给贝特尔的指令编码到一份磁盘副本上。

还有一件事。贝特尔位于吞噬者古老低温街区的下方。岁月侵蚀了封存低温雾的机制。如今，那冻结蒸气从舱室中肆意涌出，冷却了整座洞穴。你最好弄些暖和衣物来保护自己。

机械信徒的战利品归你所有。记住，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=，巴拉瑟姆会善待你的效劳。

接近奥蒙廊时要小心，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。在库德如此东远之境，普图斯圣殿骑士正在潜伏。

path:
((('string', (('ID', "With the chrome key card I gave you, you now have access to our power grid. There are chain laser emplacements and force projectors across the enclave. Be mindful of the amperage draw, though. If you overdraw the grid, you could cause brownouts.

Act quickly, =name=! The Templar near us even as we speak.

凭我给你的铬钢钥匙卡，你现在可以访问我们的电网。飞地各处都有链式激光炮位和力场投射器。利用埃列什基伽勒的侦察结果，决定启用哪些防御。你也可以通过接入埃列什基伽勒来广播超频指令，或激活罗达尼斯 Y。

不过要注意电流负载。如果从电网抽取过量，你可能会造成降压停电。

translation: 我不确定你是否知道自己向我提出的请求有多重大，=name=。尽管如此，我不能否认你为我们教团所做的一切。这些斯林斯必须像你一样接受考验；但若他们展现出与你榜样相称的胆魄与干劲，我们会接纳他们为学徒。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'You have grown bold beyond your station. What you have asked of us you have not earned. If you must ask again, become worthier first.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Otho.SlynthRequestReject.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You have grown bold beyond your station. What you have asked of us you have not earned. If you must ask again, become worthier first.
translation: 你的胆量已经越过了自己的身份。你向我们请求的东西，你尚未赢得。若你必须再次请求，就先让自己更配得上。

source: Has this slynth situation been settled yet?
translation: 斯林斯的情况已经解决了吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I did not expect to admit this, disciple, but the refugees have met my expectations. Like you, they have shown more than a willing spirit in work and curiosity both.\n\nThe slynth have promise, and you may have been right to bring them to us.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Otho.SlynthArrived.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I did not expect to admit this, disciple, but the refugees have met my expectations. Like you, they have shown more than a willing spirit in work and curiosity both.

The slynth have promise, and you may have been right to bring them to us.
translation:
我没想到自己会承认这一点，门徒，但这些难民达到了我的期望。与你一样，他们在工作和好奇心上展现出的不只是愿意效劳的精神。

斯林斯有前途，你把他们带给我们也许是对的。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Live and drink, disciple.\n\nYou will be pleased to know that the slynth have proven themselves worthy of apprentice status. They will reside here for as long as they uphold and serve the tenets of our order.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Otho.SlynthSettled.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Live and drink, disciple.

You will be pleased to know that the slynth have proven themselves worthy of apprentice status. They will reside here for as long as they uphold and serve the tenets of our order.
translation:
生而饮水，门徒。

你会高兴地知道，斯林斯已经证明自己配得上学徒身份。只要他们维护并服务于我们教团的信条，他们就会在这里居住。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "It's as I feared, =name=. Grit Gate is being assailed. source:
It's as I feared, =name=. Grit Gate is being assailed. The Putus Templar must have followed you back from Omonporch.

Let us use the precious little time we have before they arrive to prepare our defenses.
translation:
果然如我所惧，=name=。砂砾门正遭到攻击。普图斯圣殿骑士一定是从奥蒙廊一路跟着你回来了。

趁他们抵达前这点珍贵时间，我们来准备防御。

path:
((('string', (('ID', "With the chrome key card I gave you, you now have access to our power grid. There are chain laser emplacements and force projectors across the enclave. Use Ereshkigal's reconnaissance to decide which defenses to enable. You can also broadcast an overclock command or activate Rodanis Y by interfacing with Ereshkigal.

Be mindful of the amperage draw, though. If you overdraw the grid, you could cause brownouts.

Act quickly, =name=! The Templar near us even as we speak."), ('Context', 'Conversation Gritgate Mainframe Intercom.BeginCallToArms.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
With the chrome key card I gave you, you now have access to our power grid. There are chain laser emplacements and force projectors across the enclave. Use Ereshkigal's reconnaissance to decide which defenses to enable. You can also broadcast an overclock command or activate Rodanis Y by interfacing with Ereshkigal.

Be mindful of the amperage draw, though. If you overdraw the grid, you could cause brownouts.

Act quickly, =name=! The Templar near us even as we speak.
translation:
凭我给你的铬钢钥匙卡，你现在可以访问我们的电网。飞地各处都有链式激光炮位和力场投射器。利用埃列什基伽勒的侦察结果，决定启用哪些防御。你也可以通过接入埃列什基伽勒来广播超频指令，或激活罗达尼斯 Y。

不过要注意电流负载。如果从电网抽取过量，你可能会造成降压停电。

快行动，=name=！我们说话时，圣殿骑士仍在逼近。

source:
You're going to the Thin World? I confess to some measure of envy.

I have dreamt many times of disappearing into a cool ocean of information, shaking the cruft of my physical form from newly-freed quills. If that came of my waking life, would I then dream as chore-doing Iseppa in her chambers? Perhaps it's best I don't know.
translation:
你要去薄世界？我承认有几分羡慕。

我许多次梦见自己消失在一片清凉的信息海洋中，从新获自由的刺上抖落物理形体的残垢。若那成了我清醒时的生活，我是否会转而梦见在房间里做杂务的伊塞帕？也许最好别知道。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Bethesda Susa is an antipodal place, a gallery of life and death and the stages between. Its depths prolong life and end it early, remove life from the flow of days or return it.\n\nIt will seek to make you late. Take care you come back on time.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Iseppa.Bethesda.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Bethesda Susa is an antipodal place, a gallery of life and death and the stages between. Its depths prolong life and end it early, remove life from the flow of days or return it.

It will seek to make you late. Take care you come back on time.
translation:
贝塞斯达苏萨是个对跖之地，是生命、死亡以及两者之间各阶段的陈列馆。它的深处会延长生命，也会让生命提前结束，会把生命从日子的流动中移除，或将其归还。

它会试图让你迟到。小心准时回来。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Though I adore the sights and smells of Omonporch, its bug problem becomes distracting.\n\nIf I'm to travel there, I always bring something they cannot zip away from."), ('Context', 'Conversation Iseppa.Omonporch.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Though I adore the sights and smells of Omonporch, its bug problem becomes distracting.

If I'm to travel there, I always bring something they cannot zip away from.
translation:
虽然我很喜欢奥蒙廊的景象和气味，但那里的虫害问题会令人分心。

如果我要去那里，总会带上些它们没法嗖地逃开的东西。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I fear sludges, the kind you may no longer describe with 'some'. Born of the ancient stuff of existence, possessed of malice and wanting nothing more than to eat whatever they can, and they can eat whatever. It is even worse when they drink.\n\nTake care with them."), ('Context', 'Conversation Iseppa.Sludges.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I fear sludges, the kind you may no longer describe with 'some'. Born of the ancient stuff of existence, possessed of malice and wanting nothing more than to eat whatever they can, and they can eat whatever. It is even worse when they drink.

Take care with them.
translation:
我怕的是那些你再也不能用“某些”来描述的淤泥怪。它们由存在的古老物质诞生，怀有恶意，除了吃掉一切能吃之物外别无所求，而它们什么都能吃。当它们喝东西时，情况甚至更糟。

对付它们要小心。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I am considering the window of consciousness through which each of us views the universe. What happens to it when we die?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Iseppa.Project.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I am taking inventory of my faculties, and looking for any that I might not previously have considered.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Iseppa.Project.Text.Text3')), 1),), '#text')
source: I am taking inventory of my faculties, and looking for any that I might not previously have considered.
translation: 我正在清点自己的能力，并寻找那些我此前可能从未考虑过的能力。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I am considering the thought as a discrete object. source: I am considering the thought as a discrete object. I wish to determine whether I am able to think a single thought only, and to determine how to distinguish it from another thought in the same vein.
translation: 我正在把思想视作离散对象来思考。我想确定自己是否能只思考一个单独的思想，并确定如何把它和同一脉络中的另一个思想区分开来。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I am considering the determination of goodness and badness in a thing, and how it is determined. source: I am considering the determination of goodness and badness in a thing, and how it is determined. The interaction between data and subjective evaluation, and the values that guide us that we cannot put to words.
translation: 我正在思考事物中善与恶的判定，以及这种判定如何发生。数据与主观评估之间的互动，还有那些引导我们、却无法诉诸言辞的价值。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I am considering narrative inheritances. The stories we were told when our minds were more putty-like, the follies that shaped who we are, that shape the whole of Qud.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Iseppa.Project.Text.Text7')), 1),), '#text')
source: I am considering narrative inheritances. The stories we were told when our minds were more putty-like, the follies that shaped who we are, that shape the whole of Qud.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Omonporch is a fine source of bananas, but I have little to say about self-appointed nobility.\n\nClaimed authority has a heady aroma, but no broth beneath it. Let us simply appease Asphodel and leave xem to xyr fantasies.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Dardi.Omonporch.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Omonporch is a fine source of bananas, but I have little to say about self-appointed nobility.

Claimed authority has a heady aroma, but no broth beneath it. Let us simply appease Asphodel and leave xem to xyr fantasies.
translation:
奥蒙廊是香蕉的上佳来源，但关于自封的贵族，我没什么可说的。

宣称而来的权威香气浓烈，却没有底汤。我们就安抚阿斯福德尔，让 其 留在 其 的幻想里吧。

My air-puffed pastry experiment collapsed thanks to that disturbance.

Whoever is responsible will pay dearly.
translation:

不管是谁干的，都要付出惨重代价。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I have visited the rainbow wood but once, and there I sampled an array of strange foods, one of which allowed me an unusual lens through which to view the world. It was nothing like I had ever experienced, and I imagined such wondrous recipes. I wrote them all down as best I could, of course.\n\nSadly, once I returned to my ordinary frame of reference, my scribblings proved impossible to read. So it goes.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Dardi.Klanq.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I have visited the rainbow wood but once, and there I sampled an array of strange foods, one of which allowed me an unusual lens through which to view the world. It was nothing like I had ever experienced, and I imagined such wondrous recipes. I wrote them all down as best I could, of course.

Sadly, once I returned to my ordinary frame of reference, my scribblings proved impossible to read. So it goes.
translation:
我只去过彩虹林一次，在那里尝过一系列奇异食物，其中一种让我透过一种不同寻常的透镜观看世界。那和我经历过的一切都不同，我想象出了那么多奇妙的食谱。当然，我尽力把它们全写了下来。

遗憾的是，一旦我回到平常的参照框架，我写下的潦草字迹就完全无法辨认了。事情就是这样。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "What you smell is Grit Gate's signature dish. The Porridge is a recipe passed down through generations of Barathrumites, and it is the food that inspired me to pursue my craft. Yes, outsiders quail at the intensity of the scent, for its flavor is as bold as its effects!\n\nWe use cuisine to channel lightning from our bodies! Other recipes may let us breathe fire, or learn the secrets of the Eaters. The Porridge is as precious a part of our legacy as the Barathrum Clock or the foaminator."), ('Context', 'Conversation Dardi.Porridge.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
What you smell is Grit Gate's signature dish. The Porridge is a recipe passed down through generations of Barathrumites, and it is the food that inspired me to pursue my craft. Yes, outsiders quail at the intensity of the scent, for its flavor is as bold as its effects!

We use cuisine to channel lightning from our bodies! Other recipes may let us breathe fire, or learn the secrets of the Eaters. The Porridge is as precious a part of our legacy as the Barathrum Clock or the foaminator.
translation:
你闻到的是砂砾门的招牌菜。“粥”是巴拉瑟姆派世代相传的食谱，也是启发我追求这门手艺的食物。是的，外来者会在这股气味的强度面前退缩，因为它的风味和它的效果一样大胆！

我们用料理引导闪电流出身体！其他食谱也许能让我们吐火，或学会食客的秘密。“粥”和巴拉瑟姆钟、发泡器一样，都是我们传承中珍贵的一部分。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Oh, it changes by the hour, sometimes the minute. Preserve this, observe that, add anything, taste everything.\n\nBut the starapple of my eye, the Spindle up which I cast my ambitious gaze... is edible vapor. Food that you eat, food that you breathe. Sadly, to date the most I have managed is an herbed saline suspension. Salty air, if you will.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Dardi.FoodNetwork.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Oh, it changes by the hour, sometimes the minute. Preserve this, observe that, add anything, taste everything.

But the starapple of my eye, the Spindle up which I cast my ambitious gaze... is edible vapor. Food that you eat, food that you breathe. Sadly, to date the most I have managed is an herbed saline suspension. Salty air, if you will.
translation:
哦，它每小时都在变，有时每分钟都在变。腌存这个，观察那个，什么都加，什么都尝。

但我的掌上星果，我雄心凝望攀上的纺锤……是可食用蒸汽。可以吃的食物，可以呼吸的食物。可惜到目前为止，我最多只做出了草本盐水悬浮液。可以说是咸空气。

source: Good luck with your experiments, then.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Yes. The flavor, the breathability, all successful, but the barrier between flavor and food is in the calories, and they have yet eluded me. But it is only a matter of time. I am patient, and I am relentless.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Dardi.VaporAndSalt.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Yes. The flavor, the breathability, all successful, but the barrier between flavor and food is in the calories, and they have yet eluded me. But it is only a matter of time. I am patient, and I am relentless.
translation: 是的。风味，呼吸性，全都成功了，但风味与食物之间的壁垒在于热量，而热量至今仍逃脱了我。但这只是时间问题。我有耐心，也绝不松手。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I will leave you to it. Live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Dardi.VaporAndSalt.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I will leave you to it. Live and drink.
translation: 我就不打扰你了。生而饮水。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Why don't I see myself out?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Dardi.Kitchen.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'And I suppose the Stilt is a modest church, its great bazaar a junk sale?

Look about you. Every instrument you see is precision-calibrated, every tool handcrafted and built to last. In this room, sustenance and ingenuity come together to evolve cuisine itself, to shape not this culture alone but, over time, every culture. Is that kind of influence the product of a kitchen? Can a simple clay oven in the flower fields do what we do here? Has every kitchen an indelible influence over Qud?

{{emote|*He frowns.*}}

Should they? Should we not all?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Dardi.Kitchen2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
And I suppose the Stilt is a modest church, its great bazaar a junk sale?

Look about you. Every instrument you see is precision-calibrated, every tool handcrafted and built to last. In this room, sustenance and ingenuity come together to evolve cuisine itself, to shape not this culture alone but, over time, every culture. Is that kind of influence the product of a kitchen? Can a simple clay oven in the flower fields do what we do here? Has every kitchen an indelible influence over Qud?

{{emote|*He frowns.*}}

Should they? Should we not all?
translation:
那我是不是还该说高跷只是一座朴素的教堂，它的大集市只是一场旧货甩卖？

看看你周围。你看到的每一件仪器都经过精密校准，每一件工具都由手工打造，经久耐用。在这个房间里，营养与巧思汇聚，共同演化料理本身，塑造的不只是这一种文化，而是假以时日，塑造每一种文化。这种影响力会是厨房的产物吗？花田里一座简单的黏土炉能做到我们在这里做的事吗？每间厨房都对库德有不可磨灭的影响吗？

{{emote|*他皱起眉头。*}}

它们应该有吗？我们难道不都应该如此吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "*mutter 'live and drink' while backing away*"), ('Context', 'Conversation Dardi.Kitchen2.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')

path:
((('string', (('ID', "But perhaps you are right, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Think for a moment.

Every ingredient in the soup of collective knowledge is a valuable one, and who am I to elevate myself over more humble pioneers? But! All the more reason for us to regard cuisine (and by extension, culture itself) to be a scientific endeavor, an ongoing trial-and-error, a blending of what we know and what we don't know, calling upon reality itself to be our guide.

You are more insightful than I realized, =name=. Thank you for this discussion. Did you need aught else?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Dardi.Kitchen3.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
But perhaps you are right, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Think for a moment.

Every ingredient in the soup of collective knowledge is a valuable one, and who am I to elevate myself over more humble pioneers? But! All the more reason for us to regard cuisine (and by extension, culture itself) to be a scientific endeavor, an ongoing trial-and-error, a blending of what we know and what we don't know, calling upon reality itself to be our guide.

You are more insightful than I realized, =name=. Thank you for this discussion. Did you need aught else?
translation:
但也许你是对的，=player.formalAddressTerm=。想一想。

集体知识这锅汤里的每一种配料都有价值，而我又是谁，凭什么把自己抬到更谦卑的先驱之上？但是！这更说明我们应该把料理视为一项科学事业，并由此把文化本身也视为如此；它是持续不断的试错，是已知与未知的调和，是召唤现实本身来做我们的向导。

你比我意识到的更有洞见，=name=。感谢这场讨论。你还需要别的吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I did not consider that my life could be further upturned. Truly, I have learned much and I hate it all.\n\nOnce you lot reach the spindle's apex, perhaps you could be convinced to stay there? source:
I did not consider that my life could be further upturned. Truly, I have learned much and I hate it all.

Once you lot reach the spindle's apex, perhaps you could be convinced to stay there? Or perhaps I could go in your stead.
translation:
我没想到我的生活还能被进一步颠覆。真的，我学到了很多，而且全都讨厌。

等你们这些人抵达纺锤顶端后，也许可以说服你们留在那里？或者也许我可以替你们去。

I spent so long preparing for the eventuality that my home might be breached.

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Of course it was only a matter of time before you came to speak to me.\n\nI don't suppose I can convince you to let me tend to my duties in peace? I know nothing of interest to a wayfarer. Each of my days is like the others; I maintain and protect my children, and this is enough. If I desire conversation, there is Ereshkigal."), ('Context', 'Conversation Aloysius.Greetings.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Of course it was only a matter of time before you came to speak to me.

I don't suppose I can convince you to let me tend to my duties in peace? I know nothing of interest to a wayfarer. Each of my days is like the others; I maintain and protect my children, and this is enough. If I desire conversation, there is Ereshkigal.
translation:
你来找我说话当然只是时间问题。

我想我说服不了你让我安静履行职责吧？我没有任何会让旅人感兴趣的知识。我的每一天都和其他日子一样；我维护并保护我的孩子们，这就够了。如果我想交谈，还有埃列什基伽勒。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Bethesda Susa is a vibrant and thriving ecosystem in which we have no place. That said, I certainly would not complain if someone were to clear out its Mechanimist infestation.\n\nShould you travel there, watch your step. The fronds of a lurking beth can rapidly exsanguinate fleshy creatures such as we.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Aloysius.Bethesda.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Bethesda Susa is a vibrant and thriving ecosystem in which we have no place. That said, I certainly would not complain if someone were to clear out its Mechanimist infestation.

Should you travel there, watch your step. The fronds of a lurking beth can rapidly exsanguinate fleshy creatures such as we.
translation:
贝塞斯达苏萨是一个生机勃勃、繁盛旺盛的生态系统，而我们在那里没有位置。话虽如此，如果有人清除它受机械教徒侵扰的问题，我当然不会抱怨。

如果你要去那里，注意脚下。潜伏贝斯的叶状肢能迅速放干我们这类血肉生物的血。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Speaking to other organics is as strenuous to me as any physical exercise.\n\nMy reclusiveness is not born of antipathy; I simply cannot converse as easily as you do and don't wish to learn how."), ('Context', 'Conversation Aloysius.Quiet.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Speaking to other organics is as strenuous to me as any physical exercise.

My reclusiveness is not born of antipathy; I simply cannot converse as easily as you do and don't wish to learn how.

source:
{{emote|*Hortensa chuckles.*}}

Years. Decades on decades. Centuries, perhaps. Most of these wet-earred cubs were merely sketches in their mothers' dreambooks when I arrived to study under Barathrum. We knew so little then, know so little now.
translation:
{{emote|*霍滕西娅轻声笑了。*}}

很多年。几十年又几十年。也许几个世纪。我来到巴拉瑟姆门下学习时，这些耳朵还湿的小崽子大多只是他们母亲梦书里的草图。那时我们知道得那么少，如今知道得也那么少。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "{{emote|*Hortensa chuckles.*}}\n\nYou are sharp, =name=. In a way that's what I am. But liquids are more willful than scrap. I can't solder them together; they would run away, hide in the shale cracks, slowly come apart and disappear. I moreso think of myself as a wisewoman in dialogue with them -- I manage their moods and phases. My notebooks are full of their quirks and caprices. It's a wonder, isn't it, how at just the right temperature and pressure the continuity of matter is smashed apart? How the gaseous butterfly flits out of the dense worm?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Hortensa.LiquidTinker.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Hortensa chuckles.*}}

You are sharp, =name=. In a way that's what I am. But liquids are more willful than scrap. I can't solder them together; they would run away, hide in the shale cracks, slowly come apart and disappear. I moreso think of myself as a wisewoman in dialogue with them -- I manage their moods and phases. My notebooks are full of their quirks and caprices. It's a wonder, isn't it, how at just the right temperature and pressure the continuity of matter is smashed apart? How the gaseous butterfly flits out of the dense worm?
translation:
{{emote|*霍滕西娅轻声笑了。*}}

你很敏锐，=name=。从某种意义上说，我就是。但液体比废料更任性。我没法把它们焊在一起；它们会逃跑，躲进页岩裂缝，慢慢散开，然后消失。我更愿意把自己看作一位与它们对话的智妇；我管理它们的情绪与相态。我的笔记本里满是它们的怪癖和反复无常。这很奇妙，不是吗？在恰到好处的温度和压力下，物质的连续性如何被砸碎？气态的蝴蝶如何从稠密的蠕虫中振翅而出？

((('string', (('ID', "Would you like to hear? When I was first put together by Father and friends, I was Shem 2, the second iteration of the make-me project.

source:
Would you like to hear? When I was first put together by Father and friends, I was Shem 2, the second iteration of the make-me project.

As I came along, scampered through the halls, listened to the stories Neek read me, climbed onto Sparafucile's workbench to have my screws replaced, I realized I was not what I could be. And so I downgraded myself to Shem 1.

That has happened three times.
translation:
你想听吗？我最初由父亲和朋友们组装起来时，我是舍姆 2，是造我项目的第二次迭代。

随着我成长，在走廊里蹿来蹿去，听尼克读给我的故事，爬上斯帕拉富奇莱的工作台更换螺丝，我意识到我还不是我可以成为的样子。于是我把自己降级为舍姆 1。

这已经发生过三次。

Too many fingers tangle in the honeypot, as my cubhood mentor would tell me.

Beauty manifest, whose chromium shoals are Awe itself. In my belief system, She's the being from whom all metal was birthed, out in the ever-void. There are pieces of Her in every chrome belfry and every machine. Even bits of Her in our own blood.

For me, Her essence extends beyond mere metal. Anything that's ordered, She infuses: a poem, a mathematical proof, a clean workspace... so definitely not Q Girl's.
translation:
显现的美，其铬质浅滩即是敬畏本身。在我的信仰体系中，她是在永恒虚空中孕育出一切金属的存在。每座铬钢钟楼、每台机器里都有她的碎片。甚至我们的血液里也有她的碎片。

对我而言，她的本质不止延伸到金属。凡有秩序之物，她皆灌注其中：一首诗，一个数学证明，一处整洁的工作区……所以肯定不是 Q 女孩的工作区。

问题是我总在刻录更多磁盘。新装置。逆向工程造物。我想，这也算是个好问题。

看一看吧。看看有没有让你感兴趣的。

有点像这样。你去找贝特尔。你和它说话，然后你说：“你看，丛林里的每一只珠串手镯在哪里？水藤沼泽里的每一只珠串手镯在哪里？斯维河里的每一只珠串手镯在哪里？”

然后它告诉你，你就去拿手镯。
