path: ((('string', (('ID', "You felt it too! Every. rock. moved. Wooooooow! It's sort of like a community dance we all performed together. Mafeo. Sparafucile. The chromelings. The rocks. Everyone else."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neek.Rumbling.Text')), 1),), '#text')

Neek winks at you! Ha ha ha. She knows I still do it.
translation:
比如我*不会*做的事，就是喝霍滕西娅的淤泥汤样本。我喝过一次，她看见了我，只是很得体地笑了笑，但我能感觉到她心里其实在“哇哦哦哦哦哦”，所以我不喝。

尼克朝你眨眼！哈哈哈。她知道我还在喝。

尼克吟唱：“矩形头发！矩形头发！矩形头发！”

这有点像史前蜥蜴长出大帆来调节体温，然后你说：“我喜欢，但它看起来太有机生成了。要是把它锉成尖锐的矩形呢？”

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'It's a big bear city with a lot of books and scratched brass and strange noises. But if you start chanting in sync with the noises Otho will hush you. It's sort of like this, let me explain.

Iseppa is napping so you peek into her room and rearrange her papers.
Then you walk down the hall and say "ding ding" so Mafeo shakes his head and dings back.
Then you foaminate by Hortensa. You foaminate right on by. You hug her too.
Then you scoot over and hug Spara.

{{emote|*Neek nods thoughtfully.*}}'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neek.GritGate.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
It's a big bear city with a lot of books and scratched brass and strange noises. But if you start chanting in sync with the noises Otho will hush you. It's sort of like this, let me explain.

Iseppa is napping so you peek into her room and rearrange her papers.
Then you walk down the hall and say "ding ding" so Mafeo shakes his head and dings back.
Then you foaminate by Hortensa. You foaminate right on by. You hug her too.
Then you scoot over and hug Spara.
Then you scoot over to Jacobo and look over his shoulder and nod like this.

{{emote|*Neek nods thoughtfully.*}}
translation:
它是一座大熊城市，有好多书、刮花的黄铜和奇怪的噪音。但如果你开始跟着那些噪音一起吟唱，奥托会叫你安静。大概是这样，让我解释。

伊塞帕在打盹，所以你偷看她的房间，重新摆她的纸。
然后你走下走廊，说“叮叮”，于是马费奥摇摇头，也叮回来。
然后你从霍滕西娅身边发泡过去。你就这么一路发泡过去。你也抱抱她。
然后你滑过去抱抱斯帕拉。
然后你滑到雅各博身边，越过他的肩膀看，并像这样点头。

{{emote|*尼克若有所思地点点头。*}}

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'You go and run at Q Girl and tap all the gadgets and tap her on the head.
Then you sneak by Otho's office.
Then you hug Shem -1 and you drag them to the library and read to them. Sometimes Barathrum and Hortensa are in there, and they smile at you.
Then you get hungry and you roll toward the kitchen. You slurp honey from the vase and Dardi glares at you. You say, "I'm just 'jidding'."
Then you climb the pipes and whisper to Aloysius, "Live and drink, live and drink, live and drink."
Then you pat the chromelings on their heads. You say to Ereshkigal, "boom boom boom boom boom I love you."
Then you sneak into storage and pat all the chromelings on their heads.
You take a nap in the peptic chair.
Then you get a bright idea and go back to your room to write it in your notebook.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neek.GritGate2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
You go and run at Q Girl and tap all the gadgets and tap her on the head.
Then you sneak by Otho's office.
Then you hug Shem -1 and you drag them to the library and read to them. Sometimes Barathrum and Hortensa are in there, and they smile at you.
Then you get hungry and you roll toward the kitchen. You slurp honey from the vase and Dardi glares at you. You say, "I'm just 'jidding'."
Then you climb the pipes and whisper to Aloysius, "Live and drink, live and drink, live and drink."
Then you pat the chromelings on their heads. You say to Ereshkigal, "boom boom boom boom boom I love you."
Then you sneak into storage and pat all the chromelings on their heads.
You take a nap in the peptic chair.
Then you get a bright idea and go back to your room to write it in your notebook.
translation:
你跑向 Q 女孩，拍拍所有小装置，再拍拍她的头。
然后你悄悄经过奥托的办公室。
然后你抱抱舍姆 -1，把他们拖去图书馆，读书给他们听。有时巴拉瑟姆和霍滕西娅也在那里，他们会对你微笑。
然后你饿了，就朝厨房滚过去。你从花瓶里吸蜜，达迪瞪着你。你说：“我只是在‘尼开玩笑’。”
然后你爬上管道，对阿洛伊修斯低声说：“生而饮水，生而饮水，生而饮水。”
然后你拍拍铬灵的头。你对埃列什基伽勒说：“砰砰砰砰砰我爱你。”
然后你偷偷溜进储藏室，拍拍所有铬灵的头。
你在消化椅上打个盹。
然后你有了一个明亮的点子，就回到房间，把它写进笔记本。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'My condolences to your sense of smell, =player.formalAddressTerm=.\n\nGolgotha is an execrable place in more ways than one, and I would advise you not to visit without a healthy stock of yuckwheat and honey. If you can cook, a meal with yuckwheat may banish a disease before it comes into its own. Bring salves or urberries, too, and mind your feet in the Cloaca.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Mafeo.Golgotha.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
My condolences to your sense of smell, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

Golgotha is an execrable place in more ways than one, and I would advise you not to visit without a healthy stock of yuckwheat and honey. If you can cook, a meal with yuckwheat may banish a disease before it comes into its own. Bring salves or urberries, too, and mind your feet in the Cloaca.
translation:
我向你的嗅觉致以哀悼，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

各各他在不止一层意义上都可谓恶劣，我建议你若没有备足恶心麦和蜂蜜，就别去那里。如果你会烹饪，一顿带恶心麦的饭菜也许能在疾病真正发作前把它驱散。药膏或乌尔莓也带上，在泄殖腔里还要小心脚下。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Bethesda Susa? Lovely, but a bit dangerous for a holiday destination. You'll want to bring bandages and warm clothing. Why not take a look at my stock in case something suits you?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Mafeo.Bethesda.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Bethesda Susa? Lovely, but a bit dangerous for a holiday destination. You'll want to bring bandages and warm clothing. Why not take a look at my stock in case something suits you?
translation: 贝塞斯达苏萨？可爱，但作为度假地有点危险。你最好带上绷带和保暖衣物。不如看看我的存货，也许有适合你的东西？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "It's a lovely place, and the bananas are delicious.\n\nAs for the so-called Earl, well. I'm loath to recognize nobility to begin with, and I cannot decide whether Asphodel claiming xyr own title is better or worse than if xe inherited it."), ('Context', 'Conversation Mafeo.Omonporch.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
It's a lovely place, and the bananas are delicious.

As for the so-called Earl, well. I'm loath to recognize nobility to begin with, and I cannot decide whether Asphodel claiming xyr own title is better or worse than if xe inherited it.
translation:
那是个可爱的地方，香蕉也很好吃。

至于所谓伯爵，嗯。我本就不乐意承认什么贵族，也说不准阿斯福德尔自封头衔到底比继承头衔更好还是更糟。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Nothing short of explosives or heavy equipment could have made such a sound.\n\nBe ready for the worst, =player.formalAddressTerm=.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Mafeo.Rumbling.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Nothing short of explosives or heavy equipment could have made such a sound.

Be ready for the worst, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
translation:
除了爆炸物或重型设备，没什么能发出那样的声音。

做好最坏的准备，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "The Rainbow Wood is a fair bit too dangerous for a casual promenade, but nothing compares to its beauty. Once, I viewed it from above by means of a gyrocopter, and I will never forget the sights that I saw.\n\nNor will I forget crashing to the ground because the gyrocopter broke, but every adventure has its complications, wouldn't you say?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Mafeo.Klanq.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
The Rainbow Wood is a fair bit too dangerous for a casual promenade, but nothing compares to its beauty. Once, I viewed it from above by means of a gyrocopter, and I will never forget the sights that I saw.

Nor will I forget crashing to the ground because the gyrocopter broke, but every adventure has its complications, wouldn't you say?
translation:
彩虹林对于随意散步来说危险得很，但没有什么能比得上它的美丽。有一次，我乘着旋翼机从空中俯瞰它，我永远不会忘记我所见的景象。

我也不会忘记旋翼机坏掉后我摔到地上的事，不过每场冒险都有它的麻烦，不是吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Oh, I sell whatever sundries that meet my standards of quality, with some measure of curation. I try to ensure that my shelves carry a bit of many things, but you can count on finding more than enough ammunition and a few recoilers that can lead you back here in difficult times.\n\nIf you have anything in need of identification or repair, I can take care of that for you for a few drams as well.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Mafeo.WhatWares.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Oh, I sell whatever sundries that meet my standards of quality, with some measure of curation. I try to ensure that my shelves carry a bit of many things, but you can count on finding more than enough ammunition and a few recoilers that can lead you back here in difficult times.

If you have anything in need of identification or repair, I can take care of that for you for a few drams as well.
translation:
哦，我卖各种符合我品质标准的杂货，多少也经过一点筛选。我会尽量保证货架上各类东西都有一些，不过你肯定能找到充足的弹药，还有几枚能在困难时刻把你带回这里的回弹器。

如果你有什么东西需要鉴定或修理，我也可以收几打兰替你处理。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Why, this place is Grit Gate! O the vaulted halls, the glint of chrome, the gentle hum of chain turret emplacements!\n\nThere's nowhere like Grit Gate in the whole of Qud, =player.formalAddressTerm=. I've journeyed in my comparatively short time, but I always return here. The very air buzzes with knowledge, as well as quite a few other things."), ('Context', 'Conversation Mafeo.GritGate.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Why, this place is Grit Gate! O the vaulted halls, the glint of chrome, the gentle hum of chain turret emplacements!

There's nowhere like Grit Gate in the whole of Qud, =player.formalAddressTerm=. I've journeyed in my comparatively short time, but I always return here. The very air buzzes with knowledge, as well as quite a few other things.
translation:
哎呀，这里可是砂砾门！哦，那穹顶大厅，那铬钢闪光，那链式炮塔阵地温柔的嗡鸣！

整个库德都没有别处像砂砾门这样，=player.formalAddressTerm=。我在自己相对短暂的岁月里也旅行过，但总会回到这里。连空气都因知识而嗡嗡作响，当然，也因不少别的东西。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'We are called the Urshiib, =player.formalAddressTerm=.\n\nOur kind are smarter than the average bear. Sharper, too, and a bit more handy.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Mafeo.AboutTheQuillbear.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
We are called the Urshiib, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

Our kind are smarter than the average bear. Sharper, too, and a bit more handy.
translation:
我们被称为乌尔希布，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

我们这种族比普通熊聪明。也更尖锐，还更灵巧一些。

source: Why did you come to Omonporch?
translation: 你们为什么来到奥蒙廊？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'To make preparations, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Barathrum instructed us here after you secured the grounds.'), ('Context', 'Conversation OmonporchBarathrumites.Spindle.Text')), 1),), '#text')

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Crowsong, Deathwonder, a colony of ants eating me, the leaves, the light, and there on.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Crowsong.Who.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Crowsong, Deathwonder, a colony of ants eating me, the leaves, the light, and there on.
translation: 鸦歌，死亡奇观，一群正在吃我的蚂蚁，叶子，光，还有那边。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Hiding, no. Being grass. The feeling of animate being. Radiate inward like a turned out star.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Crowsong.Hiding.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Hiding, no. Being grass. The feeling of animate being. Radiate inward like a turned out star.
translation: 躲藏，不。做草。有生命者的感觉。像翻出的星辰一样向内辐射。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Why are you here, in Kyakukya?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Crowsong.Hiding.KyakukyaChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Why are you here, in Kyakukya?
translation: 你为什么在这里，在克亚库克亚？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Death is the color of everything but sometimes it waves in bright ribbons, like here. The whittlers weigh their passing goods, and the walls are corpse eaters.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Crowsong.Kyakukya.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Death is the color of everything but sometimes it waves in bright ribbons, like here. The whittlers weigh their passing goods, and the walls are corpse eaters.
translation: 死亡是万物的颜色，但有时它会像这里一样，摇曳成明亮的缎带。削刻者称量他们转瞬即逝的货物，墙壁则吞食尸身。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Tugged from the claws of one who had become a cord in time's silly carpet. I outrooted the hilts and sheathed the blades, and now I am he. I still have the nail dirt."), ('Context', 'Conversation Crowsong.Swords.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Tugged from the claws of one who had become a cord in time's silly carpet. I outrooted the hilts and sheathed the blades, and now I am he. I still have the nail dirt.
translation: 从一位已成为时间愚蠢地毯上一根线的人爪中拽出。我连根拔起剑柄，收鞘刀刃，于是我现在就是他。我指甲里还留着泥。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "You're a member of the Consortium of Phyta, right? What do you know about the Earl of Omonporch?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Yurl.Welcome.AsphodelChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You're a member of the Consortium of Phyta, right? What do you know about the Earl of Omonporch?
translation: 你是植群商会的成员，对吧？你知道奥蒙廊伯爵的什么事？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "What are you? What's your story?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Yurl.Welcome.StoryChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: What are you? What's your story?
translation: 你是什么？你有什么故事？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I'm Yurl, chandler and Consortium notary. As for my story, I've been growing out of this pot for a while now. Before that, I was in another pot."), ('Context', 'Conversation Yurl.Story.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I'm Yurl, chandler and Consortium notary. As for my story, I've been growing out of this pot for a while now. Before that, I was in another pot.
translation: 我是尤尔，杂货商兼商会公证人。至于我的故事，我已经从这个盆里长出来有一阵子了。在那之前，我在另一个盆里。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Yes, the Consortium of Phyta. We're a merchant fellowship of trees, vines, shrubs, weeds, flowers, herbs, cacti, algae -- most sorts of plants, really.\n\nI can't say I trust any of them, but there is no doubting their usefulness. My shelves are full and the gossip flows."), ('Context', 'Conversation Yurl.Consortium.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Yes, the Consortium of Phyta. We're a merchant fellowship of trees, vines, shrubs, weeds, flowers, herbs, cacti, algae -- most sorts of plants, really.

I can't say I trust any of them, but there is no doubting their usefulness. My shelves are full and the gossip flows.
translation:
是的，植群商会。我们是树木、藤蔓、灌木、杂草、花卉、草本、仙人掌、藻类组成的商人同业会，说真的，差不多各种植物都有。

我不能说我信任其中任何一个，但它们的用处毋庸置疑。我的货架满满当当，闲话也流个不停。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*Yurl flicks a leaf in displeasure.*}}\n\nWhat about fungi?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Yurl.Fungi.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Yurl flicks a leaf in displeasure.*}}

What about fungi?
translation:
{{emote|*尤尔不悦地弹动一片叶子。*}}

真菌怎么了？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Are there any fungi in the Consortium?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Yurl.Fungi.Fungi2Choice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Are there any fungi in the Consortium?

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I am a gentleplant, -friend-. Uncross your roots and figure it out.\n\nLive and DRINK.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Yurl.But.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I am a gentleplant, -friend-. Uncross your roots and figure it out.

Live and DRINK.
translation:
我是个文雅植物，-朋友-。把你的根解开，自己想明白。

生而饮水。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Asphodel the socialite? Asphodel the scoundrel? You can hate xym -- and I do -- but you have to admire xym (I don't).\n\nThe truth of it is that Plysago had the idea first, to lay claim to the Spindle per some precedent of law established in Abram's time. Of course, Plysago isn't around to make their case, are they?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Yurl.Asphodel.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Asphodel the socialite? Asphodel the scoundrel? You can hate xym -- and I do -- but you have to admire xym (I don't).

The truth of it is that Plysago had the idea first, to lay claim to the Spindle per some precedent of law established in Abram's time. Of course, Plysago isn't around to make their case, are they?
translation:
阿斯福德尔，那个社交名流？阿斯福德尔，那个无赖？你可以憎恨 其，而我确实憎恨，但你不得不佩服 其（我不佩服）。

真相是普利萨戈先有了这个主意，想依据亚伯兰时代确立的某个法律先例，对纺柱提出权利主张。当然，普利萨戈如今不在这里陈述自己的理由了，不是吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'How can I convince Asphodel to lease the Spindle to Barathrum?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Yurl.Asphodel.LeaseChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: How can I convince Asphodel to lease the Spindle to Barathrum?
translation: 我怎样才能说服阿斯福德尔把纺柱租给巴拉瑟姆？

path:
((('string', (('ID', "Asphodel trades on reputation and favors. Xe is likely to want to leverage your connections, so be in good social standing with a few factions for xem to even consider it.

Now, alternatively, if you're loved by the Consortium, xe will feel the pressure to acquiesce. Xe has enough enemies among phyta.

Of course, where all else fails, you can always sharpen your shears, if you get my meaning.

{{emote|*Yurl winks with one of their leaves.*}}"), ('Context', 'Conversation Yurl.Lease.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Asphodel trades on reputation and favors. Xe is likely to want to leverage your connections, so be in good social standing with a few factions for xem to even consider it.

Now, alternatively, if you're loved by the Consortium, xe will feel the pressure to acquiesce. Xe has enough enemies among phyta.

Of course, where all else fails, you can always sharpen your shears, if you get my meaning.

{{emote|*Yurl winks with one of their leaves.*}}
translation:
阿斯福德尔靠名声和人情做买卖。其 很可能想利用你的人脉，所以你得和几个派系保持良好关系，其 才会考虑这件事。

另一个办法是，如果你深受商会喜爱，其 就会感到压力而不得不让步。其 在植群里已经有够多敌人了。

当然，若其他办法全都失败，你总还可以磨快你的修枝剪，如果你懂我的意思。

{{emote|*尤尔用一片叶子眨了眨眼。*}}

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I see. Live and drink, Yurl.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Yurl.Lease.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I see. Live and drink, Yurl.
translation: 我明白了。生而饮水，尤尔。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Be ape-still and muse, wanderer, and welcome to my village, Kyakukya. Have some mulled mushroom cider!'), ('Context', 'Conversation Nuntu.Welcome.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Be ape-still and muse, wanderer, and welcome to my village, Kyakukya. Have some mulled mushroom cider!
translation: 像猿一样静止并沉思吧，旅人，欢迎来到我的村庄克亚库克亚。来点热蘑菇苹果酒！

source: What can you tell me about Kyakukya?

source: Is there work to be found here?

source: Have you heard news of girshlings on Qud's surface? The watervine farmers of Joppa confirm it is true.
translation: 你听说库德地表出现吉尔什幼体的消息了吗？约帕的水藤农确认这是真的。

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'Ah, bad habit. It's a possessive feeling I should work to scrub myself of, perhaps?

But I am its mayor, and I have been for some time. You see, years ago I deserted my people. We were of two different minds -- they desired nothing but to bludgeon everything to death, while I asked, "What is the nature of this thing we bludgeon? Or of the act itself?"

Recognizing that my answers lay elsewhere, I cast myself into the swell of the wilds, as a sailor from Perth with no windweird casts their ship to the whims of the Pale Sea!'), ('Context', 'Conversation Nuntu.Village.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Ah, bad habit. It's a possessive feeling I should work to scrub myself of, perhaps?

But I am its mayor, and I have been for some time. You see, years ago I deserted my people. We were of two different minds -- they desired nothing but to bludgeon everything to death, while I asked, "What is the nature of this thing we bludgeon? Or of the act itself?"

Recognizing that my answers lay elsewhere, I cast myself into the swell of the wilds, as a sailor from Perth with no windweird casts their ship to the whims of the Pale Sea!
translation:
啊，坏习惯。也许我该努力洗去这种占有欲？

但我是它的村长，而且已经当了一段时间。你看，多年前我离开了自己的族人。我们心思各异——他们只想把一切都敲打至死，而我则问：“我们所敲打之物的本质是什么？这个行为本身的本质又是什么？”

意识到答案在别处之后，我便把自己投入荒野的涌浪，就像一名没有风怪的珀斯水手，把船交给苍白海的任性！

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Some years later and twenty ago, I came upon these mushrooms huts and their goodly inhabitants. They are a people full of earthen poetry, and I was charmed by the warmth they welcomed me with. Surely, I owed my acceptance at first to the countenance I share with their mighty god, but they soon grew to love me, and I them. I've remained here ever since in contemplation of those questions that first stirred in me all those years ago."), ('Context', 'Conversation Nuntu.Village2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Some years later and twenty ago, I came upon these mushrooms huts and their goodly inhabitants. They are a people full of earthen poetry, and I was charmed by the warmth they welcomed me with. Surely, I owed my acceptance at first to the countenance I share with their mighty god, but they soon grew to love me, and I them. I've remained here ever since in contemplation of those questions that first stirred in me all those years ago.
translation: 又过了二十余年，我遇见了这些蘑菇小屋和其中善良的居民。他们是充满泥土诗意的族群，他们迎接我时的温暖令我着迷。当然，我最初能被接纳，是因为我与他们那位伟大神祇有着相似面貌，但他们很快便爱上了我，我也爱上了他们。从那以后，我一直留在这里，沉思许多年前最初在我心中萌动的那些问题。

path:
((('string', (('ID', "We're watered by the river spray -- we pluck the fruit of the wood, and we hunt. The worshippers of Oboroqoru whittle and brood, too. They will pay you no mind unless you ask of them. Here you can be with friends, or muse alone. 

If it's trade goods that interest you, take a gander at Yurl's wares in the northwest corner. The odd one Crowsong's, too, if you can scry them in the bush.

I must warn you, however; cast no villain's shadow on these grounds. Warden Indrix will be watching."), ('Context', 'Conversation Nuntu.Kyakukya.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
We're watered by the river spray -- we pluck the fruit of the wood, and we hunt. The worshippers of Oboroqoru whittle and brood, too. They will pay you no mind unless you ask of them. Here you can be with friends, or muse alone. 

If it's trade goods that interest you, take a gander at Yurl's wares in the northwest corner. The odd one Crowsong's, too, if you can scry them in the bush.

I must warn you, however; cast no villain's shadow on these grounds. Warden Indrix will be watching.
translation:
我们由河流飞沫浇灌——我们采摘林木的果实，也狩猎。奥博罗科鲁的崇拜者也削刻、沉思。除非你主动问起，他们不会理会你。在这里，你可以与朋友相伴，也可以独自沉思。

如果你感兴趣的是货物，可以去西北角看看尤尔的商品。还有古怪的鸦歌，如果你能在灌木里窥见他们的话。

不过我必须警告你，别让恶徒的影子落在这片土地上。守卫因德里克斯会看着。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Yurl is a harmless cucumber vine. They came to Kyakukya a few years ago after the last Consortium chandler, a wicked little hyacinth named Plysago, suffered something of an... accident. In Tarotep's defense, Plysago shouldn't have berated someone with claws so close in resemblance to pruning shears. At any length, Yurl stocks a plethora of goods; you will be satisfied with your visit."), ('Context', 'Conversation Nuntu.Yurl.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Yurl is a harmless cucumber vine. They came to Kyakukya a few years ago after the last Consortium chandler, a wicked little hyacinth named Plysago, suffered something of an... accident. In Tarotep's defense, Plysago shouldn't have berated someone with claws so close in resemblance to pruning shears. At any length, Yurl stocks a plethora of goods; you will be satisfied with your visit.
translation: 尤尔是一株无害的黄瓜藤。几年前，上一任商会杂货商，一株名叫普利萨戈的邪恶小风信子，遭遇了某种……意外，随后他们便来到克亚库克亚。替塔罗泰普说句公道话，普利萨戈不该责骂一个爪子看起来那么像修枝剪的人。总之，尤尔备有大量货物；你这趟去访会满意的。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Oh, another of our dwellers. I won't speak to what Crowsong's deal is. Best you find them and ask yourself."), ('Context', 'Conversation Nuntu.Crowsong.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Oh, another of our dwellers. I won't speak to what Crowsong's deal is. Best you find them and ask yourself.
translation: 哦，我们的另一位居民。鸦歌究竟是怎么回事，我不好说。最好你自己找到他们问问。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Warden Indrix is one of the most ferocious warriors I've ever met. Once upon a time, he and his brothers gorged themselves on the flesh of beasts by starlight, but now I count myself lucky to call him my warden. Some believe he is of sour kind, though I assure you, he's but a victim of his goatish nature."), ('Context', 'Conversation Nuntu.Indrix.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Warden Indrix is one of the most ferocious warriors I've ever met. Once upon a time, he and his brothers gorged themselves on the flesh of beasts by starlight, but now I count myself lucky to call him my warden. Some believe he is of sour kind, though I assure you, he's but a victim of his goatish nature.
translation: 守卫因德里克斯是我见过最凶猛的战士之一。从前，他和兄弟们曾在星光下狼吞虎咽地吞食野兽之肉，但如今能称他为我的守卫，我觉得自己很幸运。有些人认为他生性恶劣，不过我向你保证，他只是自己那山羊本性的受害者。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "A waterhand, you are? Speak to my friend and warden Indrix. You'll find him patrolling the village."), ('Context', 'Conversation Nuntu.Work.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: A waterhand, you are? Speak to my friend and warden Indrix. You'll find him patrolling the village.
translation: 你是水佣？去和我的朋友兼守卫因德里克斯谈谈吧。你会看到他在村里巡逻。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'As far west as Joppa, you say? Oh, grim! Yes, we found the remains of pale-things in the mouth of Svy. Does the Gyre widen again? Hrmmmm.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Nuntu.Joppa.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: As far west as Joppa, you say? Oh, grim! Yes, we found the remains of pale-things in the mouth of Svy. Does the Gyre widen again? Hrmmmm.
translation: 你说远到西边的约帕？哦，真阴沉！是的，我们在斯维之口发现了苍白之物的残骸。轮回又在扩张了吗？嗯嗯嗯。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I don't imagine you brought me this information merely to observe. Are you suggesting that these slynth might take up residence here in my village?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Nuntu.SlynthRequest.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I don't imagine you brought me this information merely to observe. Are you suggesting that these slynth might take up residence here in my village?
translation: 我想你把这个消息带给我，不只是为了让我旁观。你是在建议这些斯林斯可以在我的村庄里定居吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Coming from anyone else, =name=, I might refuse outright. Housing recently-sentient refugees is no mean favor, I think you'll agree. My people are slow to trust, as well, so I fear that the slynth may feel unwelcome for some time. But then, grafted branches grow the best starapples, do they not? Yes, your lilypad friends are welcome here if they wish."), ('Context', 'Conversation Nuntu.SlynthRequestAccept.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Coming from anyone else, =name=, I might refuse outright. Housing recently-sentient refugees is no mean favor, I think you'll agree. My people are slow to trust, as well, so I fear that the slynth may feel unwelcome for some time. But then, grafted branches grow the best starapples, do they not? Yes, your lilypad friends are welcome here if they wish.
translation: 若是别人来开口，=name=，我或许会直接拒绝。安置新近开智的难民可不是小小人情，我想你会同意。我的族人也很慢才会信任他者，所以我担心斯林斯会有一段时间觉得不受欢迎。不过话说回来，嫁接的枝条结出的星苹果最甜，不是吗？是的，只要你的睡莲叶朋友们愿意，他们在这里会受到欢迎。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Had I no responsibility to represent my people, I might accept out of the goodness of my own heart alone. Sadly, I do not consider my heart, or even my mind, to be more important than my duty. Perhaps if you were a more renowned figure among my people, I would reconsider.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Nuntu.SlynthRequestReject.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Had I no responsibility to represent my people, I might accept out of the goodness of my own heart alone. Sadly, I do not consider my heart, or even my mind, to be more important than my duty. Perhaps if you were a more renowned figure among my people, I would reconsider.
translation: 若我没有代表族人的责任，也许只凭自己内心的善意，我就会接受。遗憾的是，我并不认为自己的心，甚至自己的头脑，比职责更重要。也许如果你在我的族人中更有名望，我会重新考虑。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Have the slynth yet to choose a destination, =player.formalAddressTerm=?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Nuntu.SlynthAbout.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Have the slynth yet to choose a destination, =player.formalAddressTerm=?
translation: 斯林斯已经选择目的地了吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Never has Kyakukya seen such bustle. These slynth are seem to be as good citizens as any, but I am at my limit with the stress of keeping track of everything.\n\nPlease check in again after some time, when I have my wits about me once again.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Nuntu.SlynthArrived.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Never has Kyakukya seen such bustle. These slynth are seem to be as good citizens as any, but I am at my limit with the stress of keeping track of everything.

Please check in again after some time, when I have my wits about me once again.
translation:
克亚库克亚从未见过这样的忙乱。这些斯林斯看起来和任何人一样都能成为好村民，但光是要理清所有事情，就已经让我压力到了极限。

请过一段时间再来看看，等我重新找回清醒头脑之后。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Greetings once again, =name=. I am pleased to report that the settling-in of the slynth has gone well, more or less. The villagers are yet wary, but as some slynth have joined in the rituals and worship of Oboroqoru that wariness has waned somewhat.\n\nThey've settled in across the village over time. Crowsong has taught the basics of hunting to a select few, and I'll be teaching a cooking class once I can wrest aside the time."), ('Context', 'Conversation Nuntu.SlynthSettled.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Greetings once again, =name=. I am pleased to report that the settling-in of the slynth has gone well, more or less. The villagers are yet wary, but as some slynth have joined in the rituals and worship of Oboroqoru that wariness has waned somewhat.

They've settled in across the village over time. Crowsong has taught the basics of hunting to a select few, and I'll be teaching a cooking class once I can wrest aside the time.
translation:
再次问候，=name=。我很高兴地报告，斯林斯的安顿过程大体顺利。村民们仍有戒心，但随着一些斯林斯加入奥博罗科鲁的仪式和崇拜，这份戒心已经稍稍减退。

随着时间推移，他们已经在村庄各处安顿下来。鸦歌把狩猎基础教给了少数被选中的人，而我一旦能挤出时间，也会开一门烹饪课。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Be nimble, wayfarer. Take in a draught of cider before leaving.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Erah.Start.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Be nimble, wayfarer. Take in a draught of cider before leaving.
translation: 灵活些，旅人。离开前喝一口苹果酒。
为什么苹果酒里有块状物？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Is that a Naphtaali mask over there?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Erah.Start.MaskChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Is that a Naphtaali mask over there?
translation: 那边那是纳夫塔利面具吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I am called Erah. Branches part for you, =name=.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Erah.Introduce.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I am called Erah. Branches part for you, =name=.
translation: 我被称作埃拉。枝条为你分开，=name=。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "That'd be the mushrooms. Bit heartier, a-ye?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Erah.Cider.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: That'd be the mushrooms. Bit heartier, a-ye?
translation: 那是蘑菇。更厚实些，欸，是吧？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Why would you put mushrooms in cider?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Erah.Cider.MushroomsChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Why would you put mushrooms in cider?
translation: 你为什么要把蘑菇放进苹果酒？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Let us speak of something else.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Erah.Mask.SubjectChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Let us speak of something else.

path: ((('string', (('ID', "A-ye, quit. Lost most my minyan to goatfolk. The sower's eye fell upon us and so we fell too."), ('Context', 'Conversation Erah.Naphtaali.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: A-ye, quit. Lost most my minyan to goatfolk. The sower's eye fell upon us and so we fell too.
translation: 欸，是，退出了。我的祈祷团大多死于羊民之手。播种者的眼落在我们身上，于是我们也倒下了。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Let us speak of something else.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Erah.Naphtaali.SubjectChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Let us speak of something else.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'As the very canopy, they will.\n\nThank you.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Erah.Memories.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
As the very canopy, they will.

Thank you.
translation:
他们会的，如同这整片树冠。

谢谢。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Let us speak of something else.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Erah.Memories.SubjectChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Let us speak of something else.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Pilgrims, drawn together by need and awe and inspiration. Tinkers and sodders and guards and scouts, alloyed under the pressure of lifeswork.\n\nFamily, like.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Erah.Minyan.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Pilgrims, drawn together by need and awe and inspiration. Tinkers and sodders and guards and scouts, alloyed under the pressure of lifeswork.

Family, like.
translation:
朝圣者，被需要、敬畏和灵感牵引到一起。修匠、泥工、守卫和斥候，在终生事业的压力下熔铸成合金。

像家人。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Don't know. Wrecked? Fled?\n\nI crawled away, never looked back. That's the all of it."), ('Context', 'Conversation Erah.Godhed.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Don't know. Wrecked? Fled?

I crawled away, never looked back. That's the all of it.
translation:
不知道。毁了？逃了？

我爬走了，再没回头。就这些。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Aren't you supposed to be helping Barathrum in his study?"), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq.Welcome.BarathrumStudyChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Aren't you supposed to be helping Barathrum in his study?
translation: 你不是应该在巴拉瑟姆的书房里帮忙吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Why are you the color of coral? And why did the brick road outside only appear after I ate the Eater's fleshcap?"), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq.Welcome.ChoicePlace.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Why are you the color of coral? And why did the brick road outside only appear after I ate the Eater's fleshcap?
translation: 你为什么是珊瑚的颜色？还有，为什么外面的砖路只在我吃下吞噬者肉帽后才出现？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I'm here to collect a debt for the Barathrumites."), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq.Welcome.ChoicePresume.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I'm here to collect a debt for the Barathrumites.
translation: 我是来替巴拉瑟姆派讨债的。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Klanq distribute! Cannot kill Klanq in a way that matters.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq.Die.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Klanq distribute! Cannot kill Klanq in a way that matters.
translation: 克兰克分布！无法以有意义方式杀死克兰克。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Klanq want no visitors, so Klanq relocate workshop. Half dimension away. Tasties alter viewing plane.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq.Place.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Klanq want no visitors, so Klanq relocate workshop. Half dimension away. Tasties alter viewing plane.
translation: 克兰克不想要访客，所以克兰克搬走工坊。半个维度之外。好吃的改变观看平面。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Why do you owe... "prickles"... a debt?'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq.Presume.ChoicePrickles.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Why do you owe... "prickles"... a debt?

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Well, you can repay the debt now. Barathrum wants you to build something. A climber. He says only you can do it.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq.Presume.ChoiceQuest.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Well, you can repay the debt now. Barathrum wants you to build something. A climber. He says only you can do it.
translation: 好吧，你现在可以还债了。巴拉瑟姆想让你造个东西。一台攀登器。他说只有你能做到。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Klanq puff on prickles during lecture on light refraction. Prickles angry.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq.Light.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Klanq puff on prickles during lecture on light refraction. Prickles angry.
translation: 克兰克在光折射讲座上对刺刺喷孢。刺刺生气。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'But you owe Barathrum. He needs your help.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq.Quest.Quest2Choice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: But you owe Barathrum. He needs your help.
translation: 但你欠巴拉瑟姆。他需要你的帮助。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Is there anything I can do change your mind?'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq.Quest2.Quest3Choice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Is there anything I can do change your mind?
translation: 我能做什么让你改变主意吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Klanq got it! Klanq puff on you.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq.Quest4.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Klanq got it! Klanq puff on you.
translation: 克兰克想到了！克兰克向你喷孢。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Puff on yourself, mushroom. I'm leaving."), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq.Quest4.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Puff on yourself, mushroom. I'm leaving.
translation: 喷你自己吧，蘑菇。我要走了。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Klanq puff on you. You host Klanq. You spread Klanq for Klanq. Then your Klanq shrivels away.\n\nKlanq puff on you, then Klanq build jalopy.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq.Quest5.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Klanq puff on you. You host Klanq. You spread Klanq for Klanq. Then your Klanq shrivels away.

Klanq puff on you, then Klanq build jalopy.
translation:
克兰克向你喷孢。你寄宿克兰克。你为克兰克传播克兰克。然后你的克兰克枯萎。

克兰克向你喷孢，然后克兰克造破车。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Klanq puff on you! Klanq build jalopy.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq.Quest6.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Klanq puff on you! Klanq build jalopy.
translation: 克兰克向你喷孢！克兰克造破车。

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'Klanq puff on you...


..later. Now, Klanq pause puff for prickles favor.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq2.Welcome.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Klanq puff on you...


..later. Now, Klanq pause puff for prickles favor.
translation:
克兰克向你喷孢……


……以后。现在，克兰克暂停喷孢，为刺刺做人情。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I am ready for the Creature to be moulded and catalyzed.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq2.Welcome.BuildGolemChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I am ready for the Creature to be moulded and catalyzed.
translation: 我已经准备好让造物塑形并被催化。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Can you tell me about the components I must gather?'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq2.Welcome.GolemComponentQuestionsChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Can you tell me about the components I must gather?
translation: 你能告诉我必须收集哪些组件吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'What should I know about the Creature?'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq2.Welcome.GolemOtherQuestionsChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: What should I know about the Creature?
translation: 关于造物，我该知道什么？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Do you live in Grit Gate now?'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq2.Welcome.BarathrumsStudyChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Do you live in Grit Gate now?

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I would like to ask some questions about the large creature.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq2.Welcome.GolemOtherQuestionsChoice2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I would like to ask some questions about the large creature.
translation: 我想问些关于大型造物的问题。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Klanq distribute! Cannot kill Klanq in a way that matters.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq2.Die.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Klanq distribute! Cannot kill Klanq in a way that matters.
translation: 克兰克分布！无法以有意义方式杀死克兰克。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Materials ready? Circuits to solder. Klanq stir the soup?'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq2.BuildGolem.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Materials ready? Circuits to solder. Klanq stir the soup?
translation: 材料准备好？电路要焊。克兰克搅汤？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "You haven't provided the mound with all the necessary materials."), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq2.BuildGolem.GolemThreeDaysChoice.BuildGolem')), 1),), '#text')
source: You haven't provided the mound with all the necessary materials.
translation: 你还没有向土丘提供所有必要材料。

source: You don't have enough primordial soup.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Klanq stir! Come back three days and Creature arrive. Now, take operating manual.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq2.GolemThreeDays.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Klanq stir! Come back three days and Creature arrive. Now, take operating manual.
translation: 克兰克搅！三天回来，造物抵达。现在，拿操作手册。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Soup, body, catalyst, atzmus, armament, incantation, hamsa, power source, soup. Ask component!'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq2.GolemComponentQuestions.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Soup, body, catalyst, atzmus, armament, incantation, hamsa, power source, soup. Ask component!
translation: 汤、身体、催化剂、阿兹穆斯、武装、咒文、汉萨、动力源、汤。问组件！

source: Tell me about the power source.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Where do I place components once they are gathered?'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq2.GolemComponentQuestions.MoundChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Where do I place components once they are gathered?
translation: 组件收集好后，我要把它们放在哪里？

source: I have something else to ask.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Primordial soup 20 drams. Act as Creature circulatory liquid. Catalyzed and boom! Animating substance. Electromagnets induce sinusoidal flow.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq2.Soup.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Primordial soup 20 drams. Act as Creature circulatory liquid. Catalyzed and boom! Animating substance. Electromagnets induce sinusoidal flow.
translation: 原初汤 20 打兰。作为造物循环液。催化然后砰！活化物质。电磁体诱导正弦流动。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Body of creature friend to form Creature after. Must follow you and be experience. No worry, friend not consumed in creation.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq2.Body.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Body of creature friend to form Creature after. Must follow you and be experience. No worry, friend not consumed in creation.
translation: 生物朋友的身体，之后形成造物。必须跟随你，而且有经验。别担心，朋友不会在创造中被消耗。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Three dram of pure liquid to catalyze soup and circulate nutrient. Liquid choice alter sanguine mixture, change Creature.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq2.Catalyst.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Three dram of pure liquid to catalyze soup and circulate nutrient. Liquid choice alter sanguine mixture, change Creature.
translation: 三打兰纯净液体，用来催化汤并循环养分。液体选择改变血性混合物，改变造物。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Atzmus transcendental imprint of being. Pattern trait after creature part, crossed with Body.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq2.Atzmus.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Atzmus transcendental imprint of being. Pattern trait after creature part, crossed with Body.
translation: 阿兹穆斯是存在的超验印记。以生物部件为蓝本塑造特质，与身体交叉。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Zetachrome weapon. Attune Creature to the martial art and shape metachrome fist-types in the fashion after.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq2.Armament.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Zetachrome weapon. Attune Creature to the martial art and shape metachrome fist-types in the fashion after.
translation: 泽塔铬武器。使造物与武艺调谐，并依其样式塑造超铬拳型。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Words spoken from your experience and inscribed to form being-bond. First sounds heard in Creature's early dreambrain."), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq2.Incantation.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Words spoken from your experience and inscribed to form being-bond. First sounds heard in Creature's early dreambrain.
translation: 由你的经历说出并铭刻的话语，用以形成存在纽带。造物早期梦脑听见的第一批声音。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Chosen token to palm-solder and orient with object-meaning, 5 lbs. or less. Like others, choice alters Creature trait and behavior.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq2.Hamsa.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Chosen token to palm-solder and orient with object-meaning, 5 lbs. or less. Like others, choice alters Creature trait and behavior.
translation: 所选信物，用来掌焊并以物义定向，重量 5 磅或更少。和其他选择一样，它会改变造物特质和行为。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Ascending Creature need mightful battery with rare electromagnet shielding. Purple prickles make neutron cell with 3 flux drams, or must find different source.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq2.Power.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Ascending Creature need mightful battery with rare electromagnet shielding. Purple prickles make neutron cell with 3 flux drams, or must find different source.
translation: 升攀造物需要带稀有电磁屏蔽的强大电池。紫色刺刺能用 3 打兰通量造中子电池，或者必须找别的来源。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Interact with scrap-clay mound. Then chat Klanq to solder circuits and stir the soup.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq2.Mound.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Interact with scrap-clay mound. Then chat Klanq to solder circuits and stir the soup.
translation: 与废料黏土土丘互动。然后和克兰克说话，焊电路，搅汤。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I will bond with the Creature. How does this work?'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq2.GolemOtherQuestions.WorkChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I will bond with the Creature. How does this work?
translation: 我会与造物结下纽带。这要怎么运作？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I am bonded with the Creature. How does this work?'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq2.GolemOtherQuestions.WorkChoice2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I am bonded with the Creature. How does this work?
translation: 我已经与造物结下纽带。这要怎么运作？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Barathrum and I will ascend the Spindle inside the Creature?'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq2.GolemOtherQuestions.SpindleChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Barathrum and I will ascend the Spindle inside the Creature?
translation: 巴拉瑟姆和我会在造物体内升攀纺柱？

source: What if it's damaged or destroyed?
translation: 如果它受损或被毁怎么办？

source: I have something else to ask.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Creature follow you like friend. Also, can enter Creature and take control. One friend fit inside with you.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq2.Work.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Creature follow you like friend. Also, can enter Creature and take control. One friend fit inside with you.
translation: 造物像朋友一样跟随你。另外，可以进入造物并取得控制。一个朋友能和你一起装进去。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Creature is large creature, can only wear gigantic gear. Like kraken or saltback.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq2.Equip.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Creature is large creature, can only wear gigantic gear. Like kraken or saltback.
translation: 造物是大型生物，只能穿戴巨型装备。像海怪或盐背那样。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Prickles install reshaping nook in Court of Sultans at Omonporch. There, respackle Creature with one dram of sunslag. Or recall creature if lost.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq2.Damage.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Prickles install reshaping nook in Court of Sultans at Omonporch. There, respackle Creature with one dram of sunslag. Or recall creature if lost.
translation: 刺刺在奥蒙廊的苏丹庭院安装重塑角。在那里，用一打兰日渣重新填补造物。或者造物丢失时召回。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Yes! But before then, can walk around with creature. Talk, fight, sleep... the normal. Friend.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq2.Spindle.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Yes! But before then, can walk around with creature. Talk, fight, sleep... the normal. Friend.
translation: 是！但在那之前，可以和造物四处走。说话、战斗、睡觉……正常。朋友。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Klanq live! Tragedy of jalopy invite Klanq to dimcandlespace. Klanq soften stone floor with plushes, dust shelves of boring jars with happy and spores. Prickles look at it.'), ('Context', 'Conversation PaxKlanq2.BarathrumsStudy.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Klanq live! Tragedy of jalopy invite Klanq to dimcandlespace. Klanq soften stone floor with plushes, dust shelves of boring jars with happy and spores. Prickles look at it.
translation: 克兰克住！破车悲剧邀请克兰克到暗烛空间。克兰克用毛绒软化石地板，用快乐和孢子拂去无聊罐子架上的尘。刺刺看着它。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Impudent swine! You would bear that stygian charm in my presence?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Indrix.Start.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Impudent swine! You would bear that stygian charm in my presence?
translation: 无礼的猪猡！你竟敢在我面前带着那件幽冥护符？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I am in search of work.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Indrix.Start2.Raising1Choice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I am in search of work.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Is Mamon dead? Have you recovered the talisman?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Indrix.Start3.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Is Mamon dead? Have you recovered the talisman?
translation: 马蒙死了吗？你取回护符了吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Yes. Mamon is dead and I possess the prism.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Indrix.Start3.HasPrismChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Yes. Mamon is dead and I possess the prism.
translation: 是的。马蒙死了，棱镜在我手里。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Where will I find him again?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Indrix.Start3.RiverChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Where will I find him again?

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Speak nothing of that name to me. You are warned.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Indrix.PariahA.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Speak nothing of that name to me. You are warned.
translation: 别在我面前提那个名字。我警告过你了。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I must insist; why are you called "pariah"?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Indrix.PariahA.Pariah2Choice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I must insist; why are you called "pariah"?
translation: 我必须追问：为什么你被称作“弃民”？

source: I am in search of work.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Speak nothing of that name to me. You are warned.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Indrix.PariahB.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Speak nothing of that name to me. You are warned.
translation: 别在我面前提那个名字。我警告过你了。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I must insist; why are you called "pariah"?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Indrix.PariahB.Pariah2Choice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I must insist; why are you called "pariah"?
translation: 我必须追问：为什么你被称作“弃民”？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I will ravage your nubile heart!'), ('Context', 'Conversation Indrix.Pariah2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I will ravage your nubile heart!
translation: 我要撕碎你那初熟的心！

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Grrrraaaah! There is but one task I know to offer. It is most treacherous, and in all likelihood you will perish. Is your interest waned?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Indrix.Raising1.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Grrrraaaah! There is but one task I know to offer. It is most treacherous, and in all likelihood you will perish. Is your interest waned?
translation: 咕噜噜啊啊！我只知道一件可交付的任务。它极其险恶，而且你多半会死。你的兴趣减退了吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'There is a river just south of the village that runs an eastwardly course into the jungle. Along its bank lies a goatfolk village. There resides a mighty shaman, Mamon Souldrinker. He is in possession of a talisman of great power, an amaranthine prism that refracts the psyche of its handler in much the same way, as Mayor Nuntu has explained to me, a common prism refracts light. The thing is cursed, traveler. No man or goat may safely wield it for long. You must travel to the village and retrieve the prism from Mamon by any means necessary. Do you understand?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Indrix.Raising2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: There is a river just south of the village that runs an eastwardly course into the jungle. Along its bank lies a goatfolk village. There resides a mighty shaman, Mamon Souldrinker. He is in possession of a talisman of great power, an amaranthine prism that refracts the psyche of its handler in much the same way, as Mayor Nuntu has explained to me, a common prism refracts light. The thing is cursed, traveler. No man or goat may safely wield it for long. You must travel to the village and retrieve the prism from Mamon by any means necessary. Do you understand?
translation: 村庄正南有一条河，向东流入丛林。沿着河岸有一座羊民村庄。那里住着一位强大的萨满，马蒙·饮魂者。他拥有一件力量巨大的护符，一枚不凋棱镜；按照努恩图村长向我解释的说法，它会折射持有者的心魂，就像普通棱镜折射光线一样。那东西受了诅咒，旅人。无论人还是羊，都无法安全持有太久。你必须前往那座村庄，以任何必要手段从马蒙手中取回棱镜。你明白吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Why don't you retrieve it yourself?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Indrix.Raising2.Raising3aChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Why don't you retrieve it yourself?

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Yes. Is there anything else I should know?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Indrix.Raising2.Raising3bChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Yes. Is there anything else I should know?
translation: 明白。还有什么我该知道的吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Because, traveler, Mamon is my elder brother. He would discern my presence before I could strike.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Indrix.Raising3a.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Because, traveler, Mamon is my elder brother. He would discern my presence before I could strike.
translation: 因为，旅人，马蒙是我的兄长。我尚未出手，他就会察觉我的存在。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Is there anything else I should know?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Indrix.Raising3a.Raising3bChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Is there anything else I should know?
translation: 还有什么我该知道的吗？

path:
((('string', (('ID', "There is. Firstly, Mamon will likely have several goatfolk under his enthrallment, and they will protect him at all costs.

Secondly, take care to stay out of Mamon's reach, for his power is most potent when he may lay hands on you.

Finally, once you recover the prism, do not under any circumstances wield it. I needn't warn you of the consequences should you return to me bearing that charm.

That is all. Are you willing?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Indrix.Raising3b.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
There is. Firstly, Mamon will likely have several goatfolk under his enthrallment, and they will protect him at all costs.

Secondly, take care to stay out of Mamon's reach, for his power is most potent when he may lay hands on you.

Finally, once you recover the prism, do not under any circumstances wield it. I needn't warn you of the consequences should you return to me bearing that charm.

That is all. Are you willing?
translation:
有。首先，马蒙很可能奴役着几名羊民，他们会不惜一切代价保护他。

其次，小心别进入马蒙触手可及的范围，因为当他能把手放到你身上时，他的力量最为强大。

最后，一旦取回棱镜，无论如何都不要使用它。若你带着那护符回到我面前，我无需再警告你后果。

就这些。你愿意吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'No, I would risk too much.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Indrix.Raising3b.EndChoice2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: No, I would risk too much.

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Just south of the village, there's a river that runs an eastwardly course into the jungle. Follow it to the goatfolk village. There you will find Mamon."), ('Context', 'Conversation Indrix.River.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Just south of the village, there's a river that runs an eastwardly course into the jungle. Follow it to the goatfolk village. There you will find Mamon.
translation: 村庄正南有一条河，向东流入丛林。沿着它走到羊民村庄。你会在那里找到马蒙。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Is it so? Only a ferocious warrior could have slain Mamon. You must be such a warrior. Now hand over the prism and choose your reward.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Indrix.HasPrism.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Is it so? Only a ferocious warrior could have slain Mamon. You must be such a warrior. Now hand over the prism and choose your reward.
translation: 果真如此？只有凶猛的战士才能杀死马蒙。你必定就是这样的战士。现在交出棱镜，并选择你的奖赏。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '[Give the amaranthine prism to Warden Indrix]'), ('Context', 'Conversation Indrix.HasPrism.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: [Give the amaranthine prism to Warden Indrix]
translation: [将不凋棱镜交给守卫因德里克斯]

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'You! Are you come to attend his waking dream? Nor do I have cloven hooves, but, yes, a cloven mind.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Wild Water Merchant.Start.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You! Are you come to attend his waking dream? Nor do I have cloven hooves, but, yes, a cloven mind.
translation: 你！你是来参与他的醒梦的吗？我没有裂蹄，但，是的，我有一颗分裂的心智。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'What are you talking about?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Wild Water Merchant.Start.WhatChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
((('string', (('ID', 'I must talk with the shaman Mamon Souldrinker.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Wild Water Merchant.Start.MamonChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I must talk with the shaman Mamon Souldrinker.
translation: 我必须和萨满马蒙·饮魂者谈谈。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Who am I? Who are you? What does it matter? You and I are nothing, the most insignificant afterthoughts of an amaranthine shade.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Wild Water Merchant.Who.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Who am I? Who are you? What does it matter? You and I are nothing, the most insignificant afterthoughts of an amaranthine shade.
translation: 我是谁？你是谁？那有什么要紧？你我什么都不是，只是不凋幽影最微不足道的余念。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'What are you talking about?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Wild Water Merchant.Who.WhatChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
((('string', (('ID', 'I must talk with the shaman Mamon Souldrinker.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Wild Water Merchant.Who.MamonChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I must talk with the shaman Mamon Souldrinker.
translation: 我必须和萨满马蒙·饮魂者谈谈。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'The amaranthine dream! The heights within ourselves we might yet reach with his guidance. There it is in all of us -- shades of our elder selves. Within each man, a goat. Within each goat, a man!'), ('Context', 'Conversation Wild Water Merchant.What.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: The amaranthine dream! The heights within ourselves we might yet reach with his guidance. There it is in all of us -- shades of our elder selves. Within each man, a goat. Within each goat, a man!
translation: 不凋之梦！在他的指引下，我们或许还能抵达自身之内的高处。它就在我们所有人里面——我们更古老自我的影子。每个人之内都有一只羊。每只羊之内都有一个人！

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I must talk with the shaman Mamon Souldrinker.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Wild Water Merchant.What.MamonChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I must talk with the shaman Mamon Souldrinker.
translation: 我必须和萨满马蒙·饮魂者谈谈。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "You don't talk with that mangoat -- you listen to him."), ('Context', 'Conversation Wild Water Merchant.Mamon.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You don't talk with that mangoat -- you listen to him.
translation: 你不是和那个人羊谈话——你聆听他。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'What are you talking about?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Wild Water Merchant.Mamon.WhatChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')

source:
Liquids are better.

I prefer liquids.
translation:
液体更好。

我更喜欢液体。

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'A connoisseur of liquids. Sure, I dabble in other states of matter.

But I prefer the shifting and tumbling of angleless motion.

Not too hot, not too cold, not too indeterminate.'), ('Context', 'Conversation SusaAlchemist.Liquids.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
A connoisseur of liquids. Sure, I dabble in other states of matter.

But I prefer the shifting and tumbling of angleless motion.

Not too hot, not too cold, not too indeterminate.
translation:
液体鉴赏家。当然，我也涉猎其他物态。

但我更喜欢无角运动的变换与翻滚。

不太热，不太冷，也不太不确定。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Welcome to Omonporch, traveler. Enjoy your visit to my earldom. Feast your eyes upon my tall and glorious Spindle. Take in the scent of roasted musa.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Asphodel.Start.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Welcome to Omonporch, traveler. Enjoy your visit to my earldom. Feast your eyes upon my tall and glorious Spindle. Take in the scent of roasted musa.
translation: 欢迎来到奥蒙廊，旅人。愿你享受造访我伯爵领的时光。尽情欣赏我高耸而荣光的纺柱。吸入烤芭蕉的香气吧。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Are you truly the Earl of Omonporch?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Asphodel.Start.WhyYours.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Are you truly the Earl of Omonporch?
translation: 你真的是奥蒙廊伯爵吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Earl Asphodel, the Barathrumites request your permission to lease control of the Spindle. Their inquiries into the past have led them here.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Asphodel.Start.NeedThisLand.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Earl Asphodel, the Barathrumites request your permission to lease control of the Spindle. Their inquiries into the past have led them here.
translation: 阿斯福德尔伯爵，巴拉瑟姆派请求你准许他们租用纺柱的控制权。他们对过去的探询把他们带到了这里。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Indubitably, for I've proclaimed it so! There was no Earl to tell me otherwise."), ('Context', 'Conversation Asphodel.Yours.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Indubitably, for I've proclaimed it so! There was no Earl to tell me otherwise.
translation: 毫无疑问，因为我已经如此宣告！没有别的伯爵能告诉我并非如此。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Lease control of my Spindle, you say? Well, well... That's a colossal request. There's no simple price I can assign to such a thing. Were I to grant such a request, you would owe me a great debt. You and several of your allies."), ('Context', 'Conversation Asphodel.Lease.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Lease control of my Spindle, you say? Well, well... That's a colossal request. There's no simple price I can assign to such a thing. Were I to grant such a request, you would owe me a great debt. You and several of your allies.
translation: 你说租用我的纺柱控制权？嗯，嗯……这是个庞大的请求。这种事我可没法标一个简单价格。若我要准许这样的请求，你会欠我一大笔债。你和你的几位盟友都是。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'So you say. How can I appease you?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Asphodel.Lease.CouncilChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: So you say. How can I appease you?
translation: 既然你这么说。我该如何安抚你？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I will convene a council. The First Council of Omonporch. Send word to four of your allied factions. Have them send delegates. Together, perhaps, you can appease me.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Asphodel.Council.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I will convene a council. The First Council of Omonporch. Send word to four of your allied factions. Have them send delegates. Together, perhaps, you can appease me.
translation: 我会召集一场议会。奥蒙廊第一议会。给你的四个盟友派系传话，让他们派遣代表。你们合力，也许能安抚我。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Hear me, Asphodel. I am a dear friend to the Consortium. I ask that you reconsider.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Asphodel.Council.LovedChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Hear me, Asphodel. I am a dear friend to the Consortium. I ask that you reconsider.
translation: 听我说，阿斯福德尔。我是商会的亲密朋友。我请求你重新考虑。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Convene the council, then. I am willing.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Asphodel.Council.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Convene the council, then. I am willing.
translation: 那就召集议会吧。我愿意。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Not today, Asphodel. Live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Asphodel.Council.EndChoice2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Not today, Asphodel. Live and drink.
translation: 今天不行，阿斯福德尔。生而饮水。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Oh... oh! It's you! You are a dear friend, indeed. Of course, of course! You and your bear friends are most welcome to my Spindle."), ('Context', 'Conversation Asphodel.Loved.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Oh... oh! It's you! You are a dear friend, indeed. Of course, of course! You and your bear friends are most welcome to my Spindle.
translation: 哦……哦！是你！你确实是亲密朋友。当然，当然！你和你的熊朋友们非常欢迎来到我的纺柱。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'You are kind, Earl Asphodel. You have my thanks.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Asphodel.Loved.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You are kind, Earl Asphodel. You have my thanks.
translation: 你真仁慈，阿斯福德尔伯爵。多谢你。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Greetings, my viceroy. Sit your rump on a cushion or lie your long back on a kline. Soak in the natural light.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Asphodel.Start2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Greetings, my viceroy. Sit your rump on a cushion or lie your long back on a kline. Soak in the natural light.
translation: 问候你，我的总督。把你的屁股坐到软垫上，或把你的长背躺到克林卧榻上。沐浴自然光吧。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "That's right. I've leased your friends the Spindlegrounds and appointed you viceroy to oversee their operation.\n\nWelcome to court, asphodelyte. You serve at my pleasure."), ('Context', 'Conversation Asphodel.Viceroy.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
That's right. I've leased your friends the Spindlegrounds and appointed you viceroy to oversee their operation.

Welcome to court, asphodelyte. You serve at my pleasure.
translation:
正是。我已将纺柱地租给你的朋友们，并任命你为总督，监督他们的运作。

欢迎入廷，阿斯福德尔侍从。你按我的意愿效劳。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Live and drink, kendren. I am Hindriarch Keh; welcome to Bey Lah.\n\nIt's nearly unprecedented for one such as you to pass by our scouts unaccosted, but these are unprecedented circumstances. I have a task for you. Are you interested?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Start.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Live and drink, kendren. I am Hindriarch Keh; welcome to Bey Lah.

It's nearly unprecedented for one such as you to pass by our scouts unaccosted, but these are unprecedented circumstances. I have a task for you. Are you interested?
translation:
生而饮水，肯德伦。我是欣德族女族长凯；欢迎来到贝拉。

像你这样的人能不受阻拦地经过我们的斥候，几乎没有先例，但现在也是前所未有的情势。我有一件任务交给你。你有兴趣吗？

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'Good.

We hindren are a close-knit and staid people, and our safety depends on our solidarity. In order to preserve our safety and culture, we ask that any of our number who leave us never come back. Recently, one such exile took the treasure of our village, a bracelet named Kindrish, with her when she left. None of our number can leave to get it back, or it will be a violation of the values that I have guarded, and the Hindriarchs before me, for countless generations.

Will you help us recover our treasure? We have a small cache of valuables we can offer as a reward.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Yes. Go on..Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Good.

We hindren are a close-knit and staid people, and our safety depends on our solidarity. In order to preserve our safety and culture, we ask that any of our number who leave us never come back. Recently, one such exile took the treasure of our village, a bracelet named Kindrish, with her when she left. None of our number can leave to get it back, or it will be a violation of the values that I have guarded, and the Hindriarchs before me, for countless generations.

Will you help us recover our treasure? We have a small cache of valuables we can offer as a reward.
translation:
很好。

我们欣德伦是紧密而稳重的族群，我们的安全依赖于团结。为了保存我们的安全与文化，我们要求任何离开我们的人永不回来。最近，一名这样的流放者离开时带走了我们村庄的宝物，一只名为金德里什的手镯。我们之中无人能离开去取回它，否则就会违背我以及我之前无数代欣德族女族长所守护的价值。

你愿意帮我们找回宝物吗？我们有一小批贵重物可以作为报酬。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "All right. I'll find your treasure."), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Yes. Go on..AcceptChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: All right. I'll find your treasure.
translation: 好。我会找到你们的宝物。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "No thank you. I don't care for this job."), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Yes. Go on..No.Choice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: No thank you. I don't care for this job.
translation: 不，谢谢。我不喜欢这份差事。

path:
((('string', (('ID', "Excellent. I will do my best to reward you to your satisfaction.

Though her name is sand in my mouth now, the exile who stole Kindrish is called Eskhind. She left a few weeks ago, and took her sister and brother with her. I don't know where she's gone, but Warden Neelahind might, as they were close friends as children.

Find the exile called Eskhind and retrieve Kindrish from her, even... even if the cost is the life of her and her siblings. Kindrish has been handed down over countless generations, and it belongs to my people, not any individual. Go, kendren. Speak to Warden Neelahind, and find out where Eskhind is hidden."), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Accept.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Excellent. I will do my best to reward you to your satisfaction.

Though her name is sand in my mouth now, the exile who stole Kindrish is called Eskhind. She left a few weeks ago, and took her sister and brother with her. I don't know where she's gone, but Warden Neelahind might, as they were close friends as children.

Find the exile called Eskhind and retrieve Kindrish from her, even... even if the cost is the life of her and her siblings. Kindrish has been handed down over countless generations, and it belongs to my people, not any individual. Go, kendren. Speak to Warden Neelahind, and find out where Eskhind is hidden.
translation:
很好。我会尽力给你满意的报酬。

虽然如今她的名字在我口中如同沙砾，偷走金德里什的流放者名叫埃斯欣德。她几周前离开，还带走了她的姐妹和兄弟。我不知道她去了哪里，但守卫尼拉欣德也许知道，因为她们小时候曾是亲密朋友。

找到名叫埃斯欣德的流放者，从她手中取回金德里什，即便……即便代价是她和她手足的性命。金德里什已经传承了无数代，它属于我的族人，而非任何个人。去吧，肯德伦。和守卫尼拉欣德谈谈，查出埃斯欣德藏在哪里。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Then I will thank you to leave as quickly as possible. I don't want the faundren to become used to our borders being permeable."), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.No..Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Then I will thank you to leave as quickly as possible. I don't want the faundren to become used to our borders being permeable.
translation: 那我会感谢你尽快离开。我不希望幼欣德伦习惯于我们的边界可以被穿过。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'As you say. Live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.No..EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: As you say. Live and drink.

path: ((('string', (('ID', "You've found our treasure? I'll admit, kendren, I'm very impressed. Take this as thanks.\n\nThat said, the exile must answer for her crimes. There is further reward for you if you see this case through to the end."), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.KindrishReturnBefore.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
You've found our treasure? I'll admit, kendren, I'm very impressed. Take this as thanks.

That said, the exile must answer for her crimes. There is further reward for you if you see this case through to the end.
translation:
你找到了我们的宝物？我承认，肯德伦，我非常佩服。收下这个作为谢礼。

话虽如此，流放者必须为她的罪行负责。如果你把这案子查到底，还有额外报酬给你。
生而饮水，欣德族女族长。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "You've found our treasure? I'll admit, kendren, I'm very impressed.\n\nTake this as thanks, and... well. I suppose you've earned your stay for a while. Just try not to give the faundren any ideas."), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.KindrishReturnAfter.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
You've found our treasure? I'll admit, kendren, I'm very impressed.

Take this as thanks, and... well. I suppose you've earned your stay for a while. Just try not to give the faundren any ideas.
translation:
你找到了我们的宝物？我承认，肯德伦，我非常佩服。

收下这个作为谢礼，而且……好吧。我想你已经赢得了在这里停留一阵的资格。只是尽量别让幼欣德伦产生什么想法。
生而饮水，欣德族女族长。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "You're back. Have you found the exile and retrieved our treasure?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Start2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You're back. Have you found the exile and retrieved our treasure?
translation: 你回来了。你找到流放者并取回我们的宝物了吗？

source: I have found Kindrish, but not Eskhind.
translation: 我找到了金德里什，但没找到埃斯欣德。

source: Eskhind is dead, but Kindrish was not on her body.
translation: 埃斯欣德死了，但金德里什不在她身上。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Perhaps you should get back to it rather than hanging around my village. Warden Neelahind may be able to help you.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.I have not..Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Perhaps you should get back to it rather than hanging around my village. Warden Neelahind may be able to help you.
translation: 也许你该继续办事，而不是在我的村庄里闲逛。守卫尼拉欣德或许能帮你。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'As you say. Live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.I have not..EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: As you say. Live and drink.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Ayvah. She must have sold it. Tell no one about this. Please understand that I cannot reward you, as you did not complete the task I asked of you.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Dead.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Ayvah. She must have sold it. Tell no one about this. Please understand that I cannot reward you, as you did not complete the task I asked of you.
translation: 艾瓦。她一定把它卖了。别把这事告诉任何人。请理解，我不能奖赏你，因为你没有完成我托付给你的任务。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Why is an exile standing in my village? Are you trying to play me for a fool?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Start3.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Why is an exile standing in my village? Are you trying to play me for a fool?
translation: 为什么一名流放者站在我的村庄里？你想把我当傻子耍吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Hindriarch, I have found Kindrish, but Eskhind did not have it.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Start3.KindrishReturnBeforeChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Hindriarch, I have found Kindrish, but Eskhind did not have it.
translation: 欣德族女族长，我找到了金德里什，但它不在埃斯欣德手里。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Eskhind claims to be wrongfully accused.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Start3.AccusedChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Eskhind claims to be wrongfully accused.
translation: 埃斯欣德声称自己遭到诬告。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'The pariah claims to be wrongfully accused, and you believe her?\n\nShe is obviously lying. Are all kendren so gullible?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Accused.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
The pariah claims to be wrongfully accused, and you believe her?

She is obviously lying. Are all kendren so gullible?
translation:
那个弃民声称自己遭到诬告，而你相信她？

她显然在撒谎。所有肯德伦都这么轻信吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'There is no proof that she is lying.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Accused.ProofChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: There is no proof that she is lying.
translation: 没有证据证明她在撒谎。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Fine! Go to the Warden, then, and have her solve this mystery.\n\nBut know this: until a thief is found and Kindrish is recovered, I cannot reward you. You get nothing. Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Proof.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Fine! Go to the Warden, then, and have her solve this mystery.

But know this: until a thief is found and Kindrish is recovered, I cannot reward you. You get nothing. Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
translation:
好！那就去找守卫，让她解开这个谜。

但你要明白：在找到窃贼并取回金德里什之前，我不能奖赏你。你什么都得不到。生而饮水，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Why are you speaking to me? You have work to do.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Start4.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Why are you speaking to me? You have work to do.
translation: 你为什么来和我说话？你还有事要做。
