source: Does this poem belong to you?

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Does this poem belong to you?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Kehstions.ShowSonnetChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Does this poem belong to you?

translation: 埃斯欣德为什么被流放？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Is Neelahind a good warden?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Kehstions.Neel before meChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
translation: 尼拉欣德是个好守卫吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Why did you tell me Eskhind had a brother?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Kehstions.No brotherChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Why did you tell me Eskhind had a brother?
translation: 你为什么告诉我埃斯欣德有个兄弟？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'She exiled herself by leaving Bey Lah. Our codes demand that no hindren who leaves us ever return.\n\nShe knew this, and still she chose to leave.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Eskxile.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
She exiled herself by leaving Bey Lah. Our codes demand that no hindren who leaves us ever return.

She knew this, and still she chose to leave.
translation:
她离开贝拉，便是自我流放。我们的准则要求任何离开我们的欣德伦永不回来。

她知道这一点，却仍选择离开。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Kesehind is a good boy. He lost his parents long ago, but has been like a son to me.\n\nNow his axe-arm is strong where mine is not, and so he lends it.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Kesehind you.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Kesehind is a good boy. He lost his parents long ago, but has been like a son to me.

Now his axe-arm is strong where mine is not, and so he lends it.
translation:
凯瑟欣德是个好孩子。他很久以前失去了父母，但一直像我的儿子一样。

如今他的持斧之臂强壮，而我的不够强，所以他把它借给我。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I see. Live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Kesehind you.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')

((('string', (('ID', "Warden Neelahind attends to her duties admirably. She is not terribly assertive, but she need not be.\n\nI'm surprised she's going along with this outsider-led investigation, but she always had a soft spot for the exile."), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Neel before me.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Warden Neelahind attends to her duties admirably. She is not terribly assertive, but she need not be.

I'm surprised she's going along with this outsider-led investigation, but she always had a soft spot for the exile.
translation:
守卫尼拉欣德履行职责的样子令人钦佩。她不算特别强硬，但她也不必如此。

我很惊讶她会配合这场由外人主导的调查，不过她一直对那名流放者有些心软。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I have further questions.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Neel before me.KehstionsChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
((('string', (('ID', 'I see. Live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Neel before me.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')

((('string', (('ID', "If you ask the exile, I'm sure she'll spin some kind of accusation that I believe gender to be an immutable prison, that I impose it on others.

She's lying. Our people have a long history of two-gender hindren called {{w|hartind}}, respected and consecrated. There is a proper path to gender variance in our society, of which the male exile could have availed himself years ago.

He never did, so I do not recognize him."), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.No brother.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
If you ask the exile, I'm sure she'll spin some kind of accusation that I believe gender to be an immutable prison, that I impose it on others.

She's lying. Our people have a long history of two-gender hindren called {{w|hartind}}, respected and consecrated. There is a proper path to gender variance in our society, of which the male exile could have availed himself years ago.

He never did, so I do not recognize him.
translation:
如果你问那名流放者，我肯定她会编出某种指控，说我相信性别是一座不可改变的牢笼，说我把它强加给别人。

她在撒谎。我们的族人有着悠久历史，尊重并圣化被称为 {{w|哈特欣德}} 的双性别欣德伦。在我们的社会中，性别差异有一条正当道路，那名男性流放者多年前本可利用它。

他从未这样做，所以我不承认他。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I... see. Live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.No brother.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')

((('string', (('ID', "Poem? I detest poetry. Why would one go about learning to write only to use purposefully unclear language, choosing rhyme scheme over clarity?\n\nOf course it's not mine. Take it back."), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.ShowSonnet.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Poem? I detest poetry. Why would one go about learning to write only to use purposefully unclear language, choosing rhyme scheme over clarity?

Of course it's not mine. Take it back.
translation:
诗？我厌恶诗。一个人为什么要费心学习书写，却只用故意不清不楚的语言，把押韵格式置于清晰之上？

当然不是我的。拿回去。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I have a terrible feeling that I've brought ill fortune to my village.\n\nPerhaps it was a mistake to have hired you."), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Start6.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I have a terrible feeling that I've brought ill fortune to my village.

Perhaps it was a mistake to have hired you.
translation:
我有一种可怕的感觉，是我给自己的村庄带来了厄运。

也许雇用你是个错误。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'If you say so. Live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Start6.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: If you say so. Live and drink.
translation: 既然你这么说。生而饮水。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'They conspired against me. It is the only explanation.\n\nYou! Leave me alone.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Start7.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
They conspired against me. It is the only explanation.

You! Leave me alone.
translation:
他们合谋反对我。这是唯一的解释。

你！别来烦我。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'You will find a way. Live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Start7.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You will find a way. Live and drink.
translation: 你会找到办法的。生而饮水。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I should have kept them apart.\n\nI should have kept all of you apart.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Start8.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I should have kept them apart.

I should have kept all of you apart.
translation:
我本该让他们分开的。

我本该让你们所有人都分开的。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'You will find a way. Live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Start8.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You will find a way. Live and drink.
translation: 你会找到办法的。生而饮水。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Ah, you again. I'd been doing so well at forgetting your countenance.\n\nLeave me be."), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Start9.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Ah, you again. I'd been doing so well at forgetting your countenance.

Leave me be.
translation:
啊，又是你。我本来都快顺利忘掉你的面容了。

别管我。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "You have a great deal of nerve to speak to me after what you've done."), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Start10.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You have a great deal of nerve to speak to me after what you've done.
translation: 做了那种事之后，你还敢来和我说话，胆子真大。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'You again?\n\nIt is only a matter of time until we are overtaken by hostile kendren. Your presence mocks our fate.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.MocksFate.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
You again?

It is only a matter of time until we are overtaken by hostile kendren. Your presence mocks our fate.
translation:
又是你？

我们被敌对肯德伦淹没只是时间问题。你的存在是在嘲弄我们的命运。
欣德族女族长，我找到了金德里什。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'You will find a way. Live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.MocksFate.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You will find a way. Live and drink.
translation: 你会找到办法的。生而饮水。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Some help you are! Now our village lacks a warden.\n\nHow are we to protect ourselves?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Start11.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Some help you are! Now our village lacks a warden.

How are we to protect ourselves?
translation:
你可真会帮忙！现在我们的村庄没有守卫了。

我们该如何保护自己？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'You will find a way. Live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Start11.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You will find a way. Live and drink.
translation: 你会找到办法的。生而饮水。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Ah, welcome back to the village, =name=. You won't be staying long, will you?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Start12.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Ah, welcome back to the village, =name=. You won't be staying long, will you?
translation: 啊，欢迎回到村庄，=name=。你不会待太久，对吧？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'While I appreciate your help, kendren, I would prefer that you not stay longer than you must.\n\nThe faundren might get ideas.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Keh.Start13.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
While I appreciate your help, kendren, I would prefer that you not stay longer than you must.

The faundren might get ideas.
translation:
虽然我感谢你的帮助，肯德伦，但我还是希望你不要停留得超过必要时间。

幼欣德伦可能会产生什么想法。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "{{emote|*The warden's gaze is distant.*}} Esk..."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Distant.Text')), 1),), '#text')
translation: {{emote|*守卫的目光遥远。*}} 埃斯克……

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Follow the road =EskhindRoadDirection= to find the hollow tree where Esk and I used to play.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Direct.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Follow the road =EskhindRoadDirection= to find the hollow tree where Esk and I used to play.
translation: 沿着 =EskhindRoadDirection= 的道路走，找到我和埃斯克过去玩耍的空心树。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "{{emote|*The warden is lost in rumination.*}} It can't be. It simply can't be."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Ruminating.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: {{emote|*The warden is lost in rumination.*}} It can't be. It simply can't be.
translation: {{emote|*守卫陷入反刍般的沉思。*}} 不可能。不可能的。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Kendren, do you... have any news of Eskhind, and Kindrish?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Dead.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Kendren, do you... have any news of Eskhind, and Kindrish?
translation: 肯德伦，你……有埃斯欣德和金德里什的消息吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Ah! Yes. My apologies, kendren. Live and drink. I am Neelahind, Warden of Bey Lah. How... may I help you?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Warden Neelahind?.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Ah! Yes. My apologies, kendren. Live and drink. I am Neelahind, Warden of Bey Lah. How... may I help you?
translation: 啊！是。抱歉，肯德伦。生而饮水。我是尼拉欣德，贝拉的守卫。我……能帮你什么？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Hindriarch Keh told me that you were once friends with Eskhind.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Warden Neelahind?.Friends with EskhindChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Hindriarch Keh told me that you were once friends with Eskhind.
translation: 欣德族女族长凯告诉我，你曾经和埃斯欣德是朋友。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "We were... yes. We were close.\n\nI can scarcely believe that she would be capable of doing such a thing. Stealing our greatest treasure? Eskhind wouldn't possibly... but if Grand-Doe says it, it must be so."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Friends with Eskhind.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
We were... yes. We were close.

I can scarcely believe that she would be capable of doing such a thing. Stealing our greatest treasure? Eskhind wouldn't possibly... but if Grand-Doe says it, it must be so.
translation:
我们曾经……是的。我们很亲近。

我几乎无法相信她会做出这种事。偷走我们最伟大的宝物？埃斯欣德不可能……但如果大母鹿这么说，那一定是真的。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Do you know where Eskhind and her siblings might have gone?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Friends with Eskhind.Where?Choice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Do you know where Eskhind and her siblings might have gone?
translation: 你知道埃斯欣德和她的手足可能去了哪里吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Is it possible that the Hindriarch is lying?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Friends with Eskhind.Hindriarch is lying?Choice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Is it possible that the Hindriarch is lying?
translation: 欣德族女族长有没有可能在撒谎？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Wh—no! No! What? No, that's not possible! Ayvah, what an absurd idea!"), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Hindriarch is lying?.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Wh—no! No! What? No, that's not possible! Ayvah, what an absurd idea!
translation: 什——不！不！什么？不，那不可能！艾瓦，多荒唐的想法！

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Do you know where Eskhind and her siblings might have gone?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Hindriarch is lying?.Where?Choice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Do you know where Eskhind and her siblings might have gone?
translation: 你知道埃斯欣德和她的手足可能去了哪里吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Grand-Doe speaks only truth! Grand-Doe only ever speaks truth!\n\nIt's not possible. She didn't lie."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Why not?.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Grand-Doe speaks only truth! Grand-Doe only ever speaks truth!

It's not possible. She didn't lie.
translation:
大母鹿只说真话！大母鹿从来只说真话！

不可能。她没有撒谎。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Anyone can lie.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Why not?.Anyone can lie.Choice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
((('string', (('ID', 'You ruminant people are impossible. I will find Eskhind myself.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Why not?.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You ruminant people are impossible. I will find Eskhind myself.
translation: 你们这些反刍人真没法沟通。我会自己去找埃斯欣德。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "No. It's not true, and I won't hear any more of your poisonous ideas, kendren. Consider the topic closed.\n\nDo you actually have a question?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Anyone can lie..Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
No. It's not true, and I won't hear any more of your poisonous ideas, kendren. Consider the topic closed.

Do you actually have a question?
translation:
不。那不是真的，我不想再听你这些有毒的想法了，肯德伦。这个话题到此为止。

你到底有没有真正的问题？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Do you know where Eskhind and her siblings might have gone?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Anyone can lie..Where?Choice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Do you know where Eskhind and her siblings might have gone?
translation: 你知道埃斯欣德和她的手足可能去了哪里吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Forget it. I don't need your help."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Anyone can lie..EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Forget it. I don't need your help.
translation: 算了。我不需要你的帮助。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Oh. Esk and I, we had a place... there's a path to the =EskhindRoadDirection= that leads to the remains of a lightning-struck tree, made hollow by the fire from above. It was the furthest from the village either of us had ever been, until I attended my first warden's moot.\n\nShe and I would spend time there, back then. Perhaps she is there now, but I don't dare check."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Where?.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Oh. Esk and I, we had a place... there's a path to the =EskhindRoadDirection= that leads to the remains of a lightning-struck tree, made hollow by the fire from above. It was the furthest from the village either of us had ever been, until I attended my first warden's moot.

She and I would spend time there, back then. Perhaps she is there now, but I don't dare check.
translation:
哦。埃斯克和我，我们有个地方……有一条通往 =EskhindRoadDirection= 的小路，会通到一棵遭雷击的树的残骸，来自天上的火把它烧成了空心。那是我们两人去过离村庄最远的地方，直到我参加第一次守卫会议为止。

那时候，她和我会在那里消磨时间。也许她现在就在那里，但我不敢去查看。

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'Oh.

Oh.

Did... you recover Kindrish?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Eskhind is dead..Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Oh.

Oh.

Did... you recover Kindrish?
translation:
哦。

哦。

你……取回金德里什了吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'No. She must have sold the artifact.'), ('Context', "Conversation Neelahind.Eskhind is dead..No. I'm sorry.Choice.Text")), 1),), '#text')
source: No. She must have sold the artifact.
translation: 没有。她一定把神器卖了。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'No. The Hindriarch lied to you.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Eskhind is dead..No. The Hindriarch lied to you.Choice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: No. The Hindriarch lied to you.
translation: 没有。欣德族女族长骗了你。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'No, this was for fun.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Eskhind is dead..No, this was for fun.Choice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
((('string', (('ID', "No. I'm sorry."), ('Context', "Conversation Neelahind.Eskhind is dead..No. I'm sorry.Choice2.Text")), 1),), '#text')
((('string', (('ID', "No... no, I can't... and the artifact is lost?\n\nIt was all for nothing... for nothing..."), ('Context', "Conversation Neelahind.No. I'm sorry..Text")), 1),), '#text')
source:
No... no, I can't... and the artifact is lost?

It was all for nothing... for nothing...
translation:
不……不，我不能……而且神器也丢了？

这一切都毫无意义……毫无意义……

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I will leave you to your grief. Live and drink.'), ('Context', "Conversation Neelahind.No. I'm sorry..EndChoice.Text")), 1),), '#text')
source: I will leave you to your grief. Live and drink.
translation: 我让你独自哀悼。生而饮水。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "No, it can't be... how. This place. This accursed village!\n\nThis whole village be damned!"), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.No. The Hindriarch lied to you..Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
No, it can't be... how. This place. This accursed village!

This whole village be damned!
translation:
不，不可能……怎么会。这个地方。这个受诅咒的村庄！

这整座村庄都该被诅咒！

path: ((('string', (('ID', '*back away slowly*'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.No. The Hindriarch lied to you..EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
((('string', (('ID', 'You monster! You monster! How dare you!'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.No, this was for fun..Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You monster! You monster! How dare you!
translation: 你这个怪物！你这个怪物！你怎么敢！

path: ((('string', (('ID', "You're next."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.No, this was for fun..EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')

((('string', (('ID', "Oh! Kendren, thank you, thank you! You've done so much for us. Here is a reward for your hard work.\n\nUm, that said, there's still the matter of finding out who stole our treasure. It'd mean a great deal if you could still help with the resolution of the case."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.KindrishReturn.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Oh! Kendren, thank you, thank you! You've done so much for us. Here is a reward for your hard work.

Um, that said, there's still the matter of finding out who stole our treasure. It'd mean a great deal if you could still help with the resolution of the case.
translation:
哦！肯德伦，谢谢你，谢谢你！你为我们做了这么多。这是你辛劳的报酬。

呃，话虽如此，仍然要查明是谁偷走了我们的宝物。如果你还能帮助解决这桩案子，那会意义重大。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Wh-what's going on? Esk is here, a-and Grand-Doe seems very upset.\n\nWould you please speak to her, kendren?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Start.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Wh-what's going on? Esk is here, a-and Grand-Doe seems very upset.

Would you please speak to her, kendren?
translation:
怎、怎么回事？埃斯克在这里，而、而且大母鹿看起来非常不安。

你能去和她谈谈吗，肯德伦？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Wait, why... why is Esk here? What's going on? Do you have Kindrish?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Start2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Wait, why... why is Esk here? What's going on? Do you have Kindrish?
translation: 等等，为什么……为什么埃斯克在这里？发生了什么？你拿到金德里什了吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Yes, I do, but Eskhind didn't have it."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Start2.KindrishReturnChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Yes, I do, but Eskhind didn't have it.
translation: 是的，我拿到了，但它不在埃斯欣德手里。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'No. Eskhind claims to be wrongfully accused.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Start2.No. Eskhind claims to be wrongfully accused.Choice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: No. Eskhind claims to be wrongfully accused.
translation: 没有。埃斯欣德声称自己遭到诬告。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Oh.\n\nBut... what now?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.No. Eskhind claims to be wrongfully accused..Text')), 1),), '#text')
translation:
哦。

可是……现在怎么办？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "You're the Warden. You tell me."), ('Context', "Conversation Neelahind.No. Eskhind claims to be wrongfully accused..You're the Warden. You tell me.Choice.Text")), 1),), '#text')
source: You're the Warden. You tell me.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'We will investigate and find the truth.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.No. Eskhind claims to be wrongfully accused..We will investigate and find the truth.Choice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: We will investigate and find the truth.
translation: 我们会调查并找出真相。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "You are useless. I'll get to the bottom of this."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.No. Eskhind claims to be wrongfully accused..EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You are useless. I'll get to the bottom of this.
translation: 你真没用。我会查个水落石出。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I... I don't know. Grand-doe usually resolves Bey Lah's disputes. I am present to defuse violence, or keep the peace through the threat of it.\n\nWhat do you think?"), ('Context', "Conversation Neelahind.You're the Warden. You tell me..Text")), 1),), '#text')
source:
I... I don't know. Grand-doe usually resolves Bey Lah's disputes. I am present to defuse violence, or keep the peace through the threat of it.

What do you think?
translation:
我……我不知道。贝拉的纠纷通常由大母鹿解决。我在场是为了化解暴力，或以暴力威慑来维持和平。

你怎么想？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'We will investigate and find the truth.'), ('Context', "Conversation Neelahind.You're the Warden. You tell me..We will investigate and find the truth.Choice.Text")), 1),), '#text')
source: We will investigate and find the truth.
translation: 我们会调查并找出真相。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "You are useless. I'll get to the bottom of this."), ('Context', "Conversation Neelahind.You're the Warden. You tell me..EndChoice.Text")), 1),), '#text')
source: You are useless. I'll get to the bottom of this.
translation: 你真没用。我会查个水落石出。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Oh. Well, yes, that's... that's a good idea. You'll help, right? My axe-arm and conviction are strong, but deduction has never been my greatest strength.\n\nI can answer questions about the people in town, if that would be helpful."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.We will investigate and find the truth..Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Oh. Well, yes, that's... that's a good idea. You'll help, right? My axe-arm and conviction are strong, but deduction has never been my greatest strength.

I can answer questions about the people in town, if that would be helpful.
translation:
哦。嗯，是的，那……那是个好主意。你会帮忙，对吧？我的持斧之臂和信念都很强，但推理从来不是我最擅长的事。

如果有帮助，我可以回答关于镇上居民的问题。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'It would. Could you answer some questions now?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.We will investigate and find the truth..Questioning NeelahindChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: It would. Could you answer some questions now?
translation: 会有帮助。你现在能回答几个问题吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I will return when I have questions... or an accusation.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.We will investigate and find the truth..EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I will return when I have questions... or an accusation.
translation: 等我有问题……或者有指控时，我会回来。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Ah, =name=, live and drink!\n\nHas your investigation reached a conclusion? Our fate is in your hands.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Fate.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Ah, =name=, live and drink!

Has your investigation reached a conclusion? Our fate is in your hands.
translation:
啊，=name=，生而饮水！

你的调查有结论了吗？我们的命运在你手中。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Not yet. How are you and Eskhind?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Fate.Neelahind is giddyChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Not yet. How are you and Eskhind?
translation: 还没有。你和埃斯欣德怎么样？
守卫，我找到了金德里什。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Yes, I am ready to accuse the thief.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Fate.KithAndKinCircumstanceChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Yes, I am ready to accuse the thief.
translation: 是的，我准备好指控窃贼了。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Not yet. May I ask you some questions?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Fate.Questioning NeelahindChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Not yet. May I ask you some questions?
translation: 还没有。我可以问你几个问题吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'No, I do not have enough evidence yet.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Fate.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: No, I do not have enough evidence yet.
translation: 没有，我还没有足够证据。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Oh, =name=! I'm so happy!\n\nI can scarcely believe she loves me, much less that... that we could be together. But it's true. Wherever we go from now on, we go together."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Neelahind is giddy.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Oh, =name=! I'm so happy!

I can scarcely believe she loves me, much less that... that we could be together. But it's true. Wherever we go from now on, we go together.
translation:
哦，=name=！我太高兴了！

我几乎不敢相信她爱我，更不敢相信……我们可以在一起。但这是真的。从今以后，无论去哪里，我们都一起去。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'May your journeys favor you. Live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Neelahind is giddy.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: May your journeys favor you. Live and drink.
translation: 愿旅途眷顾你们。生而饮水。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Oh dear, a mystery.\n\nPerhaps I should have accepted Angohind's lessons after all."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Start3.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Oh dear, a mystery.

Perhaps I should have accepted Angohind's lessons after all.
translation:
哎呀，一桩谜案。

也许我当初终究该接受安戈欣德的课程。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I believe this poem was meant for you.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Start3.SonnetOfferChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I believe this poem was meant for you.
translation: 我相信这首诗是写给你的。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'May I ask some questions about the suspects?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Start3.Questioning NeelahindChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: May I ask some questions about the suspects?
translation: 我可以问些关于嫌疑人的问题吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Patience, Warden. I'll get to the bottom of this."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Start3.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Patience, Warden. I'll get to the bottom of this.
translation: 耐心些，守卫。我会查个水落石出。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Live and drink, kendren. Have you... come to a conclusion?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Start4.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Live and drink, kendren. Have you... come to a conclusion?
translation: 生而饮水，肯德伦。你……得出结论了吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I believe this poem was meant for you.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Start4.SonnetOfferChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I believe this poem was meant for you.
translation: 我相信这首诗是写给你的。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Yes, I am ready to accuse the thief.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Start4.KithAndKinCircumstanceChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Yes, I am ready to accuse the thief.
translation: 是的，我准备好指控窃贼了。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Not yet. May I ask you some questions?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Start4.Questioning NeelahindChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Not yet. May I ask you some questions?
translation: 还没有。我可以问你几个问题吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'No, I do not have enough evidence yet.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Start4.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: No, I do not have enough evidence yet.
translation: 没有，我还没有足够证据。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I discovered a patch of watervine stained red with blood, a sign of recent violence.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.KithAndKinCircumstance.KithAndKinCircumstance.KithAndKinMotiveChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I discovered a patch of watervine stained red with blood, a sign of recent violence.
translation: 我发现一片被鲜血染红的水藤，这是近期暴力事件的迹象。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I'm still not completely certain. Let me ponder it more."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.KithAndKinCircumstance.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I'm still not completely certain. Let me ponder it more.
translation: 我还不是完全确定。让我再想想。

source: Signs of =circumstance.influence=, seemingly hidden from the village. But that can't be your only evidence, can it? There's no culprit!
translation: =circumstance.influence= 的迹象，似乎被瞒过了村庄。但那不可能是你唯一的证据，对吧？还没有罪犯！

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I'm afraid that well is poisoned due to your false accusation: =thief.name|strip= isn't the culprit."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.KithAndKinExclusion')), 1),), '#text')
source: I'm afraid that well is poisoned due to your false accusation: =thief.name|strip= isn't the culprit.
translation: 恐怕这条线已经被你的错误指控污染了：=thief.name|strip= 不是罪犯。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Hmm. But the only fur there was from a hindren's pelt, and kendren warriors fight to the death. With no corpse and no other fur, it seems unlikely that a hindren fought an outsider."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.KithAndKinExclusion.Clue_BloodyPatchOfFur')), 1),), '#text')
source: Hmm. But the only fur there was from a hindren's pelt, and kendren warriors fight to the death. With no corpse and no other fur, it seems unlikely that a hindren fought an outsider.
translation: 嗯。但那里唯一的毛来自欣德伦的毛皮，而肯德伦战士会战至死。既没有尸体，也没有其他毛发，欣德伦与外人交战的可能性似乎很低。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I'm afraid that makes no sense. Why would an outsider invite a trader to our village, when they could simply meet one outside of Bey Lah?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.KithAndKinExclusion.Clue_SawATrader')), 1),), '#text')
source: I'm afraid that makes no sense. Why would an outsider invite a trader to our village, when they could simply meet one outside of Bey Lah?
translation: 恐怕这说不通。一个外人明明可以在贝拉外面见商人，为什么还要邀请商人到我们的村庄里来？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "But weren't the rumors of sore throats in the village? That wouldn't have anything to do with kendren."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.KithAndKinExclusion.Clue_SoreThroats')), 1),), '#text')
source: But weren't the rumors of sore throats in the village? That wouldn't have anything to do with kendren.
translation: 但喉咙痛的传闻不是在村里吗？那和肯德伦没有关系。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Why wouldn't an outsider bring their own leather? It would better disguise Kindrish. It seems a lot of work to find and raid our leather stores."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.KithAndKinExclusion.Clue_LeatherGoneMissing')), 1),), '#text')
source: Why wouldn't an outsider bring their own leather? It would better disguise Kindrish. It seems a lot of work to find and raid our leather stores.
translation: 外人为什么不带自己的皮革？那样更能伪装金德里什。寻找并洗劫我们的皮革储藏处，未免太费工夫。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Bracers are a Bey Lah craft! It would make no sense for a kendren to have one, then throw it away in the village.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.KithAndKinExclusion.Clue_WornBracer')), 1),), '#text')
source: Bracers are a Bey Lah craft! It would make no sense for a kendren to have one, then throw it away in the village.
translation: 护腕是贝拉工艺！肯德伦拥有一只护腕，又把它丢在村里，这毫无道理。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Kesehind wields Ari, a battleaxe handed down through generations. It cannot break, and if it broke a weapon there would be scorch marks on it. This evidence does not hold up.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.KithAndKinExclusion.Clue_SplinteredWeaponHaft')), 1),), '#text')
source: Kesehind wields Ari, a battleaxe handed down through generations. It cannot break, and if it broke a weapon there would be scorch marks on it. This evidence does not hold up.
translation: 凯瑟欣德挥舞的是阿里，一把世代相传的战斧。它不会断裂，而且如果它打断了武器，那武器上会有焦痕。这项证据站不住脚。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "There are few voices as low as Kesehind's in our village. Witnesses report a higher-pitched voice, don't they? They would know if Kesehind were speaking."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.KithAndKinExclusion.Clue_TalkingLateAtNight')), 1),), '#text')
source: There are few voices as low as Kesehind's in our village. Witnesses report a higher-pitched voice, don't they? They would know if Kesehind were speaking.
translation: 我们村里很少有声音像凯瑟欣德那样低沉。目击者报告的是更尖的声音，不是吗？如果说话的是凯瑟欣德，他们会知道的。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Oh, no, that wouldn't be Kesehind. He'd sooner die of fever than choke down a single stem of yuckwheat."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.KithAndKinExclusion.Clue_YuckwheatChaff')), 1),), '#text')
source: Oh, no, that wouldn't be Kesehind. He'd sooner die of fever than choke down a single stem of yuckwheat.
translation: 哦，不，那不会是凯瑟欣德。他宁愿发烧而死，也不会强咽下一根恶心麦茎。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Oh, no, that wouldn't be Kesehind. He'd sooner die of fever than choke down a single stem of yuckwheat."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.KithAndKinExclusion.Clue_YuckwheatStench')), 1),), '#text')
source: Oh, no, that wouldn't be Kesehind. He'd sooner die of fever than choke down a single stem of yuckwheat.
translation: 哦，不，那不会是凯瑟欣德。他宁愿发烧而死，也不会强咽下一根恶心麦茎。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'That would be nigh unto impossible for Kesehind. He cannot perform fine tasks by torchlight; his night vision is too poor.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.KithAndKinExclusion.Clue_SoundOfToolsAtNight')), 1),), '#text')
source: That would be nigh unto impossible for Kesehind. He cannot perform fine tasks by torchlight; his night vision is too poor.
translation: 这对凯瑟欣德来说几乎不可能。他无法在火炬光下做精细活；他的夜视太差。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "No, that can't be it. Eskhind hates everything about watervine and keeps a wide berth from it. If her blood was spilled, it would have happened nearer to the path."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.KithAndKinExclusion.Clue_BloodyWatervine')), 1),), '#text')
source: No, that can't be it. Eskhind hates everything about watervine and keeps a wide berth from it. If her blood was spilled, it would have happened nearer to the path.
translation: 不，不可能是这样。埃斯欣德厌恶水藤的一切，并且总是远远避开。如果她流了血，那也会发生在更靠近道路的地方。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "No, no. Eskhind makes the most of what few possessions she keeps, and if she traded a treasure for so much water, she'd never have lost track of any."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.KithAndKinExclusion.Clue_BulgingWaterskin')), 1),), '#text')
source: No, no. Eskhind makes the most of what few possessions she keeps, and if she traded a treasure for so much water, she'd never have lost track of any.
translation: 不，不。埃斯欣德会充分利用自己保有的少数财物，如果她用宝物换了这么多水，就绝不会忘记其中任何一袋的去向。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Oh, no, Eskhind is deathly afraid of saltbacks. She would never get close enough to trade with a dromad merchent.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.KithAndKinExclusion.Clue_GreatSaltbackPrint')), 1),), '#text')
source: Oh, no, Eskhind is deathly afraid of saltbacks. She would never get close enough to trade with a dromad merchent.
translation: 哦，不，埃斯欣德极度害怕盐背。她绝不会靠近到足以和卓玛德商人交易。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I doubt it. If Eskhind were sick, the last place she would stumble to evacuate her guts would be a watervine field.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.KithAndKinExclusion.Clue_PoolOfPutrescence')), 1),), '#text')
source: I doubt it. If Eskhind were sick, the last place she would stumble to evacuate her guts would be a watervine field.
translation: 我怀疑不是。如果埃斯欣德生病了，她最不可能跌跌撞撞跑去排空肠胃的地方就是水藤田。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I'm afraid that Eskhind has no idea how to use proper leatherworking tools, much less pay for a set so fine. This surely isn't hers."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.KithAndKinExclusion.Clue_ForeignLeatherworkingTools')), 1),), '#text')
source: I'm afraid that Eskhind has no idea how to use proper leatherworking tools, much less pay for a set so fine. This surely isn't hers.
translation: 恐怕埃斯欣德根本不知道如何使用正规的皮革工具，更别说花钱买这么精良的一套。这肯定不是她的。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I know the rumor you mean, but villagers heard the clash of weapons. Keh is too old for a prolonged fight like that, so I do not believe it was her.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.KithAndKinExclusion.Clue_HeardFighting')), 1),), '#text')
source: I know the rumor you mean, but villagers heard the clash of weapons. Keh is too old for a prolonged fight like that, so I do not believe it was her.
translation: 我知道你说的是哪条传闻，但村民听见的是武器交击声。凯年纪太大，打不了那种持久战，所以我不认为是她。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Grand-Doe cannot swim, and panics even near the shallow pools of our paddies. I cannot imagine she would make splashing noises without adding screaming noises to them.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.KithAndKinExclusion.Clue_HeardLoudSplashing')), 1),), '#text')
source: Grand-Doe cannot swim, and panics even near the shallow pools of our paddies. I cannot imagine she would make splashing noises without adding screaming noises to them.
translation: 大母鹿不会游泳，甚至靠近我们稻田里的浅池都会惊慌。我无法想象她会弄出泼水声却不同时发出尖叫声。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Copper causes Grand-Doe to break out in great welts. She would not have traded for it, and if she saw a trader drop it, surely she would have told them to pick it up. She hates mess.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.KithAndKinExclusion.Clue_CopperNugget')), 1),), '#text')
source: Copper causes Grand-Doe to break out in great welts. She would not have traded for it, and if she saw a trader drop it, surely she would have told them to pick it up. She hates mess.
translation: 铜会让大母鹿起大片肿痕。她不会为了铜而交易，如果她看见商人掉下铜，肯定会让对方捡起来。她讨厌杂乱。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I cannot bring myself to believe that Grand-Doe would allow anyone to stumble upon her own severed tongue. She would surely burn it as soon as she saw it.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.KithAndKinExclusion.Clue_SeveredTongue')), 1),), '#text')
source: I cannot bring myself to believe that Grand-Doe would allow anyone to stumble upon her own severed tongue. She would surely burn it as soon as she saw it.
translation: 我无法相信大母鹿会让任何人偶然发现她自己被割下的舌头。她一看见它，肯定会立刻烧掉。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "No, Grand-Doe is absolutely meticulous about work clutter. She wouldn't leave scraps lying about."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.KithAndKinExclusion.Clue_LeatherScraps')), 1),), '#text')
source: No, Grand-Doe is absolutely meticulous about work clutter. She wouldn't leave scraps lying about.
translation: 不，大母鹿对工作杂物极其讲究。她不会把碎料随地乱放。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Oh. Yes, this does indicate that some kind of =motive.influence= transpired, and =thief.name|strip= was trying to hide it.\n\nSo what you're saying is...."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.KithAndKinAccusation.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Oh. Yes, this does indicate that some kind of =motive.influence= transpired, and =thief.name|strip= was trying to hide it.

So what you're saying is....
translation:
哦。是的，这确实表明发生过某种 =motive.influence=，而 =thief.name|strip= 试图掩盖它。

所以你的意思是……

path: ((('string', (('ID', "That's right. By concealing =all.influence=, it was =thief.name|strip= who stole Kindrish!"), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.KithAndKinAccusation.KithAndKinFinaleChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: That's right. By concealing =all.influence=, it was =thief.name|strip= who stole Kindrish!
translation: 没错。通过隐瞒 =all.influence=，偷走金德里什的人正是 =thief.name|strip=！

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I'm still not completely certain. Let me ponder it more."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.KithAndKinAccusation.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I'm still not completely certain. Let me ponder it more.
translation: 我还不是完全确定。让我再想想。

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'The evidence is clear. In violation of sacred law and the will of her people, Eskhind stole the artifact called Kindrish from Bey Lah. She will be stripped of honor, stripped of water, and stripped from our oral histories. Never will her name be spoken here again, and she will never return... on pain of death.

And I... I will go with her. May my property be payment for the harm she has done to our people, and I will gladly pay it for the privilege of walking by her side.

I have no doubt that Bey Lah will thrive in my absence as it did before I became warden. Live and drink, my kin. Long may Hindriarch Keh lead you.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.KithAndKinFinale.EskProsperousLove')), 1),), '#text')
source:
The evidence is clear. In violation of sacred law and the will of her people, Eskhind stole the artifact called Kindrish from Bey Lah. She will be stripped of honor, stripped of water, and stripped from our oral histories. Never will her name be spoken here again, and she will never return... on pain of death.

And I... I will go with her. May my property be payment for the harm she has done to our people, and I will gladly pay it for the privilege of walking by her side.

I have no doubt that Bey Lah will thrive in my absence as it did before I became warden. Live and drink, my kin. Long may Hindriarch Keh lead you.
translation:
证据清楚。埃斯欣德违背神圣律法和族人的意志，从贝拉偷走了名为金德里什的神器。她将被剥夺荣誉，剥夺饮水权，并从我们的口述史中剥除。她的名字永远不会再在这里被提起，她也永远不得回来……违者处死。

而我……我会和她一起走。愿我的财产作为她伤害我们族人的赔偿，而我会欣然付出这一切，只为获得走在她身旁的资格。

我毫不怀疑，贝拉会像我成为守卫之前那样，在我缺席时继续兴盛。生而饮水，我的亲族。愿欣德族女族长凯长久引领你们。

path:

She could never hope to repay the harm caused by her actions, but we will grant her this last mercy: Bey Lah will forget her debt alongside her name.

Just is the leadership of Hindriarch Keh. Long may she live!'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.KithAndKinFinale.EskProsperousNoLove')), 1),), '#text')

Just is the leadership of Hindriarch Keh. Long may she live!

欣德族女族长凯的领导是公正的。愿她长寿！

For me? Are you sure?

But... this is a poem. In Esk's handwriting. Are you s-sure this is for me?
translation:
给我的？你确定吗？

可是……这是一首诗。是埃斯克的笔迹。你、你确定这是给我的？

path:
((('string', (('ID', "Oh.

Ayvah, she-- Eskhind wrote this about... me? How my head swims at these lavish words. If she wrote this and meant it for me, she must... love me.

But it can't be. Can it?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.SonnetDelivered.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Oh.

Ayvah, she-- Eskhind wrote this about... me? How my head swims at these lavish words. If she wrote this and meant it for me, she must... love me.

But it can't be. Can it?
translation:
哦。

艾瓦，她——埃斯欣德写的是……我？这些华美的词句让我头晕目眩。如果她写下这些，并且是写给我的，她一定……爱我。

但这不可能。可能吗？

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'Kendren, you must understand. I spent so many years trying in vain to fall out of love with Eskhind. I thought it the only way to endure our adolescence, watching her poor attempts at courtship with other hindren.

I thought it the only way to endure her departure, as well. But she is returned, and she loves me. Ayvah. I am terrified to speak to her of this, but I must.

Thank you.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.NeelaLovesEsk.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Kendren, you must understand. I spent so many years trying in vain to fall out of love with Eskhind. I thought it the only way to endure our adolescence, watching her poor attempts at courtship with other hindren.

I thought it the only way to endure her departure, as well. But she is returned, and she loves me. Ayvah. I am terrified to speak to her of this, but I must.

Thank you.
translation:
肯德伦，你必须明白。我花了许多年徒劳地试图不再爱埃斯欣德。我以为这是忍受我们青春岁月的唯一办法，看着她笨拙地试图追求其他欣德伦。

我也以为这是忍受她离开的唯一办法。但她回来了，而且她爱我。艾瓦。我害怕极了，不敢和她谈这件事，但我必须谈。

谢谢你。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "No. You are the one investigating, so my bias need not enter play. If you determine that Eskhind is guilty, I will heed your word and carry out a just sentence.\n\nAfter that, I'm not sure."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Investigation.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
No. You are the one investigating, so my bias need not enter play. If you determine that Eskhind is guilty, I will heed your word and carry out a just sentence.

After that, I'm not sure.
translation:
不会。调查的人是你，所以我的偏见不必参与其中。如果你判定埃斯欣德有罪，我会听从你的话，执行公正的判决。

至于之后，我不确定。

path:
((('string', (('ID', "Keh is very wise and very careful, which makes up for her lack of strength or... tact. She always knows what's right, and she runs a very tight shift.

She hates clutter from work like nothing else and cleans up any mess she makes--unless it's a spill, then she makes Kesehind do it. It's because Grand-Doe has a terrible fear of standing pools of water, refusing to touch them. Copper and bronze afflict her with allergy-sores and she can't touch them. She's too old to spar with me, but her bow-arm still aims true.

That's all I can think of."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Neelahind on Keh.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Keh is very wise and very careful, which makes up for her lack of strength or... tact. She always knows what's right, and she runs a very tight shift.

She hates clutter from work like nothing else and cleans up any mess she makes--unless it's a spill, then she makes Kesehind do it. It's because Grand-Doe has a terrible fear of standing pools of water, refusing to touch them. Copper and bronze afflict her with allergy-sores and she can't touch them. She's too old to spar with me, but her bow-arm still aims true.

That's all I can think of.
translation:
凯非常睿智，也非常谨慎，这弥补了她力量上的不足，或者说……圆融上的不足。她总是知道什么是正确的，也把值守安排得极其严密。

她最讨厌工作留下的杂乱，会清理自己制造的一切脏乱——除非是洒出的液体，那时她会让凯瑟欣德去做。因为大母鹿非常害怕静止的水池，拒绝触碰它们。铜和青铜会让她起过敏疮，所以她碰不得。她年纪太大，不能和我对练，但她的持弓之臂仍然瞄得很准。

我能想到的就这些。

path:
((('string', (('ID', "Oh. She's, well, she's a good person with strong convictions, or has always seemed so. I suppose that isn't helpful.

Esk has a good eye for detail. She hates watervine so much that she avoids the paddies and won't eat matz without lah broth to make it taste better. Umm, she's afraid of saltbacks. She's good at foraging and terrible at crafting.

I've missed her so much."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Neelahind on Eskhind.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Oh. She's, well, she's a good person with strong convictions, or has always seemed so. I suppose that isn't helpful.

Esk has a good eye for detail. She hates watervine so much that she avoids the paddies and won't eat matz without lah broth to make it taste better. Umm, she's afraid of saltbacks. She's good at foraging and terrible at crafting.

I've missed her so much.
translation:
哦。她，嗯，她是个信念坚定的好人，或者一直看起来如此。我想这没什么帮助。

埃斯克很善于注意细节。她讨厌水藤到会避开水田，没有拉汤调味就不肯吃马茨。呃，她害怕盐背。她擅长采集，手工制作却糟透了。

我太想念她了。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Kesehind is completely loyal to Grand-Doe. We used to be friends, but his disposition has become so sour since he was appointed her protector, and he's quite cold to me now. He can't see well in darkness. He's the holder of Ari, an unbreakable heirloom fire axe, and he's very skilled with it.\n\nHe's terribly finicky about food. He'll only eat bland food and meat, and... oh! Once, when he had a bad cough as a faundren, a caretaker tried to feed him yuckwheat, and he kicked her so hard it dislocated her jaw. Poor Elder Eselhind."), ('Context', 'Conversation Neelahind.Neelahind on Kesehind.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Kesehind is completely loyal to Grand-Doe. We used to be friends, but his disposition has become so sour since he was appointed her protector, and he's quite cold to me now. He can't see well in darkness. He's the holder of Ari, an unbreakable heirloom fire axe, and he's very skilled with it.

He's terribly finicky about food. He'll only eat bland food and meat, and... oh! Once, when he had a bad cough as a faundren, a caretaker tried to feed him yuckwheat, and he kicked her so hard it dislocated her jaw. Poor Elder Eselhind.
translation:
凯瑟欣德完全忠于大母鹿。我们过去是朋友，但自从他被任命为她的保护者后，性情变得很阴郁，现在对我也相当冷淡。他在黑暗中看不清。他持有阿里，那是一把不可摧毁的传家火斧，他也非常擅长使用它。

他对食物极其挑剔。他只吃清淡食物和肉，而且……哦！有一次，他还是幼欣德伦、咳嗽得很厉害时，一名照料者试图喂他恶心麦，他一脚踢得她下巴脱臼。可怜的埃塞尔欣德长老。

I could have gone years unknowing that my love for her was returned. But this is her script, and these words describe me.

我本可能许多年都不知道，我对她的爱也得到了回应。但这是她的笔迹，而这些词写的是我。

艾瓦，我必须去和她谈谈！非常感谢你，肯德伦。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Thank you again for opening my eyes, kendren.\n\nI have trouble smiling for my grief, my loss. Thank you again for opening my eyes, kendren.

I have trouble smiling for my grief, my loss. Nonetheless, Eskhind and I have a brighter future because of you, and we are together. The road is hazardous, but we will walk it in time.

再次感谢你让我睁开眼睛，肯德伦。

因我的悲伤与失去，我很难微笑。尽管如此，因为你，埃斯欣德和我有了更明亮的未来，而且我们在一起。道路危险，但我们终会走下去。

Poetry. In the exile's handwriting. Extolling love for... me, or someone very like me.

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'She loved me.

source:
She loved me.

She loved me and I ... I exiled her. Oh, my heart.

Kendren I, I am grateful that you have opened my eyes to the truth, but how dearly I wish you had intervened earlier. This poem serves only as a harsh reminder that I must give up everything for my duty.

Please. Please leave me be. My heart... Esk, my heart...
translation:
她爱我。

她爱我，而我……我流放了她。哦，我的心。

肯德伦，我、我感激你让我看见真相，但我多么希望你能更早介入。这首诗只是一种严酷的提醒：我必须为了职责放弃一切。

求你。请别管我。我的心……埃斯克，我的心……

但如果这个想法来自你，他们至少可能会考虑把它付诸投票。如果你愿意稍候，我会召集一次公投。

((('string', (('ID', 'Rude? How dare--

source:
Rude? How dare--

No, I... I apologize for my rudeness. Please understand that we have lost so much by leaving Bey Lah. My mind is not in a gentle place, and being revisited by the tyranny I left behind is causing newly-closed wounds to open.

Forgive my tone, but please understand: I did not steal Kindrish. You are being used.
translation:
无礼？你怎么敢——

不，我……我为自己的无礼道歉。请理解，我们离开贝拉已经失去了太多。我的心境并不柔和，而我离开的暴政如今又来纠缠，让刚刚闭合的伤口重新裂开。

原谅我的语气，但请明白：我没有偷金德里什。你正在被利用。

((('string', (('ID', 'The proof is in the petals, kendren. You want justice? Find out what really happened.

If you find evidence, Warden Neelahind will support you. Speak to her. She is loyal to Grand-Doe, but more loyal to the truth.

I will return to the village and we will sort this out. The Hindriarch will have to tolerate my presence until my name is cleared.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Eskhind.What should I do?.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
The proof is in the petals, kendren. You want justice? Find out what really happened.

If you find evidence, Warden Neelahind will support you. Speak to her. She is loyal to Grand-Doe, but more loyal to the truth.

I will return to the village and we will sort this out. The Hindriarch will have to tolerate my presence until my name is cleared.
translation:
证明就在花瓣里，肯德伦。你想要正义？那就查明真正发生了什么。

如果你找到证据，守卫尼拉欣德会支持你。去和她谈谈。她忠于大母鹿，但更忠于真相。

我会回到村庄，我们会把这事理清。在洗清我的名字之前，欣德族女族长必须容忍我的存在。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Why? Why did I leave a single parasang square piece of land upon which I was expected to live my entire life, forever obeying a woman whose sole qualification of rule is her gender and age? Why did I leave a place where we eat the same damned soup for nine out of ten meals and the height of occupational versatility is leatherworking?\n\nThe question isn't why I left, it's why I'm the only one who chose to do so, why none of my pleas were convincing to the hindren I love. If we would just open the borders, it would never have come to this."), ('Context', 'Conversation Eskhind.Why.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Why? Why did I leave a single parasang square piece of land upon which I was expected to live my entire life, forever obeying a woman whose sole qualification of rule is her gender and age? Why did I leave a place where we eat the same damned soup for nine out of ten meals and the height of occupational versatility is leatherworking?

The question isn't why I left, it's why I'm the only one who chose to do so, why none of my pleas were convincing to the hindren I love. If we would just open the borders, it would never have come to this.
translation:
为什么？我为什么要离开一块方圆不过一帕拉桑、却被期望终生居住其上的土地，永远服从一个唯一统治资格只是性别和年龄的女人？我为什么要离开一个十顿饭里有九顿都吃同一种该死汤、职业多样性的顶峰就是皮革加工的地方？

问题不是我为什么离开，而是为什么我是唯一选择离开的人，为什么我的恳求没有一个能说服我所爱的欣德伦。如果我们愿意开放边界，事情永远不会走到这一步。

path:
((('string', (('ID', "The Hindriarch is the most likely suspect, in my opinion. She might have kept it for herself or sold it. I've been suspicious of her pet bodyguard, Kesehind, for years--I wouldn't put it past him to steal the treasure himself.

That said, it might have been an outsider like you. I doubt any of the villagers had the nerve to steal such a valuable object, but I suppose it's faintly possible.

But it wasn't Neelahind. You won't find a purer heart in all of Qud than hers."), ('Context', 'Conversation Eskhind.Who.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
The Hindriarch is the most likely suspect, in my opinion. She might have kept it for herself or sold it. I've been suspicious of her pet bodyguard, Kesehind, for years--I wouldn't put it past him to steal the treasure himself.

That said, it might have been an outsider like you. I doubt any of the villagers had the nerve to steal such a valuable object, but I suppose it's faintly possible.

But it wasn't Neelahind. You won't find a purer heart in all of Qud than hers.
translation:
在我看来，欣德族女族长是最可能的嫌疑人。她可能把它据为己有，也可能卖掉了。我多年来一直怀疑她那条宠物护卫凯瑟欣德——他亲手偷走宝物，我也不会惊讶。

话虽如此，也可能是像你这样的外来者。我怀疑村里没人有胆量偷这么贵重的东西，但我想也有那么一点可能。

但不是尼拉欣德。整个库德都找不到比她更纯净的心。

My heart quails in your hands, kendren.

你让我无计可施。那首诗是我对一项令我恐惧的深层真相的笨拙表达。那是一份我没有力量承担，也没有力量放弃的风险。

path:
((('string', (('ID', "No! Yes? I don't know.

Yes, I wish I burned it, but I wish I had given it. I wish I had never written it, or I had written it better, or I had simply confessed in person. I wish I had a harder heart.

I wish you would give it back, or burn it, or give it to her."), ('Context', 'Conversation Eskhind.SonnetBurn.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
No! Yes? I don't know.

Yes, I wish I burned it, but I wish I had given it. I wish I had never written it, or I had written it better, or I had simply confessed in person. I wish I had a harder heart.

I wish you would give it back, or burn it, or give it to her.
translation:
不！是吗？我不知道。

是的，我希望自己烧掉了它，但我也希望自己把它送出去了。我希望自己从未写过它，或者写得更好，或者干脆当面坦白。我希望自己有一颗更硬的心。

我希望你把它还给我，或者烧掉它，或者把它交给她。

Thank you again for bringing Neela around, and please forgive her reservation. She mourns the people she thought she knew, but our future will be brighter together.

肯德伦！很高兴见到你。

再次感谢你让尼拉回心转意，也请原谅她的保留。她正在哀悼那些她以为自己了解的族人，但我们的未来会因彼此相伴而更加明亮。

((('string', (('ID', 'I am afeared to even mention this notion to the villagers. Can you imagine my epitaph?

我甚至害怕向村民提起这个想法。你能想象我的墓志铭吗？

“这里安息着贝拉史上最年轻的欣德族女族长，她因提议邀请一支最容易被描述为‘长腿拉’的族群进入村庄而被踩死。”

如果他们更信任你，也许我们可以付诸投票。但现在这样？不行。抱歉，=name=。

path:
((('string', (('ID', "Never greater has been my desire to be voted out of office.

Room, board, assignments... it never occurred to me that immigration would require such intensive logistics."), ('Context', 'Conversation Eskhind.SlynthArrived.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Never greater has been my desire to be voted out of office.

Oh, not because of the slynth! Well, yes, because of the slynth, but it's because I'd rather be out there with them -- scouting, guarding, even tending to lah would be better than all this dry supervisory work.

Room, board, assignments... it never occurred to me that immigration would require such intensive logistics.
translation:
我从未如此希望自己被投票赶下台。

哦，不是因为斯林斯！好吧，确实因为他们，但那是因为我宁愿出去陪他们——侦察、守卫，甚至照料拉赫，都比这些枯燥的监督工作强。

住房、伙食、分工……我从没想过迁入新居民竟需要如此繁重的后勤安排。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Live and drink, =name=!\n\nAt long last I bear a lighter load of work coordinating our new family members. path:
((('string', (('ID', "Extremely frustrating! But I am yet hopeful.

Extremely frustrating! But I am yet hopeful.

My people are resistant to change, but they don't seem opposed to the idea of a Democracy. I need to give them a measure of time before we hold an election, but they'll ultimately agree as long as I am acting Hindriarch.

极其令人沮丧！但我仍怀有希望。

我的族人抗拒改变，但他们似乎并不反对民主的想法。在举行选举前，我需要给他们一些时间，但只要我仍是代理欣德族女族长，他们最终会同意的。

然后，如果命运愿意，他们会投票把我赶下台。我自己会投给伊萨欣德。等我说服她参选之后。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I can't help but wonder why you're telling me this in particular. I am not a mayor, nor even a citizen. source:
I can't help but wonder why you're telling me this in particular. I am not a mayor, nor even a citizen. I am a drifter, a pariah, and my 'people' are those who have no home anywhere else.

... and here I wonder a bit less. You're asking me to whisper into the winds on behalf of the slynth, aren't you?
translation:
我忍不住想，你为什么偏要把这事告诉我。我不是村长，甚至不是公民。我是漂泊者，是弃民，而我的“族人”是那些在别处都没有家的人。

……现在我没那么疑惑了。你是在请我替斯林斯向风中低语，对吧？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'What a strange fate, to pass from new sentience to outcast with no steps in between. Regardless, if it is their will and you vouch for them, that is enough for me. Tell the slynth that should they choose to wander, the wind will blow at their backs.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Lulihart.SlynthRequestAccept.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: What a strange fate, to pass from new sentience to outcast with no steps in between. Regardless, if it is their will and you vouch for them, that is enough for me. Tell the slynth that should they choose to wander, the wind will blow at their backs.
translation: 从新生意识直接成为流亡者，中间没有任何过渡，多么奇怪的命运。无论如何，如果这是他们的意愿，而你愿为他们担保，那对我就足够了。告诉斯林斯，如果他们选择漂泊，风会吹在他们背后。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'It is hardly so simple, =name=. We drifters hold no hierarchy. source: It is hardly so simple, =name=. We drifters hold no hierarchy. I can whisper all I like, but no winds will blow behind the slynth if your name cannot stir more than a breeze. Make yourself known to Pariahs and ask me again.
translation: 事情没那么简单，=name=。我们漂泊者没有层级。我可以随意低语，但如果你的名字只能搅起一缕微风，就不会有风吹在斯林斯背后。先让弃民们知道你，再来问我。

source:
New voices, strange and beautiful, carry on the salt breeze.

Some will no doubt be silenced by sun, blade, thirst, bullet, or glow, but they will not fall still alone.
translation:
新的声音，陌生而美丽，乘着盐风传来。

其中一些无疑会被烈日、刀刃、干渴、子弹或辉光止息，但他们不会孤独地倒下归静。

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'Live and drink, =name=.

Have you seen your slynth out there? My sources tell me that they are, for the most part, traveling well enough with others. They stop by my tent from time to time to visit and smoke with me, as you do.

One might assume they were born for this kind of life.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Lulihart.SlynthSettled.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Live and drink, =name=.

Have you seen your slynth out there? My sources tell me that they are, for the most part, traveling well enough with others. They stop by my tent from time to time to visit and smoke with me, as you do.

One might assume they were born for this kind of life.
translation:
生而饮水，=name=。

你见过外面的那些斯林斯了吗？我的消息源告诉我，他们大体上已经能和别人一起顺利旅行。他们时不时会来我的帐篷拜访，和我一起抽烟，就像你一样。

有人或许会以为他们天生就适合这种生活。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I see. In that case, rest and speak a bit with me, won't you? My worries can wait another day.\n\nThat said, if you change your mind, you'll come find me, won't you?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Lulihart.Refuse.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I see. In that case, rest and speak a bit with me, won't you? My worries can wait another day.

That said, if you change your mind, you'll come find me, won't you?
translation:
我明白了。既然如此，休息一下，和我说会儿话吧？我的忧虑可以再等一天。

话虽如此，如果你改变主意，会来找我的，对吧？

source:
Lovely. Take a seat. Chew the bark with me, and I will tell you what I know.

I've heard tell that my ancestral hometown, Bey Lah, is in some kind of trouble. They've opened their borders for the first time I know of and are specifically seeking to hire kendren -- that's their word for outsiders like you. Would you be willing to go see what they need?
translation:
很好。坐下吧。和我一起嚼嚼树皮，我会告诉你我知道的事。

我听说我的祖先故乡贝拉遇上了某种麻烦。据我所知，他们第一次开放了边界，并且专门想雇用肯德伦——那是他们对你这种外来者的称呼。你愿意去看看他们需要什么吗？

我从未靠近过我族人的土地一帕拉桑之内，但我确切知道那座曾经隐秘的村庄坐落何处。如果你同意考虑他们可能提出的任何请求，我会把这项知识分享给你。

I am not welcome in Bey Lah.

My blood is not pure, and I was not born in the meadow. These things make my name as salt in the mouths of true hindren.

They are misguided, but they are my misguided family. They stagnate as Qud changes around them. I worry.
translation:
贝拉不欢迎我。

我的血并不纯净，我也不是在草甸中出生。这些事让我的名字在真正欣德伦口中如同盐粒。

他们被误导了，但他们仍是我被误导的家人。当库德在他们周围改变时，他们停滞不前。我很担心。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Bless you, =player.formalAddressTerm=. I feel better knowing that at least one kendren will reach back to aid my kin. They are on the cusp of a new fate, and I wish to see it while I yet live.\n\nLet me advise you of Bey Lah's location, and here is a little chew-boon for your trouble."), ('Context', 'Conversation Lulihart.Very Well.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Bless you, =player.formalAddressTerm=. I feel better knowing that at least one kendren will reach back to aid my kin. They are on the cusp of a new fate, and I wish to see it while I yet live.

Let me advise you of Bey Lah's location, and here is a little chew-boon for your trouble.
translation:
祝福你，=player.formalAddressTerm=。知道至少有一名肯德伦会伸手帮助我的亲族，我感觉好些了。他们正站在新命运的边缘，而我希望趁自己还活着时看见它。

让我告诉你贝拉的位置，这里还有一点嚼恩果，算作给你添麻烦的谢礼。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Thank you, Lulihart. Live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Lulihart.Very Well.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Thank you, Lulihart. Live and drink.
translation: 谢谢你，卢利哈特。生而饮水。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I hear that Bey Lah's status is once again quo. I hoped for a measure more of change, but thousands of years of tradition do not give so easily.\n\nThank you for helping my foolish people."), ('Context', 'Conversation Lulihart.Start3.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I hear that Bey Lah's status is once again quo. I hoped for a measure more of change, but thousands of years of tradition do not give so easily.

Thank you for helping my foolish people.
translation:
我听说贝拉的现状又回到了现状。我本希望能多一点改变，但数千年的传统不会轻易退让。

谢谢你帮助我愚蠢的族人。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I've heard that the youngest Hindriarch in history now leads Bey Lah, and their warden aims to join the Quetzal Caucus. You've worked wonders, kendren.\n\nI can't wait to see what happens next."), ('Context', 'Conversation Lulihart.Start4.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I've heard that the youngest Hindriarch in history now leads Bey Lah, and their warden aims to join the Quetzal Caucus. You've worked wonders, kendren.

I can't wait to see what happens next.
translation:
我听说史上最年轻的欣德族女族长如今领导着贝拉，而他们的守卫打算加入羽蛇党团。你创造了奇迹，肯德伦。

我迫不及待想看接下来会发生什么。

path:
((('string', (('ID', "Every flame burns low one day, but the warmth of my people's story still carries me forward.

Bey Lah has not survived joining Qud, but the hindren live on, and our legacy will never be wholly lost.

I wonder what became of Kindrish."), ('Context', 'Conversation Lulihart.Start5.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Every flame burns low one day, but the warmth of my people's story still carries me forward.

Bey Lah has not survived joining Qud, but the hindren live on, and our legacy will never be wholly lost.

I wonder what became of Kindrish.
translation:
每团火焰终有一天都会低燃，但我族人故事的温暖仍会托着我前行。

贝拉没能在加入库德后存续，但欣德伦仍活着，我们的遗产永远不会完全失落。

我想知道金德里什后来怎样了。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Come smoke with me, friend. Set a spell.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Lulihart.Start6.Text')), 1),), '#text')

translation: 来和我抽一会儿烟吧，朋友。坐上一阵。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Poem? Oh! This is a Shakespriggan sonnet, but I didn't write it--the rhymes are a bit facile, and love poems don't interest me.\n\nI've been teaching Eskhind about sonnets, so she must have written this. But that means... oh, poor thing."), ('Context', 'Conversation Angohind.ShowSonnet.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Poem? Oh! This is a Shakespriggan sonnet, but I didn't write it--the rhymes are a bit facile, and love poems don't interest me.

I've been teaching Eskhind about sonnets, so she must have written this. But that means... oh, poor thing.

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*She gives you a hard stare.*}}\n\nI am a Daughter of Exile, but you should call me Yla Haj.'), ('Context', 'Conversation YlaHaj.Greet.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*She gives you a hard stare.*}}

I am a Daughter of Exile, but you should call me Yla Haj.
translation:
{{emote|*她冷冷地盯着你。*}}

我是流亡之女，但你该叫我伊拉·哈吉。

path:
((('string', (('ID', "Tinker-nuns. The world sees fit to call us that, my sisters and me.

Do you know the story told of Rebekah the Exile? She was a teacher to Resheph, but he excommunicated her from the sultanate and banished her from the realm.

To know her, I've chosen a life of unbelonging. And among my sisters, I have the honor of permanent residence by her gravesite.

I'll tell you this, traveler: the shape of a society is visible only from the outside, and there is peace beyond a boundary."), ('Context', 'Conversation YlaHaj.Daughter.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Tinker-nuns. The world sees fit to call us that, my sisters and me.

Do you know the story told of Rebekah the Exile? She was a teacher to Resheph, but he excommunicated her from the sultanate and banished her from the realm.

To know her, I've chosen a life of unbelonging. And among my sisters, I have the honor of permanent residence by her gravesite.

I'll tell you this, traveler: the shape of a society is visible only from the outside, and there is peace beyond a boundary.
translation:
修匠修女。世人觉得该这样称呼我们，称呼我和我的姐妹们。

你知道关于流亡者利百加的故事吗？她曾是瑞谢夫的老师，但他将她逐出苏丹国，也从疆域中放逐了她。

为了认识她，我选择了一种无所归属的生活。而在我的姐妹当中，我有幸能常驻在她的墓旁。

我告诉你吧，旅人：一个社会的形状，唯有从外部才能看清；界线之外，也有宁静。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Wasn't Rebekah a healer? Why are you an order of tinkers?"), ('Context', 'Conversation YlaHaj.Daughter.RebekahChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')

translation: 利百加不是医者吗？为什么你们会是修匠修会？

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*Yla Haj pauses.*}}\n\nYou presume too narrow a meaning of "health".'), ('Context', 'Conversation YlaHaj.Rebekah.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Yla Haj pauses.*}}

You presume too narrow a meaning of "health".
