{{emote|*伊拉·哈吉停顿了一下。*}}

你对“健康”一词的理解太狭窄了。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Ezra sits in the shadow of history, where small things grow. It's the moss beneath the statue, quite literally. For centuries monarchs concerned themselves with felling trees, and now of the Covenate only Ezra remains.\n\nIt's home to Rebekah's gravesite, so for the Daughters, it is a sacred place. You may notice more of us on pilgrimage."), ('Context', 'Conversation YlaHaj.Ezra.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Ezra sits in the shadow of history, where small things grow. It's the moss beneath the statue, quite literally. For centuries monarchs concerned themselves with felling trees, and now of the Covenate only Ezra remains.

It's home to Rebekah's gravesite, so for the Daughters, it is a sacred place. You may notice more of us on pilgrimage.
translation:
埃兹拉坐落在历史的阴影里，小事物在这里生长。它确确实实就是雕像脚下的苔藓。几个世纪以来，君王们只顾着砍伐树木，如今盟会时代只剩下埃兹拉。

这里是利百加墓地所在，所以对流亡之女而言，这是圣地。你也许会注意到更多前来朝圣的姐妹。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Zothom. I don't see utility in unkindness, but he's a fool. Were it that proximity to meekness made one meek...\n\nI have no use for a man who seeks salvation in the body of a dead woman."), ('Context', 'Conversation YlaHaj.Zothom.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Zothom. I don't see utility in unkindness, but he's a fool. Were it that proximity to meekness made one meek...

I have no use for a man who seeks salvation in the body of a dead woman.
translation:
佐索姆。我看不出刻薄有什么用，但他是个蠢人。要是靠近温顺之人就能让人变得温顺……

我用不着一个在死去女人的身体里寻找救赎的男人。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Live and drink, wayfarer.\n\nCause no strife here and we will have no quarrel.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Zothom.Start.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Live and drink, wayfarer.

Cause no strife here and we will have no quarrel.
translation:
生而饮水，路客。

不要在这里挑起纷争，我们便不会争执。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I am no one of any importance.\n\nBut my name is Zothom, and some call me the Penitent.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Zothom.ZothomGreets.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I am no one of any importance.

But my name is Zothom, and some call me the Penitent.
translation:
我不是任何重要人物。

但我的名字是佐索姆，有些人称我为忏悔者。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I am no Warden. My only fellowship is with my own shame.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Zothom.ZothomWarden.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I am no Warden. My only fellowship is with my own shame.
translation: 我不是守望者。我唯一的同伴是自己的羞愧。

source: My name is =name=. What is yours?

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I watch over the Grave of Rebekah to atone for my deeds, and to find my credo.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Zothom.ZothomWhat.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I watch over the Grave of Rebekah to atone for my deeds, and to find my credo.
translation: 我守望利百加之墓，以偿还我的所作所为，也为了寻找我的信条。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I was once a vile graverobber, the lowest of the low. Years ago I sought to plunder the Tomb of the Eaters, and set off to do so with a pair of confederates. I watched both of them die, slain by ancient artifice and entombed with the ancient dead.\n\nI would have shared their fate, but for a coterie of mopango nesting in the catacombs. They kept me safe and fed me while I treated my wounds. It is in their honor that I seek a credo now.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Zothom.ZothomThePenitent.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I was once a vile graverobber, the lowest of the low. Years ago I sought to plunder the Tomb of the Eaters, and set off to do so with a pair of confederates. I watched both of them die, slain by ancient artifice and entombed with the ancient dead.

I would have shared their fate, but for a coterie of mopango nesting in the catacombs. They kept me safe and fed me while I treated my wounds. It is in their honor that I seek a credo now.
translation:
我曾是卑劣的盗墓贼，低贱者中的最低贱者。多年前，我想掠夺食者之墓，便和两名同伙一同出发。我眼看着他们双双死去，被古老造物杀死，和古代死者一起埋葬。

若不是一群在地下墓穴筑巢的莫潘戈，我本会和他们命运相同。他们在我疗伤时保护我、供养我。正是为了向他们致敬，我如今才寻求一条信条。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I need to enter the Tomb of the Eaters.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Zothom.ZothomThePenitent.ZothomTombChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I need to enter the Tomb of the Eaters.

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Only those who pay their respects to the Grave of Rebekah will know the way into the tomb.\n\nIf you make it inside, the mopango will offer you solace and knowledge, and can tell you more about the Tomb's contents."), ('Context', 'Conversation Zothom.ZothomJust.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Only those who pay their respects to the Grave of Rebekah will know the way into the tomb.

If you make it inside, the mopango will offer you solace and knowledge, and can tell you more about the Tomb's contents.
translation:
只有向利百加之墓致敬的人，才会知道进入墓中的道路。

如果你能进去，莫潘戈会给你慰藉与知识，也能告诉你更多关于墓中事物的情况。

source: Can't you tell me anything else?
translation: 你不能再告诉我点别的吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'May you share my fate, then.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Zothom.ZothomUnjust.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: May you share my fate, then.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Tell me how to get in anyway.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Zothom.ZothomUnjust.ZothomHelpChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Tell me how to get in anyway.
translation: 无论如何，告诉我怎么进去。

source: Tell me about the mopango, then.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Yes. It is a rite of passage for the mopango people: a statement that inspires contemplation, discussion, and thought. An ideal credo has no single explanation or interpretation and is meant to inspire contemplation in those who hear it. For this reason, it is considered rude among mopango to ask the meaning of a credo.\n\nSomeday I will find mine.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Zothom.ZothomCredo.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Yes. It is a rite of passage for the mopango people: a statement that inspires contemplation, discussion, and thought. An ideal credo has no single explanation or interpretation and is meant to inspire contemplation in those who hear it. For this reason, it is considered rude among mopango to ask the meaning of a credo.

Someday I will find mine.
translation:
是的。那是莫潘戈人的成年仪式：一句能激发沉思、讨论与思考的话。理想的信条没有单一解释或阐释，它的本意就是让听见它的人陷入沉思。因此，在莫潘戈之间询问信条的含义会被视为失礼。

终有一天，我会找到属于我的信条。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I need to enter the Tomb of the Eaters.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Zothom.ZothomCredo.ZothomTombChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I need to enter the Tomb of the Eaters.

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Mopango are plated, digging creatures whose armor scales glow a pale white. They are contemplative, sociable, and mostly peaceful. They commune with ancient objects, which is why a coterie of their kind lives in the Tomb of the Eaters.\n\nThey are patient even with rough-hewn wanderers such as we, but it's still not best to ask one to explain eir credo."), ('Context', 'Conversation Zothom.ZothomLovesMopango.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Mopango are plated, digging creatures whose armor scales glow a pale white. They are contemplative, sociable, and mostly peaceful. They commune with ancient objects, which is why a coterie of their kind lives in the Tomb of the Eaters.

They are patient even with rough-hewn wanderers such as we, but it's still not best to ask one to explain eir credo.
translation:
莫潘戈是披甲、善于挖掘的生物，甲鳞泛着淡白色光芒。他们爱沉思、重社交，大多和平。他们能与古物交流，所以才会有一群同族住在食者之墓里。

即便面对我们这样粗糙的游荡者，他们也很有耐心，但最好仍不要请其中一位解释其信条。

source: I'd like to meet these mopango.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I need to enter the Tomb of the Eaters.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Zothom.ZothomLovesMopango.ZothomTombChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I need to enter the Tomb of the Eaters.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'If you do find =player.reflexive= in the Tomb, the mopango settlement is nestled in the wall of the Northwest Catacombs. The entrance is guarded by a chain turret named Vivira, brightly-painted to distinguish em from eir brethren.\n\nResist your reflexive urge to fight or flee, as Vivira is friendly and open to parley. If you meet, tell em I sent you.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Zothom.PangoQuest.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
If you do find =player.reflexive= in the Tomb, the mopango settlement is nestled in the wall of the Northwest Catacombs. The entrance is guarded by a chain turret named Vivira, brightly-painted to distinguish em from eir brethren.

Resist your reflexive urge to fight or flee, as Vivira is friendly and open to parley. If you meet, tell em I sent you.
translation:
如果你真的在墓中找到了 =player.reflexive=，莫潘戈聚落就嵌在西北地下墓穴的墙壁里。入口由一座名叫维维拉的链炮塔守卫，身上涂着鲜艳色彩，用以和同类区分。

压住你战斗或逃跑的本能冲动，因为维维拉很友善，也愿意谈判。如果你们见面，告诉维维拉是我派你去的。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Speak to a... turret? I suppose I will; live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Zothom.PangoQuest.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Speak to a... turret? I suppose I will; live and drink.
translation: 和一座……炮塔说话？我想我会的；生而饮水。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Speak to a... turret? No thank you; live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Zothom.PangoQuest.EndChoice2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Speak to a... turret? No thank you; live and drink.
translation: 和一座……炮塔说话？不了，谢谢；生而饮水。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Rebekah was a physician, and an advisor to Resheph until she lost his favor. When, after years of exile, she lost her voice and her life, she was buried here, an outsider unfit to be interred with the honored dead. So she rests here.\n\nI believe her proximity will help me find my credo.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Zothom.ZothomKnowsRebekah.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Rebekah was a physician, and an advisor to Resheph until she lost his favor. When, after years of exile, she lost her voice and her life, she was buried here, an outsider unfit to be interred with the honored dead. So she rests here.

I believe her proximity will help me find my credo.
translation:
利百加是一名医师，也是瑞谢夫的顾问，直到她失去他的恩宠。多年流亡之后，她失去了声音，也失去了生命，于是被葬在这里；她是外人，不配与受尊荣的死者同葬。所以她安息于此。

我相信靠近她会帮助我找到自己的信条。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I need to enter the Tomb of the Eaters.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Zothom.ZothomKnowsRebekah.ZothomTombChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I need to enter the Tomb of the Eaters.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'You are welcome in the village of Ezra, seedling. Sit with me and watch the sun breathe shadows over the day.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Haddas.Start.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You are welcome in the village of Ezra, seedling. Sit with me and watch the sun breathe shadows over the day.
translation: 埃兹拉村欢迎你，幼苗。与我同坐吧，看太阳把影子呼吸到白昼之上。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'The carved reliefs here are Eater-ancient. What is the history of this place?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Haddas.Start.ReliefsChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: The carved reliefs here are Eater-ancient. What is the history of this place?
translation: 这里的浮雕古老到属于食者时代。这个地方有什么历史？
告诉我你们的商人在哪里。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'HA. You would fain plant them here, to joggle their fingers at the salt sky alongside the musa?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Haddas.SlynthRequest.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: HA. You would fain plant them here, to joggle their fingers at the salt sky alongside the musa?
translation: 哈。你愿意把他们栽在这里，让他们和穆萨蕉一起向盐天摇动手指？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Lilypad-folk, you say. The slynth, you say. HA..... HA HA HA! Yes! I never thought to see yet fresher thought-sprouts take seed here in Ezra, but our sun is theirs, and the sky below it, and the thickening air down to the ground. Bring them to hear the songs of our musa-herders, and hope that they survive.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Haddas.SlynthRequestAccept.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Lilypad-folk, you say. The slynth, you say. HA..... HA HA HA! Yes! I never thought to see yet fresher thought-sprouts take seed here in Ezra, but our sun is theirs, and the sky below it, and the thickening air down to the ground. Bring them to hear the songs of our musa-herders, and hope that they survive.
translation: 睡莲叶之民，你说。斯林思，你说。哈……哈 哈 哈！好！我从未想过还能看见更新鲜的思想嫩芽在埃兹拉扎根，但我们的太阳属于他们，太阳下的天空也属于他们，向下稠厚到地面的空气也属于他们。带他们来听我们的穆萨蕉牧者歌唱吧，并希望他们能活下来。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Rocky soil fits only so many roots, little walker. Perhaps if yours were more anchored here. HA.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Haddas.SlynthRequestReject.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Rocky soil fits only so many roots, little walker. Perhaps if yours were more anchored here. HA.
translation: 多石的土壤只能容纳这么多根，小小行者。或许等你的根在这里扎得更深些。哈。

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'It is the good wind that brought the slynth to Ezra.

HA HA HA.

I will watch as these seedlings wilt or thrive.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Haddas.SlynthArrived.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
It is the good wind that brought the slynth to Ezra.

HA HA HA.

I will watch as these seedlings wilt or thrive.
translation:
是好风把斯林思带到了埃兹拉。

哈 哈 哈。

我会看着这些幼苗枯萎，或兴盛。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Returning so soon to check on our seedlings?\n\nHA. They grow, eat, sing, and joggle their curious little fingers at the salt sky. See for yourself.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Haddas.SlynthSettled.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Returning so soon to check on our seedlings?

HA. They grow, eat, sing, and joggle their curious little fingers at the salt sky. See for yourself.
translation:
这么快就回来查看我们的幼苗了？

哈。他们生长、进食、歌唱，向盐天摇动好奇的小手指。你自己去看吧。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'HA.......\n\nHA HA HA. So I am. I split stone and joggle my fingers at the salt sky. So I do today, so I did yesterday.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Haddas.Tree.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
HA.......

HA HA HA. So I am. I split stone and joggle my fingers at the salt sky. So I do today, so I did yesterday.
translation:
哈……

哈 哈 哈。确是如此。我劈开石头，向盐天摇动手指。我今日如此，昨日亦然。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'How did you become mayor of this village?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Haddas.Tree.MayorChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: How did you become mayor of this village?
translation: 你是怎么成为这个村子的村长的？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I'd like to ask you something else."), ('Context', 'Conversation Haddas.Tree.HaddasQuestionsChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I'd like to ask you something else.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I tally so many autumns, but until I am black with rot, I cannot be ring-right. The etching on my undertrunk places my seed-date to the reign of =sultan:4=, so I am told.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Haddas.Old.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I tally so many autumns, but until I am black with rot, I cannot be ring-right. The etching on my undertrunk places my seed-date to the reign of =sultan:4=, so I am told.
translation: 我数过许多秋天，但在我黑腐之前，我无法以年轮定准。有人告诉我，我下干上的刻痕把我的播种之日定在 =sultan:4= 统治时期。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Technically, that makes you an Eater, doesn't it?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Haddas.Old.EaterChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Technically, that makes you an Eater, doesn't it?
translation: 严格说来，那就让你成了食者，不是吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'HA HA HA. I suppose so.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Haddas.Eater.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: HA HA HA. I suppose so.
translation: 哈 哈 哈。我想是吧。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'HA. I stood long enough. I joggled my fingers at the salt sky, and I watched thy seedlings sprout and wither, and I watched thou place stones in straight lines like the bees and their nests of wax. I stood until the stones were nigh by me. The people followed the stones.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Haddas.Mayor.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: HA. I stood long enough. I joggled my fingers at the salt sky, and I watched thy seedlings sprout and wither, and I watched thou place stones in straight lines like the bees and their nests of wax. I stood until the stones were nigh by me. The people followed the stones.
translation: 哈。我站得够久。我向盐天摇动手指，看着汝等幼苗发芽又枯萎，看着汝等像蜜蜂和它们的蜡巢一样，把石头摆成直线。我一直站着，直到石头靠近了我。人们便跟随着石头。

path:
((('string', (('ID', "Ezra is more than tree-old. It's stone-old. Seedlings have lived here since our roots dreamed of joggling their fingers at the salt sky.

They ate earth and belched freight at the stars, and this place was their stomach.

Later, as the Star-Tree died and they buried their dead under its roots, this was their funerary place.

Now, we nurse electric milk from the old and aching temple to turn our wheels and grind our seeds and grains. Now we are they."), ('Context', 'Conversation Haddas.Reliefs.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Ezra is more than tree-old. It's stone-old. Seedlings have lived here since our roots dreamed of joggling their fingers at the salt sky.

They ate earth and belched freight at the stars, and this place was their stomach.

Later, as the Star-Tree died and they buried their dead under its roots, this was their funerary place.

Now, we nurse electric milk from the old and aching temple to turn our wheels and grind our seeds and grains. Now we are they.
translation:
埃兹拉不只是树那样古老。它有石头那样古老。自从我们的根还梦想着向盐天摇动手指时，幼苗们就已经住在这里。

他们吞食大地，朝群星嗳出货物，而这里就是他们的胃。

后来，星树死去，他们把死者埋在它的根下，这里便成了他们的葬地。

如今，我们从古老而疼痛的神庙中吮取电之乳，用它转动车轮，磨碎我们的种子与谷粒。如今，我们就是他们。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Aye, the Blue Mother who breaks the sky. Those who Eat called her Gjaus, and those who Wake call her Spindle.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Haddas.StarTree.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Aye, the Blue Mother who breaks the sky. Those who Eat called her Gjaus, and those who Wake call her Spindle.
translation: 是啊，劈开天空的蓝母。食者称她为贾乌斯，醒者称她为纺锤。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'One called 1-FF, who wandered in errancy out from the Tomb and was reprogrammed by the Daughter who lived and died in the rot-black box, nine Daughters ago.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Haddas.Warden.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: One called 1-FF, who wandered in errancy out from the Tomb and was reprogrammed by the Daughter who lived and died in the rot-black box, nine Daughters ago.
translation: 一位名叫 1-FF 的存在，曾因迷途而从墓中游荡出来，在九代流亡之女以前，被那位生于黑腐盒中也死于其中的流亡之女重新编程。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'To the northwest seek the rot-black box. There a plant and Daughter live. There cats of chrome purr at tiny suns.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Haddas.Merchants.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: To the northwest seek the rot-black box. There a plant and Daughter live. There cats of chrome purr at tiny suns.
translation: 向西北寻找黑腐盒。那里住着一株植物和一位流亡之女。那里，铬钢之猫对着小小太阳发出呼噜声。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Ezra is old and has long since cut a groove into the world and resides there in stillness and harmony. But Zothom the Penitent One is a seedling, new to the world, and he quakes at all the tensing the world does. Perhaps you can share in his angst.\n\nGo find him by the headstones for the dead.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Haddas.Work.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Ezra is old and has long since cut a groove into the world and resides there in stillness and harmony. But Zothom the Penitent One is a seedling, new to the world, and he quakes at all the tensing the world does. Perhaps you can share in his angst.

Go find him by the headstones for the dead.
translation:
埃兹拉很古老，早已在世界中刻出一道沟槽，并在其中静止而和谐地居住。但忏悔者佐索姆是一株幼苗，新来到这个世界；世界每一次绷紧，他都会颤抖。或许你可以分担他的焦虑。

去死者墓碑旁找他吧。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Oh joy, another meat-being. Please tell me you're here to buy something."), ('Context', 'Conversation Sixshrew.Start.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Oh joy, another meat-being. Please tell me you're here to buy something.
translation: 哦，真高兴，又一个肉体生物。拜托告诉我你是来买东西的。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I suppose I'll be leaving, then."), ('Context', 'Conversation Sixshrew.Start.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I suppose I'll be leaving, then.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I am Sixshrew, a merchant from the Consortium of Phyta disinclined to waste xyr time on talkative strangers.\n\nI sell things, and you can buy them. I would in fact strongly encourage you to buy them, or be on your way.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Sixshrew.Introduction.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I am Sixshrew, a merchant from the Consortium of Phyta disinclined to waste xyr time on talkative strangers.

I sell things, and you can buy them. I would in fact strongly encourage you to buy them, or be on your way.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'We are mopango: witnesses of the past and shepherds of the future. The Sacred Light of the Kasaphescence shineth within us, and we commune with relics of antiquity to maintain our humility and grow our wisdom.\n\nWe believe that one day, with enough knowledge, anyone who seeketh the Light shalt find it within emself. In the meantime, we work to become better and brighter as each one of us findeth a personal credo by which to live.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Agyra.AgyraMopango.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
We are mopango: witnesses of the past and shepherds of the future. The Sacred Light of the Kasaphescence shineth within us, and we commune with relics of antiquity to maintain our humility and grow our wisdom.

We believe that one day, with enough knowledge, anyone who seeketh the Light shalt find it within emself. In the meantime, we work to become better and brighter as each one of us findeth a personal credo by which to live.
translation:
我们是莫潘戈：过去的见证者，未来的牧者。卡萨辉体的圣光在我们之内闪耀，我们与古代遗物交流，以维持谦卑并增长智慧。

我们相信终有一天，只要拥有足够知识，任何寻求光者都将在 自身——也就是其自身——之中找到它。在此之前，我们努力变得更好、更明亮，而我们每个人都寻找一条赖以生活的个人信条。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Aye. Ey, em, eir, eirs, emself. Thusly do we call ourselves and one another.\n\nSex is personal and mattereth not to a bare acquaintence. Gender is a societal relic in which we see no current utility.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Agyra.AgyraGender.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Aye. Ey, em, eir, eirs, emself. Thusly do we call ourselves and one another.

Sex is personal and mattereth not to a bare acquaintence. Gender is a societal relic in which we see no current utility.
translation:
是的。其、其、其、其、自身，是我们用来称呼自己与彼此的一套代词。

生理性别是私事，泛泛之交不必知晓。社会性别则是一种社会遗物，我们认为它如今已没有实际用途。

食者之墓由十二层组成；如果=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=把过渡层也算进去，则是十层：民众地下墓穴（=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=如今正站在其中）、火葬场与骨灰龛、两座墓室，以及上方库德诸苏丹的六座陵墓。

如果=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=在此寻求财富，那就准备好失望吧。墓中容纳着奇异而亵渎的物件，但地表居民所认为的宝藏却很少。

Aye. One's own credo shouldst inspire reflection and thought, with no clear-cut meaning but meaning nonetheless. Some of our coterie yet seeketh theirs, but an experienced watcher no doubt hath one. Any mopango who hath a credo wilt share it with =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, an =ifplayerplural:ye request:thou requesteth= it.

My credo is: "Malice alone staineth the sanctity of questioning."
translation:
是的。一个人的信条应当激发反思与思想；它没有清晰确定的含义，却仍有含义。我们同修群中有些人仍在寻找自己的信条，但有经验的守望者无疑已有其一。任何拥有信条的莫潘戈都会与=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=分享，只要=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=请求。

我的信条是：“唯有恶意玷污提问的神圣。”

source:
I cannot simply explain my credo to =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=. A credo informeth and confoundeth at once, and must be reflected upon by the listener.

=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou art= inexperienced in our ways, so please bear my words in the kind spirit they are meant: to ask a mopango to explain eir credo is to commit one of our few taboo acts. Be advised.
translation:
我不能简单地向=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=解释我的信条。信条既启示也困惑，必须由听者自行反思。

=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=对我们的道路尚不熟悉，所以请以善意理解我的话：要求莫潘戈解释自己的信条，是触犯我们少数禁忌之一。请记住。

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'Not... the device. Repulsive as a key to a prison doth repulse. To know a key is to know of a prison.

Our watched children are bound, and lock swalloweth key. An =ifplayerplural:ye free:thou freest= one, three remaineth forever.

k-Goninon hath it now. An =ifplayerplural:ye seek:thou seekest=.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Lebah.Repulsive.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Not... the device. Repulsive as a key to a prison doth repulse. To know a key is to know of a prison.

Our watched children are bound, and lock swalloweth key. An =ifplayerplural:ye free:thou freest= one, three remaineth forever.

k-Goninon hath it now. An =ifplayerplural:ye seek:thou seekest=.
translation:
不是……装置。排斥，像监狱的钥匙会排斥。知道钥匙，便知道监狱。

我们看守的孩子们被束缚，锁吞下钥匙。如果=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=释放一个，三个便永远留下。

k-戈尼农现在有它。若=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=寻求。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'An elder ooze. My communion so disturbed me that I allowed them too close.\n\nk-Goninon consumed the device, but I escaped.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Lebah.OozeThat.Text')), 1),), '#text')

An elder ooze. My communion so disturbed me that I allowed them too close.

k-Goninon consumed the device, but I escaped.

一只年长的软泥怪。那次交流太令我不安，以至于我让 其 靠得太近。

k-戈尼农吞掉了装置，但我逃脱了。

去问阿吉拉。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I am Doyoba, proud watcher of the children of the tomb. One child in particular. Of course =ifplayerplural:ye:thou= must comprehend, 'child' is but a fabricated epithet, as they are far older than we. translation: 我是多约巴，墓之孩子们自豪的守望者。尤其是某一个孩子。当然，=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=必须明白，“孩子”只是人为造出的称谓，因为它们远比我们古老。我是说，那些孩子。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'We mopango watch the past, each of us a different facet. My charge is named Nacham, that which watcheth and understandeth not, that which speaketh and cannot be understood. Information floweth through Nacham as water through a sieve, mixed together beyond ken.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Doyoba.WhyAreYouHere.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: We mopango watch the past, each of us a different facet. My charge is named Nacham, that which watcheth and understandeth not, that which speaketh and cannot be understood. Information floweth through Nacham as water through a sieve, mixed together beyond ken.
translation: 我们莫潘戈守望过去，每个人守望不同的侧面。我负责的对象名叫纳查姆，它观看却不理解，它说话却不可被理解。信息流过纳查姆，如水流过筛子，混杂在一起，超出认知。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I do.\n\n"Suffering breedeth in still water."'), ('Context', 'Conversation Doyoba.YourCredo.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I do.

"Suffering breedeth in still water."

path: ((('string', (('ID', '...?\n\n=ifplayerplural:Ye ask:Thou askest= after the meaning of my credo. Wouldst I shall chew =ifplayerplural:your:thy= food for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= as well?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Doyoba.Meaning.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
...?

=ifplayerplural:Ye ask:Thou askest= after the meaning of my credo. Wouldst I shall chew =ifplayerplural:your:thy= food for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= as well?
translation:
……？

=ifplayerplural:尔等在问:汝在问=我的信条是什么意思。难道我还要替=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=咀嚼=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=的食物吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'No, no, =ifplayerplural:ye know:thou knowest= not our ways and I was too harsh. I apologize, and I am not wroth with =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Doyoba.Apologize.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: No, no, =ifplayerplural:ye know:thou knowest= not our ways and I was too harsh. I apologize, and I am not wroth with =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=.
translation: 不，不，=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=不了解我们的道路，而我太严厉了。我道歉，我并未因=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=而动怒。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "By Her Light, it's ghastly. May I touch it?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Doyoba.Device.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: By Her Light, it's ghastly. May I touch it?
translation: 凭祂之光，它真可怕。我可以触碰它吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Oh.\n\nWell then, I suppose I have no insight for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Doyoba.Deny.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Oh.

Well then, I suppose I have no insight for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=.
translation:
哦。

那么，我想我没有什么洞见可给=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "{{emote|*Doyoba's face scrunches in pain as ey communes with the device, before finally pushing it back into your grasp*}}\n\nBy her light, that was unpleasant. How it twisted and turned, leading me to visions of Nacham's past, scraps and flashes. I can discern only glimpses of significance. Once a creator, an innovator. Can these parts of itself return intact, under the device's influence? An thou sendest void away, hast thou lost a part of thee?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Doyoba.Commune.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Doyoba's face scrunches in pain as ey communes with the device, before finally pushing it back into your grasp*}}

By her light, that was unpleasant. How it twisted and turned, leading me to visions of Nacham's past, scraps and flashes. I can discern only glimpses of significance. Once a creator, an innovator. Can these parts of itself return intact, under the device's influence? An thou sendest void away, hast thou lost a part of thee?
translation:
{{emote|*多约巴与装置交流时，脸因痛苦而皱紧，最后才把它推回汝手中*}}

凭祂之光，那真令人不适。它扭曲又翻转，引我看见纳查姆过去的景象，碎片与闪光。我只能辨出几处有意义的掠影。它曾是创造者，革新者。在装置影响下，它自身这些部分能完整回归吗？若汝送走虚空，汝是否失去了自己的一部分？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Perhaps we will find out. Live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Doyoba.Commune.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Perhaps we will find out. Live and drink.
translation: 也许我们会知道的。生而饮水。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Va'am is released. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= done something great, for good or ill.\n\nI thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for this new future."), ('Context', 'Conversation Dadogom.Start.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Va'am is released. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= done something great, for good or ill.

I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for this new future.
translation:
瓦姆被释放了。无论好坏，=ifplayerplural:你们:你=做成了一件伟大的事。

我为这个新的未来感谢=ifplayerplural:你们:你=。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '=factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=. =ifplayerplural:Ye did:Thou didst= rouse a child. Well done.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Dadogom.Start2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: =factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=. =ifplayerplural:Ye did:Thou didst= rouse a child. Well done.
translation: =factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=。=ifplayerplural:你们:你=确实唤醒了一个孩子。做得好。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Thank you. Live and drink, Dadogom.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Dadogom.Start2.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Thank you. Live and drink, Dadogom.
translation: 谢谢。生而饮水，达多戈姆。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I seek a use for this repulsive device.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Dadogom.Start3.DeviceChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I seek a use for this repulsive device.
translation: 我在寻找这个排斥装置的用途。

path:
((('string', (('ID', "I watch over Va'am. It watcheth over me. Together, we watch.

=ifplayerplural:Ye should:Thou shouldst= as well, =factionaddress:Mopango=. Sit. Watch. Consider how =ifplayerplural:ye would:thou wouldst= fare under a dome of adamant carapace.

Safe, undying, alone."), ('Context', 'Conversation Dadogom.WhyAreYouHere.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I watch over Va'am. It watcheth over me. Together, we watch.

=ifplayerplural:Ye should:Thou shouldst= as well, =factionaddress:Mopango=. Sit. Watch. Consider how =ifplayerplural:ye would:thou wouldst= fare under a dome of adamant carapace.

Safe, undying, alone.
translation:
我守望瓦姆。它守望我。我们一同守望。

=ifplayerplural:你们:你=也应如此，=factionaddress:Mopango=。坐下。观看。思考=ifplayerplural:你们:你=在精金甲壳的穹顶下会过得如何。

安全，不朽，孤独。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Consider =ifplayerplural:your:thy= words ere =ifplayerplural:ye say:thou sayest= them, and =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt= issue fewer apologies.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Dadogom.Apologize.Text')), 1),), '#text')

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Perhaps we will find out. Live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Dadogom.Commune.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Perhaps we will find out. Live and drink.
translation: 也许我们会知道的。生而饮水。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I hope =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou art= confident in =ifplayerplural:your:thy= choice, =factionaddress:Mopango=. I am happy with it, to be sure.\n\nKah is free. source:
I hope =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou art= confident in =ifplayerplural:your:thy= choice, =factionaddress:Mopango=. I am happy with it, to be sure.

Kah is free. It heals my heart to see it at rest. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= my thanks.
translation:
我希望=ifplayerplural:你们:你=对=ifplayerplural:你们:你=的选择有信心，=factionaddress:Mopango=。我确实为此高兴。

卡自由了。看见它休息，让我的心痊愈。请接受我的感谢。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "You're welcome, Gyamyo. Live and drink."), ('Context', 'Conversation Gyamyo.Start.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')

source:
=ifplayerplural:Did ye:Didst thou= truly free one of the children? I see =ifplayerplural:ye did:thou didst=. Congratulations.

Wouldst fain see Kah free, one day. I shall have to live a while and find a way.
translation:
=ifplayerplural:你们真的:你真的=释放了一个孩子吗？我看=ifplayerplural:你们:你=确实做到了。恭喜。

我愿有一天看见卡获得自由。我得继续活上一阵，找到办法。

我的名字是伽米约。很高兴认识=ifplayerplural:你们:你=，=name=。=ifplayerplural:你们和:你和=其他守望者说过话了吗？他们怎么样？

希望他们都好。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I have volunteered to monitor an ancient machine-creature called Kah. Perhaps =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= seen it, skipping hither and yon on strange limbs.\n\nOften I wonder if Kah knoweth aught else but fear.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Gyamyo.WhyAreYouHere.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I have volunteered to monitor an ancient machine-creature called Kah. Perhaps =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= seen it, skipping hither and yon on strange limbs.

Often I wonder if Kah knoweth aught else but fear.
translation:
我自愿监看一台名叫卡的古老机器生物。也许=ifplayerplural:你们:你=见过它，用奇怪的肢体四处跳跃。

我常常想，卡是否还知道恐惧之外的东西。

translation:
{{emote|*伽米约在交流期间几乎不动，但不时颤抖抽搐。约莫一分钟后，伽米约把装置还给了你。*}}

我被震动了。与利巴的深潜相比，我的旅程无疑很浅。但现在，我凭誓言说：卡一直是运动之物。迅捷、有动能、优雅。如果被那装置释放，它无疑也会如此。
我们会看到的。生而饮水。

source:
Yes. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= quelled the mania.

I can focus. I can render sensible the things I have seen and heard now, though I remember little of my time before the mania. Was I artisan? Teacher? I possessed great knowledge that this shell twisted into a prison. I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for the gift of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= untwisting.
translation:
是的。=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=平息了狂乱。

我能集中精神。我现在能让自己所见所闻变得有意义，尽管我几乎不记得狂乱之前的时光。我曾是工匠？教师？我拥有伟大知识，而这外壳把它扭成了监狱。我感谢=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=赐予的解扭之礼。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'The mopango have cared for me whilst I could not care for myself, giving me the only name I now know. I will stay to help them. This chassis is a prison no longer, and perhaps deeper truths may yet be found within it.\n\nTo =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, new friend, I offer a piece of this former prison that =ifplayerplural:ye may:thou mayest= find useful, along with my thanks.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Nacham.NachamFuture.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
The mopango have cared for me whilst I could not care for myself, giving me the only name I now know. I will stay to help them. This chassis is a prison no longer, and perhaps deeper truths may yet be found within it.

To =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, new friend, I offer a piece of this former prison that =ifplayerplural:ye may:thou mayest= find useful, along with my thanks.
translation:
在我无法照料自己时，莫潘戈照料了我，并给了我如今唯一知晓的名字。我会留下来帮助他们。这具底盘不再是监狱，或许其中仍能找到更深的真理。

新朋友，我把这座旧监狱的一部分赠予=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=，也许=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=会觉得它有用，并附上我的感谢。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Though I be a pale shadow of the self I once was, yes. My condition and outlook are both substantially improved.\n\nI recall few details of my life before. I was influential, one whose words stirred hearts to action. For so long I had no means to speak, trapped in my own moods. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= freed me from a dire fate.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Dagasha.DagashaResponds.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Though I be a pale shadow of the self I once was, yes. My condition and outlook are both substantially improved.

I recall few details of my life before. I was influential, one whose words stirred hearts to action. For so long I had no means to speak, trapped in my own moods. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= freed me from a dire fate.
translation:
虽然我只是昔日自我的苍白影子，但，是的。我的状态和前景都大幅改善了。

我想不起从前生命的多少细节。我曾很有影响力，是言语能激励人心行动的人。如此长久以来，我无法说话，被困在自己的情绪中。=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=将我从可怕命运中释放出来。

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'I know not. Perhaps I can lead again. These creatures that looked after me, named me, kept me safe. The mopango.

They are kind, but weak. Perhaps I can teach them. Spur them to be greater.

But for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, I must even our score. Take this piece of my chassis. Wear it with confidence. Command in my name.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Dagasha.DagashaFuture.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I know not. Perhaps I can lead again. These creatures that looked after me, named me, kept me safe. The mopango.

They are kind, but weak. Perhaps I can teach them. Spur them to be greater.

But for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, I must even our score. Take this piece of my chassis. Wear it with confidence. Command in my name.
translation:
我不知道。也许我能再次领导。那些照看我、为我命名、保护我安全的生物。莫潘戈。

他们善良，却弱小。也许我能教导他们。鞭策他们变得更伟大。

但对于=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=，我必须偿清我们之间的账。拿着我底盘的这一片。自信地佩戴它。以我的名义发号施令。
愿你长生，坚毅如故，瓦姆。

source:
I am weary to my core, but at last this once-hateful body obeyeth me. I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for restoring my autonomy.

Memory of my once-self doth elude me, but I recognize the irony of my punishment. Once a strider, then sentenced to stride without restraint, forever. I knew only fear and flight. No more.
translation:
我疲惫入骨，但这具曾经可恨的身体终于服从于我。感谢=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=恢复了我的自主。

昔日自我的记忆逃离了我，但我认得自己惩罚中的讽刺。我曾是阔步者，后来被判永远毫无限制地阔步。我只知道恐惧与逃离。如今不再。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I shall enjoy my free mobility freely, for a time. After that, I know not. I may speak to these mopango creatures that named me, and find a purpose with them. I cannot ever repay their care, but perhaps I may repay =ifplayerplural:yours:thine=.\n\nI wouldst fain offer =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= a fragment of this form come loose. =ifplayerplural:May ye:Mayst thou= ever run free.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Kah.KahFuture.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I shall enjoy my free mobility freely, for a time. After that, I know not. I may speak to these mopango creatures that named me, and find a purpose with them. I cannot ever repay their care, but perhaps I may repay =ifplayerplural:yours:thine=.

I wouldst fain offer =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= a fragment of this form come loose. =ifplayerplural:May ye:Mayst thou= ever run free.
translation:
我会先自由地享受我的自由移动。之后，我不知道。我也许会与这些为我命名的莫潘戈生物交谈，和他们一起找到目的。我永远无法偿还他们的照料，但也许我可以偿还=ifplayerplural:尔等的:汝之=。

我愿将这具形体上松脱的一片赠予=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=。愿=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=永远自由奔跑。

……哦……我是希罗多狄库斯，宝石匠、石印师、雕塑家、钙矿师，也是盘绕羔羊的传记官。我会在这里逗留，直到神首逝去，然后我会以高浮雕封圣他的功业。

我如今已经逗留了相当长的时间……何等惊人的统治！赞美盘绕羔羊！

Oh... poor, doltish friend. You cantered too long outside the House of the Coiled Lamb, and now you are a dolt.'), ('Context', 'Conversation ImperialBiographer.SultanGone.Text')), 1),), '#text')

.....oh.... oh.... Poor friend. The ironshank must be upsetting your digestion. The darkness must be blooming in your brain, making you slow and doltish.

Oh... poor, doltish friend. You cantered too long outside the House of the Coiled Lamb, and now you are a dolt.

苏丹国解体了？消息会传到我这里的……总会有人这么说的……

哦……可怜又愚笨的朋友。你在盘绕羔羊之家外驰骋得太久，如今成了傻瓜。

source: I want to ask you something else.

translation:
{{emote|希罗多狄库斯恐惧地嗡鸣。}}

印记是 =MarkOfDeath=。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Oh! Brightsheol? The forever braid of life? The Garden Behind the High Gate? Why, you must rank among the crown echelon of machine and folk, and you must... well, you must...\n\nStart to decompose. You must... You must be dead. Dead and entombed. The body remains, but the mind wanders...'), ('Context', 'Conversation ImperialBiographer.Brightsheol.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Oh! Brightsheol? The forever braid of life? The Garden Behind the High Gate? Why, you must rank among the crown echelon of machine and folk, and you must... well, you must...

Start to decompose. You must... You must be dead. Dead and entombed. The body remains, but the mind wanders...
translation:
哦！明灼阴府？生命的永恒编辫？高门之后的花园？哎呀，你必须跻身机器与民众的冠冕阶层，而且你必须……嗯，你必须……

开始腐解。你必须……你必须死去。死去并入葬。身体留下，心智漫游……

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'You must be dead? Is that truly the only way?'), ('Context', 'Conversation ImperialBiographer.Brightsheol.OnlyWayChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You must be dead? Is that truly the only way?
translation: 必须死去？真的只有这一种方法吗？

source: I bear the Mark. Entomb me.

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|Herododicus pauses.}}\n\nYe... yes? Is this a test? I suppose you... could we... could we have been in Brightsheol all along? Is that the answer?'), ('Context', 'Conversation ImperialBiographer.OnlyWay.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|Herododicus pauses.}}

Ye... yes? Is this a test? I suppose you... could we... could we have been in Brightsheol all along? Is that the answer?
translation:
{{emote|希罗多狄库斯停顿了。}}

是……是的？这是考验吗？我想你……我们会不会……会不会一直都在明灼阴府？这是答案吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Wrong on both counts. Resheph stands before you. Entomb me.'), ('Context', 'Conversation ImperialBiographer.BearTheMark.EntombMeReshephDisguiseChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Wrong on both counts. Resheph stands before you. Entomb me.
translation: 两点都错。瑞谢夫就站在你面前。埋葬我。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Resheph is gone, biographer. I am here, and I have need to travel to Brightsheol. Entomb me.'), ('Context', 'Conversation ImperialBiographer.BearTheMark.EntombMeChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Resheph is gone, biographer. I am here, and I have need to travel to Brightsheol. Entomb me.
translation: 瑞谢夫已经离去，传记官。我在这里，而且我需要前往明灼阴府。埋葬我。

source: Of course not. Let's back up.
translation: 当然不是。我们退一步说。

path:
((('string', (('ID', "That's not even how it works!

First, I image your head, read your self's narrative from the folds of your brain, cross-check it against the Thin World's ambient log of your life's deeds...

Then I... stylize... the story, and I engrave it on the walls. Once I'm done... then you can entomb =player.reflexive=."), ('Context', 'Conversation ImperialBiographer.EntombMe.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
That's not even how it works!

First, I image your head, read your self's narrative from the folds of your brain, cross-check it against the Thin World's ambient log of your life's deeds...

Then I... stylize... the story, and I engrave it on the walls. Once I'm done... then you can entomb =player.reflexive=.
translation:
这根本不是它的运作方式！

首先，我要扫描你的头，从你的脑褶中读取你自我的叙事，再与薄世界中关于你一生事迹的环境日志交叉核验……

然后我……修饰……这个故事，再把它刻在墙上。等我完成后……你才能埋葬 =player.reflexive=。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Hold on. I have more to ask.'), ('Context', 'Conversation ImperialBiographer.EntombMe.StartChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Hold on. I have more to ask.
translation: 等一下。我还有更多要问。

source: You are forgiven. Now entomb me.
translation: 你被宽恕了。现在埋葬我。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I've misled you, biographer. I have another question."), ('Context', 'Conversation ImperialBiographer.EntombMeReshephDisguise.StartChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I've misled you, biographer. I have another question.
translation: 我误导了你，传记官。我还有另一个问题。

path:
((('string', (('ID', "Moloch! Allow me to explain the deification procedure, as it is clearly beneath your station to know!

First, I must image the great Moloch's head, read your self's narrative from the folds of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= Holiest Brain, cross-check it against the Thin World's ambient log of His Eminence's life's deeds...

{{emote|*Herododicus whispers*}} I'm sure your version is the better one, Moloch..."), ('Context', 'Conversation ImperialBiographer.EntombMeResheph.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Moloch! Allow me to explain the deification procedure, as it is clearly beneath your station to know!

First, I must image the great Moloch's head, read your self's narrative from the folds of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= Holiest Brain, cross-check it against the Thin World's ambient log of His Eminence's life's deeds...

{{emote|*Herododicus whispers*}} I'm sure your version is the better one, Moloch...
translation:
摩洛克！请容我解释神化流程，因为以您的地位，显然不该亲自知晓这等细节！

首先，我必须扫描伟大摩洛克的头颅，从=ifplayerplural:你们:你=至圣大脑的褶皱中读取自我叙事，再与薄世界中关于尊驾一生事迹的环境日志交叉核验……

{{emote|*希罗多狄库斯低语*}} 我相信您的说法才是更好的版本，摩洛克……

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Then I... stylize... the story, and I engrave it on the walls. Once I'm finished, the sarcophagus will open, and you can lay =player.reflexive= to rest!"), ('Context', 'Conversation ImperialBiographer.EntombMeResheph2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Then I... stylize... the story, and I engrave it on the walls. Once I'm finished, the sarcophagus will open, and you can lay =player.reflexive= to rest!
translation: 然后我……修饰……这个故事，再把它刻在墙上。等我完成后，石棺就会打开，而您就能让 =player.reflexive= 安息！

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Commencing cross-check with the Thin World annals............'), ('Context', 'Conversation ImperialBiographer.DoThat4.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Commencing cross-check with the Thin World annals............
translation: 开始与薄世界年鉴交叉核验…………

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Cross-check complete. Your narrative is compiled. Now to engrave it.\n\nPeace.... peace to all who canter in the House of the Coiled Lamb.'), ('Context', 'Conversation ImperialBiographer.DoThat7.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Cross-check complete. Your narrative is compiled. Now to engrave it.

Peace.... peace to all who canter in the House of the Coiled Lamb.
translation:
交叉核验完成。你的叙事已编成。现在去雕刻它。

平安……愿所有在盘绕羔羊之家驰骋者平安。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Commencing cross-check with the Thin World annals............'), ('Context', 'Conversation ImperialBiographer.DoThatResheph4.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Commencing cross-check with the Thin World annals............
translation: 开始与薄世界年鉴交叉核验…………

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Cross-check complete. Your narrative is compiled, Moloch. Now to go engrave it.\n\nPeace.... peace to all who canter in the House of the Coiled... in Your House, Moloch.'), ('Context', 'Conversation ImperialBiographer.DoThat7Resheph.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Cross-check complete. Your narrative is compiled, Moloch. Now to go engrave it.

Peace.... peace to all who canter in the House of the Coiled... in Your House, Moloch.
translation:
交叉核验完成。您的叙事已编成，摩洛克。现在去雕刻它。

平安……愿所有在盘绕……在您的家中驰骋者平安，摩洛克。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '\'Tis a saying among the stonemasons, "Never finish a job too early." By the decretum of Sagittar, old as it is, they have until the Coiled Lamb is... is decom-.. passed... decompassed.... dead, deadlike... to complete their work on the Tomb.\n\nBless the Coiled Lamb, peace to those who canter in his house, and let us pray the day never comes!'), ('Context', 'Conversation ImperialBiographer.Unfinished.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
'Tis a saying among the stonemasons, "Never finish a job too early." By the decretum of Sagittar, old as it is, they have until the Coiled Lamb is... is decom-.. passed... decompassed.... dead, deadlike... to complete their work on the Tomb.

Bless the Coiled Lamb, peace to those who canter in his house, and let us pray the day never comes!
translation:
石匠之间有句俗话：“永远别太早完工。”按萨吉塔尔古老敕令，他们有直到盘绕羔羊……腐……逝去……腐逝……死亡，死一般……之前的时间来完成墓的工程。

祝福盘绕羔羊，愿在他家中驰骋者平安，也让我们祈祷那一天永不到来！

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'But Resheph is dead. The sultanate is dissolved.'), ('Context', 'Conversation ImperialBiographer.Unfinished.SultanGoneChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: But Resheph is dead. The sultanate is dissolved.
translation: 但瑞谢夫已经死了。苏丹国已经解体。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Live and drink, friend. rrk come to the Yd, shared together. Feel safe and free as woodsmoke.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Goek.Start.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Live and drink, friend. rrk come to the Yd, shared together. Feel safe and free as woodsmoke.
translation: 生而饮水，朋友。呱 来到伊德，共同分享。感到安全又自由，像木烟一样。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "You tower over every other frog I've seen. Are you svardym?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Goek.Start.GoekToweringChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You tower over every other frog I've seen. Are you svardym?
translation: 你比我见过的其他蛙类都高大。你是斯瓦尔丁吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'These shining pipes! What are they?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Goek.Start.GoekPipesChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: These shining pipes! What are they?
translation: 这些闪亮的管道！它们是什么？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'What can you tell me about Yd?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Goek.Start.GoekFreeholdChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: What can you tell me about Yd?
translation: 你能告诉我伊德的事吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'rrk knows of the glow-hats! Yd-friends see glimpses at night, about the reef.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Goek.SlynthRequest.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: rrk knows of the glow-hats! Yd-friends see glimpses at night, about the reef.
translation: 呱 知道发光帽！伊德朋友夜里在礁中瞥见过。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'If you would have them, I ask that you grant them sanctuary.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Goek.SlynthRequest.SlynthRequestAcceptChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: If you would have them, I ask that you grant them sanctuary.
translation: 如果你愿意接纳他们，我请求你给予他们庇护。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'If you would have them, I ask that you grant them sanctuary.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Goek.SlynthRequest.SlynthRequestRejectChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: If you would have them, I ask that you grant them sanctuary.
translation: 如果你愿意接纳他们，我请求你给予他们庇护。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Boon-friend asks a friend-boon, and what boon is friend! rrk welcome slynth to an Yd, be safe and free as woodsmoke.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Goek.SlynthRequestAccept.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Boon-friend asks a friend-boon, and what boon is friend! rrk welcome slynth to an Yd, be safe and free as woodsmoke.
translation: 恩惠朋友请求朋友恩惠，而朋友何尝不是恩惠！呱 欢迎斯林思来到伊德，安全又自由，像木烟一样。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Ah! rrk would grant you this boon, rrk would. Were not for the unspoken cries of future-kin, free as woodsmoke but no more safe so longer. rrk would and cannot.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Goek.SlynthRequestReject.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Ah! rrk would grant you this boon, rrk would. Were not for the unspoken cries of future-kin, free as woodsmoke but no more safe so longer. rrk would and cannot.
translation: 啊！呱 愿给你这份恩惠，呱 愿意。若不是未来亲族无声哭喊，自由如木烟却不再长久安全。呱 愿意却不能。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'rrk wonder of the glow-hats. Which wind will blow.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Goek.SlynthAbout.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: rrk wonder of the glow-hats. Which wind will blow.
translation: 呱 想着发光帽。哪阵风会吹来。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=! How arresting of the glow-hats arrival, much to do. rrk soothe Mak, Bep, Krka, look stores, still much slime and sweat to pool below rrk. Enjoy helpful toil!'), ('Context', 'Conversation Goek.SlynthArrived.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=! How arresting of the glow-hats arrival, much to do. rrk soothe Mak, Bep, Krka, look stores, still much slime and sweat to pool below rrk. Enjoy helpful toil!
translation: 问候你，=player.formalAddressTerm=！发光帽到来多么夺目，有许多事要做。呱 安抚马克、贝普、克尔卡，查看储备，呱 下方仍有许多黏液与汗水要汇成池。享受有帮助的辛劳！

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'All is well, =name=! Trials make for overcoming, and done together.\n\nrrk can tell the sky dark and not know. Visit and witness! Glow-hats enliven the night, safe and free. Slynth-home is Yd.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Goek.SlynthSettled.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
All is well, =name=! Trials make for overcoming, and done together.

rrk can tell the sky dark and not know. Visit and witness! Glow-hats enliven the night, safe and free. Slynth-home is Yd.
translation:
一切都好，=name=！试炼生来就是要被克服，而且要一起克服。

呱 能分辨天黑，却也不知。来访并见证！发光帽让夜晚活起来，安全又自由。斯林思之家就是伊德。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*reeeeeps joyfully*}}\n\nGreetings, =name=! Live and drink, friend.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Goek.Greetings.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*reeeeeps joyfully*}}

Greetings, =name=! Live and drink, friend.
translation:
{{emote|*欢快地 reeeeeps*}}

问候你，=name=！生而饮水，朋友。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'rrk is called by dwellers Goek. rrk is a dweller here, too, and before then, a builder of place. Goek, Geeub, Mak and Many Eyes build a new Yd in the reef, hundreds of years.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Goek.Who.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: rrk is called by dwellers Goek. rrk is a dweller here, too, and before then, a builder of place. Goek, Geeub, Mak and Many Eyes build a new Yd in the reef, hundreds of years.
translation: 居民叫 呱 戈埃克。呱 也是这里的居民，在那之前，是地方的建造者。戈埃克、吉厄布、马克和多眼在礁中建造新伊德，数百年。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'rrk did before then, but rrk all build it now.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Goek.Built.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: rrk did before then, but rrk all build it now.
translation: 呱 从前建造过，但 呱 如今都建造它。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'rrk is svardym like the hatchling from the egg, but wound down the chute of years in hundreds, and grown so long and warty! rrk was a hatchling once, cries to think on it!'), ('Context', 'Conversation Goek.Towering.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: rrk is svardym like the hatchling from the egg, but wound down the chute of years in hundreds, and grown so long and warty! rrk was a hatchling once, cries to think on it!
translation: 呱 是斯瓦尔丁，像从蛋里出来的幼体一样，但沿着岁月滑槽滚了几百年，长得这么长、这么多疣！呱 也曾是幼体，一想到就想哭！

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Aren't the svardym one of the Gyre plagues?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Goek.Towering.GyreChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Aren't the svardym one of the Gyre plagues?
translation: 斯瓦尔丁不是轮回瘟灾之一吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Yes rrk was once, "plague" in the sky hundreds of years. Not so now. Longtime rrk, Geeub, Mak hide in the sponge and eat lice. When find Many Eyes, rrk and friends built the Yd. Joyful helping!'), ('Context', 'Conversation Goek.Gyre.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Yes rrk was once, "plague" in the sky hundreds of years. Not so now. Longtime rrk, Geeub, Mak hide in the sponge and eat lice. When find Many Eyes, rrk and friends built the Yd. Joyful helping!
translation: 是，呱 曾经是，天空中的“瘟灾”数百年。现在不是了。很久以来，呱、吉厄布、马克藏在海绵里吃虱子。找到多眼后，呱 和朋友们建造了伊德。快乐帮助！

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Do you know anything of the other plagues?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Goek.Gyre.OtherPlaguesChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Do you know anything of the other plagues?
translation: 你知道其他瘟灾的事吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Plagues bloom a thousand year then die back, shrink under the earth-sponge or move here and east. Vanta, girshling, rot die. rrk the hatchling once saw the Nephilim loom! rrk frightened and hid inside a sponge for thirty moons.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Goek.OtherPlagues.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Plagues bloom a thousand year then die back, shrink under the earth-sponge or move here and east. Vanta, girshling, rot die. rrk the hatchling once saw the Nephilim loom! rrk frightened and hid inside a sponge for thirty moons.
translation: 瘟灾盛放千年，然后衰败，缩回地海绵之下，或迁到这里和东方。万塔、吉尔什幼体、腐烂死去。幼体 呱 曾见拿非利显现！呱 害怕，躲进海绵里三十个月亮。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Do you know anything of the other plagues?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Goek.OtherPlagues.OtherPlaguesChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Do you know anything of the other plagues?
translation: 你知道其他瘟灾的事吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Water and gas piped through the Yd to feed the plants, dwellers, and machines! Dwellers blew the glass in hues like the prism perch, to look pretty. Shared together. Joyful helping!'), ('Context', 'Conversation Goek.Pipes.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Water and gas piped through the Yd to feed the plants, dwellers, and machines! Dwellers blew the glass in hues like the prism perch, to look pretty. Shared together. Joyful helping!
translation: 水和气体穿过伊德的管道，喂养植物、居民和机器！居民把玻璃吹成棱镜栖木般的色泽，好看。共同分享。快乐帮助！

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'rrk read the signs and descend the stairs. rrk breathe the water smoke and sit on starfish.

Visit hovels, meet friends Mak, Geeub, Bep, Krka, Une, Tilli, farmer Rokhas, and every rest!

rrk rrkself.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Goek.Freehold2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
rrk read the signs and descend the stairs. rrk breathe the water smoke and sit on starfish.

Visit hovels, meet friends Mak, Geeub, Bep, Krka, Une, Tilli, farmer Rokhas, and every rest!

rrk rrkself.
translation:
呱 读标牌，走下楼梯。呱 呼吸水烟，坐在海星上。

拜访棚屋，见朋友马克、吉厄布、贝普、克尔卡、乌恩、蒂利、农夫罗卡斯，还有每一个其他！

呱 是 呱 自己。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'What indignity have you come to heap upon the mound, whelp? Out with it.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Mak.Start.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: What indignity have you come to heap upon the mound, whelp? Out with it.
translation: 你又来往这堆土上堆什么羞辱，小崽子？说吧。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "You're one of the founders of this freehold, aren't you?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Mak.Start.FounderChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You're one of the founders of this freehold, aren't you?
translation: 你是这个自由堡的创立者之一，对吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I've never seen a frog of your stature."), ('Context', 'Conversation Mak.Start.StatureChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I've never seen a frog of your stature.
translation: 我从没见过你这样体格的蛙类。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'What can you tell me about the Freehold?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Mak.Start.FreeholdChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: What can you tell me about the Freehold?
translation: 你能告诉我自由堡的事吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'What of it? Scurry on and leave me to brood.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Mak.Founder.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: What of it? Scurry on and leave me to brood.
translation: 那又怎样？快滚，让我独自阴郁。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'This seems a joyful place. Why are you angry?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Mak.Founder.Founder2Choice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: This seems a joyful place. Why are you angry?
translation: 这里看起来很欢乐。你为什么生气？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Why? A lifetime of vexation. Born to a cacophony of static ringing the ears raw. Thousands of my kinfolk cut down by that porphyric wasp fools called Lamb. A millenium of hot stinking sun and disgusting brine lice for supper.\n\nMisery obtains on this pond, whelp. By Chavvah if you start beaming like a sunray and yodeling at the Beetle Moon, I'll eat you where you stand."), ('Context', 'Conversation Mak.Founder2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Why? A lifetime of vexation. Born to a cacophony of static ringing the ears raw. Thousands of my kinfolk cut down by that porphyric wasp fools called Lamb. A millenium of hot stinking sun and disgusting brine lice for supper.

Misery obtains on this pond, whelp. By Chavvah if you start beaming like a sunray and yodeling at the Beetle Moon, I'll eat you where you stand.
translation:
为什么？一辈子的烦恼。生在静电杂音的喧嚣里，耳朵被震得生疼。我的数千同族被那些蠢货称作羔羊的斑紫胡蜂砍倒。一千年炎热发臭的太阳，还有恶心的盐水虱当晚饭。

痛苦就在这池塘上，小崽子。以查瓦之名，要是你开始像阳光一样笑得灿烂，对着甲虫月亮约德尔唱歌，我会当场把你吃掉。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Who am I? Mak. That's all you get. I'll not waste the honey of my mouth on idle inquiries."), ('Context', 'Conversation Mak.Who.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Who am I? Mak. That's all you get. I'll not waste the honey of my mouth on idle inquiries.
translation: 我是谁？马克。你只能知道这么多。我不会把嘴里的蜜浪费在无聊问题上。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '...\n\nAnd? Is that the whole of your fool statement?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Mak.Stature.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
...

And? Is that the whole of your fool statement?
translation:
……

然后呢？你那愚蠢陈述就这些？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Trust what you hear of the svardym, whelp. The sky blackens at our accession and we are like to eat you.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Mak.Stature2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Trust what you hear of the svardym, whelp. The sky blackens at our accession and we are like to eat you.
translation: 相信你听说过的斯瓦尔丁吧，小崽子。我们升起时天空会变黑，而我们很可能吃掉你。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Have the adiyy chewed the hue from your eyes? See for yourself. Free folk make a gathering here and their racket rings through the reef. One can hardly steep in his greens without being mewled to by a salt-stung baby.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Mak.Freehold.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Have the adiyy chewed the hue from your eyes? See for yourself. Free folk make a gathering here and their racket rings through the reef. One can hardly steep in his greens without being mewled to by a salt-stung baby.
translation: 阿迪斯把你眼里的颜色嚼掉了吗？自己看。自由民在这里聚集，他们的喧闹响彻礁中。一个人想泡泡自己的绿叶都难，旁边总有被盐蜇过的婴孩喵喵叫。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Whelp, affix your eyes to that clam right yonder. Go step inside and find your answers.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Mak.Pond2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Whelp, affix your eyes to that clam right yonder. Go step inside and find your answers.
translation: 小崽子，把你的眼睛钉到那边那只蛤蜊上。进去，自己找答案。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*long, smoky croak*}}\n\nAh, =player.formalAddressTerm=, here at last. Sit. Smoke. Rest.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Geeub.Start.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*long, smoky croak*}}

Ah, =player.formalAddressTerm=, here at last. Sit. Smoke. Rest.
translation:
{{emote|*一声悠长、烟雾般的蛙鸣*}}

啊，=player.formalAddressTerm=，终于来了。坐。抽烟。休息。
抱歉，我们已经说过话了吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "You're one of the founders of this freehold, aren't you?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Geeub.Start.FounderChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You're one of the founders of this freehold, aren't you?
translation: 你是这个自由堡的创立者之一，对吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I can't help but notice your impressive stature, even in repose."), ('Context', 'Conversation Geeub.Start.GeeubToweringChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I can't help but notice your impressive stature, even in repose.
translation: 即便你静卧着，我也无法不注意到你惊人的体格。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'What can you tell me about Yd?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Geeub.Start.GeeubFreeholdChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: What can you tell me about Yd?
translation: 你能告诉我伊德的事吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Ayup. But seconds ago. As only yesterday, no? Hoh hoh hoh.\n\n{{emote|*continued croaking laughter*}}'), ('Context', 'Conversation Geeub.Familiar.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Ayup. But seconds ago. As only yesterday, no? Hoh hoh hoh.

{{emote|*continued croaking laughter*}}
translation:
是啊。就在几秒前。就像昨天，不是吗？呵呵呵。

{{emote|*持续的蛙鸣笑声*}}

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Ah. Well. Let's talk about something else, then."), ('Context', 'Conversation Geeub.Familiar.GeeubQuery.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Ah. Well. Let's talk about something else, then.
translation: 啊。好吧。那我们聊点别的。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Oh, very funny. Live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Geeub.Familiar.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Oh, very funny. Live and drink.

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*croaking sigh*}}\n\nCongratulation, condolence, which ever. Mind and name slip by another.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Geeub.Introduce.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*croaking sigh*}}

Congratulation, condolence, which ever. Mind and name slip by another.
translation:
{{emote|*蛙鸣般的叹息*}}

恭喜，慰问，哪个都好。心智与名字彼此滑过。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'So large? Hoh hoh. Well. Hatchlings, so rage-dense. Size diffuses, no?\n\nHowever. Mak diverges, hoh hoh. Egg-rage simmers on a greater pot. Our voice eld-feeble, close your ears to it. Hoh hoh hoh.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Geeub.Towering.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
So large? Hoh hoh. Well. Hatchlings, so rage-dense. Size diffuses, no?

However. Mak diverges, hoh hoh. Egg-rage simmers on a greater pot. Our voice eld-feeble, close your ears to it. Hoh hoh hoh.
translation:
这么大？呵呵。嗯。幼体，怒意太密。体型会扩散，不是吗？

不过。马克不同，呵呵。蛋中怒火在更大的锅里慢炖。我们的声音老朽虚弱，对它闭上耳朵吧。呵呵呵。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Sun we once blotted out nestles our horizon. We tend thought-seeds with algae, wrap in crysteel, bathe in arc-light. Build, live, fight.\n\nHere as elsewhere, grow is struggle. Fun to watch, no? Hoh. Hoh.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Geeub.Freehold.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Sun we once blotted out nestles our horizon. We tend thought-seeds with algae, wrap in crysteel, bathe in arc-light. Build, live, fight.

Here as elsewhere, grow is struggle. Fun to watch, no? Hoh. Hoh.
translation:
我们曾遮蔽的太阳，如今依偎在我们的地平线上。我们用藻类照料思想种子，以晶钢包裹，沐浴弧光。建造，生活，战斗。

在这里，也和别处一样，成长就是挣扎。看着有趣，不是吗？呵。呵。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Yes, we were present, if less active than other-bodies. But we saw, and rattle with memory-artifacts as a Consortium lockbox rattles with jewels; shards of an eon-old data disk, bits of stories and places. Kin-fleeing, louse-meals, ghastly boredom. But Fate's caprice brought us through history's footsteps. There was a machine-speaker, and her ursine apprentice with his little plant, and the Sower with a tetrad of chubby whelps, and then, at last, Many-Eyes. Our dear galgal. So many."), ('Context', 'Conversation Geeub.Founder2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Yes, we were present, if less active than other-bodies. But we saw, and rattle with memory-artifacts as a Consortium lockbox rattles with jewels; shards of an eon-old data disk, bits of stories and places. Kin-fleeing, louse-meals, ghastly boredom. But Fate's caprice brought us through history's footsteps. There was a machine-speaker, and her ursine apprentice with his little plant, and the Sower with a tetrad of chubby whelps, and then, at last, Many-Eyes. Our dear galgal. So many.
translation: 是，我们在场，虽然没有其他身体那样活跃。但我们看见了，也因记忆遗物而作响，像商会锁箱因珠宝而作响；一片亿年旧数据盘的碎片，故事与地点的零星残片。亲族逃离，虱子餐食，骇人的无聊。但命运的反复无常带我们走过历史的足迹。曾有机器言说者，还有她的熊形学徒和他的小植物，播种者带着四个胖墩墩的小崽子，然后，最后，多眼。我们亲爱的 加尔加尔。太多了。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "But alas. Like our sea-grape friend's lockbox, these memories are not mine to retrieve at will. They come and go, and may be warped by eld."), ('Context', 'Conversation Geeub.Founder3.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: But alas. Like our sea-grape friend's lockbox, these memories are not mine to retrieve at will. They come and go, and may be warped by eld.
translation: 但唉。就像我们海葡萄朋友的锁箱，这些记忆不是我能随意取出的。它们来来去去，也可能被年岁扭曲。

但是。温柔？不杀。
为什么你也不具攻击性？

杀，吃，不被吃。复仇地平静下来。

translation:
月与日，=player.formalAddressTerm=。你行走在伊德自由堡，如果你和平，便受欢迎。

你有什么需要乌恩帮忙的吗？需要保护，还是义体货品，还是你是为了手摇琴而来？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'That thing sounds like a dying animal.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Une.Start.UneDying.Text')), 1),), '#text')

I did, and I do.

Are you in the market?

我说过，而且我确实卖。

你有购买意向吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Were they in use when you found them?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Une.Source.IgnoreChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')

And you? What's your name?

我被称为乌恩。当有人需要为外来者披上权威时，就是“守望者”乌恩。

你呢？你叫什么？

Now. Need a question answered, a tune played, a body upgraded?

现在。需要回答问题，演奏曲调，还是升级身体？

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*Warden Une tilts their head and purses their lips*}}\n\nVery well. Need you aught, O Nameless One?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Une.Snub.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Warden Une tilts their head and purses their lips*}}

Very well. Need you aught, O Nameless One?
translation:
{{emote|*守望者乌恩歪过头，抿起嘴唇*}}

很好。无名者啊，你需要什么吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Oh, I am hardly an unbiased observer, I'm afraid -- the Freehold is the only welcoming home I could ever have imagined for myself, and my home before was worse than most. I feel a freedom and responsibility here that I would know nowhere else. That no one else could ever know at all.\n\nBut bias aside, you can see for yourself that we are a collective thriving without hierarchy. I'm rightly proud to defend that."), ('Context', 'Conversation Une.Freehold.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Oh, I am hardly an unbiased observer, I'm afraid -- the Freehold is the only welcoming home I could ever have imagined for myself, and my home before was worse than most. I feel a freedom and responsibility here that I would know nowhere else. That no one else could ever know at all.

But bias aside, you can see for yourself that we are a collective thriving without hierarchy. I'm rightly proud to defend that.
translation:
哦，恐怕我很难算是没有偏见的观察者——自由堡是我唯一能为自己想象出的、会欢迎我的家，而我从前的家比大多数地方都糟。我在这里感到一种在别处不会知道的自由与责任。别人也根本不可能知道。

但抛开偏见，你自己也能看见，我们是一个没有等级却繁荣的共同体。我理应为守护这一点而自豪。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "An old, old, old, old music machine.\n\nWell, I suppose this one is not so old. This one I commissioned from a wandering artisan whose life I saved. A story for another time. Surely you've business."), ('Context', 'Conversation Une.Gurdy.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
An old, old, old, old music machine.

Well, I suppose this one is not so old. This one I commissioned from a wandering artisan whose life I saved. A story for another time. Surely you've business.
translation:
一台很老、很老、很老、很老的音乐机器。

好吧，我想这一台并没那么老。这一台是我委托一位游荡工匠做的，我曾救过他的命。那是另一个时候的故事。你肯定有正事。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Oh, so it called to you, a fellow dying animal?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Une.Dying.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Oh, so it called to you, a fellow dying animal?
translation: 哦，所以它呼唤了你，一个同为垂死动物的家伙？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "You are a dying animal. So am I. We are all dying animals, scrabbling for what extra scraps of time we can grasp. Even the eons-old. We are each and every one of us a dying animal. Or plant. We all decay, is the point.\n\nAnd the hurdy-gurdy doesn't like how you sound either, for what it is worth."), ('Context', 'Conversation Une.Dying2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
You are a dying animal. So am I. We are all dying animals, scrabbling for what extra scraps of time we can grasp. Even the eons-old. We are each and every one of us a dying animal. Or plant. We all decay, is the point.

And the hurdy-gurdy doesn't like how you sound either, for what it is worth.
translation:
你是垂死的动物。我也是。我们全都是垂死的动物，拼命抓取还能抓到的额外时间碎片。即便那些活了亿万年的也是。我们每一个都是垂死的动物。或者植物。重点是，我们都会腐朽。

顺便说一句，手摇琴也不喜欢你的声音。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Is this how you always greet visitors?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Une.Dying2.Dying3Choice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Is this how you always greet visitors?
translation: 你总是这样问候访客吗？
