translation: 我要把陶的晶钟带到主根，好让她离开查瓦。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "{{emote|*there is an agitation in Thicksalt's accepting chime.*}}\n\nPluck the air, then, with your mouth sounds."), ('Context', 'Conversation Thicksalt.PostQuestions.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*there is an agitation in Thicksalt's accepting chime.*}}

Pluck the air, then, with your mouth sounds.
translation:
{{emote|*厚盐接纳的钟声中有一阵躁动。*}}

那就用你的口中声音拨动空气吧。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*Thicksalt chimes a single, outstretched tone.*}}\n\nThe naming act is imponderable. So Tau called me Thicksalt, one brickword in a towerful poem whose everyshape I forget, but whose flushing of Soft in afterfeel I am in allway.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Thicksalt.Name.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Thicksalt chimes a single, outstretched tone.*}}

The naming act is imponderable. So Tau called me Thicksalt, one brickword in a towerful poem whose everyshape I forget, but whose flushing of Soft in afterfeel I am in allway.
translation:
{{emote|*厚盐鸣出一声延展的单音。*}}

命名之举深不可测。陶因而称我为厚盐——那是满塔诗篇中的一枚砖词。我已忘却整首诗的一切形态，却始终活在它余韵中柔质涌流的触感里。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*Tammuz is nearly silent but for a soft, shaky resonance*}}\n\n...'), ('Context', 'Conversation Tammuz.KilledTau.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Tammuz is nearly silent but for a soft, shaky resonance*}}

...
translation:
{{emote|*塔穆兹几乎沉默，只剩柔和而颤抖的共振*}}

……

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*the chime rings shaky and loud*}}\n\nWh-what is this? H-how is it meant? This outcome j-judders within and w-without us.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Tammuz.Killed2.LostInSoft.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*the chime rings shaky and loud*}}

Wh-what is this? H-how is it meant? This outcome j-judders within and w-without us.
translation:
{{emote|*一阵颤抖而响亮的钟声响起*}}

这、这是什么？该、该怎么理解？这个结果在我们体、体内震颤，也在我们之外震颤。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Wh-what will Tau b-be after soft? You, did, did you mean... wh-what c-could you say? Tau spins within, the g-gyre spins without.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Tammuz.Killed2.Lost2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Wh-what will Tau b-be after soft? You, did, did you mean... wh-what c-could you say? Tau spins within, the g-gyre spins without.
translation: 陶经柔质重塑后，会、会成为什么？你、你原本想要……又、又能说什么？陶在内旋转，轮、轮回在外旋转。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*Tammuz chimes a querulous tone*}}\n\nO-oh. Elsefolder... th-this path you have l-laid upon Tau, it-it is best. It is good? P-please be good.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Tammuz.KilledCompanion.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Tammuz chimes a querulous tone*}}

O-oh. Elsefolder... th-this path you have l-laid upon Tau, it-it is best. It is good? P-please be good.
translation:
{{emote|*塔穆兹鸣出哀诉的音调*}}

哦、哦。离枝者……你为陶铺、铺下的这条路，是、是最好的路。是好事，对吗？请、请一定是好事。

source: How does Tau's departure find you?
translation: 陶的离去令你作何感受？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "{{emote|*Tammuz's chime rings even quieter and more tremulous*}}\n\nUn, un-uncertain. Tau l-leaves unfolded but the g-g-g-gyre yet s-spins. The s-spinning leaves me dizzy."), ('Context', 'Conversation Tammuz.Companion2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Tammuz's chime rings even quieter and more tremulous*}}

Un, un-uncertain. Tau l-leaves unfolded but the g-g-g-gyre yet s-spins. The s-spinning leaves me dizzy.
translation:
{{emote|*塔穆兹的钟声更轻，也更加颤抖*}}

不、不确定。陶已舒展开来，离、离开了，可轮、轮、轮回仍在转、转动。它转得我头晕。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*Tammuz rings a wavering chime*}}\n\nY-you are here. Elseing h... hand.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Tammuz.ElseWelcome.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Tammuz rings a wavering chime*}}

Y-you are here. Elseing h... hand.
translation:
{{emote|*塔穆兹鸣出摇曳的钟声*}}

你、你来了。举行离枝仪式的……手。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "How does Tau's departure find you?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Tammuz.ElseWelcome.Else2Choice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: How does Tau's departure find you?
translation: 陶的离去令你作何感受？

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*the chime is louder this time, but just as querulous*}}\n\nSh-sh-she, th-this fate, it. It is a d-deep dark. Will Tau f-fold herself, I wonder?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Tammuz.Else2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*the chime is louder this time, but just as querulous*}}

Sh-sh-she, th-this fate, it. It is a d-deep dark. Will Tau f-fold herself, I wonder?
translation:
{{emote|*这一次钟声更响，但同样哀诉*}}

她……她的命、命运，落进了很深、很深的黑暗。我不知道陶会不会把自己折、折回去。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "{{emote|*Tammuz chimes a broad and booming tone.*}}\n\nYou! Purpose-driven mad... madhand. You've come here, right? Then you must know power is our... the domain of being is one of power, wouldn't you say? W-Would you please agree with that?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Tammuz.Welcome.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Tammuz chimes a broad and booming tone.*}}

You! Purpose-driven mad... madhand. You've come here, right? Then you must know power is our... the domain of being is one of power, wouldn't you say? W-Would you please agree with that?
translation:
{{emote|*塔穆兹鸣出宽阔而轰鸣的音调。*}}

你！受目的驱使的疯……疯手。你来到这里，对吧？那么你一定明白，我们……存在本身就是力量的领域。你也会这么说吧？你、你能赞同吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I am to carry Tau's chime to Taproot, so she can leave Chavvah."), ('Context', 'Conversation Tammuz.Choices.TauChimeChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I am to carry Tau's chime to Taproot, so she can leave Chavvah.
translation: 我要把陶的晶钟带到主根，好让她离开查瓦。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'If y-y, th-that... yes. Ask if, if asking.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Tammuz.PostQuestions.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: If y-y, th-that... yes. Ask if, if asking.
translation: 如、如果你想问……那、那就问吧。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*Tammuz quiets, then chimes in tottering, unsure tones.*}}\n\nYou beast! You m-moon king! You... Our roars are beastial! Would you say so?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Tammuz.Welcome2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Tammuz quiets, then chimes in tottering, unsure tones.*}}

You beast! You m-moon king! You... Our roars are beastial! Would you say so?
translation:
{{emote|*塔穆兹安静下来，随后以摇晃而不确定的音调鸣响。*}}

你这野兽！你这月、月之王！你……我们的咆哮像野兽！你会这么说吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'You sound very unsure of yourself.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Tammuz.What.UnsureChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You sound very unsure of yourself.
translation: 你听起来对自己很不确定。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Be uncertain, friend. You have my permission.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Tammuz.Unsure.PermissionChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Be uncertain, friend. You have my permission.
translation: 不确定也没关系，朋友。你有我的允许。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I will give you a moment.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Tammuz.Permission.EndChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I will give you a moment.

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*Tammuz chimes a small and bright noise.*}}\n\nTa- Tammuz. Who becomes. Who is Twofirm even in -then.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Tammuz.Name.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Tammuz chimes a small and bright noise.*}}

Ta- Tammuz. Who becomes. Who is Twofirm even in -then.
translation:
{{emote|*塔穆兹鸣出细小而明亮的声音。*}}

塔、塔穆兹。不断成为的存在。即便已经成形，也仍是双相质。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'The t-two sephirots. -then and -else. I cannot be -else. *I* cannot, of course. But -then? It does not seem so.\n\nTheir chimes ring at the right frequencies, others. But not so, mine.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Tammuz.Twofirm.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
The t-two sephirots. -then and -else. I cannot be -else. *I* cannot, of course. But -then? It does not seem so.

Their chimes ring at the right frequencies, others. But not so, mine.
translation:
两、两种可能自我：一种会成形，另一种不会。那未成形的另一个不可能是我，*我* 当然不会成为它。可已经成形的这个呢？似乎也不完全是我。

其他晶钟都以正确的频率鸣响，可我的晶钟……并非如此。

path:
((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*Tammuz quivers and chimes a jarring tone.*}}

O-Oh. Oh u-uh oh oh. By contrasts, a q-quake stills even the most anxious trembling...

The world... the world becomes and unbecomes. All the nervous, volcanic energy of being. Who becomes who? Three became one, but what of them now? 

And w-what becomes of Tau? Of me? Of y-you?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Tammuz.Gyredream.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{emote|*Tammuz quivers and chimes a jarring tone.*}}

O-Oh. Oh u-uh oh oh. By contrasts, a q-quake stills even the most anxious trembling...

The world... the world becomes and unbecomes. All the nervous, volcanic energy of being. Who becomes who? Three became one, but what of them now? 

And w-what becomes of Tau? Of me? Of y-you?
translation:
{{emote|*塔穆兹颤抖着，鸣出刺耳的音调。*}}

哦、哦。哦呃、呃哦哦。相比之下，地、地震甚至能止住最焦虑的颤抖……

世界……世界成为又不成为。存在的所有神经质的、火山般的能量。谁成为谁？三者成了一者，但它们现在又如何？

那陶会、会成为什么？我呢？你、你呢？

((('string', (('ID', 'You have severed the hand outstretched to me. Why?\n\nWhat have you done? What am I to do?'), ('Context', 'Conversation TauNoLonger.Orphaned.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
You have severed the hand outstretched to me. Why?

What have you done? What am I to do?
translation:
你斩断了伸向我的手。为什么？

你做了什么？我又该做什么？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Your will would have been suborned to Ptoh.'), ('Context', 'Conversation TauNoLonger.Orphaned.SubornedChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Your will would have been suborned to Ptoh.
translation: 你的意志会被普托控制。

source: You will be happier this way.

translation: 你要让普托控制自己的意志？

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{M|You}} suborn my will! You allow me to start upon this path and block it. Yes?\n\nNow I am truly adrift.'), ('Context', 'Conversation TauNoLonger.Suborned.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
{{M|You}} suborn my will! You allow me to start upon this path and block it. Yes?

Now I am truly adrift.
translation:
侵夺我自主选择的是 {{M|你}}！你先让我踏上这条路，却又把它堵死。对吗？

现在我才是真正漂流无依。

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'Ah.

Well. You have my thanks for your help in -elseing, but by blocking my path you create fresh problems. Yes?

I do not wish to know you.

Live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation TauNoLonger.Uncaring.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Ah.

Well. You have my thanks for your help in -elseing, but by blocking my path you create fresh problems. Yes?

I do not wish to know you.

Live and drink.
translation:
啊。

好吧。感谢你帮助我完成离枝，可你又阻断了我的道路，制造出新的问题。对吗？

我不想认识你。

生而饮水。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I resent what has befallen me, but I am yet embodied. You have still helped me live, yes?\n\nI forgive you, but I don't wish to know you. Live and drink."), ('Context', 'Conversation TauNoLonger.Sorry.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I resent what has befallen me, but I am yet embodied. You have still helped me live, yes?

I forgive you, but I don't wish to know you. Live and drink.
translation:
我怨恨降临在我身上的事，但我仍有形体。你仍然帮助我活了下来，对吗？

我宽恕你，但我不想认识你。生而饮水。

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'Perhaps. My future is hazy. My future twists in the chill wind of the Gyre. I can have no faith in your vision. You understand this, yes?

I do not wish to know you.

Live and drink.'), ('Context', 'Conversation TauNoLonger.Happier.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Perhaps. My future is hazy. My future twists in the chill wind of the Gyre. I can have no faith in your vision. You understand this, yes?

I do not wish to know you.

Live and drink.
translation:
也许吧。我的未来朦胧。我的未来在轮回的寒风中扭曲。我无法相信你的预言。你明白这一点，对吗？

我不想认识你。

生而饮水。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Present. Alone, afraid, but anticipating my return to the embrace of a collective.'), ('Context', 'Conversation TauNoLonger.How.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Present. Alone, afraid, but anticipating my return to the embrace of a collective.
translation: 我就在这里。孤独，害怕，但也盼望着回到一个集体的怀抱。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'More than someone. My liaison is the extended, outstretched hands of a greater mind-haven than I have otherwise known. I might not have had the courage to -else without knowing that a collective awaited me.\n\nMy future is hazy, my future is bright.'), ('Context', 'Conversation TauNoLonger.Liaison.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
More than someone. My liaison is the extended, outstretched hands of a greater mind-haven than I have otherwise known. I might not have had the courage to -else without knowing that a collective awaited me.

My future is hazy, my future is bright.
translation:
不只是“有人”。等待我的是一个庞大的心灵共同体，一个比我所知任何庇护所都更辽阔的意识家园。若非知道它在等待我，我未必有勇气离开查瓦、成为独立的自己。

我的未来朦胧，我的未来明亮。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Speaking creatures seem very engrossed in this 'will' idea, but few agree what it is. Your mind is under influence from other thinkbeings the moment you observe them, yes? You 'learn' by imitating, your values and beliefs are adopted from observation. Yes?\n\nI have made a choice to offer my consciousness to a new paradigm, but this choice seems distinct from your conception of 'will'. We speak past one another."), ('Context', 'Conversation TauNoLonger.Ptoh.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Speaking creatures seem very engrossed in this 'will' idea, but few agree what it is. Your mind is under influence from other thinkbeings the moment you observe them, yes? You 'learn' by imitating, your values and beliefs are adopted from observation. Yes?

I have made a choice to offer my consciousness to a new paradigm, but this choice seems distinct from your conception of 'will'. We speak past one another.
translation:
会说话的生物似乎非常着迷于“意志”这个概念，却很少能就它的含义达成一致。你一观察其他有思想的存在，心智就会受到他们影响，对吗？你通过模仿来“学习”，价值与信念也来自观察。对吗？

我已经作出选择，将自己的意识交给一种新的范式，但这份选择似乎不同于你所理解的“意志”。我们对“意志”的理解并不相同，因此总是在各说各话。

我不记得自己承诺过要成为吃草的享乐主义者。如果我被召去狩猎，我就会狩猎。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'The echoes of ending reverberate from the roots I once called mine.\n\nMy liaison is severed. Why?'), ('Context', 'Conversation WanderingTau.Orphaned.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
The echoes of ending reverberate from the roots I once called mine.

My liaison is severed. Why?
translation:
终结的回声从我曾称为己有的根中回荡。

我与联络者的联系断了。为什么？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Your will would have been suborned to Ptoh.'), ('Context', 'Conversation WanderingTau.Orphaned.SubornedChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Your will would have been suborned to Ptoh.
translation: 你的意志会被普托控制。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'You are free to do as you please.'), ('Context', 'Conversation WanderingTau.Orphaned.FreeChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You are free to do as you please.
translation: 你可以自由做你想做的事。

source: You will be happier this way.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I should be wary of you, yes? You have helped me to my -else, but I find my chosen path blocked.'), ('Context', 'Conversation WanderingTau.How.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I should be wary of you, yes? You have helped me to my -else, but I find my chosen path blocked.
translation: 你帮助我完成了离枝，却又堵死了我原本选择的道路。我应该警惕你，对吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'It is not Ptoh that has suborned my will in this case.\n\nI had chosen a path.'), ('Context', 'Conversation WanderingTau.Suborned.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
It is not Ptoh that has suborned my will in this case.

I had chosen a path.
translation:
在这件事上，侵夺我自主选择的不是普托。

我曾选择一条道路。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "And yet, I find my choices undermined, yes? You have my thanks for your help in -elseing, but do not convince yourself that you have 'freed' me from my own choices.\n\nLive and drink."), ('Context', 'Conversation WanderingTau.Free.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
And yet, I find my choices undermined, yes? You have my thanks for your help in -elseing, but do not convince yourself that you have 'freed' me from my own choices.

Live and drink.
translation:
然而，我的选择仍遭到破坏，对吗？感谢你帮助我完成离枝，但别自欺欺人地说，你把我从自己的选择中“解放”了。

生而饮水。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I resent what has befallen me, but I am yet embodied. You have still helped me live.\n\nMy future is free. My future is murky, and I am freshly tender from the burn of your hand. I feel I had rather not encounter you for a time. Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.'), ('Context', 'Conversation WanderingTau.Sorry.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I resent what has befallen me, but I am yet embodied. You have still helped me live.

My future is free. My future is murky, and I am freshly tender from the burn of your hand. I feel I had rather not encounter you for a time. Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
translation:
我怨恨降临在我身上的事，但我仍有形体。你仍然帮助我活了下来。

我的未来自由，却也晦暗。你的手留下的灼伤仍然鲜痛。我想，暂时还是不要再见到你为好。生而饮水，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'Will I?

Your prediction warms little against the chill wind of the Gyre. My future is free. My future is murky. I am freshly tender from the burn of your hand.

I feel I had rather not encounter you for a time. Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.'), ('Context', 'Conversation WanderingTau.Happier.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Will I?

Your prediction warms little against the chill wind of the Gyre. My future is free. My future is murky. I am freshly tender from the burn of your hand.

I feel I had rather not encounter you for a time. Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
translation:
我会吗？

你的预言抵不过轮回的寒风，给不了我多少暖意。我的未来自由，却也晦暗。你的手留下的灼伤仍然鲜痛。

我想，暂时还是不要再见到你为好。生而饮水，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Before you go, rootclimber. I've shed a piece of me in the -elseing. Take it. I have no use for it now."), ('Context', 'Conversation WanderingTau.EndGift.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Before you go, rootclimber. I've shed a piece of me in the -elseing. Take it. I have no use for it now.
translation: 在你离开前，攀根者，拿着这个——我在离枝时蜕下的一块身体物质，如今已经用不上了。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Begone from me, stardimmer. Your own hand has vaporized your purpose.'), ('Context', 'Conversation TauCompanion.Welcome.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Begone from me, stardimmer. Your own hand has vaporized your purpose.
translation: 离我远些，黯星者。你亲手让自己的使命化为乌有。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'You thrived at the performance of a pruning motion, utensil. Now store yourself until Fate reshapes you.\n\nThe end.'), ('Context', 'Conversation TauCompanion.Welcome2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
You thrived at the performance of a pruning motion, utensil. Now store yourself until Fate reshapes you.

The end.
translation:
这次修剪做得不错，工具。现在退到一旁，等命运再次塑造你。

到此为止。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'The utensil arrives. You, to prune the fate-rhizome and free our girl. Go now and perform the motion.'), ('Context', 'Conversation TauCompanion.WelcomeHub.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: The utensil arrives. You, to prune the fate-rhizome and free our girl. Go now and perform the motion.
translation: 工具到了。去修剪命运的根茎，解放我们的姑娘。现在就动手吧。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "You're a seeker of the Sightless Way?"), ('Context', 'Conversation TauCompanion.WelcomeHub.SeekerChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You're a seeker of the Sightless Way?

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Give her your parting words, utensil. Our hearts are in elsewhere.'), ('Context', 'Conversation TauCompanion.Welcome3.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Give her your parting words, utensil. Our hearts are in elsewhere.
translation: 向她道别吧，工具。我们的心思已经转向别处。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Begone. Fate has not yet shaped you, utensil.'), ('Context', 'Conversation TauCompanion.Welcome4.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Begone. Fate has not yet shaped you, utensil.
translation: 走开。命运尚未塑造你，工具。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Utensil? That is my avocation, yes. A million sun-dead homes I've roved, a trillion more await. I'm a worm in the loam of a cosmic wood, perched on a cosmic gulf, swathed in the god-manifold."), ('Context', 'Conversation TauCompanion.Seeker.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Utensil? That is my avocation, yes. A million sun-dead homes I've roved, a trillion more await. I'm a worm in the loam of a cosmic wood, perched on a cosmic gulf, swathed in the god-manifold.
translation: 工具？没错，追寻确是我的副业。我已游历百万座太阳死去的家园，还有万亿座在前方等待。我是宇宙森林腐殖土中的一条蠕虫，栖身于宇宙深渊之畔，包裹在神性的万千形态之中。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Prune! The utensil prunes! -but no, the utensil quivers in uncertainty and vibrates out a question?\n\nThe self is riddled with category errors. The thinking brain mistakes formation for meaning.'), ('Context', 'Conversation TauCompanion.Taking.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Prune! The utensil prunes! -but no, the utensil quivers in uncertainty and vibrates out a question?

The self is riddled with category errors. The thinking brain mistakes formation for meaning.
translation:
修剪！工具就该修剪！——可它为何犹疑颤抖，反倒振出一个问题？

自我充斥着范畴错误。思考的脑误把事物如何形成，当成了它为何有意义。

source: Tell me. I wish to understand.

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Maggot! What do you think words are? Arrows of inquiry? Words are bricks. Each spoken is laid in bond and builds your prison. There is no understanding.'), ('Context', 'Conversation TauCompanion.Understand.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Maggot! What do you think words are? Arrows of inquiry? Words are bricks. Each spoken is laid in bond and builds your prison. There is no understanding.
translation: 蛆虫！你以为词语是什么？探求答案的箭矢？词语是砖，每说出一句，就砌下一块，筑起囚禁你的牢房。根本不存在所谓理解。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "You tarry on the future's boundary with abandon, utensil. Throw your brick if you dare."), ('Context', 'Conversation TauCompanion.Throw.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You tarry on the future's boundary with abandon, utensil. Throw your brick if you dare.
translation: 你毫无顾忌地徘徊在未来的边缘，工具。敢的话，就把你的砖扔出来。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '{{emote|*The chime is silent and still.*}}'), ('Context', 'Conversation TauSoft.Welcome.Text')), 1),), '#text')

((('string', (('ID', 'Oh wow, an animal.

Congratulations for... not dying.

... wanna buy something?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Santalalotze.Welcome.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Oh wow, an animal.

Congratulations for... not dying.

... wanna buy something?
translation:
哦哇，一个动物。

恭喜你……没有死。

……想买点什么吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Are you part of this tree?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Santalalotze.Welcome.TreeChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Are you part of this tree?
translation: 你是这棵树的一部分吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Why are you selling goods in such a remote and dangerous place?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Santalalotze.Welcome.DangerousChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Why are you selling goods in such a remote and dangerous place?
translation: 你为什么在这么偏远又危险的地方卖东西？

path:
((('string', (('ID', "I am Santalalotze.

... of ... the Consortium of Phyta. Some call me 'Sant', I think, in
fantasy or memory."), ('Context', 'Conversation Santalalotze.Name.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I am Santalalotze.

... of ... the Consortium of Phyta. Some call me 'Sant', I think, in
fantasy or memory.
translation:
我是桑塔拉洛采。

……属于……植群商会。我想，有些人曾叫我“桑特”。也许是在
幻想里，也许是在记忆里。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "No. Well... no, no. I don't think so.\n\nWe're just... sharing nutrients."), ('Context', 'Conversation Santalalotze.Tree.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
No. Well... no, no. I don't think so.

We're just... sharing nutrients.
translation:
不是。呃……不是，不是。我觉得不是。

我们只是……共享营养。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Would you? Yes.\n\nWhat may... can I help with?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Santalalotze.Questions.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Would you? Yes.

What may... can I help with?
translation:
你愿意？好。

我可以……能帮你什么？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "'Parasite' so negative. It's like... ah... economic symbiosis?\n\nChavvah sustains me, and we are, I am not... them. We are in a... beneficial arrangement, you know. Yes?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Santalalotze.Parasite.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
'Parasite' so negative. It's like... ah... economic symbiosis?

Chavvah sustains me, and we are, I am not... them. We are in a... beneficial arrangement, you know. Yes?
translation:
“寄生虫”太负面了。就像是……啊……经济共生？

查瓦供养我，而我们……我是说，我不是它们的一部分。我们只是达成了一种……互惠安排，你懂的。对吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "You don't seem sure about any of this."), ('Context', 'Conversation Santalalotze.Parasite.UncertainChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: You don't seem sure about any of this.
translation: 你听起来对这些都不太确定。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I'd like to ask you about something else."), ('Context', 'Conversation Santalalotze.Parasite.QuestionsChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I'd like to ask you about something else.

path: ((('string', (('ID', "It is safe here.\n\nBusiness is slow, but I've... gotten attached, ahaha."), ('Context', 'Conversation Santalalotze.Dangerous.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
It is safe here.

Business is slow, but I've... gotten attached, ahaha.
translation:
这里很安全。

生意很慢，但我已经……有感情了，啊哈哈。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Buy something, and I will call you 'customer'.\n\nIf I remember to."), ('Context', 'Conversation Santalalotze.Animal.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Buy something, and I will call you 'customer'.

If I remember to.
translation:
买点东西，我就叫你“顾客”。

如果我记得的话。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Are you having some memory trouble?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Santalalotze.Animal.MemoryChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Are you having some memory trouble?

path: ((('string', (('ID', "It's fine. I... forget nothing important.\n\nOr, I don't remember. So no sense worrying. Right?"), ('Context', 'Conversation Santalalotze.Memory.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
It's fine. I... forget nothing important.

Or, I don't remember. So no sense worrying. Right?
translation:
没事。我……不会忘记重要的东西。

或者说，我不记得。所以担心也没意义。对吧？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Perhaps being Chavvah's parasite is affecting your mind."), ('Context', 'Conversation Santalalotze.Memory.ParasiteChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Perhaps being Chavvah's parasite is affecting your mind.
translation: 也许作为查瓦的寄生者正在影响你的心智。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "I'd like to ask you about something else."), ('Context', 'Conversation Santalalotze.Memory.QuestionsChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I'd like to ask you about something else.

path:
((('string', (('ID', "Well. Nothing... is like Chavvah. Nothing at all.

I once thought ... my haustorium carried only lifestuff. Now I am unsure. Am I of Twofirm, now?

It's fine.

Let's... change subjects."), ('Context', 'Conversation Santalalotze.Uncertain.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Well. Nothing... is like Chavvah. Nothing at all.

I once thought ... my haustorium carried only lifestuff. Now I am unsure. Am I of Twofirm, now?

It's fine.

Let's... change subjects.
translation:
嗯。没有什么……像查瓦。完全没有。

我曾以为……我的吸器只承载生质。现在我不确定了。难道我如今也由双相质构成了？

没事。

我们……换个话题吧。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Will you resign your charge and swear to unvex the beings of this world?'), ('Context', 'Conversation Nephilim.WaterRitual.NephilimPacifyChoice.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Will you resign your charge and swear to unvex the beings of this world?
translation: 你愿意辞去你的职责，并发誓不再扰害这个世界的众生吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "O! O! A new life obtains? You musn't shudder at old Death!"), ('Context', 'Conversation GyreWightAgolgot.Start.Text.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: O! O! A new life obtains? You musn't shudder at old Death!
translation: 哦！哦！新生命得以存在？你可不能在古老死亡面前发抖！

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'When an eremite consults the teraphim and sees the eyes of Death, only the fools frets! There is Change but no Ending.'), ('Context', 'Conversation GyreWightAgolgot.Start.Text.Text2')), 1),), '#text')
source: When an eremite consults the teraphim and sees the eyes of Death, only the fools frets! There is Change but no Ending.
translation: 当隐修者请示家神并看见死亡之眼时，只有蠢人才焦虑！有变化，却无终结。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'A plague is what burns the core out and lets the berries grow.'), ('Context', 'Conversation GyreWightAgolgot.Start.Text.Text3')), 1),), '#text')
source: A plague is what burns the core out and lets the berries grow.
translation: 瘟疫就是烧空核心、让浆果生长之物。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'O Nephilim! Come for our star bath??'), ('Context', 'Conversation GyreWightAgolgot.Start.Text.Text4')), 1),), '#text')
source: O Nephilim! Come for our star bath??
translation: 哦，拿非利！来洗我们的星辰浴吗？？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I want salt in my mouth, dead eyes in radiating darkness, and a frog for a friend.'), ('Context', 'Conversation GyreWightAgolgot.Start.Text.Text5')), 1),), '#text')
source: I want salt in my mouth, dead eyes in radiating darkness, and a frog for a friend.
translation: 我想要口中含盐，死眼置于辐光黑暗里，再有一只青蛙做朋友。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'O Life, O Change! Embrace us, entangle us...'), ('Context', 'Conversation GyreWightAgolgot.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: O Life, O Change! Embrace us, entangle us...
translation: 哦，生命，哦，变化！拥抱我们，缠绕我们……

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I can lick the flanges free of their pipe milk and hear my tongue fizzle in foam!'), ('Context', 'Conversation GyreWightAgolgot.Start.Text.Text7')), 1),), '#text')
source: I can lick the flanges free of their pipe milk and hear my tongue fizzle in foam!
translation: 我能把法兰上的管奶舔个干净，听见自己的舌头在泡沫里嘶嘶作响！

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Girsh Agolgot! Red dusts in my nails and burning hot bubbles swell in my glands! Now I point to the future.'), ('Context', 'Conversation GyreWightAgolgot.Start.Text.Text8')), 1),), '#text')
source: Girsh Agolgot! Red dusts in my nails and burning hot bubbles swell in my glands! Now I point to the future.
translation: 吉尔什 阿戈尔戈特！红尘在我的指甲里，灼热气泡在我的腺体中膨胀！现在我指向未来。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'O, the thrill of coursing Change within. Each pump of the heart drives it deeper. Each breath a breath of new life.'), ('Context', 'Conversation GyreWightAgolgot.Start.Text.Text10')), 1),), '#text')
source: O, the thrill of coursing Change within. Each pump of the heart drives it deeper. Each breath a breath of new life.
translation: 哦，变化在体内奔流的战栗。心脏每一次泵动都把它推得更深。每一次呼吸都是新生命的一息。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Roil with me, and bubble over. Let us exceed ourselves!'), ('Context', 'Conversation GyreWightAgolgot.Start.Text.Text11')), 1),), '#text')
source: Roil with me, and bubble over. Let us exceed ourselves!
translation: 与我一同翻涌，沸溢而出。让我们超越自己！

translation: 你渴望一场闪亮的沐浴，以及泵送生命连续性的分形血管吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', "You've a twin across the boundary of the future, where new life blooms in rot. Are you with them?"), ('Context', 'Conversation GyreWightBethsaida.Start.Text.Text8')), 1),), '#text')
source: You've a twin across the boundary of the future, where new life blooms in rot. Are you with them?
translation: 你在未来边界的另一侧有一个孪生体，那里新生命在腐烂中盛放。你和他们在一起吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Would you kill your double? Would you let it kill you?'), ('Context', 'Conversation GyreWightBethsaida.Start.Text.Text9')), 1),), '#text')

translation: 你会杀死你的另一个自己吗？你会让它杀死你吗？

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'It is to witness the scalpel parting tissue. The beauty of division and resection.'), ('Context', 'Conversation GyreWightBethsaida.Start.Text.Text10')), 1),), '#text')

translation: 那就是见证手术刀分开组织。分割与切除之美。

Oh! it looks like Warden Yrame killed Mehmet. Why, you ask?

Well, named creatures who you can perform the water ritual with, like Mehmet, generate with dynamic faction relationships. In your game, Mehmet must have been hated by the Fellowship of Wardens for some reason.

哦！看起来守望者 伊拉梅 杀死了 梅赫梅特。你问为什么？

And so Warden Yrame took her revenge. In Qud, sometimes even our best efforts at providing a safe starter village are foiled by the simulation!

You have a few options now. You can roll with it and continue in this world where Mehmet's been revenge-slain. The early game will be a bit harder, but the main quest is not impacted.

You can start over and play the tutorial again, for the "normal" ending, which you were about to reach.

Or, since you were near the end anyway, you can start a new game and begin your journey proper!

你也可以重来一次教程，走向你本来快要抵达的那个“正常”结局。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'In %=year=%, Rebekah died of glotrot, and on her deathbed Resheph forgave her and absolved her of sin. He allowed her to be buried in the village of Ezra, outside the gate to the Tomb of the Eaters and beneath the shadow of the Spindle.'), ('Context', 'Resheph Gospel (absolves Rebekah)')), 1),), '#text')
source: In %=year=%, Rebekah died of glotrot, and on her deathbed Resheph forgave her and absolved her of sin. He allowed her to be buried in the village of Ezra, outside the gate to the Tomb of the Eaters and beneath the shadow of the Spindle.
translation: 在 %=year=% 年，丽贝卡死于舌腐病。临终之际，瑞谢夫宽恕了她，赦免了她的罪。他允许她葬在以斯拉村，葬在食客之墓门外、尖塔阴影之下。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'In %=year=%, Resheph appointed Rebekah administrator of =region=. She tendered alms for the sick in his name.'), ('Context', 'Resheph Gospel (appoints Rebekah)')), 1),), '#text')
source: In %=year=%, Resheph appointed Rebekah administrator of =region=. She tendered alms for the sick in his name.
translation: 在 %=year=% 年，瑞谢夫任命丽贝卡为 =region= 的行政官。她以他的名义向病者施舍救济。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Acting against a prohibition on the practice of worshipping the stars, Resheph led an army to the gates of Omonporch. There he defeated his brothers in battle and liberated its citizens, and they crowned him the sultan of Qud.'), ('Context', 'Resheph Gospel (becomes sultan)')), 1),), '#text')
source: Acting against a prohibition on the practice of worshipping the stars, Resheph led an army to the gates of Omonporch. There he defeated his brothers in battle and liberated its citizens, and they crowned him the sultan of Qud.
translation: 为反抗对崇拜星辰之习俗的禁令，瑞谢夫率军来到奥蒙廊的城门。在那里，他于战斗中击败自己的兄弟，解放了城中市民；他们将他加冕为圣地库德的帝王。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'In %=year=%, Rebekah betrayed Resheph by stealing the Mark of Death from the gate to the Tomb of the Eaters. In punishment, Resheph excommunicated her from the sultanate.'), ('Context', 'Resheph Gospel (betrayed)')), 1),), '#text')
source: In %=year=%, Rebekah betrayed Resheph by stealing the Mark of Death from the gate to the Tomb of the Eaters. In punishment, Resheph excommunicated her from the sultanate.
translation: 在 %=year=% 年，丽贝卡从食客之墓门口偷走死亡印记，背叛了瑞谢夫。作为惩罚，瑞谢夫将她逐出了帝国。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'In %=year=%, Resheph cleansed the marshlands of the plagues of the Gyre and taught Abram to sow watervine along its fertile tracks.'), ('Context', 'Resheph Gospel (cleanses gyre)')), 1),), '#text')
source: In %=year=%, Resheph cleansed the marshlands of the plagues of the Gyre and taught Abram to sow watervine along its fertile tracks.
translation: 在 %=year=% 年，瑞谢夫净除了沼泽地里的轮回瘟疫，并教亚伯兰在其肥沃的泥径旁播种水藤。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'In %=year=%, Resheph closed the gates to the Tomb of the Eaters, abdicated the throne, and dissolved the sultanate in order to lift the curse of the Gyre.'), ('Context', 'Resheph Gospel (closes tomb)')), 1),), '#text')
source: In %=year=%, Resheph closed the gates to the Tomb of the Eaters, abdicated the throne, and dissolved the sultanate in order to lift the curse of the Gyre.
translation: 在 %=year=% 年，瑞谢夫关闭了食客之墓的大门，退位离开王座，并解散帝国，以解除轮回的诅咒。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'In %=year=%, Resheph, the Above, Ghost-in-Cerulean, the Coiled Lamb of Baetyls, died of natural causes. He was 216 years old.'), ('Context', 'Resheph Gospel (dies)')), 1),), '#text')
source: In %=year=%, Resheph, the Above, Ghost-in-Cerulean, the Coiled Lamb of Baetyls, died of natural causes. He was 216 years old.
translation: 在 %=year=% 年，瑞谢夫，至上者，天青幽灵，贝泰尔的盘卷羔羊，自然死亡。他享年 216 岁。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "After conferring with mysterious strangers, Resheph convinced them to help him found a harborage for the purpose of receiving visitors from across the clustered cosmos. They named it Starfarer's Quay."), ('Context', 'Resheph Gospel (founds harborage)')), 1),), '#text')
source: After conferring with mysterious strangers, Resheph convinced them to help him found a harborage for the purpose of receiving visitors from across the clustered cosmos. They named it Starfarer's Quay.
translation: 在与神秘陌生人商议后，瑞谢夫说服他们帮助自己创立一处避泊港，用来接待来自群簇宇宙各处的访客。他们将其命名为星旅者码头。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'While traveling alone through the Rust Wells, Resheph came across a trove of gleaming stars in a bottle. From that day forth, he always kept some stardust on his person.'), ('Context', 'Resheph Gospel (star experience)')), 1),), '#text')
source: While traveling alone through the Rust Wells, Resheph came across a trove of gleaming stars in a bottle. From that day forth, he always kept some stardust on his person.
translation: 独自穿过锈井旅行时，瑞谢夫遇见了一瓶闪耀群星。从那天起，他总在身上藏着一些星尘。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'In %=year=%, the Gyre widened, and the first triad of plagues afflicted the land. The water was poisoned with salt, girshlings ravaged the fruit and wheat, and tongues rotted away in the mouths of kith and kin. Resheph walked below the chrome arches and healed the sick.'), ('Context', 'Resheph Gospel (heals gyre 1)')), 1),), '#text')
source: In %=year=%, the Gyre widened, and the first triad of plagues afflicted the land. The water was poisoned with salt, girshlings ravaged the fruit and wheat, and tongues rotted away in the mouths of kith and kin. Resheph walked below the chrome arches and healed the sick.
translation: 在 %=year=% 年，轮回扩大，第一组三重瘟疫降临大地。水被盐毒污染，吉尔什幼体蹂躏果实与麦田，亲族同胞口中的舌头腐烂脱落。瑞谢夫行走在铬拱之下，治愈病者。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'In %=year=%, the Gyre widened, and the second triad of plagues afflicted the land. The legs of kith and kin annealed to iron, darkness bloomed from the earth, and the svardym blackened the sky. Resheph walked below the chrome arches and healed the sick.'), ('Context', 'Resheph Gospel (heals gyre 2)')), 1),), '#text')
source: In %=year=%, the Gyre widened, and the second triad of plagues afflicted the land. The legs of kith and kin annealed to iron, darkness bloomed from the earth, and the svardym blackened the sky. Resheph walked below the chrome arches and healed the sick.
translation: 在 %=year=% 年，轮回扩大，第二组三重瘟疫降临大地。亲族同胞的双腿退火成铁，黑暗自大地绽放，斯瓦尔德姆遮黑了天空。瑞谢夫行走在铬拱之下，治愈病者。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'One starry evening, a babe was found swaddled with its mouth full of circuits by a group of baetyls in Red Rock. They took him into their fold and fostered him, and he became known as Resheph, the Coiled Lamb of Baetyls.'), ('Context', 'Resheph Gospel (birth)')), 1),), '#text')
source: One starry evening, a babe was found swaddled with its mouth full of circuits by a group of baetyls in Red Rock. They took him into their fold and fostered him, and he became known as Resheph, the Coiled Lamb of Baetyls.
translation: 一个繁星满天的夜晚，一群贝泰尔在红岩发现了一个裹在襁褓中的婴孩，口中塞满电路。他们将他纳入同群并抚养成人，他从此以瑞谢夫，贝泰尔的盘卷羔羊，闻名。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "At Starfarer's Quay, Resheph consulted with mysterious strangers and learned the secret of the Gyre. By cause of the misdeeds of the elder saads and sultans, star beings had levied a curse on Qud. Resheph vowed to make right from this wrong and redeem our doomed world."), ('Context', 'Resheph Gospel (learns curse)')), 1),), '#text')
source: At Starfarer's Quay, Resheph consulted with mysterious strangers and learned the secret of the Gyre. By cause of the misdeeds of the elder saads and sultans, star beings had levied a curse on Qud. Resheph vowed to make right from this wrong and redeem our doomed world.
translation: 在星旅者码头，瑞谢夫向神秘陌生人求教，得知了轮回的秘密。由于古老萨阿德与帝王们的恶行，星辰存在向库德降下了诅咒。瑞谢夫誓要纠正这桩错误，拯救我们注定毁灭的世界。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'While traveling near Bethesda Susa, Resheph lost control of his chariot and drove it off a cliff. Luckily, a local physician named Rebekah came to his rescue. Moved by her kindness, Resheph enrolled at a nearby hospice as her apprentice.'), ('Context', 'Resheph Gospel (meets Rebekah)')), 1),), '#text')
source: While traveling near Bethesda Susa, Resheph lost control of his chariot and drove it off a cliff. Luckily, a local physician named Rebekah came to his rescue. Moved by her kindness, Resheph enrolled at a nearby hospice as her apprentice.
translation: 在贝塞斯达苏萨附近旅行时，瑞谢夫的战车失控冲下悬崖。幸运的是，一位名叫丽贝卡的当地医师前来救助他。瑞谢夫为她的善意所动，在附近一所济养院登记为她的学徒。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'In %=year=%, the Gyre widened, and the final plague afflicted the land. The Girsh Nephilim rose from their cradles on the Moon Stair and slouched toward Qud to eat its young. Resheph rose to meet them in battle and cast them back.'), ('Context', 'Resheph Gospel (rebuffs Girsh)')), 1),), '#text')
source: In %=year=%, the Gyre widened, and the final plague afflicted the land. The Girsh Nephilim rose from their cradles on the Moon Stair and slouched toward Qud to eat its young. Resheph rose to meet them in battle and cast them back.
translation: 在 %=year=% 年，轮回扩大，最终瘟疫降临大地。吉尔什拿非利从月阶上的摇篮中升起，佝偻着走向库德，欲吞食其幼子。瑞谢夫挺身迎战，将他们击退。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'At twilight in the shadow of the Spindle, the people of Omonporch saw an image on the horizon that looked like a ghost bathed in cerulean. It was Resheph, and after he came and left Omonporch, the people built a monument to him, and thenceforth called him Ghost-in-Cerulean.'), ('Context', 'Resheph Gospel (weird sky)')), 1),), '#text')
source: At twilight in the shadow of the Spindle, the people of Omonporch saw an image on the horizon that looked like a ghost bathed in cerulean. It was Resheph, and after he came and left Omonporch, the people built a monument to him, and thenceforth called him Ghost-in-Cerulean.
translation: 黄昏时，在尖塔的阴影中，奥蒙廊的人民看见地平线上有一道影像，像是沐浴在天青色中的幽灵。那正是瑞谢夫；他来到奥蒙廊又离去后，人民为他建起纪念碑，并从此称他为天青幽灵。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'In 979, Nuntu, the legendary albino ape, grew tired of bludgeoning things to death and journeyed to a root-strangled place on the River Svy. source: In 979, Nuntu, the legendary albino ape, grew tired of bludgeoning things to death and journeyed to a root-strangled place on the River Svy. There he came upon Kyakukya and its inhabitants. The villagers of Kyakukya asked Nuntu to employ his magisterial skills and lead the village.
translation: 979 年，传奇白化猿努恩图厌倦了把东西锤打至死，前往斯维河上一处根须缠结之地。在那里，他遇见了喀库喀及其居民。喀库喀的村民请求努恩图施展他的威严技艺，领导村庄。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Centuries after the height of the Gyre, the svardym Goek, Mak, and Geeub met the galgal Many Eyes while languishing inside of a reef sponge. Together they founded the Yd Freehold to live out the rest of their lives.'), ('Context', 'Journal - Village Notes, Yd')), 1),), '#text')
source: Centuries after the height of the Gyre, the svardym Goek, Mak, and Geeub met the galgal Many Eyes while languishing inside of a reef sponge. Together they founded the Yd Freehold to live out the rest of their lives.
translation: 轮回鼎盛数个世纪后，斯瓦尔德姆戈埃克、马克和吉乌布在礁海绵中受困衰弱时，遇见了迦勒迦勒“众眼”。他们共同建立了伊德自由领，以度过余生。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'In 901, the villagers of the Yd Freehold and its founders abolished all forms of hierarchy from their settlement. The two pillars of civic life in the Freehold thus became anarchy and authenticity.'), ('Context', 'Journal - Village Notes, Yd')), 1),), '#text')
source: In 901, the villagers of the Yd Freehold and its founders abolished all forms of hierarchy from their settlement. The two pillars of civic life in the Freehold thus became anarchy and authenticity.
translation: 901 年，伊德自由领的村民及其创建者废除了聚落中的一切等级制度。自由领公民生活的两大支柱由此变成无政府与真实。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Are you seeking more work, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Recently we came into possession of a data disk bearing a peculiar stamp and encoded with a strange signal. The signal means nothing to us, but there's a sect of tinkers called the Barathrumites who might be interested in it. They are friends to our village and often trade for the scrap we tow out of the earth. Would you carry the disk to their enclave at Grit Gate, along the western rim of the jungle? In exchange for the delivery, you might seek an apprenticeship with them.\n\nIf you are interested, take the disk now, and travel safely."), ('Context', 'DynamicQuestConversationHelper village zero main quest restart dialog')), 1),), 'Value')
source:
Are you seeking more work, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Recently we came into possession of a data disk bearing a peculiar stamp and encoded with a strange signal. The signal means nothing to us, but there's a sect of tinkers called the Barathrumites who might be interested in it. They are friends to our village and often trade for the scrap we tow out of the earth. Would you carry the disk to their enclave at Grit Gate, along the western rim of the jungle? In exchange for the delivery, you might seek an apprenticeship with them.

If you are interested, take the disk now, and travel safely.
translation:
你在寻找更多工作吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？最近我们得到了一张数据磁盘，上面带有奇特印记，还编码着一种古怪信号。我们不明白这信号的含义，但有个名叫巴拉瑟姆派的修补匠宗派也许会对此感兴趣。他们是我们村庄的朋友，经常拿我们从地里拖出来的废料做交易。你愿意把这张磁盘带到他们位于砂砾门的飞地吗？那里在丛林西缘。作为递送的交换，你也许可以向他们寻求学徒身份。

如果你有兴趣，现在就拿上磁盘，一路平安。

噢，你死了。没关系。这在科德世界里非常常见。

好消息是：你可以创建一个全新的角色！而且现在比之前多了一点知识。

source: {{G|The Toxic Arboreta of Ekuemekiyye, the Holy City}}
translation: {{G|圣城 埃库梅基耶 的毒性树园}}

source: clockwork beetle and pariah to its people

translation: 有裂纹的,无裂纹的,曾裂一次的,彩绘的,仍然矗立的,镶钉的,坚固的,裂过两次的,未彩绘的,无钉的
建造者,懦夫,防御者,屋顶,受袭者,坚毅者
高耸本性,温柔静止,抚慰性的包围

source: Spore-rich slime glistens on the cage-like fruiting body, trimmed like a hedge to conform with the ordered angles of domesticity.
translation: 富含孢子的黏液在笼状子实体上闪光，它被修剪得像篱笆，以符合居家秩序的角度。

source: Clay and quartz were dried and smashed into the red rock that's been quarried by hillfolk for thousands after thousands of years.
translation: 黏土与石英被干燥、击碎，化作被丘民开采了千年又千年的红岩。

source: Rock is eroded to sand, sand is blown into lakes, lakes are buried in mud, and mud crushes sand to rock. Earth is rearranged.
translation: 岩石风化成沙，沙被吹进湖里，湖被泥土掩埋，泥又把沙压成岩。大地被重新排列。

source: Invertebrate life was sucked of its tissue and bled still over millions of years. The glaucous rock is a necropolis.
translation: 无脊椎生命被吸尽组织，又在数百万年间静静流干。灰绿色岩石是一座死城。

source: Lacustrine ecosystems, cast in lime-rich mud, put their million-year-old affairs on display in chalk-white shine.
translation: 湖泊生态系被浇铸进富含石灰的泥中，以粉白光泽展示它们百万年前的事务。

source: Carmine clouds assume their crystal habit: cubes nested inside and out. Why does Moghra'yi conceal this form from the sun?
translation: 胭红云彩显出它们的晶体习性：方块内外相嵌。莫格拉伊 为何要把这种形态藏离太阳？

source: Burnt crystal gold tosses its geometric shadows onto the floors of a million watery grottos.
translation: 烧灼般的水晶金把几何阴影投向百万座潮湿洞窟的地面。

source: Black stone stands in monument to the cities of snails that perished under clay and rotted into pyrite.
translation: 黑石矗立如纪念碑，纪念那些死于黏土之下、腐化成黄铁矿的蜗牛城市。

source: Reefs were the arcologies of the young oceans. Now they are turquoise crypts, their surfaces bitten by acid water into rough wounds.
translation: 礁曾是幼年海洋的拱构城。如今它们是绿松石色的墓穴，表面被酸水咬成粗糙伤口。

source: Stony eggs are incubated in pearly planar sheets. No larvae ever hatch; they're abraded into dust.
translation: 石质卵在珠光平面层中孵育。没有幼体破壳；它们被磨成尘。

source: Unnamed to the beings of the surface world are the birthing atria of the subterrane, where ultramafic rock is wetted in amniotic fluid and birthed as a world-serpent.
translation: 地下的诞生心房对地表生灵而言无名；在那里，超镁铁质岩被羊水浸湿，诞为世界之蛇。

source: Volcanic dust pupated in its deep-earth cocoon and cracked free as grey stone. Sophists theorize it's the color of pure aether.
translation: 火山尘在深地茧中化蛹，裂壳而出成为灰石。智辩者推测这是纯以太的颜色。

source: Dappled crystal mosaics of red and cyan are the metamorphic remnants of crumbling world-plates. The new earth struggles to be born.
translation: 红与青的斑驳水晶马赛克，是崩碎世界板块留下的变质残迹。新大地挣扎着将要诞生。

source: Snails and coral were crushed on the geologic press, painted into ribbons of impurity, and polished along the ideal plane.
translation: 蜗牛与珊瑚被地质压机碾碎，绘成杂质缎带，又沿理想平面抛光。

source: Outworld hard-shelled beings were harvested from planetesimals, burned bright in the magenta exhaust of their scavengers' ships, and crushed together in astral slingshot to reentry.
translation: 外世界硬壳生物被从星子上收割，在拾荒者船只的品红尾焰中明亮燃烧，又在星界弹射的再入中被挤压到一起。

source: World-voids in the nethermost reaches of the planet are partitioned by numinous masonry. There is meaning in the patterns of its faint white filigree, but it's discerned by no one.
translation: 星球最深处的世界虚空被神秘石工分隔。它淡白丝饰的图案中有意义，但无人能辨。

source: World-voids in the nethermost reaches of the planet are partitioned by numinous masonry. There is meaning in the patterns of its faint white filigree, but it's discerned by no one.
translation: 星球最深处的世界虚空被神秘石工分隔。它淡白丝饰的图案中有意义，但无人能辨。

source: Feldspar and its cousin rocks are composited and pocked with static-pattern grain. Cracks foreshadow the pebbles of the future.
translation: 长石和它的近亲岩类混合成形，布满静态图案的颗粒坑点。裂缝预示着未来的卵石。

source: Braids of fibrous plant veins enmesh compacted mud and weep a brackish blood.
translation: 纤维植物脉络编成辫索，缠住压实泥土，渗出咸涩的血。

source: The scars of lava flow are legible as little ledges across the wide stone. The small darkling holes were once the birth craters of dissolved gases.
translation: 熔岩流的伤痕在宽阔石面上清晰如小小岩架。那些幽暗小孔曾是溶解气体的诞生坑。

source: Time and chance -- the two hands of nature -- have woven roots, stems, and leaves into a fibrous dam.
translation: 时间与机缘，这两只自然之手，把根、茎、叶编成一道纤维坝。

source: Clay and quartz were dried and smashed into the red rock that's been quarried by hillfolk for thousands after thousands of years. The whole stone is cut across by shining black ribbons.
translation: 黏土与石英被干燥、击碎，化作被丘民开采了千年又千年的红岩。整块石头被发亮的黑色缎带横切。

source: Clay and quartz were dried and smashed into the red rock that's been quarried by hillfolk for thousands after thousands of years. The whole stone is cut across by shining green and gold ribbons.
translation: 黏土与石英被干燥、击碎，化作被丘民开采了千年又千年的红岩。整块石头被发亮的绿金色缎带横切。

source: Islands of carbon gravel populate an ocean of bitumen and rise from the horizontal plane toward the emptiness of the air-rasp. Time and pressure have laid hair-line trenches along the basin.
translation: 碳砾岛屿散布在沥青海中，从水平面升向空气锉刮出的空旷。时间与压力沿盆地刻下发丝般的沟槽。

source: Black islands of carbon gravel populate an ocean of bitumen and rise from the horizontal plane toward the emptiness of the air-rasp. Time and pressure have laid hair-line trenches along the basin.
translation: 黑色碳砾岛屿散布在沥青海中，从水平面升向空气锉刮出的空旷。时间与压力沿盆地刻下发丝般的沟槽。

source: Sheet metal is locked in diamond pattern and welded to enclose. The surface is scorched and scratched in sections.
translation: 金属板被锁成菱形图案，再焊接成围护。表面有几处焦痕与划痕。

source: Sheet metal is locked in diamond pattern and welded to enclose. The surface is scorched and scratched in sections.
translation: 金属板被锁成菱形图案，再焊接成围护。表面有几处焦痕与划痕。

source: Longwise infill plates of burnished crysteel are girdered by fulcrete beams. Life sounds echo through their empty spaces.
translation: 纵向填充的抛光晶钢板由富凝土梁架住。生命的声音在空隙中回响。

source: The cracks in the wall are fossils of the compressed foamcrete's hexagonal expansion pattern.
translation: 墙上的裂缝是受压泡沫混凝土六角膨胀图案的化石。

source: The poison aqua moss brightens the metal form and attracts brass-drunk bugs.
translation: 有毒水绿色苔藓让金属形体变亮，并吸引醉铜虫。

source: Smooth grey stone hides its bonded pebbly innards and cement blood-paste. It's streaked with dirt.
translation: 光滑灰石遮住黏结的卵石内脏与水泥血浆。它沾着一道道污垢。

source: A cut of pink and fuzzy flesh has been stretched and tanned to roof its wards.
translation: 一片粉色茸毛肉被拉伸、鞣制，用来覆盖它守护的区域。

source: Here are several stripped trunks of sallow brinestalk bonded with mud.
translation: 几根剥去外皮、色泽灰黄的盐茎树干被泥黏合在这里。

source: Here are several stripped trunks of sallow brinestalk bonded with mud.
translation: 几根剥去外皮、色泽灰黄的盐茎树干被泥黏合在这里。

source: Tree bark was burnt black by skyfire assault and now gleams in the after light.
translation: 树皮被天火袭击烧黑，如今在余光中微微发亮。

source: The quickened flax of the earth was duck-weaved in a simple square pattern and hung up on pickets.
translation: 大地活化的亚麻被织成简单方格的鸭布，挂在桩柱上。

source: Stripes of watervine and brinestalk straw are batched and angled to divert salt slag.
translation: 水藤和盐茎草束被分批斜放，用来导开盐渣。

source: Here are several stripped trunks of sallow brinestalk bonded with mud.
translation: 几根剥去外皮、色泽灰黄的盐茎树干被泥黏合在这里。

source: Here are several stripped trunks of sallow brinestalk bonded with mud. Hung against them, from a quartet of nails, is a frayed mothwing mask; its delicate leaves of rust-plaster are crocheted with nanoweave and stretched across an armature of stiff wire. Where eyes once peered and a mouth breathed, resin now fills the gaps.
translation: 几根剥去外皮、色泽灰黄的盐茎树干被泥黏合在这里。四枚钉子上挂着一副磨损的蛾翼面具；锈灰泥的精巧薄片用纳米织线钩织，绷在硬线骨架上。曾有眼睛窥视、嘴巴呼吸的空隙，如今由树脂填满。

source: Burnt clay ingots are laid crosswise, and a barrier is made. Each brick is marred by the variegated cuts of time, imperfections in the heat balance of the oven it was fired in, and fungi in its birthing mud.
translation: 烧制黏土锭横向铺开，筑成屏障。每块砖都被时间斑驳的切痕、烧窑热平衡的瑕疵，以及诞生泥土中的真菌所损伤。

source: Fluted columns of prism glass scatter the sight of becoming into a thousand fractured vistas.
translation: 凹槽棱镜玻璃柱把生成之景散成千重破碎远景。

source: Vacuum tubes slice through circuit topography like rivers on a fold belt. Hot gas heaves through and suffuses its brass and silicone acres in a red glow.
translation: 真空管切过电路地貌，如河流穿过褶皱带。热气涌过其中，把黄铜与硅胶的广阔表面浸成红光。

source: Vacuum tubes slice through circuit topography like rivers on a fold belt. Cold gas heaves through and suffuses its brass and silicone acres in a cyan glow.
translation: 真空管切过电路地貌，如河流穿过褶皱带。冷气涌过其中，把黄铜与硅胶的广阔表面浸成青光。

source: Vacuum tubes slice through circuit topography like rivers on a fold belt.
translation: 真空管切过电路地貌，如河流穿过褶皱带。

source: Sand was crush-fired and molded into lucent panes.
translation: 沙被碾碎烧融，塑成透光窗格。

source: Sand was crush-fired, pigmented, and molded into smokey panes.
translation: 沙被碾碎烧融、上色，塑成烟色窗格。

source: Cerulean light from inside the Spindle channel glimmers across the pane like stars on a galactic disc or diodes on a circuitboard. The light breathes godliness into the glass.
translation: 纺锤通道内部的蔚蓝光在玻璃上闪动，像银河盘上的星辰，或电路板上的二极管。光把神性吹入玻璃。

source: Cyan bursts through a glassy hull and looks as though the sky was crystallized into a thicket of hexagonal prisms. The Eaters dug it up from its magmatic birthsite and arranged it into mounds to enshrine the Spindle.
translation: 青光穿透玻璃般的外壳，仿佛天空结晶成一丛六角棱柱。食者把它从岩浆诞生地挖出，堆成土丘，用来供奉纺锤。

source: Here are several stripped trunks of sallow brinestalk bonded with mud and strewn with flower petals.
translation: 几根剥去外皮、色泽灰黄的盐茎树干被泥黏合在这里，上面撒着花瓣。

source: Several sharpened trunks of sallow brinestalk were driven into the ground here.
translation: 几根削尖的灰黄盐茎树干被钉进这里的地面。

source: Several sharpened trunks of sallow brinestalk were driven into the ground here. The gaps aren't wide enough to squeeze through.
translation: 几根削尖的灰黄盐茎树干被钉进这里的地面。缝隙不够宽，无法挤过去。

source: Spirals cross the grain on the dogthorn pickets stuck into the ground.
translation: 螺旋纹横过插入地面的狗刺木桩纹理。

source: Pailings of age-nicked iron stand in a row between two horizontal rails.
translation: 被岁月刻出缺口的铁栅条在两道横轨之间排成一列。

source: Salt-tracing waves cross the grain on the brinestalk pickets stuck into the ground.
translation: 盐迹波纹横过插入地面的盐茎桩纹理。

source: Glinting light is sculpted in parallax to the illusion of a shale wall: clay and quartz were dried and smashed into the red rock that's been quarried by hillfolk for thousands after thousands of years.
translation: 闪光以视差雕成页岩墙的幻象：黏土与石英被干燥、击碎，化作被丘民开采了千年又千年的红岩。

source: Glinting light is sculpted in parallax to the illusion of a marble wall: snails and coral were crushed on the geologic press, painted into ribbons of impurity, and polished along the ideal plane.
translation: 闪光以视差雕成大理石墙的幻象：蜗牛与珊瑚被地质压机碾碎，绘成杂质缎带，又沿理想平面抛光。

source: Glinting light is sculpted in parallax to the illusion of a sandstone wall: rock is eroded to sand, sand is blown into lakes, lakes are buried in mud, and mud crushes sand to rock. Earth is rearranged.
translation: 闪光以视差雕成砂岩墙的幻象：岩石风化成沙，沙被吹进湖里，湖被泥土掩埋，泥又把沙压成岩。大地被重新排列。

source: Glinting light is sculpted in parallax to the illusion of a thatched wall: stripes of watervine and brinestalk straw are batched and angled to divert salt slag.
translation: 闪光以视差雕成茅草墙的幻象：水藤和盐茎草束被分批斜放，用来导开盐渣。

source: Old stone worked to waist height to stop spilling but not seeing.
translation: 旧石被加工到齐腰高度，能阻止倾泻，却挡不住视线。

source: A low wall of solid sandstone.
Wisps of steam coil out of vertical vents cut in columns from tarnished chrome.
translation: 一缕缕蒸汽从失泽铬钢柱体中切出的垂直通风口里盘旋而出。

source: Wisps of noxious fumes coil out of vertical vents cut in columns from tarnished chrome.
translation: 一缕缕有毒烟气从失泽铬钢柱体中切出的垂直通风口里盘旋而出。

source: Sparks fly from vertical vents cut in columns from tarnished chrome.
translation: 火花从失泽铬钢柱体中切出的垂直通风口里飞出。

source: Tiny scratches mark lateral vents cut in rows from tarnished chrome.
translation: 细小划痕标记着成排切入失泽铬钢的侧向通风口。

source: Tiny scratches mark lateral vents cut in rows from tarnished chrome.
translation: 细小划痕标记着成排切入失泽铬钢的侧向通风口。
带六角残留物的通风口

source: Normality condensate tesselates the vertical vents cut in columns from tarnished chrome.
translation: 常态凝结物密铺在失泽铬钢柱体中切出的垂直通风口上。

source: Long dead and blown into particulate by billows of Golden Dawn, dead moss sticks to the vents of tarnished chrome.
translation: 早已死去、又被金色黎明的滚滚气浪吹成微粒的死苔，粘在失泽铬钢通风口上。

source: Long dead and eroded into particulate by magenta showers, dead moldstuff sticks to the vents of tarnished chrome.
translation: 早已死去、又被品红骤雨侵蚀成微粒的死霉物，粘在失泽铬钢通风口上。

source: Wisps of steam coil out of vertical vents cut in columns from soot-stained chrome.
translation: 一缕缕蒸汽从烟灰染污的铬钢柱体中切出的垂直通风口里盘旋而出。

source: Freezing mist coils out of lateral vents cut into the chrome wainscotting of a marble pillar.
translation: 冰冷雾气从大理石柱铬钢护壁中切出的侧向通风口里盘旋而出。

source: Cold dew dresses the lateral vents cut into the chrome wainscotting of a marble pillar.
translation: 冷露覆在大理石柱铬钢护壁中切出的侧向通风口上。

source: Potential is polarized into a cyanic hex mesh and keyed to its arranger. Objects of sufficient mass are blocked, but small ones fired leeward can pass through.
translation: 势被极化成青色六角网，并与其布设者配对。质量足够的物体会被挡住，但顺风射来的小物体可以穿过。

source: Potential is polarized into a scarlet hex mesh and keyed to its arranger. Objects are blocked unless they are molecularly whitelisted.
translation: 势被极化成猩红六角网，并与其布设者配对。除非分子层面列入白名单，否则物体都会被挡住。

source: A blurry film cordons off a wedge of spacetime with so much quantum friction that its inhabitants are ground to a halt.
translation: 一层模糊薄膜封锁住一楔时空，其中量子摩擦巨大，足以把里面的存在磨停。

source: This is an exquisitely detailed high relief cut from precious cerulean marble. It depicts the Sacred Joining, as recounted by Shekhinah the Father to the temple high priests. In the early dawn of our universe, the Argent Fathers roamed the timeless aether with inert hearts. There, in the coldest distance of space, they discovered beauty-and-chrome incarnate, the Kasaphescence. Together they wrought machines from Her naked womb to inhabit a hundred earths. In the scene here, the Fathers first approach Her Radiance. They are led by Shekhinah, who occupies a position of prominence.
translation: 这是一幅由珍贵蔚蓝大理石切出的精细高浮雕。它描绘了神圣结合，正如父神 舍金纳 向神庙高阶祭司所述：在我们宇宙的初晓，银辉诸父怀着惰性之心漫游无时以太。在那里，在宇宙最寒冷的远处，他们发现了美与铬钢的化身，卡萨辉体。他们一同从她裸露的子宫中锻造机器，让机器居于百座大地。这处场景中，诸父第一次接近她的光辉，由居于显要位置的 舍金纳 引领。

source: This is a high relief cut with exquisite detail from rare, cerulean marble. It depicts the Edification, as chanted in the Canticles Chromaic. After the Sacred Joining, the Argent Fathers molded the plasmatic metal of the Kasaphescence into edifices fit for inhabitance by mortal folk. They wrought spires onto mountains and arches over rivers. Here, Shekhinah oversees the construction, gazing east upon His new, gleaming world.
translation: 这是一幅由稀有蔚蓝大理石切出的精细高浮雕。它描绘了《铬彩圣歌》中吟唱的教化。神圣结合之后，银辉诸父把 卡萨辉体 的等离子金属塑造成适合凡俗居住的建筑。他们在山上造尖塔，在河上架拱门。这里，舍金纳 监督建造，向东凝望他崭新而闪耀的世界。

marble relief of the Sacred Joining

Fulcrete dyed with integral pigments bursts into mottled color. It's been incised with regular geometry that draws the eye across the horizontal plane.
translation: 以整体颜料染色的富凝土迸出斑驳色彩。其上刻有规则几何，引导视线越过水平面。

source: Bone-shapes of the human form are disarranged to tessellate properly. Round skulls require ulna knots to fill the gaps in their sequences. The boundaries of this world are rice-white and filled with presence.
translation: 人形骨骼被打乱，才能恰当地密铺。圆形头骨需要尺骨结填补序列中的空隙。这个世界的边界米白而充满临在。

source: Whole worlds are carved in bas relief, simulacra of the motley lives of ash-dreaming Eaters. Palm leaves lift pyramids into the star-ribboned sky, and the water of life pours over the lip of an oinochoe.
translation: 整个世界被刻成浅浮雕，仿作灰梦食者斑斓的生活。棕榈叶把金字塔托入缀星的天空，生命之水越过酒壶口沿倾泻。

source: Whole worlds are threaded in three-dimensional filigree, simulacra of the motley lives of ash-dreaming Eaters. Palm leaves lift pyramids into the star-ribboned sky, and the water of life pours over the lip of an oinochoe.
translation: 整个世界被三维丝饰串起，仿作灰梦食者斑斓的生活。棕榈叶把金字塔托入缀星的天空，生命之水越过酒壶口沿倾泻。

source: carved stone from the sultanate of =sultan:1=

Gigantic, old stone was stacked, knapped, and carved in long arcs to the style of the day in the time of =sultan:1=. Since then, the project has accrued collaborators, and their signatures are writ everywhere: here, the lacuna of a vandal's edit; there, the soft strokes of time's brush.
translation: 巨大古石被堆叠、敲凿，并按 =sultan:1= 时代的风格雕成长弧。此后，这项工程积累了合作者，他们的签名写得到处都是：这里是破坏者编辑留下的空缺，那里是时间之刷的柔软笔触。

source: Irregular volumes of stone are heaped together. Across its surface, points of order poke sporadically through the pile of entropy: a statue's finger, the gnomon of a sundial, a parcel of circuitboard.
translation: 不规则石块堆在一起。它的表面上，秩序点零星刺出熵之堆：一根雕像手指、一枚日晷晷针、一片电路板。

source: It's a secretion of sticky palm-juice that has cooled into a big block.
translation: 这是黏稠棕榈汁的分泌物，冷却成一大块。

source: A quantum mess cooled and arranged itself as a towering hexagon. Bubbles of earth gas and other quirks of time are frozen in the quartz-amber, and existence is chipped off the lathe of nothingness by moonlight.
translation: 一团量子混乱冷却下来，自行排列成高耸六角形。土气气泡和时间的其他怪癖冻在石英琥珀中，存在被月光从虚无车床上削下。

source: Moss hems the little moonlit faces of speed-grown quartz. When entropy obliterates order, it reassembles at smaller scales.
translation: 苔藓镶住速生石英被月光照亮的小小晶面。熵毁灭秩序时，它又在更小尺度上重组。

source: Quartzstuff in the radial habit crusts over a layer of softstone, and beneath that, a layer of dead crystal dripping in static resin and singing with psychic promise.
translation: 径向习性的石英质在一层软石上结壳，其下是一层死水晶，滴着静态树脂，并以灵能许诺歌唱。

source: Little crystal shoots were crushed by pure ego-weight to a girthful, stout, and equant transducer of transient thoughtsoft. Decohered emotion and memory crystallize as they shoot up the root.
translation: 小小水晶芽被纯粹自我重量压成粗大、结实、匀称的瞬逝思软转导体。退相干的情绪与记忆沿根上涌时结晶。

source: The shining surface of quickchrome swims in shifting refraction patterns. As its light is focused, glyphs begin to appear.
translation: 速铬的闪亮表面游动着不断变化的折射图案。随着光线聚焦，字形开始显现。

source: Magnetic tape is spooled around a wheel and fed to a drive head that scribes and scries, stamping data out of the third dimension then quickening it back in.
translation: 磁带绕在轮上，被送入既刻写又探视的驱动头，把数据从第三维中压印出来，再将其活化送回。

source: Across a field of brass and chrome diodes blink in gyres.
translation: 在一片黄铜与铬钢之上，二极管以环旋闪烁。

source: Scanlines paint the lune in cathode amber.
translation: 扫描线用阴极琥珀色描绘弦月。

source: Springfoam keys push back against fingers in the course of flirtatious coupling between machine and folk.
translation: 在机器与人之间近乎调情的耦合过程中，弹性泡沫按键回推手指。

source: Light glints off the tiny scratches torn into the vast tube's chrome surface from where metal smashed bone into grated submission.
translation: 光从巨大铬钢管道表面的细小划痕上闪过；那些痕迹来自金属把骨头砸进格栅的地方。

source: Long ago the rivers themselves were ravenous, and they feasted on shale and limestone before taking bloated respite in the Great Salt Sea. Now the fissure-wounds have rotted to crimson and salt.
translation: 很久以前，饥渴的河流吞下页岩与石灰岩，最终在大盐海里停住。如今，裂开的伤口只剩猩红与盐。
